templates.title: 六级议论文·学生能力培养类模板（2020.12真题）
templates.note: 适用2020年12月六级作文三套同型题目：why students should be encouraged to develop effective communication skills（第一套）/ the ability to meet challenges（第二套）/ creativity（第三套）。均为「为什么应鼓励学生培养某种能力」的观点论证型议论文。结构：时代背景引入→亮明论点→两至三点理由论证→总结升华。套用要点：① 用 Living in a time when... 引出时代背景；② 用 To begin with / Moreover / In addition 分层；③ 结尾用 not only...but also 或 Only when...can... 倒装升华。
templates.tip: 套用要点：把模板中 X 替换为当次题目要求的能力（communication skills / the ability to meet challenges / creativity），其余句式可直接套用。 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: Living in a time when science and technology has already been highly developed, students are gradually used to accepting large numbers of structured and experience-based knowledge.
sents.zh: 生活在科技已高度发达的时代，学生们逐渐习惯于接受大量结构化、基于经验的知识。

sents.en: When it comes to students' all-round development, effective communication skills are by no means dispensable.
sents.zh: 说到学生的全面发展，有效的沟通技巧绝非可有可无。

sents.en: There is no denying that the ability to meet challenges paves the way for one's future success.
sents.zh: 不可否认，应对挑战的能力为一个人未来的成功铺平了道路。

sents.en: Developing the ability to meet challenges can not only render us outstanding easily but also lead us to success eventually.
sents.zh: 培养应对挑战的能力不仅能让我们轻松脱颖而出，最终还能引领我们走向成功。

sents.en: Only when students are well equipped with these qualities can they stand out in an increasingly competitive society.
sents.zh: 学生只有具备这些品质，才能在竞争日益激烈的社会中脱颖而出。

templates.title: 六级图表作文·原因分析与评论段模板（2021.6真题）
templates.note: 适用2021年6月六级图表作文三套：comment on China's achievements in higher education（高等教育毛入学率）/ urbanization（城市化率）/ poverty alleviation（脱贫）。本段用于开头描述图表数据之后，分析变化原因并评论中国成就。结构：承上启下总起→分层列举原因（经济/政策/文化）→总结趋势。套用要点：① 用 The reasons for this...are manifold 总起；② 用 To begin with / Moreover / Besides 分层；③ 用 The past decades have witnessed... 引出成就评论。
templates.tip: 套用要点：与「图表开头段模板」搭配使用——开头段描述数据趋势，本段分析成因，结尾段总结展望。把模板中 higher education 替换为当次图表主题（urbanization / poverty alleviation）即可。 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: The reasons for this stunning achievement are manifold.
sents.zh: 取得这一惊人成就的原因是多方面的。

sents.en: China's booming economy over this period has substantially improved people's living standards and enabled families to invest more in their children's education.
sents.zh: 这一时期中国蓬勃发展的经济大幅提高了人民生活水平，使家庭能够在子女教育上投入更多。

sents.en: Placing a high priority on fostering an educated workforce, the government has been pursuing measures to expand educational opportunities and subsidize tuition.
sents.zh: 政府高度重视培养受过良好教育的劳动力，一直采取措施扩大教育机会并补贴学费。

sents.en: The past thirty years have witnessed China's remarkable achievements in higher education, urbanization and poverty alleviation.
sents.zh: 过去三十年见证了中国在高等教育、城市化和脱贫攻坚方面取得的显著成就。

sents.en: I believe that this positive trend will surely continue and will in turn benefit our great country.
sents.zh: 我相信这一积极趋势必将延续，并进而造福我们伟大的国家。

templates.title: 六级议论文·社会现象评论与措施建议模板（2021.12真题）
templates.note: 适用2021年12月六级作文三套：理性看待网络虚假信息（第一套）/ 理性追星（第二套）/ 父母过度保护孩子（第三套）。题目均要求「评论短文中描述的现象并提出解决措施」。结构：现象引入（让步）→指出问题/危害→分条提出措施→倒装句总结升华。套用要点：① 用 Living in an age of..., ...tend to... 引出现象，再用 Convenient as it may seem, ...cannot be guaranteed 让步转折；② 用 To begin with / Moreover / Last but not least 提措施；③ 结尾用 Only by doing so can we... 倒装收束。
templates.tip: 套用要点：把模板中 online information / star chasing / overprotection 替换为当次题目现象；措施段对应「监管—家庭教育—个人自律」三个层面，可按题目取舍。 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: Living in an age of the Internet, young generations tend to acquire assorted information about the world totally via the virtual environment.
sents.zh: 生活在互联网时代，年轻一代往往完全通过虚拟环境获取关于世界的各种信息。

sents.en: Convenient as it may seem, the reliability of online information sources cannot be guaranteed.
sents.zh: 尽管看起来很方便，但网络信息来源的可靠性却无法得到保证。

sents.en: To avoid youngsters being misguided by irresponsible mass media, we need to take several effective measures urgently.
sents.zh: 为避免年轻人被不负责任的媒体误导，我们亟需采取若干有效措施。

sents.en: First and foremost, authorities concerned should enhance their supervision of the information published on the Internet.
sents.zh: 首要的是，有关部门应加强对网上发布信息的监管。

sents.en: Moreover, parents should encourage their children to develop independent thinking rather than become a shadow of anyone else.
sents.zh: 此外，父母应鼓励孩子培养独立思考能力，而不是成为别人的影子。

sents.en: Only by doing so can we strike a balance between care and the independent growth of the younger generation.
sents.zh: 只有这样，我们才能在关爱与年轻一代的独立成长之间取得平衡。

templates.title: 六级作文·开头句给定型趋势议论模板（2022.6）
templates.note: 六级「给定开头句」趋势类议论文万能模板（2022年6月三套真题均为此题型：适应快速变化的世界/环保生活方式/帮助有需要的人）。题型特点：题目给出一句陈述句作为开头（Nowadays more and more people...），要求就此发表评论、举例或结合个人经历展开。套用要点：① 首句必须照抄题目给定句；② 第二段用 First/Second/Besides 从学习、职场、生活三个层面分论点；③ 结尾段用 In all 总结并发出倡议。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: It is a truth universally acknowledged that we are living in a constantly changing world, which makes it essential for everyone to keep learning new skills so as to keep up with the pace of the times.
sents.zh: 举世公认，我们生活在一个不断变化的世界里，这使得每个人都必须不断学习新技能，以便跟上时代的步伐。

sents.en: First, when a student keeps learning new skills, he or she always desires to explore the unknown world, and there is an excellent chance that he or she will stand out among peers.
sents.zh: 首先，当学生不断学习新技能时，他/她总是渴望探索未知世界，因此很有可能在同龄人中脱颖而出。

sents.en: Second, in the workplace, people with such an attitude generally finish tasks in higher quality and are more likely to climb up the career ladder more quickly than those who are content with their existing skills.
sents.zh: 其次，在职场上，持这种态度的人通常能更高质量地完成任务，也比满足于现有技能的人更有可能更快获得晋升。

sents.en: In all, we must keep learning new skills so as to adapt to the fast-changing world. On the one hand, we should make friends with people who have such an attitude; on the other hand, we should bear in mind that the only constant is change itself.
sents.zh: 总之，我们必须不断学习新技能以适应快速变化的世界。一方面，我们应结交有这种态度的人；另一方面，我们应牢记：唯一不变的就是变化本身。

templates.title: 六级作文·观点对比型议论模板（2022.12）
templates.note: 六级「观点对比二选一」型议论文万能模板（2022年12月三套真题均为此题型：培养团队精神/培养批判性思维/信息技术在教育中的应用）。题型特点：题目给出一句给定句引出话题，正文要求就两种对立看法发表自己观点。套用要点：① 首段用 There is a heated debate over... 引出双方观点并亮明立场；② 主体段用 Firstly/Moreover/Besides 三层递进；③ 结尾段用 In sum 总结并提出具体做法。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: There is a heated debate over whether college students should cultivate team spirit or merely focus on finishing their own jobs. Some prefer the former, whereas others advocate the latter. As for me, the former is more reasonable.
sents.zh: 关于大学生应该培养团队精神还是只专注于完成自己的工作，存在着热烈的争论。有人赞同前者，有人主张后者。在我看来，前者更合理。

sents.en: There are a variety of reasons accounting for my statement. Firstly, college students with strong team spirit generally have better academic performance, because they tend to contribute to the team and learn from other members.
sents.zh: 我的观点有多种理由可以解释。首先，具有强烈团队精神的大学生通常学业表现更好，因为他们倾向于为团队做贡献并向其他成员学习。

sents.en: Moreover, when they graduate and enter the workplace, those with team spirit are more likely to create a good impression on their colleagues and bosses, and therefore climb up the ladder more quickly.
sents.zh: 此外，当他们毕业进入职场时，有团队精神的人更有可能给同事和老板留下好印象，从而更快获得晋升。

sents.en: In sum, we, as college students, ought to attach more importance to cultivating team spirit. We are supposed to seize every opportunity to collaborate with others and learn from our peers who have such a virtue.
sents.zh: 总之，作为大学生，我们应该更加重视培养团队精神。我们应抓住每一个与他人合作的机会，并向拥有这种美德的同龄人学习。

templates.title: 六级作文·重要性论述型议论模板（2023.6）
templates.note: 六级「论述某品质/目标重要性」型议论文万能模板（2023年6月三套真题：心理健康与身体健康同等重要/通过友好讨论与合理争辩达成共识/教育的重要目标是教会学生如何学习）。题型特点：给定句点明主题，要求论述其重要性或意义。套用要点：① 首段用 while...it is...that... 强调句式引出核心论点；② 主体段用 For one thing / For another / Moreover 三层展开；③ 结尾段用 In conclusion 提出应如何做，呼应主题。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: While the accumulation of knowledge is undoubtedly crucial, it is the capacity to acquire, assimilate, and apply information that truly benefits individuals throughout their lives.
sents.zh: 虽然知识的积累无疑至关重要，但真正让人终身受益的，是获取、吸收并运用信息的能力。

sents.en: For one thing, the world is constantly evolving, with new information and ideas emerging at a rapid pace; the ability to learn equips students with the necessary skills to keep up with these changes.
sents.zh: 首先，世界在不断发展，新信息、新思想层出不穷；学习的能力使学生具备跟上这些变化所需的技能。

sents.en: For another, developing learning capacity promotes problem-solving skills and fosters creativity, enabling students to approach challenges with innovative solutions rather than relying on fixed memorization.
sents.zh: 其次，培养学习能力能提升解决问题的技能并激发创造力，使学生能够以创新方法应对挑战，而非依赖死记硬背。

sents.en: In conclusion, the focus of education should be shifted from merely imparting knowledge to cultivating learning skills, so that students can develop curiosity and become lifelong learners.
sents.zh: 总之，教育的重心应从单纯传授知识转向培养学习技能，使学生激发好奇心，成为终身学习者。

templates.title: 六级开头句议论文·主体论证模板（2023.12真题）
templates.note: 六级「给定开头句作文」主体段万能模板。2023年12月三套作文均要求以给定句子开头，话题分别为：家长给孩子更多自由以培养独立与自信；老年人凭宝贵技能经验继续为社会做贡献。套用要点：① 开头句照抄，随即用 I fully endorse this view / this view is well-founded 亮明立场；② 主体段用 Firstly / Secondly 展开 2~3 个分论点，每点「论点句+解释+举例」；③ 结尾段用 To sum up / In conclusion 回扣开头句。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence.
sents.zh: 如今父母越来越意识到，让孩子拥有更多自主探索与学习的自由，有助于培养其独立性、增强其自信心。（照抄给定开头句）

sents.en: The importance of this practice can be explained as follows. Firstly, children given more freedom can cultivate critical thinking and problem-solving abilities as they navigate challenges and learn from their mistakes.
sents.zh: 这一做法的重要性可解释如下。首先，拥有更多自由的孩子在应对挑战、从错误中学习的过程中，能够培养批判性思维与解决问题的能力。

sents.en: With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society, and I fully endorse this view.
sents.zh: 老年人凭借宝贵的技能与经验，仍能继续为社会作出重要贡献——我完全赞同这一观点。（对应另一套开头句后的立场表态）

sents.en: To sum up, raising awareness of autonomy in childhood is crucial, for it not only fosters children's independence and confidence but also contributes to their long-term well-being.
sents.zh: 总之，提升对童年自主性的认识至关重要，因为它不仅培养孩子的独立与自信，也有助于他们长远的幸福与发展。

templates.title: 六级开头句议论文·重要性论证模板（2024.6真题）
templates.note: 六级「给定开头句作文」重要性类万能模板。2024年6月三套开头句分别为：①数字素养与技能的重要性；②社会实践与学术学习同等重要；③培养独立学习能力。套用要点：① 照抄开头句，紧接 As technology / the society continues to evolve... 扩充背景；② 主体段从「校园／职场／日常生活」三个层面展开（Firstly... Secondly... Lastly...）；③ 结尾 In conclusion 重申 cannot be overstated，并呼吁大学生行动。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: There is a growing awareness of the importance of digital literacy and skills in today's world. As technology continues to evolve at a rapid pace, the ability to make effective use of digital tools has become essential to both personal and professional development.
sents.zh: 如今，人们日益认识到数字素养与技能的重要性。随着技术飞速发展，有效运用数字工具的能力对个人与职业发展都至关重要。

sents.en: Secondly, digital skills are essential in the modern workplace, where employers increasingly value those who can analyze data and adapt to new technologies.
sents.zh: 其次，数字技能在现代职场中不可或缺，雇主日益看重能够分析数据、适应新技术的人。

sents.en: Nowadays more and more college students have come to realize that social practice and academic learning are equally important; the latter provides the framework of knowledge, while the former offers the pathway to apply it.
sents.zh: 如今越来越多大学生认识到社会实践与学术学习同等重要：后者提供知识框架，前者提供运用知识的途径。

sents.en: In conclusion, the importance of digital literacy and skills cannot be overstated, and college students should strive to develop them to thrive in the digital age.
sents.zh: 总之，数字素养与技能的重要性再怎么强调也不为过，大学生应努力培养，以在数字时代从容发展。

templates.title: 六级开头句议论文·个人成长类模板（2024.12真题）
templates.note: 六级「给定开头句作文」个人成长类万能模板。2024年12月三套开头句／话题分别为：①自律对个人成长的重要性；②大学为学生探索各种可能、找到适合自己道路提供良机；③设定现实目标并坚持不懈才能提高成功概率。套用要点：① 照抄开头句，用 This recognition stems from... 或 It serves as a roadmap... 承接；② 主体段从时间管理／品格塑造／责任感（或目标—执行—坚持）三角度展开；③ 结尾 In conclusion / To sum up 重申 cannot be overstated，并号召将其融入日常。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth, and this recognition stems from the growing emphasis on individual development.
sents.zh: 如今，越来越多学生意识到自律对个人成长的重要性，这种认识源于对个人发展的日益重视。

sents.en: Firstly, self-discipline is instrumental in time management; students who are self-disciplined are adept at structuring their daily routines, which enhances productivity while keeping a balance between study and leisure.
sents.zh: 首先，自律有助于时间管理：自律的学生善于安排日常作息，这既提高效率，又能在学习与休闲间保持平衡。

sents.en: To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them; realistic goals act as a roadmap, transforming vague aspirations into actionable steps.
sents.zh: 为提高成功概率，应设定现实目标并坚持不懈；现实的目标如同路线图，把模糊的愿望化为可执行的步骤。

sents.en: In conclusion, the significance of self-discipline in personal growth cannot be overstated, and students should incorporate it into daily life, such as setting realistic goals and sticking to a disciplined routine.
sents.zh: 总之，自律对个人成长的重要性再怎么强调也不为过，学生应将其融入日常生活，例如设定现实目标并坚持有规律的作息。

templates.title: 六级观点类议论文·开头段模板（2025.6三套）
templates.note: 适用2025年6月六级三套议论文（第一套：过度依赖AI对创造力的危害；第二套：社交媒体的合理使用；第三套：大学生职业准备）的开头段。先用 As 引出社会现象或背景，再用主句一句话点明中心论点。套用要点：① As 引导背景从句，交代时代趋势；② 主句直接亮明立场或现象；③ 尽快落到具体话题，避免空泛；④ 万能兜底句可用于任意话题起笔。
templates.tip: 【难度：基础版】

sents.en: As AI tools become increasingly popular, over-dependence on them is harming human creativity in critical ways.
sents.zh: 随着AI工具日益普及，过度依赖它们正在以关键方式损害人类的创造力。

sents.en: As social media is used more and more extensively, there is a growing awareness of the importance of using it properly and responsibly.
sents.zh: 随着社交媒体使用日益广泛，人们越来越意识到合理、负责任地使用它的重要性。

sents.en: As the requirement of job application is increasing, students ought to be better prepared for their future career.
sents.zh: 随着求职要求不断提高，学生应当为未来的职业做好更充分的准备。

sents.en: In an era of rapid technological and social change, it is imperative for us to re-examine how we should respond to this trend.
sents.zh: 在技术与社会快速变革的时代，我们有必要重新审视应如何应对这一趋势。

templates.title: 六级观点类议论文·结尾段模板（2025.6三套）
templates.note: 适用2025年6月六级议论文结尾段。先用 In conclusion / To address this issue 总结全文，再用 By doing... 引出具体做法或展望，收束到时代背景。套用要点：① In conclusion 重申立场；② By + doing 提出建议；③ 用 while / even in the age of... 收束升华；④ 万能倒装结尾句可任意套用。
templates.tip: 【难度：基础版】

sents.en: To address this issue, we should view AI as a complementary tool rather than a substitute for human thinking.
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们应把AI视为一种辅助工具，而非人类思考的替代品。

sents.en: In conclusion, proper social media use means being a mindful user. By protecting privacy, managing time wisely, and promoting civil discourse, individuals can harness its advantages while avoiding negative impacts.
sents.zh: 总之，合理使用社交媒体意味着做一个用心的用户。通过保护隐私、明智管理时间并倡导文明交流，人们可以在规避负面影响的同时利用其优势。

sents.en: In conclusion, comprehensive career preparation combines academic foundation, practical capabilities, and market awareness. By balancing these aspects, students can navigate the competitive job market with confidence.
sents.zh: 总之，全面的职业准备结合了学业基础、实践能力与市场意识。通过平衡这些方面，学生便能自信地在竞争激烈的就业市场中前行。

sents.en: Only by doing so can we turn challenges into opportunities and embrace a brighter future alongside advancing technology.
sents.zh: 唯有如此，我们才能化挑战为机遇，在技术不断进步的同时拥抱更光明的未来。

templates.title: 六级成长成才类议论文·开头段模板（2025.12三套）
templates.note: 适用场景：2025年12月六级给定首句议论文（三套：T1 老师对学生学术追求和个人发展的影响；T2 通过中国梦实现自我价值；T3 大学生应对大学中的多样化挑战）的开头段。题目类型：给定首句续写型议论文（必须逐字照抄引号内首句）。套用要点：① 首句直接给出中心判断或照抄题目给定句；② 用现在分词短语或 Beyond... 拓展双重意义；③ 第二句点明学业与个人/国家两个层面。
templates.tip: 【难度：基础版】

sents.en: Teachers are pivotal guides in students' academic and personal growth, exerting a profound influence that shapes their future.
sents.zh: 教师是学生学业与个人成长中关键的引路人，其深远影响塑造着学生的未来。

sents.en: College students who are well prepared are better equipped to confront the diverse challenges they encounter in university life.
sents.zh: 准备充分的大学生更有能力应对大学生活中遇到的多样化挑战。

sents.en: For us college students, the Chinese Dream is not something far away. It actually gives us a great chance to grow and find our own value in life.
sents.zh: 对我们大学生而言，中国梦并非遥不可及，它实际上给了我们成长并实现自我价值的良机。

sents.en: When we connect our personal future with our country's future, our studies and efforts become more meaningful.
sents.zh: 当我们把个人前途与国家未来联系起来时，我们的学习与努力便更有意义。

templates.title: 六级成长成才类议论文·结尾段模板（2025.12三套）
templates.note: 适用场景：2025年12月六级给定首句议论文（T1 老师影响/T2 中国梦/T3 大学挑战）的结尾段。题目类型：给定首句续写型议论文的总结升华段。套用要点：① In conclusion / In short 重申主题词；② lays a solid foundation for / empowers... 给出意义；③ By + doing 落到具体行动，把个人与国家/长远发展联系起来。
templates.tip: 【难度：基础版】

sents.en: In conclusion, teachers' influence on academics and character is indispensable. Their guidance lays a solid foundation for students' success, making the mentorship a lifelong treasure.
sents.zh: 总之，教师在学业与品格上的影响不可或缺。他们的指导为学生的成功奠定坚实基础，使这份师生情谊成为终身的财富。

sents.en: In short, the Chinese Dream and our personal dreams support each other. By working hard in our studies and contributing in our own way, we can build a valuable life for ourselves and at the same time help our nation move forward.
sents.zh: 总之，中国梦与我们的个人梦想相互支撑。通过勤奋学习并以自己的方式贡献力量，我们既能为自己创造有价值的人生，同时也能推动国家前进。

sents.en: In conclusion, thorough preparation empowers college students to face university challenges with confidence and competence.
sents.zh: 总之，充分的准备使大学生能够自信而从容地应对大学中的种种挑战。

sents.en: It plays a crucial role in ensuring academic success and fostering long-term personal growth.
sents.zh: 它在确保学业成功与促进长远个人成长方面发挥着关键作用。

templates.title: 六级给定句开头议论文·文化自信类模板（2026.6第3套）
templates.note: 适用2026年6月六级「给定首句续写」型议论文（本题：深入了解中华传统文化有助于培养文化自信）。结构：① 逐字照抄题目给定首句；② 用 In an age when... 铺时代背景；③ 用 Only by... can we... 倒装强调必要性并举例；④ 结尾用 The more... the more... 升华。套用要点：必须照抄引号内首句；举例用 Take...as an example；避免写成空喊口号。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: Faced with growing globalization, students realize that a deep understanding of traditional Chinese culture helps cultivate cultural confidence.
sents.zh: 面对日益深化的全球化，学生们意识到，深入了解中国传统文化有助于培养文化自信。

sents.en: In an age when Western brands, movies and festivals flood daily life, many young people begin to look back at their own roots.
sents.zh: 在这个西方品牌、电影和节日充斥日常生活的时代，许多年轻人开始回望自己的文化根脉。

sents.en: Only by learning the ideas behind Confucianism, the beauty of calligraphy, or the spirit of traditional festivals can we answer that question with pride.
sents.zh: 只有了解儒家思想背后的理念、书法之美或传统节日的精神，我们才能自豪地回答这个问题。

sents.en: The deeper we understand traditional Chinese culture, the more confident we become in facing the world.
sents.zh: 我们对中国传统文化理解得越深入，在面对世界时就越自信。

templates.title: 六级·2020.12·作文T1·沟通能力模板
templates.note: 适用2020年12月六级作文第一套题目「why students should be encouraged to develop effective communication skills（为什么应鼓励学生培养有效沟通能力）」，题目类型为观点论证型议论文（品质/能力重要性类）。结构：时代背景引入→亮明论点→两点理由论证（全球化社会需要＋求职需要）→总结升华。套用要点：开头用 While...is developing 引入时代背景，主体用 Perhaps the primary reason is that... / It would be universally acknowledged that... 两层论证，结尾用 Only by doing so can we... 倒装升华。
templates.tip: 套用要点：把模板中 communication skills 直接保留，按「开头段—主体段—结尾段」三段拼装；主体两段原因避免交叉重复，一段写社会大环境、一段写个人求职。

sents.en: While social technology is developing at a rapid rate, communication skills have become formidable challenges for myriads of people, especially for students.
sents.zh: 随着社交技术飞速发展，沟通技巧已成为包括学生在内的无数人面临的严峻挑战。

sents.en: Personally, this advice is meaningful and students are supposed to make every effort to cultivate their communication skills.
sents.zh: 就我个人而言，这一建议颇有道理，学生应当尽力培养自己的沟通能力。

sents.en: Perhaps the primary reason is that with the rapid development of globalization, the importance of communication between people is becoming more and more evident.
sents.zh: 首要原因或许是，随着全球化的快速发展，人与人之间沟通的重要性日益凸显。

sents.en: It would be universally acknowledged that communication skills matter much when students graduate and seek employment, for staff with outstanding communication skills are usually preferred by employers.
sents.zh: 人们普遍认为，学生毕业求职时沟通能力至关重要，因为沟通出色的员工往往更受雇主青睐。

sents.en: Only by cultivating effective communication skills can we realize our life goals in an increasingly interconnected world.
sents.zh: 只有培养有效的沟通能力，我们才能在联系日益紧密的世界中实现人生目标。

templates.title: 六级·2020.12·作文T2·应对挑战能力模板
templates.note: 适用2020年12月六级作文第二套题目「why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges（为什么应鼓励学生培养应对挑战的能力）」，题目类型为观点论证型议论文（品质/能力重要性类，可举例论证）。结构：以「生活即挑战」引入→举例论证（名人/科学家轶事）＋现实意义→总结升华（以登山为喻）。套用要点：开头用 Life consists of... 引出，主体举一例证明 only when...can we...，结尾用类比 + Only in this way can we...。
templates.tip: 套用要点：本套适合「列举法＋举例法」结合；举例时用 one of the most famous... 引出人物，再用 His/Her life is the best evidence to prove that... 收束例子。

sents.en: Life itself consists of a series of challenges, whether large or small.
sents.zh: 生活本身由一系列或大或小的挑战组成。

sents.en: When faced with these challenges, we students should confront them with the attitude that all setbacks can be overcome in the end.
sents.zh: 面对这些挑战，我们学生应秉持「一切挫折终能克服」的态度去迎难而上。

sents.en: His life is the best evidence to prove that only when we are brave enough to confront challenges can we achieve success.
sents.zh: 他的一生极好地证明了：只有足够勇敢地面对挑战，我们才能取得成功。

sents.en: In the age of science and technology, there is no denying that society requires us to be more courageous when meeting setbacks.
sents.zh: 在科技时代，不可否认的是，社会要求我们在遭遇挫折时更加勇敢。

sents.en: Life resembles the process of mountain climbing; we need to keep on climbing despite the twists and turns until we eventually conquer the highest peak.
sents.zh: 人生犹如登山，我们须不顾曲折不断攀登，直至最终征服最高峰。

templates.title: 六级·2020.12·作文T3·创造力模板
templates.note: 适用2020年12月六级作文第三套题目「why students should be encouraged to develop creativity（为什么应鼓励学生培养创造力）」，题目类型为观点论证型议论文（品质/能力重要性类）。结构：时代背景（科技发达、知识结构化）引入→对比凸显创造力珍贵→三点理由（丰富内心/激发想象/提升解决问题效率）→总结升华。套用要点：开头用 Living in a time when...，主体用 First of all / Moreover / Last but not least 分层，结尾用 not only...but also + 未来展望。
templates.tip: 套用要点：本套用「列举法」分三点论证创造力的价值；By contrast 用于对比引出创造力的珍贵，使开头段有起伏。

sents.en: Living in a time when science and technology has already been highly developed, students are gradually used to accepting large numbers of structured and experience-based knowledge.
sents.zh: 生活在科技已高度发达的时代，学生们逐渐习惯于接受大量结构化、基于经验的知识。

sents.en: By contrast, creativity seems relatively more precious because it is a quality so rare that most people would ignore its existence.
sents.zh: 相比之下，创造力显得尤为珍贵，因为它是一种如此稀有、以至多数人都会忽视其存在的品质。

sents.en: Moreover, creativity can stimulate students' imagination, to which people attach great importance in the process of invention.
sents.zh: 此外，创造力能激发学生的想象力，而这正是人们在发明创造过程中极为看重的。

sents.en: Last but not least, this ability can undoubtedly enhance students' efficiency to solve problems in their real lives.
sents.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，这种能力无疑能提高学生在现实生活中解决问题的效率。

sents.en: Developing creativity can not only render us outstanding easily but also lead us to success eventually.
sents.zh: 培养创造力不仅能让我们轻松脱颖而出，最终还能引领我们走向成功。

templates.title: 六级·2021.6·作文T1·高等教育模板
templates.note: 适用2021年6月六级图表作文第一套「comment on China's achievements in higher education（评论中国高等教育取得的成就，图表为中国高等教育毛入学率变化）」，题目类型为图表类作文。结构：开头简要描述图表数据趋势→主体分析原因（经济发展＋政府重视教育投入）→结尾总结成就并展望。套用要点：开头用 The chart demonstrates that... 引出毛入学率上升，主体用 The reasons are manifold 分层，结尾用 The past decades have witnessed...。
templates.tip: 套用要点：图表作文开头必须先「简述图表数据」再「评论成就」；把模板中 higher education 替换为当次图表主题即可套用至城市化、脱贫等同类题。

sents.en: The bar chart above explicitly demonstrates that the gross enrollment rate of higher education in China has been rising steadily over the past decades.
sents.zh: 上图柱状图清楚地显示，过去几十年中国高等教育毛入学率持续稳步上升。

sents.en: The reasons for this stunning achievement are manifold.
sents.zh: 取得这一惊人成就的原因是多方面的。

sents.en: China's booming economy has substantially improved people's living standards and enabled families to invest more in their children's education.
sents.zh: 中国蓬勃发展的经济大幅提高了人民生活水平，使家庭能够在子女教育上投入更多。

sents.en: Placing a high priority on fostering an educated workforce, the government has been pursuing measures to expand educational opportunities and subsidize tuition.
sents.zh: 政府高度重视培养受过良好教育的劳动力，持续采取措施扩大教育机会并补贴学费。

sents.en: The past decades have witnessed China's remarkable achievements in higher education, and I believe this positive trend will surely continue.
sents.zh: 过去几十年见证了中国在高等教育领域取得的显著成就，我相信这一积极趋势必将延续。

templates.title: 六级·2021.6·作文T2·城市化模板
templates.note: 适用2021年6月六级图表作文第二套「comment on China's achievements in urbanization（评论中国城市化成就，图表为1980—2019年中国城镇化率变化，约从19.4%升至60.6%）」，题目类型为图表类作文。结构：开头描述城镇化率持续攀升→主体分析原因（经济发展＋农村劳动力进城）→结尾总结成就并展望。套用要点：开头用 As is vividly shown in the chart...，主体分层列举原因，结尾用 The past decades have witnessed...。
templates.tip: 套用要点：开头段务必先描述图表关键数据（年份＋起止百分比），再点出「反映城市化快速推进」；数据可按真题图表实际数值替换。

sents.en: As is vividly shown in the chart, the degree of urbanization in China has been climbing steadily, from about 19% in 1980 to over 60% in 2019.
sents.zh: 正如图表生动展示的那样，中国城镇化率持续攀升，从1980年的约19%升至2019年的60%以上。

sents.en: This striking increase in the urban population reflects the rapid progress of urbanization in China.
sents.zh: 城镇人口的这一显著增长，反映出中国城市化的快速推进。

sents.en: The reasons for this trend are manifold.
sents.zh: 这一趋势的原因是多方面的。

sents.en: China's booming economy and the expansion of cities have attracted a large number of rural labourers to seek better job opportunities in urban areas.
sents.zh: 中国蓬勃发展的经济和城市扩张，吸引了大量农村劳动力到城市寻求更好的就业机会。

sents.en: The past decades have witnessed China's remarkable achievements in urbanization, and this positive trend will surely continue.
sents.zh: 过去几十年见证了中国在城市化进程中取得的显著成就，这一积极趋势必将延续。

templates.title: 六级·2021.6·作文T3·脱贫攻坚模板
templates.note: 适用2021年6月六级图表作文第三套「comment on China's achievements in poverty alleviation（评论中国在脱贫攻坚方面的成就，图表为农村贫困人口数量变化）」，题目类型为图表类作文。结构：开头描述贫困人口大幅下降→主体分析原因（政府精准扶贫＋政策支持）→结尾总结成就并展望。套用要点：开头用 The chart reveals a striking trend...，主体分层，结尾用 witness achievements + trend will continue。
templates.tip: 套用要点：描述图表时突出「drop sharply/dropped sharply」的下降趋势；评论角度强调「政府民生投入＋精准扶贫」，与高等教育、城市化共用同一套图表作文骨架。

sents.en: The chart above reveals a striking trend: the number of rural residents living in poverty dropped sharply over the past decades.
sents.zh: 上图揭示了一个显著趋势：过去几十年间，农村贫困人口数量大幅下降。

sents.en: This decline mirrors China's remarkable achievements in poverty alleviation.
sents.zh: 这一下降反映出中国在脱贫攻坚方面取得的显著成就。

sents.en: The reasons for this stunning achievement are manifold.
sents.zh: 取得这一惊人成就的原因是多方面的。

sents.en: Placing a high priority on people's wellbeing, the government has been pursuing targeted measures to lift impoverished rural households out of poverty.
sents.zh: 政府高度重视民生，持续采取精准扶贫措施，帮助贫困农村家庭摆脱贫困。

sents.en: The past decades have witnessed China's remarkable achievements in poverty alleviation, and this positive trend will surely continue to benefit our country.
sents.zh: 过去几十年见证了中国在脱贫攻坚方面取得的显著成就，这一积极趋势必将延续并造福国家。

templates.title: 六级·2021.12·作文T1·虚假信息模板
templates.note: 适用场景：2021年12月六级作文第一套「网络虚假信息/假新闻」。题目类型：社会现象评论+措施建议类议论文。结构位：开头段用 Living in an age of... 引出现象、Convenient as it may seem 让步转折；主体段用 To begin with / Moreover / Last but not least 从监管—家庭—个人三层提措施；结尾段用 Only when...can we... 倒装句升华。套用要点：把模板中 online information 替换为当次题目现象即可。
templates.tip: 套用要点：措施段对应「政府监管—家庭教育—个人自律」三个层面，可按题目字数取舍；结尾倒装句是得分亮点，务必保留 Only+状语前置+部分倒装结构。

sents.en: Living in an age of the Internet, young generations tend to acquire assorted information about the world totally via the virtual environment.
sents.zh: 生活在互联网时代，年轻一代往往完全通过虚拟环境获取关于世界的各种信息。

sents.en: Convenient as it may seem, the reliability of online information sources cannot be guaranteed, and youngsters might be deliberately misled by some fake news stories.
sents.zh: 尽管看起来很方便，但网络信息来源的可靠性无法保证，年轻人可能会被某些假新闻故意误导。

sents.en: To avoid youngsters being misguided by irresponsible mass media, we need to take several effective measures urgently. To begin with, authorities concerned should enhance their supervision of the information published on the Internet.
sents.zh: 为避免年轻人被不负责任的媒体误导，我们亟需采取若干有效措施。首要的是，有关部门应加强对网上发布信息的监管。

sents.en: Moreover, parents should encourage their children to develop independent thinking and often discuss with them the issues online, to make sure they grow up in a healthy mind state.
sents.zh: 此外，父母应鼓励孩子培养独立思考能力，并经常与他们讨论网络上的问题，以确保他们心理健康地成长。

sents.en: Last but not least, young people themselves should read more insightful books and learn to distinguish the values and attitudes behind online stories.
sents.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，年轻人自己应多读有见地的书籍，学会辨别网络故事背后的价值观和态度。

sents.en: Only when they are equipped with the ability to distinguish real news from fake ones in an era of information explosion can they get closer to the genuineness of the modern world.
sents.zh: 只有在信息爆炸的时代具备辨别真假新闻的能力，他们才能更接近现代世界的真实。

templates.title: 六级·2021.12·作文T2·追星模板
templates.note: 适用场景：2021年12月六级作文第二套「追星（star chasing）」。题目类型：社会现象评论+理性引导类议论文。结构位：开头段用 so...that... 描述追星狂热现象；主体段用 The question is that... 转折点出「迷失自我」，再用 On the one hand / On the other hand 从成人引导与偶像表率两方面提建议；结尾段倡导更有意义的精神力量。套用要点：把 star/idol 替换为当次题目现象即可。
templates.tip: 套用要点：On the one hand...On the other hand 分别对应「引导者—被引导者」双方责任，是现象类建议文的经典双主体结构。

sents.en: Living in an age when modern people attach increasing importance to entertainment, many teenagers are so keen on star chasing that they may imitate their idols' way of thinking and style of dressing.
sents.zh: 生活在一个现代人日益重视娱乐的时代，许多青少年如此热衷于追星，以至于会模仿偶像的思维方式和穿着风格。

sents.en: What's more, they may spare no effort to meet their idols in person, even at great expense.
sents.zh: 而且，他们可能不惜花费重金也要亲眼见到自己的偶像。

sents.en: It is not a big deal if young people choose pop stars as their idols. The question is that some youngsters have already lost themselves when facing those idols.
sents.zh: 年轻人选择流行歌星作为偶像本身无可厚非，问题在于有些年轻人在偶像面前已经迷失了自我。

sents.en: On the one hand, guidance from adults should never be absent during the growth of young people, who should be educated to develop their own values and not be a shadow of anyone else.
sents.zh: 一方面，在年轻人的成长过程中成人的引导绝不能缺席；应教育他们形成自己的价值观，而不是成为别人的影子。

sents.en: On the other hand, pop stars should consciously act as positive role models and lead their followers to express affection in a more rational way.
sents.zh: 另一方面，流行歌星应自觉扮演正面榜样，引导粉丝以更理性的方式表达喜爱。

sents.en: Besides idolatry, there must be far more meaningful spiritual power that can refresh youngsters, such as the insight of great men in history.
sents.zh: 除了偶像崇拜，一定还有更有意义的精神力量能让年轻人焕发生机，例如历史伟人的思想智慧。

templates.title: 六级·2021.12·作文T3·父母过度保护孩子模板
templates.note: 适用场景：2021年12月六级作文第三套「父母过度保护孩子（overprotection）」。题目类型：争议现象评论+原因分析+建议类议论文（Some believe... while others argue... 观点对比）。结构位：开头段用 Some believe... while others argue... 呈现双方观点；主体段用 Such phenomenon can be attributed to the following factors. 引出原因（独生子女政策—父母担忧—孩子依赖）；结尾段用 Only by doing so can we... 倒装收束。套用要点：把 parents/children 替换为当次话题主体即可。
templates.tip: 套用要点：争议类题目务必先写两方观点再表态；原因段用 can be attributed to 衔接，建议段对应「父母—孩子—社会」三方责任。

sents.en: Nowadays, the one-child policy has triggered a controversial issue as to Chinese parents overprotecting their children.
sents.zh: 如今，独生子女政策引发了一个有争议的话题——中国父母对孩子的过度保护。

sents.en: Some believe that parents can never put too much emphasis on planning for their children, while others argue that this is extremely harmful to youngsters.
sents.zh: 有人认为父母为孩子谋划再怎么重视都不为过，而另一些人则认为这对年轻人极为有害。

sents.en: First and foremost, parents cherish their only child and endeavor to prepare thoroughly for them. Planning everything in advance, they fear that their children might make mistakes or get hurt.
sents.zh: 首要的是，父母珍爱独生子女并竭力为他们做好万全准备；由于凡事都提前安排，他们担心孩子会犯错或受伤。

sents.en: What's more, youngsters are likely to become dependent on their parents both mentally and financially.
sents.zh: 而且，年轻人很容易在心理上和经济上都依赖父母。

sents.en: As far as I am concerned, parents should be aware that overprotection will only do harm to their children, and youngsters should learn to think independently when making decisions.
sents.zh: 在我看来，父母应意识到过度保护只会害了孩子，而年轻人在做决定时应学会独立思考。

sents.en: Only by doing so can we achieve a balanced family education.
sents.zh: 只有这样，我们才能实现平衡的家庭教育。

templates.title: 六级·2022.6·作文T1·终身学习适应变化模板
templates.note: 适用场景：2022年6月六级作文第一套（给定开头句型：Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world）。题目类型：给定开头句趋势评论类议论文，要求就「不断学习新技能」发表评论、举例或结合个人经历。结构位：开头段必须照抄题目给定句，再用 It is essential for everyone to... 阐释重要性；主体段用 First/Second/Besides 从学生—职场—生活三层分论点；结尾段用 In all 总结并发出倡议。套用要点：首句一字不改照抄题目句。
templates.tip: 套用要点：给定开头句型作文首句为题目原文，照抄即可得分；主体段三段分层是该题型阅卷最认可的结构。

sents.en: Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world.
sents.zh: 如今，越来越多的人不断学习新技能，以适应快速变化的世界。

sents.en: It is a truth universally acknowledged that we are living in a constantly changing world, which makes it essential for everyone to keep up with the pace of the times.
sents.zh: 举世公认，我们生活在一个不断变化的世界里，这使得每个人都必须跟上时代的步伐。

sents.en: First, when a student keeps learning new skills, he or she always desires to explore the unknown world, and there is an excellent chance that he or she will stand out among peers.
sents.zh: 首先，当学生不断学习新技能时，他/她总是渴望探索未知世界，因此很有可能在同龄人中脱颖而出。

sents.en: Second, in the workplace, people with such an attitude generally finish tasks in higher quality and are more likely to climb up the career ladder than those who are content with their existing skills.
sents.zh: 其次，在职场上，持这种态度的人通常能更高质量地完成任务，也比满足于现有技能的人更有可能更快获得晋升。

sents.en: In all, we must keep learning new skills so as to adapt to the fast-changing world, and we should bear in mind that the only constant is change itself.
sents.zh: 总之，我们必须不断学习新技能以适应快速变化的世界，而且应牢记：唯一不变的就是变化本身。

templates.title: 六级·2022.6·作文T2·环保生活方式模板
templates.note: 适用场景：2022年6月六级作文第二套（给定开头句型：Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle）。题目类型：给定开头句趋势评论+举例类议论文，可结合个人经历展开。结构位：开头段照抄题目句并概述环保行为（少垃圾、回收、带动他人）；主体段用 A, one of my friends, is a typical youngster who... 引入具体人物事例；结尾段用 As people's awareness becomes stronger 展望全民可持续生活。套用要点：举例段是该题型主体，人物细节（不开空调、包装物再利用）可直接套用。
templates.tip: 套用要点：举例类题目用「人物+具体行为」展开，比空泛议论得分高；结尾用 awareness/becoming stronger 升华趋势。

sents.en: Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle.
sents.zh: 如今，越来越多的人选择过环保的生活方式。

sents.en: They tend to produce less rubbish in their daily life and try to recycle anything that can be reused. Some even become enthusiasts and encourage people around them to change their lifestyles.
sents.zh: 他们往往在日常生活中少产生垃圾，并尽量回收一切可再利用的物品；有些人甚至成为环保爱好者，带动身边人改变生活方式。

sents.en: Simon, one of my best friends, is a typical youngster who lives an environmentally friendly lifestyle. He tries not to buy products whose manufacture may cause much pollution.
sents.zh: 我最好的朋友之一西蒙就是一个过环保生活的典型年轻人。他尽量不去购买那些制造过程会产生大量污染的产品。

sents.en: After using up the goods he bought, he always reuses their packages for other purposes, and no matter in hot summer or cold winter, he never uses air conditioners.
sents.zh: 用完买来的东西后，他总会把包装物另作他用；无论酷暑还是寒冬，他都不开空调。

sents.en: As people's awareness of protecting the earth becomes stronger, an increasing number of people from different fields will join to live sustainably and eventually make the world a more worthy place to live in.
sents.zh: 随着人们保护地球的意识不断增强，越来越多各行各业的人将加入可持续生活的行列，最终把世界变成一个更宜居的地方。

templates.title: 六级·2022.6·作文T3·帮助有需要的人模板
templates.note: 适用场景：2022年6月六级作文第三套（给定开头句型：Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy）。题目类型：给定开头句趋势评论+原因分析类议论文。结构位：开头段照抄/改写题目句并点出趋势；主体段用 The first motivation lies in... / What is more... / The last factor is... 分条分析原因（助人能力增强—成就感—媒体正能量引导）；结尾段用 With..., this trend will inevitably become a norm 展望蔚然成风。套用要点：原因三段式是该题型主体骨架。
templates.tip: 套用要点：趋势类题目常用「现象+原因+展望」三段；the needy 为「有需要的人」高频替换词，避免 people in need 重复。

sents.en: Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy.
sents.zh: 如今，越来越多的人乐于帮助有需要的人。

sents.en: Currently in our society, it is quite prevalent for citizens to give a hand to those who are in need of help, and people in growing numbers find it a pleasure to help others.
sents.zh: 当今社会，市民向有需要的人伸出援手已相当普遍，而且越来越多的人觉得助人是一件快乐的事。

sents.en: The first motivation behind this trend lies in the growing ability of average people to help others, who are now equipped with the knowledge, skills and even economic strength to provide assistance.
sents.zh: 这一趋势背后的首要动因在于普通人帮助他人的能力不断增强——如今人们具备了提供援助所需的知识、技能乃至经济实力。

sents.en: What is more, this trend is largely associated with people's sense of satisfaction: when offering timely help, those who lend a hand realize their own value.
sents.zh: 此外，这一趋势很大程度上与人们的满足感有关：及时伸出援手时，助人者实现了自身的价值。

sents.en: With people's growing ability, the sense of satisfaction and the spread of good deeds in the mass media, this trend will inevitably become a norm in our society.
sents.zh: 随着人们能力的增强、满足感的提升以及大众媒体对善举的传播，这一趋势必将成为我们社会的常态。

templates.title: 六级·2022.12·作文T1·团队精神模板
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文·观点对比（二选一）类题目。本题为2022年12月六级作文第一套：给定话题「培养大学生团队精神 vs 专注完成个人工作」，要求就两种对立看法表明立场。套用要点：① 开头用 increasing importance is being attached to... 引出话题，再用 while/whereas 摆双方观点，As for me, the former/latter is more reasonable 亮明立场；② 主体用 Firstly/Moreover/Besides 三层递进；③ 结尾用 In sum 总结并提出做法。

sents.en: Today, increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students' team spirit. Many people believe that team spirit benefits not only themselves but also the whole group, while others argue that it is more important to focus on finishing one's own job. As for me, the former is more reasonable.
sents.zh: 如今，培养大学生的团队精神越来越受到重视。许多人认为团队精神不仅有利于自己，也有利于整个团队，而另一些人则认为更重要的是专注于完成自己的工作。在我看来，前者更合理。

sents.en: There are a variety of reasons accounting for my statement. Firstly, college students with strong team spirit generally have better academic performance, because they tend to contribute to the team and learn from other members.
sents.zh: 我的观点有多种理由可以解释。首先，具有强烈团队精神的大学生通常学业表现更好，因为他们倾向于为团队做贡献并向其他成员学习。

sents.en: Moreover, when they graduate and enter the workplace, those with team spirit are more likely to create a good impression on their colleagues and bosses, and therefore climb up the ladder more quickly.
sents.zh: 此外，当他们毕业进入职场时，有团队精神的人更有可能给同事和老板留下好印象，从而更快获得晋升。

sents.en: In sum, we, as college students, ought to attach more importance to cultivating team spirit. We are supposed to seize every opportunity to collaborate with others and learn from our peers who have such a virtue.
sents.zh: 总之，作为大学生，我们应该更加重视培养团队精神。我们应抓住每一个与他人合作的机会，并向拥有这种美德的同龄人学习。

templates.title: 六级·2022.12·作文T2·批判性思维模板
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文·观点对比类题目。本题为2022年12月六级作文第二套：信息爆炸时代是否需要培养批判性思维、做出理性判断，要求就「随大流 vs 批判思考」两种立场表态。套用要点：① 开头用 In an era of..., there is a heated debate over whether... 引出争议，Some prefer..., whereas others... 摆双方，As for me, the latter/the former is more reasonable 亮立场；② 主体 Firstly/Moreover/Besides 三层；③ 结尾 In sum 总结利弊。

sents.en: In an era of information explosion, there is a heated debate over whether we need to develop critical thinking and make rational judgements. Some prefer following suit, whereas others argue that thinking critically is of great necessity. As for me, the latter is more reasonable.
sents.zh: 在一个信息爆炸的时代，关于我们是否需要培养批判性思维、做出理性判断，存在着激烈的争论。有人倾向于随大流，而另一些人则认为批判性思维十分必要。在我看来，后者更合理。

sents.en: Firstly, college students who think critically usually make better decisions, because they learn to distinguish useful information from various sources rather than accepting everything without consideration.
sents.zh: 首先，善于批判性思考的大学生通常能做出更好的决定，因为他们学会从各种来源中辨别有用信息，而非不加思索地全盘接受。

sents.en: Moreover, when they enter the workplace, the ability to think critically helps them assess whether a position suits them, enabling them to realize their potential rather than merely chasing a high salary.
sents.zh: 此外，当他们进入职场时，批判性思考的能力有助于他们判断一份工作是否适合自己，从而实现自身潜力，而不仅仅是追逐高薪。

sents.en: In sum, critical thinking is of great necessity for college students. It not only helps them gain an edge in competition, but also enables them to choose a suitable career start and build positive relationships with others.
sents.zh: 总之，批判性思维对大学生十分必要。它不仅有助于他们在竞争中占据优势，还能使他们选择合适的职业起点，并与他人建立积极的关系。

templates.title: 六级·2022.12·作文T3·信息技术教育模板
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文·重要性/观点论述类题目。本题为2022年12月六级作文第三套：信息技术在教育中的应用，要求论述其作用与影响。套用要点：① 开头用 With..., people in growing numbers begin to realize that... 引出主题，点明信息技术 plays a key role in education；② 主体 Firstly/Secondly/Thirdly 分层谈好处；③ 结尾 In sum 总结，可用 Not only does it... but also... 倒装收尾。

sents.en: With our society developing faster and faster, people in growing numbers begin to realize that information technology plays a key role in education. Applying state-of-the-art technology such as online platforms and smart classrooms renders teaching and learning more diverse and effective.
sents.zh: 随着社会发展日益加快，越来越多的人开始意识到信息技术在教育中发挥着关键作用。运用在线平台、智慧教室等最先进的技术，使教与学更加多元、高效。

sents.en: Firstly, information technology can transform college students' way of learning. Compared with traditional face-to-face classrooms, online teaching is more cost-effective, especially for those living in rural areas.
sents.zh: 首先，信息技术可以改变大学生的学习方式。与传统面对面课堂相比，在线教学更具成本效益，对生活在农村地区的学生尤其如此。

sents.en: Moreover, more freedom will be given to students, who can express their views through online chat boxes anonymously and pay closer attention to autonomous learning with the help of various tools.
sents.zh: 此外，学生将获得更多自由，他们可以通过在线聊天框匿名表达观点，并借助各种工具更加注重自主学习。

sents.en: In sum, information technology is of great necessity in education. Not only does it help diversify the learning mode, but it also grants students more freedom and enriches their campus life.
sents.zh: 总之，信息技术在教育中十分必要。它不仅有助于使学习方式多样化，还赋予学生更多自由，丰富他们的校园生活。

templates.title: 六级·2023.6·作文T1·心理健康模板
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文·重要性论述类题目。本题为2023年6月六级作文第一套：心理健康应与身体健康受到同等重视，要求论述心理健康的重要性及影响因素。套用要点：① 开头用 Mental well-being is regarded as... / this state has received as much attention as physical health 引入；② 主体 Firstly/Secondly 分析影响因素（环境、生活方式）；③ 结尾 In conclusion 呼吁关爱心理健康。

sents.en: Mental well-being is regarded as a state of health in which a person is able to cope with the normal stresses of daily life. Recently, this state has received as much attention as physical health.
sents.zh: 心理健康被视为一种能够应对日常生活正常压力的健康状态。近来，这一状态已获得与身体健康同等的关注。

sents.en: Obviously, there are several factors affecting people's mental well-being. Firstly, the living environment is a strong contributor: adverse circumstances can exert negative effects on psychological wellness, while a positive social environment provides protection against mental challenges.
sents.zh: 显然，有若干因素影响着人们的心理健康。首先，生活环境是重要成因：不利环境会对心理状态造成负面影响，而积极的社会环境则能抵御心理困扰。

sents.en: Secondly, people's lifestyle also has an impact. Poor diet, excessive alcohol consumption and a lack of exercise may result in psychological harm and have even been linked to depression.
sents.zh: 其次，人们的生活方式也有影响。饮食不良、过度饮酒、缺乏锻炼可能导致心理伤害，甚至与抑郁有关。

sents.en: In conclusion, because mental health is essential to overall well-being, we should take good care of it. Talking therapy, meditation and a positive outlook on life all contribute to a sound mental state, with which every area of life will develop in a positive way.
sents.zh: 总之，由于心理健康对整体福祉至关重要，我们应当好好呵护它。谈话疗法、冥想以及积极的人生观都有助于良好的心理状态，而拥有它，生活的方方面面都将积极发展。

templates.title: 六级·2023.6·作文T2·友好讨论达成共识模板
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文·重要性/做法类题目。本题为2023年6月六级作文第二套，给定句 When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument.，要求就「如何通过友好讨论与合理争辩达成共识」展开评论。套用要点：① 开头直接以给定句开篇，再点明 this issue has drawn wide attention；② 主体用 Friendly discussion allows... / reasonable argument allows... 分论两种方式的作用；③ 结尾 To sum up 呼吁开放心态。

sents.en: When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument. In daily life, it is common to see college students struggling to express themselves politely and logically when their views differ from others'.
sents.zh: 面对不同意见时，我们应努力通过友好讨论与合理争辩达成共识。在日常生活中，大学生在与他人观点相左时，常常苦于无法礼貌而有逻辑地表达自己。

sents.en: Friendly discussion allows individuals to share their perspectives in a respectful manner, which promotes a better mutual understanding and may even help both sides find common ground.
sents.zh: 友好讨论使人们以尊重的态度分享各自观点，从而增进相互理解，甚至有助于双方找到共同点。

sents.en: Meanwhile, reasonable argument enables people to present evidence and logic to support their position, which helps persuade others to see things from their point of view. Admittedly, compromise is sometimes necessary to reach a solution acceptable to all parties.
sents.zh: 与此同时，合理争辩使人们能够拿出证据与逻辑支撑自己的立场，从而说服他人从自己的视角看问题。诚然，有时需要妥协才能达成各方都接受的解决方案。

sents.en: To sum up, friendly discussion and reasonable argument are, to a large extent, of great use. We should be open-minded and willingly engage in such practices whenever disagreements arise.
sents.zh: 总之，友好讨论与合理争辩在很大程度上十分有用。每当分歧出现时，我们都应敞开心扉，乐于践行这种方式。

templates.title: 六级·2023.6·作文T3·学会学习模板
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文·重要性论述类题目。本题为2023年6月六级作文第三套：教育的重要目标是教会学生如何学习/掌握获取知识的方法，要求论述其意义。套用要点：① 开头用 Education has played an increasingly crucial role... 引入，点明 One important goal is to help students master the ways to acquire knowledge；② 主体 First of all/Moreover/Last but not least 分层；③ 结尾 From my perspective 升华。

sents.en: Education has played an increasingly crucial role in modern society. One important goal that education strives to achieve is to help students master the ways to acquire knowledge, rather than merely pass on facts.
sents.zh: 教育在现代社会中发挥着越来越关键的作用。教育力求实现的一个重要目标，是帮助学生掌握获取知识的方法，而不仅仅是传授事实。

sents.en: First of all, knowing that they are always ignorant of some fields in the ocean of knowledge keeps students modest and more willing to explore unfamiliar realms on their own.
sents.zh: 首先，意识到在知识的海洋中总有自己未知的领域，能让学生保持谦逊，并更愿意自主探索陌生的领域。

sents.en: Moreover, by imitating what their teachers do in and out of class, students gradually acquire the ability to carry out independent research and intellectual inquiries. Last but not least, those used to learning at school are more likely to keep studying as a lifelong habit.
sents.zh: 此外，通过模仿老师课内外的做法，学生逐渐获得独立开展研究与学术探究的能力。最后但同样重要的是，那些习惯在校学习的人更有可能把学习保持为终身习惯。

sents.en: From my perspective, education is one of the most marvelous social inventions in human history. Without it, the world could never continue developing in a civilized and prosperous direction.
sents.zh: 在我看来，教育是人类历史上最了不起的社会发明之一。没有它，世界绝不可能沿着文明与繁荣的方向持续发展。

templates.title: 六级·2023.12·作文T1·孩子自主性模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「给定开头句作文」·教育成长类（家长给孩子更多自由以培养独立与自信）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（重要性/意义论证型），要求照抄给定开头句后发表评论、举例展开。套用要点：① 照抄开头句，紧接 I fully endorse this view 亮明立场；② 主体段用 Firstly/Secondly 展开 2 个分论点（能力培养+心理建设），每点「论点句+解释」；③ 结尾段 To sum up 回扣「自主」主题，升华到自立自强。

sents.en: Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence. I fully endorse this view, for autonomy is the very soil in which confidence and competence take root.
sents.zh: 如今父母越来越意识到，让孩子拥有更多自主探索与学习的自由，有助于培养其独立性、增强其自信心。我完全赞同这一观点，因为自主正是自信与能力赖以生根的土壤。（开头段：照抄给定句+亮立场）

sents.en: Firstly, granted enough freedom, children are more likely to cultivate critical thinking and problem-solving abilities as they navigate challenges and learn from their own mistakes.
sents.zh: 首先，被给予充分自由的孩子，在应对挑战、从自身错误中学习的过程中，更有可能培养批判性思维与解决问题的能力。（主体段·论点一）

sents.en: Secondly, experiencing setbacks independently helps build genuine self-confidence, which no amount of parental protection can ever instill.
sents.zh: 其次，独立经历挫折有助于建立真正的自信，而这种自信是再多父母的庇护也无法灌输的。（主体段·论点二）

sents.en: To sum up, granting children appropriate freedom is not indulgence but an investment in their future; only self-reliant youngsters can stand firmly on their own feet.
sents.zh: 总之，给予孩子适度的自由不是放纵，而是对他们未来的投资；唯有自立的年轻人才能稳稳地站在自己的双脚上。（结尾段：回扣+升华）

templates.title: 六级·2023.12·作文T2·老年人贡献模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「给定开头句作文」·社会现象类（老年人凭宝贵技能经验继续为社会做贡献/积极老龄化）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（价值/意义论证型）。套用要点：① 照抄开头句，紧接 This view has been widely borne out 亮立场；② 主体段 First of all/In addition 从「岗位不可替代+传帮带/智库献策」两层展开；③ 结尾 Therefore 呼吁社会认可并鼓励老年人参与。

sents.en: With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society. This view has been widely borne out as society witnesses the continuing value of the older generation.
sents.zh: 老年人凭借宝贵的技能与经验，仍能继续为社会作出重要贡献。随着社会目睹老一辈持续创造的价值，这一观点已被广泛证实。（开头段：照抄给定句+亮立场）

sents.en: First of all, highly skilled senior workers remain irreplaceable in jobs that demand extensive expertise; without them, both quality and efficiency would suffer.
sents.zh: 首先，在需要广博专业知识的岗位上，高技能的老年工作者仍不可替代；少了他们，质量与效率都会受损。（主体段·论点一）

sents.en: In addition, senior citizens pass down precious skills and experience to the young, and some even serve on think tanks, offering advice that guides sound decision-making.
sents.zh: 此外，老年人向年轻人传承宝贵的技能与经验，有些人甚至进入智库，为科学决策提供建议。（主体段·论点二）

sents.en: Therefore, we should recognize the value of the elderly and encourage their active participation, rather than simply retiring them from public life.
sents.zh: 因此，我们应当认可老年人的价值、鼓励他们积极参与社会，而不是简单地让他们退出公共生活。（结尾段：回扣+呼吁）

templates.title: 六级·2023.12·作文T3·基础知识模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「给定开头句作文」·学习方法类（扎实掌握基础知识/基本原理的重要性）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（重要性论证型）。套用要点：① 照抄开头句，紧接 I fully agree +「学习是循序渐进」亮立场；② 主体段 First of all/Moreover 从「地基论+治学态度」两层展开；③ 结尾 In conclusion 重申「不可忽视基础」。

sents.en: As is known to all, gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject. I fully agree, for learning is a step-by-step process that no one can skip.
sents.zh: 众所周知，扎实掌握基础知识对于学生学好一门学科至关重要。我完全赞同，因为学习是一个循序渐进、无人能够跳过的过程。（开头段：照抄给定句+亮立场）

sents.en: First of all, without a solid foundation, it is impossible to grasp more profound theories; the basics are the very ground on which advanced knowledge is built.
sents.zh: 首先，没有扎实的基础，就不可能理解更深奥的理论；基础知识正是高深知识赖以构建的地基。（主体段·论点一）

sents.en: Moreover, a mastery of fundamentals cultivates the rigor and patience required for long-term academic pursuit, instead of the empty pride of superficial learning.
sents.zh: 此外，掌握基本原理能培养长期学术探索所需的严谨与耐心，而非浅尝辄止的虚浮骄傲。（主体段·论点二）

sents.en: In conclusion, however eager students may be to reach an advanced level, they should never overlook the basics, which pave the way for every later breakthrough.
sents.zh: 总之，无论学生多么急于达到更高水平，都不应忽视基础知识——它为日后每一次突破铺路。（结尾段：回扣+升华）

templates.title: 六级·2024.6·作文T1·数字素养模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「给定开头句作文」·科技素养类（数字素养与技能的重要性）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（重要性论证型）。套用要点：① 照抄开头句，紧接 Personally, I find...more reasonable 亮立场；② 主体段 Firstly/Secondly 从「校园能力+职场竞争力」两层展开；③ 结尾 In conclusion 用 cannot be overstated 升华并呼吁大学生行动。

sents.en: There is a growing awareness of the importance of digital literacy and skills in today's world. Personally, I find the view that digital literacy is the key to success more reasonable.
sents.zh: 如今，人们日益认识到数字素养与技能的重要性。就我而言，我认为「数字素养是成功之钥」这一观点更有道理。（开头段：照抄给定句+亮立场）

sents.en: Firstly, digital literacy enables students to develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills, preparing them for future careers in a technology-driven society.
sents.zh: 首先，数字素养使学生能够培养批判性思维与解决问题的能力，为他们在技术驱动型社会中的未来职业做好准备。（主体段·论点一）

sents.en: Secondly, in the modern workplace employers increasingly value those who can analyze data and streamline processes, so digital skills directly enhance one's employability.
sents.zh: 其次，在现代职场中，雇主日益看重能够分析数据、优化流程的人，因此数字技能直接提升个人的就业竞争力。（主体段·论点二）

sents.en: In conclusion, the importance of digital literacy cannot be overstated; college students should strive to develop it so as to thrive in the digital age.
sents.zh: 总之，数字素养的重要性再怎么强调也不为过；大学生应努力培养，以在数字时代从容发展。（结尾段：回扣+呼吁）

templates.title: 六级·2024.6·作文T2·社会实践与学习模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「给定开头句作文」·教育实践类（社会实践与学术学习同等重要）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（二者并重/辩证关系型）。套用要点：① 照抄开头句，紧接 I fully agree that neither should be neglected 表明「并重」立场；② 主体段 Firstly/Secondly 先讲实践之效、再讲学习之基，落到「相辅相成」；③ 结尾 In conclusion 呼吁兼取二者价值。

sents.en: There is a growing awareness of the equal importance of social practice and academic learning in today's world. Personally, I fully agree that neither should be neglected.
sents.zh: 如今，人们日益认识到社会实践与学术学习同等重要。就我而言，我完全赞同二者不可偏废。（开头段：照抄给定句+亮立场）

sents.en: Firstly, social practice allows students to apply what they have learned in the classroom to real-life scenarios, reinforcing knowledge that textbooks alone cannot instill.
sents.zh: 首先，社会实践让学生把课堂所学应用到真实场景中，巩固仅凭课本无法灌输的知识。（主体段·论点一）

sents.en: Secondly, academic learning provides the systematic framework of knowledge, while practice offers the pathway to apply it; the two reinforce each other.
sents.zh: 其次，学术学习提供系统的知识框架，而实践提供运用知识的途径；二者相辅相成。（主体段·论点二）

sents.en: In conclusion, by recognizing and embracing the value of both, we can foster a society that prizes knowledge, practical skills and social responsibility alike.
sents.zh: 总之，通过认可并兼取二者的价值，我们能够培育一个同等重视知识、实践能力与社会责任的社会。（结尾段：回扣+升华）

templates.title: 六级·2024.6·作文T3·独立学习模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「给定开头句作文」·学习能力类（培养独立学习能力）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（重要性/意义论证型）。套用要点：① 照抄开头句，紧接 In a rapidly changing world... 扩充背景并亮立场；② 主体段 On the one hand/On the other hand 从「兴趣动力+自律主动性」两层展开；③ 结尾 In conclusion 升华为「终身技能」，落到师生行动。

sents.en: Nowadays, cultivating independent learning ability is becoming increasingly crucial for personal development. In a rapidly changing world, only those who learn on their own can truly keep pace with the times.
sents.zh: 如今，培养独立学习能力对个人发展日益关键。在瞬息万变的世界里，唯有自主学习的人才能真正跟上时代。（开头段：照抄给定句+亮立场）

sents.en: On the one hand, independent learning allows students to explore their interests at their own pace, which greatly enhances motivation and deepens understanding.
sents.zh: 一方面，独立学习让学生按自己的节奏探索兴趣，这极大地增强了学习动力、加深了理解。（主体段·论点一）

sents.en: On the other hand, it cultivates the self-discipline and initiative that lifelong learning demands, qualities no classroom lecture alone can instill.
sents.zh: 另一方面，它培养终身学习所需的自律与主动性——这些品质绝非单凭课堂讲授所能灌输。（主体段·论点二）

sents.en: In conclusion, independent learning is a skill for a lifetime; universities should nurture it, and students should practise it every single day.
sents.zh: 总之，独立学习是一项终身受用的技能；大学应着力培养，学生应日日践行。（结尾段：回扣+升华）

templates.title: 六级·2024.12·作文T1·自律模板
templates.note: 适用2024年12月六级第一套「给定开头句·自律对个人成长的重要性」议论文（importance 观点论证类）。开头照抄给定句并用 This recognition stems from... 承接，主体从时间管理／品格塑造／责任感三角度展开，结尾用 cannot be overstated 重申并号召践行。

sents.en: Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. This recognition stems from the increasing emphasis on individual development and the pursuit of excellence in both academic and personal domains.
sents.zh: 如今，越来越多学生意识到自律对个人成长的重要性。这种认识源于对个人发展及在学术与个人领域追求卓越的日益重视。

sents.en: Firstly, self-discipline is instrumental in time management. Students who exhibit self-discipline are adept at structuring their daily routines, which not only enhances their productivity but also allows for a harmonious balance between study and leisure.
sents.zh: 首先，自律有助于时间管理。表现出自律的学生善于安排日常作息，这不仅提高效率，还能在学习与休闲间实现和谐平衡。

sents.en: Secondly, the cultivation of self-discipline contributes to the development of robust character traits. By exerting control over their impulses and maintaining focus on long-term objectives, students cultivate perseverance and determination.
sents.zh: 其次，培养自律有助于塑造坚韧的品格。通过克制冲动、专注于长期目标，学生能养成毅力与决心。

sents.en: In conclusion, the significance of self-discipline in personal growth cannot be overstated. To harness its benefits, students should strive to incorporate self-disciplinary practices into their daily lives, such as setting realistic goals and adhering to a disciplined routine.
sents.zh: 总之，自律对个人成长的重要性再怎么强调也不为过。为从中受益，学生应努力把自律实践融入日常生活，例如设定现实目标并坚持有规律的作息。

templates.title: 六级·2024.12·作文T2·大学探索模板
templates.note: 适用2024年12月六级第二套「给定开头句·大学为学生探索各种可能、找到适合自己的道路提供良机」议论文。开头照抄给定句并用 This transformative period is characterized by... 承接，主体从课程探索／课外活动／独立责任三角度展开，结尾 In summary 号召主动参与。

sents.en: College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves. This transformative period is characterized by a wealth of resources and experiences that facilitate self-discovery and personal development.
sents.zh: 大学为学生探索各种可能、找到适合自己的道路提供了良机。这一变革时期拥有丰富的资源与经历，有助于自我发现与个人发展。

sents.en: Firstly, the diverse array of academic courses allows students to delve into multiple disciplines, helping them identify their true passions and strengths. Such exploration can lead to a more informed choice of major and career path.
sents.zh: 首先，多样的课程让学生深入多个学科，帮助他们发现真正的兴趣与优势，从而更明智地选择专业与职业道路。

sents.en: Secondly, college life is replete with extracurricular activities that enhance social skills and leadership abilities. Engaging in clubs and societies not only broadens one's perspective but also fosters a sense of community and teamwork.
sents.zh: 其次，大学生活充满课外活动，能提升社交技能与领导能力。参与社团不仅拓宽视野，还培养集体归属感与团队合作。

sents.en: In summary, college is a pivotal time for students to explore and grow. To make the most of this period, students should actively participate in a variety of activities, seek out new experiences, and reflect on their interests and aspirations.
sents.zh: 总之，大学是学生探索与成长的关键时期。为充分利用这一时期，学生应积极参与各类活动、寻求新体验，并反思自身的兴趣与抱负。

templates.title: 六级·2024.12·作文T3·目标坚持模板
templates.note: 适用2024年12月六级第三套「给定开头句·设定现实目标并坚持不懈才能提高成功概率」议论文。开头照抄给定句并用 It serves as a roadmap... 承接，主体从目标可激励／可衡量进展／坚持克服障碍三角度展开，结尾 In conclusion 升华。

sents.en: To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them. In a world where aspirations often outstrip reality, the importance of goal-setting cannot be overstated. It serves as a roadmap, guiding individuals towards their desired outcomes.
sents.zh: 为提高成功概率，一个人应设定现实目标并坚持不懈。在理想常常超越现实的世界里，目标设定的重要性再怎么强调也不为过。它如同路线图，引导人们走向预期的结果。

sents.en: Firstly, realistic goals are attainable and therefore more motivating. They provide a clear target, making it easier to plan and execute strategies. This sense of direction can boost confidence and drive, leading to higher chances of achievement.
sents.zh: 首先，现实的目标是可实现的，因而更具激励作用。它们提供明确的靶心，便于规划和执行策略；这种方向感能增强信心与动力，从而提高成功的机会。

sents.en: Secondly, by setting specific objectives, individuals can measure their progress and make necessary adjustments. Thirdly, persistence is key to overcoming obstacles. Working diligently towards goals instills resilience, enabling individuals to persevere through challenges and setbacks.
sents.zh: 其次，通过设定具体目标，个人可以衡量进展并做出必要调整。第三，坚持不懈是克服障碍的关键。为目标勤勉努力能培养韧性，使人在挑战与挫折中坚持下去。

sents.en: In conclusion, the combination of realistic goal-setting and persistent effort is a potent recipe for success. By adopting this approach, individuals can unlock their full potential and realize their dreams.
sents.zh: 总之，设定现实目标与坚持不懈的努力相结合，是成功的一剂良方。通过采用这种方式，人们能释放全部潜能、实现梦想。

templates.title: 六级·2025.6·作文T1·AI与创造力模板
templates.note: 适用2025年6月六级第一套「过度依赖AI对人类创造力的危害」议论文（问题危害分析类）。开头用 As... 引出现象并点出危害，主体用 First/Second/Lastly 分论（剥夺独立思考／标准化方案压抑新颖／即时结果消磨耐心），结尾 To address this issue 提出把AI当辅助工具。

sents.en: As AI tools become increasingly popular, over-dependence on them is harming human creativity in critical ways. This problem mainly stems from reduced independent thinking and the narrowing of creative diversity.
sents.zh: 随着AI工具日益普及，过度依赖正以关键方式损害人类的创造力。这一问题主要源于独立思考的减少与创造力多样性的收窄。

sents.en: First, relying too much on AI discourages people from solving problems independently. For instance, students who use AI to write essays miss the opportunity to engage in topic analysis and idea organization, both of which are vital for nurturing creative thinking.
sents.zh: 首先，过度依赖AI使人不愿独立解决问题。例如，用AI写文章的学生错失了选题分析与思路组织的机会，而这两者对培养创造性思维都至关重要。

sents.en: Second, AI tends to provide standardized solutions, whereas true creativity thrives on novelty and uniqueness. When designers rely on AI-generated templates, they often conform to prevailing trends rather than exploring distinctive styles.
sents.zh: 其次，AI倾向提供标准化方案，而真正的创造力源于新颖与独特。当设计师依赖AI生成的模板时，往往迎合流行趋势，而非探索独特的风格。

sents.en: To address this issue, we should view AI as a complementary tool rather than a substitute for human thinking. By maintaining the habit of independent reflection and using AI to refine our ideas, we can ensure that our creativity remains intact even in the age of artificial intelligence.
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们应把AI视为辅助工具，而非人类思考的替代品。通过保持独立反思的习惯、用AI完善想法，我们便能在人工智能时代保持创造力完好无损。

templates.title: 六级·2025.6·作文T2·社交媒体模板
templates.note: 适用2025年6月六级第二套「社交媒体的合理、负责任使用」议论文。开头用 As... 引出并强调合理使用意识，主体用 First/Second/Third 分论（守住隐私边界／避免过度沉迷／文明理性交流），结尾 In conclusion 号召做 mindful user。

sents.en: As social media is used more and more extensively, there is a growing awareness of the importance of using it properly and responsibly. This awareness arises from the need to balance its benefits with potential risks to personal life and society.
sents.zh: 随着社交媒体使用日益广泛，人们日益意识到合理、负责任使用它的重要性。这种意识源于需在其益处与对个人生活及社会的潜在风险之间取得平衡。

sents.en: First, responsible social media use requires maintaining privacy boundaries. Posting sensitive information like home addresses or financial details can lead to security threats, so users should think twice before sharing personal data.
sents.zh: 首先，负责任地使用社交媒体要求守住隐私边界。发布住址、财务细节等敏感信息可能招致安全威胁，因此用户在分享个人数据前三思而后行。

sents.en: Second, avoiding excessive engagement is crucial. Spending hours scrolling through feeds often causes time waste and reduces productivity—students, for example, may see academic performance decline due to social media addiction.
sents.zh: 其次，避免过度使用至关重要。长时间刷信息流常造成时间浪费、降低效率——例如学生可能因沉迷社交媒体而成绩下滑。

sents.en: In conclusion, proper social media use means being a mindful user. By protecting privacy, managing time wisely, and promoting civil discourse, individuals can harness its advantages while avoiding negative impacts.
sents.zh: 总之，合理使用社交媒体意味着做一个用心的用户。通过保护隐私、明智管理时间并倡导文明交流，人们可以在规避负面影响的同时利用其优势。

templates.title: 六级·2025.6·作文T3·职业准备模板
templates.note: 适用2025年6月六级第三套「大学生为未来职业做准备」议论文。开头用 As... 引出并点明准备含学业＋实践＋前瞻思维，主体用 First/Second/Third 分论（夯实专业知识／培养可迁移能力／紧跟行业趋势），结尾 In conclusion 号召自信应对就业市场。

sents.en: As the requirement of job application is increasing, students ought to be better prepared for future career. This preparation involves not only academic excellence but also the cultivation of practical skills and a forward-looking mindset.
sents.zh: 随着求职要求不断提高，学生应为未来职业做好更充分的准备。这种准备不仅包括学业优异，还包括实践能力与前瞻性思维的培养。

sents.en: First, students should strengthen their professional knowledge through systematic learning. Majoring in engineering, for example, requires mastering core courses and participating in laboratory projects to apply theories in practice.
sents.zh: 首先，学生应通过系统学习夯实专业知识。例如，工科专业要求掌握核心课程、参与实验室项目，以把理论应用于实践。

sents.en: Second, developing transferable skills is equally vital. Communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities gained from internships or campus activities help adapt to diverse work environments.
sents.zh: 其次，培养可迁移能力同样重要。从实习或校园活动中获得的沟通、团队合作与解决问题能力，有助于适应多样的工作环境。

sents.en: In conclusion, comprehensive career preparation combines academic foundation, practical capabilities, and market awareness. By balancing these aspects, students can navigate the competitive job market with confidence and seize opportunities in evolving industries.
sents.zh: 总之，全面的职业准备结合了学业基础、实践能力与市场意识。通过平衡这些方面，学生便能自信地在竞争激烈的就业市场中前行，并在不断变化的行业中把握机遇。

templates.title: 六级成长成才类议论文·主体段模板（2025.12三套）
templates.note: 适用场景：2025年12月六级给定首句议论文（T1 老师影响/T2 中国梦/T3 大学挑战）的主体论证段。题目类型：给定首句续写型议论文的中间展开段。套用要点：① 主题句用 Academically / In personal development / First 分层；② 先讲道理再给具体例子或行动；③ 用 First/Second 或 Beyond... 拓展学业与个人两个维度。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: Academically, competent teachers impart systematic expertise and inspire critical thinking, guiding students to explore academic interests and encouraging them to overcome challenges in studies.
sents.zh: 在学业上，称职的教师传授系统的专业知识并激发批判性思维，引导学生探索学术兴趣，鼓励他们克服学习中的困难。

sents.en: In personal development, teachers set moral examples through their words and deeds, cultivating students' sense of responsibility and helping them develop resilience in the face of setbacks.
sents.zh: 在个人成长方面，教师以言传身教树立道德榜样，培养学生的责任感，帮助他们在挫折中培养韧性。

sents.en: To achieve this goal, we can start with our daily life. First, we should link our majors to what our country needs, and then take action by joining volunteer programs or starting small projects.
sents.zh: 为实现这一目标，我们可以从日常生活做起。首先，我们应把所学专业与国家需求联系起来，再通过参加志愿项目或启动小项目付诸行动。

sents.en: In terms of personal development, adequate preparation enhances students' psychological resilience and social adaptability, helping them manage stress and respond positively to setbacks.
sents.zh: 在个人成长方面，充分的准备增强学生的心理韧性与社会适应力，帮助他们应对压力并积极面对挫折。

templates.title: 六级给定句开头议论文·城市爱自然类模板（2026.6第1套）
templates.note: 适用场景：2026年6月六级「给定首句续写」型议论文（本题：城市化背景下城市居民增强对自然的热爱）。题目类型：给定首句续写型议论文（社会现象/个人生活类）。结构：① 逐字照抄题目给定首句；② 用「水泥森林」现象立论，指出亲近自然是必需品而非奢侈品；③ 主体段用 One practical way is to... 引出具体做法并举例；④ 结尾用 Only by...can... 倒装升华。套用要点：首句必须逐字照抄；避免泛泛谈环保，紧扣城市居民。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: With the trend of urbanization, it is vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love for nature.
sents.zh: 随着城市化趋势，城市居民培养对自然更深厚的热爱至关重要。

sents.en: As concrete forests expand, many urban dwellers rarely feel the breeze, hear birds, or touch soil; a stronger bond with nature is essential for mental and physical well-being.
sents.zh: 随着混凝土森林扩张，许多城市居民很少感受微风、听到鸟鸣或触摸泥土；与自然更紧密的联系对身心健康至关重要。

sents.en: One practical way to cultivate this love is to make nature part of daily routines — for example, walking in nearby parks, growing plants on balconies, or joining community gardening projects.
sents.zh: 培养这种热爱的一个实用方法是让自然融入日常生活——例如在附近公园散步、在阳台种植植物或参加社区园艺项目。

sents.en: Only by integrating nature into urban life can residents truly develop a stronger love for it and build healthier cities for future generations.
sents.zh: 只有将自然融入城市生活，居民才能真正培养更深厚的热爱，并为后代建设更健康的城市。

templates.title: 六级给定句开头议论文·责任感类模板（2026.6第2套）
templates.note: 适用场景：2026年6月六级「给定首句续写」型议论文（本题：社会快速发展时代提升年轻人的责任感）。题目类型：给定首句续写型议论文（青年成长/品德类）。结构：① 逐字照抄题目给定首句；② 分析即时满足文化削弱责任感的原因；③ 用 To address this problem 提出家校社协同对策并举例；④ 结尾用 Only when...can... 倒装升华到社会可持续发展。套用要点：紧扣「责任感」本身而非泛谈责任行为；用 The decline...is partly caused by... 分析原因。
templates.tip: 【难度：进阶版】

sents.en: In an era of rapid social development, it is vitally important to enhance young people's sense of responsibility.
sents.zh: 在社会快速发展的时代，提升年轻人的责任感至关重要。

sents.en: As society changes at an unprecedented pace, young people often face distractions and pressures that weaken their commitment to family, community, and the future.
sents.zh: 随着社会以前所未有的速度变化，年轻人常面临削弱其对家庭、社区和未来担当的干扰与压力。

sents.en: To address this problem, schools and families should work together to cultivate accountability through real tasks and role models, such as involving students in community service.
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，学校与家庭应协同努力，通过真实任务和榜样示范培养责任意识，例如让学生参与社区服务。

sents.en: Only when the younger generation takes responsibility seriously can society achieve sustainable development and harmony.
sents.zh: 只有当年轻一代认真承担责任时，社会才能实现可持续发展与和谐。

templates.title: 六级·2016.6·作文T1·机器人想象类模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「想象未来类」话题议论文（就某科技趋势设想其未来影响）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（现象想象+利弊评述型）。套用要点：① 开头用 when it comes to... 引出话题、opinions vary 树靶子，再用 As I see it 亮立场；② 主体段 First and foremost 预测好处、In addition 补充另一面，分点展开；③ 结尾 In a word 重申趋势，Only by... 倒装升华。

sents.en: Nowadays, when it comes to the issue of robots, people's opinions vary from person to person. Some believe that robots will enrich our life, while others worry that they might replace too many human workers. As I see it, the growing number of robots will alter our future lifestyle profoundly.
sents.zh: 如今，谈及机器人这一话题，人们的看法不尽相同。有人认为机器人将使生活更美好，也有人担心它们会取代太多人力。在我看来，越来越多的机器人将深刻改变我们未来的生活方式。（开头段：引出话题+亮立场）

sents.en: First and foremost, with the popularity of smart robots, people will no longer need to endeavor to finish complicated and repetitive tasks, which will be completed by machines quickly and accurately.
sents.zh: 首先，随着智能机器人的普及，人们将不再需要费力完成复杂而重复的任务，这些工作将由机器快速精准地完成。（主体段·利：解放人力）

sents.en: In addition, while robots save us much time and energy, overdependence on them may weaken face-to-face interaction and even put some routine jobs at risk.
sents.zh: 此外，尽管机器人为我们节省大量时间与精力，但过度依赖它们可能弱化面对面交流，甚至使一些常规工作岗位面临风险。（主体段·弊：辩证补充）

sents.en: In a word, the trend of robots entering our life is unavoidable. Only by embracing it wisely can we witness a more convenient and comfortable future.
sents.zh: 总之，机器人进入我们生活的趋势不可避免。唯有明智地拥抱这一趋势，我们才能见证更便捷舒适的未来。（结尾段：重申+倒装升华）

templates.title: 六级·2016.6·作文T2·虚拟世界想象类模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「想象未来类」话题议论文（就网络/虚拟生活趋势设想后果）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（现象想象+利弊评述型）。套用要点：① 开头 when it comes to the issue of living in the virtual world 引入，opinions vary 后用 As I see it 表明「此趋势难以避免」；② 主体 First and foremost 写便利，In addition/Consequently 转折写疏离冷漠；③ 结尾 It is time that... 虚拟语气呼吁采取措施。

sents.en: Nowadays, when it comes to the issue of living in the virtual world, people's opinions vary from person to person. Some believe that its colorful contents will enrich our life, while others worry that it may ruin real human relations. As I see it, the trend that people indulge in the virtual world is hard to reverse.
sents.zh: 如今，谈及生活在虚拟世界这一话题，人们看法不一。有人认为其丰富多彩的内容将使生活更精彩，也有人担心它会破坏真实的人际关系。在我看来，人们沉溺于虚拟世界的趋势难以逆转。（开头段）

sents.en: First and foremost, with social networks becoming pervasive, people can effortlessly acquire information and stay connected, which makes life remarkably convenient.
sents.zh: 首先，随着社交网络日益普及，人们可以毫不费力地获取信息、保持联系，这使生活极为便利。（主体段·利）

sents.en: However, spending too much time online will isolate people from one another; consequently, they may become increasingly indifferent and cold-blooded once real-world interaction is neglected.
sents.zh: 然而，过度泡在网上会使人彼此隔绝；结果，一旦忽视现实交往，他们可能变得越来越冷漠。（主体段·弊：因果链）

sents.en: In a word, this trend will become more prevalent. It is high time that we struck a balance between the virtual and the real world.
sents.zh: 总之，这一趋势将愈发普遍。我们早该在虚拟与现实世界之间取得平衡。（结尾段：虚拟语气呼吁）

templates.title: 六级·2016.6·作文T3·在线教育想象类模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「想象未来类」话题议论文（就在线教育/学习方式变革设想后果）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（现象想象+利弊评述型）。套用要点：① 开头 Currently, an increasing number of people... 引出在线学习热潮，再亮立场；② 主体 On the one hand 写资源共享便利，On the other hand 写缺乏监督/直面交流的弊端；③ 结尾 To conclude 主张线上线下结合。

sents.en: Currently, an increasing number of people begin to use the Internet to take courses and acquire knowledge, and online learning is booming all around the world. Whether it will replace traditional schooling has become a matter of concern.
sents.zh: 如今，越来越多的人开始利用互联网上课、获取知识，在线学习在全球蓬勃兴起。它是否会取代传统学校教育已成为人们关注的话题。（开头段：引出现象）

sents.en: On the one hand, e-learning breaks the limits of time and space, enabling people in remote areas to access quality courses at their own pace.
sents.zh: 一方面，在线教育打破了时空限制，使偏远地区的人们也能按自己的节奏获取优质课程。（主体段·利）

sents.en: On the other hand, without face-to-face supervision, some students may lack self-discipline, and the absence of peer interaction may weaken their communication skills.
sents.zh: 另一方面，缺乏面对面的监督，一些学生可能自律不足；而同伴互动的缺失也可能削弱他们的沟通能力。（主体段·弊）

sents.en: To conclude, online education will surely thrive, but it should complement rather than replace traditional classroom learning.
sents.zh: 总之，在线教育必将蓬勃发展，但它应补充而非取代传统课堂学习。（结尾段：辩证结论）

templates.title: 六级·2016.12·作文T1·创新重要性与措施模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「重要性论述+措施建议类」话题议论文（以 innovation 为代表）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（重要性+措施型）。套用要点：① 开头 With the rapid development of society 大背景切入，点出创新重要性；② 主体 There exist countless reasons... To begin with 从个人、国家两层论证重要性；③ 结尾 To put it in a nutshell 总结，On the one hand/On the other hand 提出政府与个人两层措施，Only in this way 倒装收束。

sents.en: Along with the rapid development of society, the importance of innovation has been attached growing significance in our country, and numerous novel gadgets keep emerging in our daily life.
sents.zh: 随着社会的快速发展，创新的重要性在我国日益受到重视，大量新颖的器具不断出现在我们的日常生活中。（开头段：背景+点题）

sents.en: To begin with, seen from the individual's perspective, once equipped with a spirit of innovation, one will never be satisfied with the status quo, which guarantees continuous progress.
sents.zh: 首先，从个人角度看，一旦具备创新精神，人便不会满足于现状，这保证了持续的进步。（主体段·重要性一：个人）

sents.en: Apart from that, innovation is the main driving force behind competitiveness; to stay ahead, a nation has to keep abreast with the times.
sents.zh: 除此之外，创新是竞争力背后的主要驱动力；为保持领先，一个国家必须与时俱进。（主体段·重要性二：国家）

sents.en: To put it in a nutshell, innovation does matter. On the one hand, relevant authorities should set up rules and regulations to highlight innovation; on the other hand, we students ought to cultivate this spirit from childhood. Only in this way can we embrace a promising future.
sents.zh: 总之，创新确实重要。一方面，相关部门应制定法规以凸显创新；另一方面，我们学生应从小培养这种精神。唯有如此，我们才能拥抱光明的未来。（结尾段：措施+倒装收束）

templates.title: 六级·2016.12·作文T2·发明创造措施模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「重要性论述+措施建议类」话题议论文（以 invention 发明为代表，与 innovation/creation 同型）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（重要性+措施型）。套用要点：① 开头 It is universally acknowledged 引入发明的价值；② 主体 In the first place/Furthermore 从推动社会进步、改善生活两论证重要性；③ 结尾 Accordingly 提出措施（教育投入、宽容失败、奖励机制），Only when 倒装升华。

sents.en: It is universally acknowledged that inventions, ranging from the wheel to the Internet, have been pushing human civilization forward at an astonishing speed.
sents.zh: 人们普遍认为，从车轮到互联网，各类发明一直在以惊人的速度推动人类文明向前发展。（开头段：引入发明价值）

sents.en: In the first place, great inventions greatly enhance productivity and give impetus to social and economic development.
sents.zh: 首先，伟大的发明显著提高生产力，为社会与经济发展注入动力。（主体段·重要性一）

sents.en: Furthermore, by liberating people from tedious labor, inventions free us to focus on more creative and meaningful pursuits.
sents.zh: 此外，发明把人们从繁重劳动中解放出来，使我们得以专注于更具创造性、更有意义的追求。（主体段·重要性二）

sents.en: Accordingly, to encourage more inventions, schools should foster curiosity, society should tolerate failures, and authorities should reward innovators. Only when innovation is truly valued can a nation stay competitive.
sents.zh: 因此，为鼓励更多发明，学校应培养好奇心，社会应宽容失败，当局应奖励创新者。唯有创新真正受到重视，一个国家才能保持竞争力。（结尾段：措施+倒装）

templates.title: 六级·2016.12·作文T3·创造驱动力模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「重要性论述+措施建议类」话题议论文（以 creation 创造为代表，与 innovation/invention 同型）题目的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（重要性+措施型）。套用要点：① 开头 Nowadays, creativity has become a buzzword 引入创造话题；② 主体 To begin with 从企业/国家竞争层面论证重要性；③ 结尾 Only when creativity is truly valued can... 倒装提出呼吁与措施。

sents.en: Nowadays, in an increasingly competitive world, creativity has become a buzzword, and no one can deny its paramount importance.
sents.zh: 如今，在竞争日益激烈的世界里，创造力已成为一个热门词，其至关重要的作用无人能否认。（开头段：点题）

sents.en: To begin with, creativity determines whether a company, or even a nation, can stand out rather than be left behind in the global race.
sents.zh: 首先，创造力决定了一家企业乃至一个国家能否在全球竞争中脱颖而出、而非被甩在后面。（主体段·重要性一：竞争）

sents.en: Moreover, by encouraging creative thinking, we can generate novel solutions to persistent problems that routine methods can hardly tackle.
sents.zh: 此外，通过鼓励创造性思维，我们能为常规方法难以解决的顽疾想出新颖的对策。（主体段·重要性二：解决问题）

sents.en: Only when creativity is truly valued and rewarded can a nation sustain its vitality, and only in this way can we embrace a promising future.
sents.zh: 唯有创造力真正受到重视与奖励，一个国家才能保持活力；也唯有如此，我们才能拥有光明的未来。（结尾段：倒装呼吁）

templates.title: 六级·2017.6·作文T1·国内外升学建议模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「观点选择类」议论文（题目要求就二选一话题给出建议并表明立场，如「在国内读大学还是出国」）的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（观点对比+立场建议型）。套用要点：① 开头 When faced with the choice between A and B, people's opinions vary... 引入争议，For my part 亮明立场；② 主体 On the one hand 写另一方优势铺垫，On the other hand 重点写己方理由（2~3点）；③ 结尾 Taking all factors into consideration 总结，强调适合自己的才是最好的。

sents.en: When faced with the choice between attending college at home and studying abroad, people's opinions vary from person to person. Some prefer the comfort of familiar surroundings, while others are drawn to overseas education. For my part, pursuing a degree abroad is a rewarding experience if conditions permit.
sents.zh: 当面临在国内读大学还是出国留学的选择时，人们看法不一。有人偏爱熟悉环境的舒适，也有人被海外教育所吸引。在我看来，如果条件允许，出国留学是一段值得的经历。（开头段：引入争议+亮立场）

sents.en: On the one hand, domestic universities offer stable academic resources and lower living costs, which is a practical choice for most families.
sents.zh: 一方面，国内大学提供稳定的学术资源与较低的生活成本，对大多数家庭而言是务实之选。（主体段·让步：国内优势）

sents.en: On the other hand, studying abroad can broaden one's horizons, improve foreign language proficiency, and cultivate independence, all of which give graduates an edge in the fiercely competitive job market.
sents.zh: 另一方面，出国留学能开阔视野、提升外语水平、培养独立能力，所有这些都使毕业生在竞争激烈的就业市场中占得优势。（主体段·己方理由）

sents.en: Taking all factors into consideration, there is no one-size-fits-all answer. The best choice is the one that suits your financial budget, career goal and personal character.
sents.zh: 综合考虑所有因素，没有放之四海而皆准的答案。最好的选择是最适合你经济预算、职业目标与个人性格的那一个。（结尾段：总结+建议）

templates.title: 六级·2017.6·作文T2·文理专业选择建议模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「观点选择类」议论文（就专业方向二选一并给出建议）的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（观点对比+立场建议型）。套用要点：① 开头 When it comes to the choice between sciences and humanities, there is a long-standing debate 引入争议；② 主体 Some argue that...However, from my perspective... 亮明立场并分点论证；③ 结尾 In conclusion 强调结合兴趣与就业前景。

sents.en: When it comes to the choice between majoring in sciences and humanities, there has long been a heated debate. Some people regard science as the only path to a prosperous career, while others value humanities as the foundation of a cultivated mind.
sents.zh: 谈及主修理科还是文科，长期以来一直存在激烈争论。有人认为理科是通往光明职业的唯一道路，也有人把文科视为修养心灵的基础。（开头段：引入争议）

sents.en: Some argue that sciences equip students with analytical skills and practical know-how, which readily translate into high-paying jobs in the technology-driven era.
sents.zh: 有人认为理科赋予学生分析能力与实用知识，在科技驱动的时代能轻易转化为高薪工作。（主体段·理科优势）

sents.en: However, from my perspective, humanities nurture critical thinking, effective communication and cultural awareness, qualities that are indispensable to leaders in every field.
sents.zh: 然而在我看来，文科培养批判性思维、有效沟通与文化意识——这些品质对各行各业的领导者都不可或缺。（主体段·己方立场）

sents.en: In conclusion, the best choice depends on one's interests and career goals. Ideally, students should strike a balance between passion and practical prospects.
sents.zh: 总之，最佳选择取决于个人兴趣与职业目标。理想情况下，学生应在热情与就业前景之间取得平衡。（结尾段：总结建议）

templates.title: 六级·2017.6·作文T3·职业学院与大学选择模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「观点选择类」议论文（就职业学院与普通大学二选一并给出建议）的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（观点对比+立场建议型）。套用要点：① 开头 Nowadays, more high school graduates face the dilemma of... 引入择校困境；② 主体 Vocational colleges focus on.../Traditional universities provide... 分别对比两类院校；③ 结尾 There is no one-size-fits-all... 建议按个人规划选择。

sents.en: Nowadays, more and more high school graduates face the dilemma of whether to attend a vocational college or a comprehensive university. This choice, seemingly simple, may shape their career trajectory for decades to come.
sents.zh: 如今，越来越多的高中毕业生面临读职业学院还是综合大学的两难选择。这一看似简单的选择，可能影响他们未来数十年的职业轨迹。（开头段：引入择校困境）

sents.en: On the one hand, vocational colleges focus on practical training, equipping students with hands-on skills that are in urgent demand in the job market.
sents.zh: 一方面，职业学院注重实操训练，使学生掌握就业市场急需的动手技能。（主体段·职业学院优势）

sents.en: On the other hand, traditional universities provide broader academic horizons, laying a solid theoretical foundation for those who wish to pursue advanced studies.
sents.zh: 另一方面，传统大学提供更广阔的学术视野，为有志深造者打下坚实的理论基础。（主体段·大学优势）

sents.en: In conclusion, there is no universal answer. Students should tailor their choice to their career aspirations, learning style and family situation.
sents.zh: 总之，没有放之四海而皆准的答案。学生应根据自己的职业抱负、学习方式与家庭情况量身选择。（结尾段：总结建议）

templates.title: 六级·2017.12·作文T1·助人谚语评论模板
templates.note: 适用于六级「谚语/名言评论类」议论文（就一句关于助人的英文谚语写评论并举例论证）的全篇模板。题目类型：议论文（谚语评论+举例论证型）。套用要点：① 开头 There goes a saying that... 引入谚语，指出其深刻寓意；② 主体 To begin with 从互助互惠角度论证，再举例（如邻里互助/团队合作）；③ 结尾 As a proverb goes 升华，强调助人即助己。

sents.en: There goes a saying that "Help others and you will be helped when you are in need." This seemingly simple remark reveals a profound truth about human interaction: kindness is reciprocal.
sents.zh: 有句谚语说：「帮助他人，危难时你也会得到帮助。」这句看似简单的话揭示了人际交往的深刻道理：善意是相互的。（开头段：引谚语+点寓意）

sents.en: To begin with, no one can thrive in complete isolation. When we lend a hand to those in trouble, we are, in effect, building a network of mutual support that will shelter us one day.
sents.zh: 首先，没有人能在完全孤立中生存。当我们向困境中的人伸出援手时，实际上也在编织一张互助之网，终有一天会庇护我们自己。（主体段·道理）

sents.en: For instance, a classmate who often tutors peers after class will, when himself overwhelmed by a tough assignment, find many willing to return the favor.
sents.zh: 例如，一位经常课后辅导同学的学生，当自己被一道难题压得喘不过气时，会发现很多人都愿意回报这份帮助。（主体段·举例）

sents.en: To sum up, just as the proverb goes, the rose's in her hand, the flavor in mine. The more we help others, the more warmth we will harvest in return.
sents.zh: 总之，正如谚语所说：予人玫瑰，手有余香。我们帮助他人越多，收获的温暖回报也越多。（结尾段：升华）

templates.title: 六级·2017.12·作文T2·理解他人谚语评论模板
