sents.en: There are several effective ways to nurture this ability. First and foremost, students should learn to set clear learning goals, which directs their efforts and prevents aimless reading.
sents.zh: 培养这种能力有几条有效途径。首先，学生应学会设定清晰的学习目标，这能指引努力方向，避免漫无目的地翻阅。（主体段·途径一）

sents.en: Moreover, they are encouraged to reflect regularly on what has been mastered and what remains puzzling, turning passive absorption into active inquiry.
sents.zh: 其次，应鼓励他们定期反思已掌握什么、仍困惑什么，把被动吸收转变为主动探究。（主体段·途径二）

sents.en: In sum, learning how to learn is not a fixed skill but a habit. Only by setting goals and reflecting consistently can students grow into truly independent, lifelong learners.
sents.zh: 总之，学会如何学习不是一项固定技能，而是一种习惯。只有设定目标并坚持反思，学生才能成长为真正独立的终身学习者。（结尾段：收束+倒装）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·开头段现象背景引入（基础版）
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文开头段——用2~3句把题目现象/趋势引入并点题。题型说明：现象分析类、社会评论类、给定句开头类通用首段起手。套用要点：第1句铺大背景（Nowadays/In recent years），第2句落到具体现象并加量化或趋势修饰，第3句用一句话亮出本文将评论/论证的核心。

sents.en: Nowadays, with the widespread popularity of social media, an increasing number of people, especially young adults, are exposed to a huge amount of information every single day.
sents.zh: 如今，随着社交媒体的广泛普及，越来越多的人尤其是年轻人每天都接触到海量信息。（开头段·铺背景，锚定2021.12虚假信息现象题）

sents.en: In recent years, the phenomenon of youngsters devoting too much time to star-chasing has aroused wide public concern across the whole society.
sents.zh: 近年来，青少年过度投入追星的现象已引起全社会的广泛关注。（开头段·点现象，锚定2021.12追星题）

sents.en: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, digital literacy has become a basic competence that no college student can afford to ignore.
sents.zh: 随着人工智能的迅猛发展，数字素养已成为大学生不容忽视的一项基本能力。（开头段·引趋势，锚定2024.6数字素养题）

sents.en: It is widely acknowledged that lifelong learning has been elevated to an irresistible trend in a fast-changing era.
sents.zh: 人们普遍认为，在这个快速变化的时代，终身学习已成为不可阻挡的趋势。（开头段·引共识，锚定2022.6终身学习题）

sents.en: There is a growing tendency nowadays that a great many graduates find it increasingly difficult to land a satisfactory job without adequate career preparation.
sents.zh: 如今有一种日益明显的趋势：许多毕业生若没有充分的职业准备，就越来越难找到满意的工作。（开头段·引趋势，锚定2025.6职业准备题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·主体段原因分析论证（进阶版）
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文主体段——剖析某现象/趋势背后的成因，做分层因果论证。题型说明：现象原因结果类、利弊分析类、重要性论述类主体段。套用要点：首句用总起句引出"多因素"，随后用 To begin with / On top of that / Lastly 分层，每层一句因果链，避免只堆 because。

sents.en: Several factors can account for the prevalence of misleading information online. To begin with, profit-driven content platforms prioritize click rate over accuracy.
sents.zh: 网络误导信息的泛滥可由多个因素解释。首先，逐利的内容平台把点击率置于真实性之上。（主体段·总起+成因一，锚定2021.12虚假信息题）

sents.en: This trend of lifelong learning is largely driven by the fast updating of knowledge, which makes a college degree no longer sufficient for a whole career.
sents.zh: 终身学习这一趋势很大程度上由知识的快速更新所驱动，大学学位已不足以支撑整个职业生涯。（主体段·成因，锚定2022.6终身学习题）

sents.en: The primary reason why digital literacy matters is that we live in an age where information filters and algorithms constantly shape what we see and believe.
sents.zh: 数字素养之所以重要，首要原因在于我们身处一个信息过滤器与算法不断塑造我们所见所信的时代。（主体段·成因，锚定2024.6数字素养题）

sents.en: A closer examination reveals that youngsters admire celebrities partly because the entertainment industry deliberately fabricates glamorous images they can identify with.
sents.zh: 细察之下可知，年轻人崇拜名人，部分原因在于娱乐产业刻意打造他们能够认同的光鲜形象。（主体段·深挖成因，锚定2021.12追星题）

sents.en: On account of fierce competition in the job market, an increasing number of students begin to realize that internships and practical experience weigh heavily in career preparation.
sents.zh: 由于就业市场竞争激烈，越来越多的学生开始意识到，实习与实践经历在职业准备中分量很重。（主体段·成因，锚定2025.6职业准备题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·主体段举例论证（基础版）
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文主体段——用具体例子支撑论点。题型说明：重要性论述类、观点论证类、成长成才类主体段。套用要点：论点句后用 Take...as a case in point / A good example is that 引出例子，例子须一句讲清"谁+做了什么+结果如何"，避免只摆例子不收束。

sents.en: Take lifelong learning as a case in point. Many experienced professionals, once retired from technical posts, still enroll in online courses to keep pace with new technologies.
sents.zh: 以终身学习为例。许多经验丰富的职场人士一旦从技术岗位退休，仍报名在线课程以跟上新技术。（主体段·举例，锚定2022.6终身学习题）

sents.en: A good case in point is a college classmate of mine, who taught himself data analysis in his spare time and thus stood out in the job market.
sents.zh: 一个很好的例子是我的一位大学同学，他自学数据分析，从而在就业市场中脱颖而出。（主体段·举例，锚定2024.6独立学习/2025.6职业准备题）

sents.en: This argument can be best illustrated by the example of environmentally friendly living: choosing public transport and avoiding disposable products, though trivial, collectively reduce carbon emissions.
sents.zh: 这一论点可用环保生活的例子很好地说明：选择公共交通、拒绝一次性用品虽看似琐碎，却能共同减少碳排放。（主体段·举例，锚定2022.6环保生活方式题）

sents.en: For instance, students who keep exercising and reading every day usually show stronger self-discipline when coping with academic pressure.
sents.zh: 例如，每天坚持锻炼和阅读的学生，在应对学业压力时往往表现出更强的自律。（主体段·举例，锚定2024.12自律题）

sents.en: Numerous examples exist to prove that persistent effort pays off, but one will suffice: a graduate who kept applying for internships finally landed his ideal job in AI-related industries.
sents.zh: 有无数例子可以证明坚持终有回报，但举一例足矣：一位持续投递实习的毕业生最终在AI相关行业拿到了理想工作。（主体段·举例，锚定2025.6 AI与职业准备题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·主体段正反对比论证（进阶版）
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文主体段——就同一议题呈现正反两面后再倾向一方。题型说明：观点对比类、利弊权衡类、平衡类主体段。套用要点：先用 While/On the one hand 让步呈现反方合理性，再用 On the other hand/Nevertheless 转向本方，最后一句点出权衡结论。

sents.en: While some argue that AI will free students from tedious homework, others worry that over-reliance on machines may gradually dull their own creativity.
sents.zh: 尽管有人认为AI将把学生从枯燥作业中解放出来，另一些人却担心过度依赖机器会逐渐消磨他们自身的创造力。（正反并陈，锚定2025.6 AI与创造力题）

sents.en: On the one hand, part-time jobs enrich students' social experience; on the other hand, they may eat into the time that should be spent on academic study.
sents.zh: 一方面，兼职能丰富学生的社会阅历；另一方面，它也可能挤占本应用于学业的时间。（正反对比，锚定2018.12学业课外活动平衡题）

sents.en: Nevertheless, the opposite is also the case: a rigid schedule without any leisure often leads to burnout rather than higher efficiency.
sents.zh: 然而，反过来同样成立：没有任何休闲的刻板作息往往导致倦怠，而非更高的效率。（转折对比，锚定2018.12工作休闲平衡题）

sents.en: Compared with blindly following celebrities, admiring their perseverance behind the spotlight turns star-chasing into positive motivation.
sents.zh: 与盲目追逐名人相比，欣赏光环背后的坚持，能把追星转化为正向动力。（对比择优，锚定2021.12追星题）

sents.en: The contrast between those who keep self-disciplined and those who indulge in short-term pleasure is striking at graduation when career paths diverge sharply.
sents.zh: 自律者与沉溺短暂享乐者之间的反差，在毕业时当职业路径急剧分化时尤为刺眼。（对比收束，锚定2024.12自律题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·结尾段总结呼吁（基础版）
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文结尾段——总结全文并发出呼吁/展望。题型说明：现象分析类、重要性论述类、成长成才类结尾。套用要点：首句用 In conclusion/To sum up 收束论点，次句用 It is high time that/Only in this way 提出呼吁或展望，尾句可升华一句意义，控制在2~3句。

sents.en: In conclusion, protecting mental health is never a luxury but a necessity for every college student who faces growing academic and employment pressure.
sents.zh: 总之，保护心理健康绝非奢侈品，而是每一位面临日益增长的学业与就业压力的大学生的必需品。（总结，锚定2023.6心理健康题）

sents.en: To sum up, cultural confidence is rooted in our splendid history and should be carried forward by the younger generation in a confident yet open manner.
sents.zh: 总而言之，文化自信根植于我们灿烂的历史，应由年轻一代以自信而开放的姿态传承下去。（总结升华，锚定2026.6文化自信题）

sents.en: It is high time that we took effective measures to guide youngsters to admire the diligence behind the spotlight rather than the spotlight itself.
sents.zh: 现在正是我们采取有效措施、引导青少年欣赏光环背后的勤奋而非光环本身的时候了。（呼吁，锚定2021.12追星题）

sents.en: Only by equipping ourselves with digital literacy can we survive and thrive in an age flooded with both opportunities and misinformation.
sents.zh: 只有具备数字素养，我们才能在这个机遇与虚假信息并存的时代里生存并发展。（展望，锚定2024.6数字素养题）

sents.en: From what has been discussed above, we may safely draw the conclusion that lifelong learning is, rather than an option, a must for anyone aspiring to a rewarding career.
sents.zh: 综上所述，我们可以有把握地得出结论：终身学习并非可选，而是任何追求有意义事业者的必需。（总结，锚定2022.6终身学习题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·建议措施分层（进阶版）
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文主体/结尾段——按"宏观（政府/社会/学校）—微观（个人）"分层提出对策。题型说明：问题解决类、现象建议类、措施类主体段或结尾段。套用要点：先用 From my perspective 引出建议总起，再用 For one thing 相关方、For another 个人，最后用 Only by joint efforts 收束，避免只给一条空泛建议。

sents.en: From my perspective, the following measures can be adopted to curb the spread of misleading information.
sents.zh: 在我看来，可采取以下措施遏制误导信息的蔓延。（总起，锚定2021.12虚假信息题）

sents.en: For one thing, relevant authorities should tighten the regulation of content platforms and impose penalties on those fabricating rumors.
sents.zh: 一方面，相关部门应收紧对内容平台的监管，对造谣者予以处罚。（宏观措施，锚定2021.12虚假信息题）

sents.en: For another, as for ourselves, college students are supposed to foster critical thinking and verify information before forwarding it.
sents.zh: 另一方面，就我们自身而言，大学生应培养批判性思维，在转发信息前加以核实。（微观措施，锚定2022.12批判性思维题）

sents.en: It is advisable that schools design practical courses and internships, so that students can translate digital literacy into real competence.
sents.zh: 学校宜设计实践课程与实习，使学生能把数字素养转化为真正的能力。（措施，锚定2024.6数字素养题）

sents.en: Only by the joint efforts of families, schools and society can youngsters be guided toward a balanced and sustainable lifestyle.
sents.zh: 只有家庭、学校与社会共同努力，才能引导青少年走向平衡而可持续的生活方式。（收束，锚定2022.6环保/2018.12平衡类题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·观点类让步转折（进阶版）
templates.note: 适用于六级观点类议论文——先退一步承认对方合理，再转折亮出本方立场。题型说明：观点对比类、我的看法类、利弊类主体段。套用要点：用 Admittedly/Although it is true that 退一步，紧接着用 However/it does not follow that/Yet 转回本方，体现思辨而非一边倒。

sents.en: Admittedly, artificial intelligence brings enormous convenience to study, yet it can never replace the independent thinking that truly defines creativity.
sents.zh: 诚然，人工智能给学习带来巨大便利，但它永远无法取代真正定义创造力的独立思考。（让步转折，锚定2025.6 AI与创造力题）

sents.en: Although it is true that social media connects people across distances, it does not follow that virtual interaction can substitute for face-to-face trust.
sents.zh: 尽管社交媒体确实拉近了人与人的距离，但这并不意味着虚拟互动可以取代面对面的信任。（让步转折，锚定2025.6社交媒体题）

sents.en: It cannot be denied that pursuing fashion and idols relieves pressure, but indulging in them blindly may cost youngsters their focus on study.
sents.zh: 不可否认，追逐时尚与偶像能缓解压力，但盲目沉溺其中可能让青少年荒废学业。（让步转折，锚定2021.12追星题）

sents.en: Some may argue that higher education guarantees a bright future, but a diploma alone can hardly save those who stop learning after graduation.
sents.zh: 有人或许会说高等教育保证了光明的前途，但单凭一纸文凭，几乎救不了那些毕业后停止学习的人。（让步转折，锚定2022.6终身学习/2021.6高等教育题）

sents.en: Much as I agree that work-life balance matters, I believe that for young graduates early in their careers, temporary dedication is what builds lasting competence.
sents.zh: 尽管我认同工作与生活平衡很重要，但我认为对职场初期的年轻毕业生而言，暂时的投入才是构建持久能力的基础。（让步转折，锚定2018.12工作休闲平衡题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·辩证分析个人与社会（进阶版）
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文——从"个人层面"与"社会/制度层面"双向辩证分析同一议题。题型说明：责任感类、环保类、文化自信类、两难平衡类主体段。套用要点：先 At the individual level 谈个人可为，再 At the societal level 谈制度/社会支撑，最后用 Neither...nor 或 Both...and 收束二者缺一不可。

sents.en: At the individual level, everyone can contribute to environmental protection by choosing public transport and cutting disposable waste.
sents.zh: 在个人层面，每个人都可以通过选择公共交通、减少一次性废弃物为环保出力。（个人层，锚定2022.6环保生活方式题）

sents.en: At the societal level, however, lasting change requires greener policies and infrastructure rather than relying solely on personal conscience.
sents.zh: 然而在社会层面，持久的改变需要更绿色的政策与基础设施，而非仅仅依靠个人良知。（社会层，锚定2022.6环保题）

sents.en: What holds for an individual is equally true of society as a whole: a sense of social responsibility binds citizens into a trustworthy community.
sents.zh: 对个人成立的道理同样适用于整个社会：社会责任感把公民联结成一个值得信赖的共同体。（个人→社会，锚定2019.12社会责任感题）

sents.en: While individual confidence in our own culture matters, a vibrant society also needs to preserve and showcase its traditions with an open mind.
sents.zh: 虽然个人对自身文化的自信很重要，但一个有活力的社会同样需要以开放的心态保护并展示其传统。（个人vs社会，锚定2026.6文化自信题）

sents.en: The problem, however, extends far beyond personal conduct to the way schools and families shape a youngster's sense of responsibility.
sents.zh: 然而，这一问题远不止于个人行为，更牵涉学校与家庭如何塑造青少年的责任感。（社会延伸，锚定2019.12家庭/社区责任感题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·图表类首段数据描述（进阶版）
templates.note: 适用于六级图表类作文首段——客观描述图表数据与趋势。题型说明：六级图表/图画作文首段（真题：2021.6 高等教育入学、城市化、脱贫攻坚等图表题）。套用要点：第1句 The chart clearly illustrates 总述，第2句用上升/下降/占比动词描述核心数据，第3句点出最显著的极端值，不加入主观评论（评论留给第二段）。

sents.en: The chart clearly illustrates the striking changes in the proportion of people receiving higher education in a certain region over the past two decades.
sents.zh: 该图表清晰地展示了过去二十年间某地区接受高等教育人口比例的显著变化。（总述，锚定2021.6高等教育图表题）

sents.en: According to the figures given in the graph, the percentage rose steadily from merely 15% in 2000 to over 45% in 2020.
sents.zh: 根据图表数据，这一比例从2000年的仅15%稳步上升到2020年的45%以上。（上升趋势，锚定2021.6高等教育题）

sents.en: It is noticeable that the urban population accounts for the largest share, whereas the rural population has been shrinking sharply.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，城市人口占比最大，而农村人口则在急剧缩减。（对比占比，锚定2021.6城市化图表题）

sents.en: As is shown in the table, the number of people lifted out of poverty increased dramatically, reaching a record high of tens of millions each year.
sents.zh: 如表所示，脱贫人数大幅增加，每年达到数千万的历史新高。（上升极值，锚定2021.6脱贫攻坚图表题）

sents.en: What stands out most is that the gap between the highest and the lowest figure has narrowed considerably, indicating a trend toward balanced development.
sents.zh: 最突出的是最高与最低数值之间的差距已明显缩小，显示出走向均衡发展的趋势。（极值+趋势，锚定2021.6图表类题）

templates.title: 六级作文·句库·万能衔接过渡（基础版）
templates.note: 适用于六级议论文全文——段落间与句子间的衔接过渡。题型说明：所有六级议论文、书信类段落内部衔接。套用要点：列举用 To begin with/Moreover/Lastly，转折用 However/Nevertheless，因果用 Therefore/Consequently，总结用 In a word；一段首句必带衔接词，杜绝中文式流水句。

sents.en: To begin with, self-discipline lays a solid foundation for independent learning, without which academic goals can hardly be achieved.
sents.zh: 首先，自律为自主学习打下坚实基础，没有它，学业目标便难以实现。（递进·列举一，锚定2024.12自律题）

sents.en: Moreover, the ability to manage emotions matters as much as the mastery of professional knowledge in coping with setbacks.
sents.zh: 此外，在应对挫折时，情绪管理能力与专业知识的掌握同等重要。（递进·列举二，锚定2023.6心理健康题）

sents.en: However, it would be unfair to attribute all academic failure to a lack of effort, since opportunities and guidance also play a role.
sents.zh: 然而，把学业失败全归因于不努力并不公平，因为机会与引导同样在起作用。（转折，锚定2023.6友好讨论/学会学习题）

sents.en: Therefore, rather than merely acquiring knowledge, students should also cultivate the ability to learn how to learn.
sents.zh: 因此，学生不应仅仅获取知识，还应培养学会学习的能力。（因果，锚定2023.6学会学习题）

sents.en: In a word, whether one can adapt to a fast-changing society depends more on the willingness to keep learning than on the diploma already in hand.
sents.zh: 总之，一个人能否适应快速变化的社会，更多取决于持续学习的意愿，而非已到手的文凭。（总结，锚定2022.6终身学习题）

sentences.src: 六级·2020.12·港珠澳大桥翻译句
sentences.en: It plays a crucial role in the overall plan to develop China's Great Bay Area, which China intends to turn into one comparable to the Bay Area of San Francisco, New York and Tokyo in terms of technological innovation and economic prosperity.
sentences.zh: 它（大桥）在中国发展大湾区的总体规划中起着关键作用；中国希望把大湾区建成一个在技术创新和经济繁荣方面能与旧金山、纽约和东京湾区相媲美的地区。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：原文两句合并为一句英文，用 which 非限制性定语从句衔接；comparable to... in terms of... 表示「在……方面可与……相媲美」，是高分结构。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：It plays a crucial role in the overall plan（主语 It=大桥，谓语 plays，宾语 a crucial role，状语 in the overall plan，后接不定式 to develop China's Great Bay Area 作后置定语）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：主句→which 引导的非限制性定语从句（修饰 the Great Bay Area），该从句内又嵌套形容词短语 comparable to... 作后置定语修饰 one，以及 in terms of... 方面状语；层次为「主句 + 非限制性定语从句（内含形容词短语后置定语 + 方面状语）」。③关键连接词/引导词：which 指代前面的 the Great Bay Area，在从句中作 intends to turn into 的宾语；one 为泛指代词指代 a region；in terms of 引出比较的方面。④翻译要点：中文原文是两个短句（大桥是关键＋中国希望建成……地区），英文用 which 合并为一句，汉译时需拆开还原为两句；comparable to...in terms of... 译为「在……方面可与……相媲美」，in terms of 短语前置。⑤易错点：which 易被误读为修饰整句或 It，实则就近修饰 the Great Bay Area；one 是泛指代词指代 a region，不可漏译；comparable to 的比较对象是「旧金山、纽约、东京三个湾区」，注意比较对象的对应逻辑。
【断句版】It plays a crucial role | in the overall plan | to develop China's Great Bay Area, | which China intends to turn into one | comparable to the Bay Area of San Francisco, New York and Tokyo | in terms of technological innovation and economic prosperity.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:It(=大桥) V:plays O:a crucial role A:in the overall plan [后置定语 to develop China's Great Bay Area] [非限制性定语从句 which S:which(=the Great Bay Area) V:intends to turn O:which(=it) C:into one [后置定语 comparable to the Bay Area of San Francisco, New York and Tokyo A:in terms of technological innovation and economic prosperity]]]]
phrases: play a crucial role in　在……中起关键作用
the overall plan　总体规划
develop China's Great Bay Area　发展中国大湾区
turn ... into ...　把……建成……
comparable to　可与……相媲美
in terms of　在……方面
technological innovation and economic prosperity　技术创新与经济繁荣

sentences.en: As it crosses the world's most vulnerable ecosystem, ecological protection measures have been adopted during and after the construction to guarantee that it becomes "a green railroad."
sentences.zh: 由于铁路穿越世界上最脆弱的生态系统，在建设期间和建成后都采取了生态保护措施，以确保它成为一条「绿色铁路」。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文「采取了……措施」为无主句，英译时转用被动语态 ecological protection measures have been adopted；「以确保」译为不定式 to guarantee that... 作目的状语。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：ecological protection measures have been adopted（被动语态；主语 measures，谓语 have been adopted），对应中文无主句「（人们）采取了……措施」。②从句类型与嵌套层次：As 引导原因状语从句（As it crosses the world's most vulnerable ecosystem）修饰整个主句；主句中嵌套 during and after the construction 时间状语，以及不定式短语 to guarantee that it becomes "a green railroad" 作目的状语，该不定式里 that 又引导宾语从句；层次为「原因状语从句 + 主句（被动）+ 不定式目的状语（内含 that 宾语从句）」。③关键连接词/引导词：As 为连词表「由于」引导原因状语从句；that 引导 guarantee 的宾语从句；it 指代铁路。④翻译要点：中文无主句转译为英文被动语态，不补出「我们/人们」；「以确保」译为不定式 to guarantee that... 作目的状语；时间状语 during and after the construction 译时置于谓语前后均可，中文习惯前置。⑤易错点：as 在此是连词「由于」而非介词「作为」，勿误译；it 指代铁路，翻译时宜补出「它」；被动语态 have been adopted 不要硬译为主动「我们采取了」；"a green railroad" 是形象说法，译文保留引号。
【断句版】As it crosses the world's most vulnerable ecosystem, | ecological protection measures have been adopted | during and after the construction | to guarantee that it becomes "a green railroad."
sentences.cut: [[原因状语从句 As S:it(=铁路) V:crosses O:the world's most vulnerable ecosystem [[主句（被动） S:ecological protection measures V:have been adopted A:during and after the construction [目的状语 to guarantee [宾语从句 that S:it V:becomes C:"a green railroad"]]]]]]
phrases: cross the ecosystem　穿越生态系统
the world's most vulnerable ecosystem　世界上最脆弱的生态系统
ecological protection measures　生态保护措施
have been adopted　已被采取（被动）
during and after the construction　建设期间及建成后
guarantee that　确保
a green railroad　绿色铁路

sentences.en: Thanks to its rich reserves of petroleum and natural gas, a large number of cities in the province have witnessed substantial and rapid economic growth with the development of oil and natural gas industries.
sentences.zh: 得益于丰富的石油和天然气储量，随着石油和天然气工业的发展，该省许多城市的经济都取得了长足而迅速的增长。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「在……带动下/得益于」译为 Thanks to... 置于句首作原因状语；「城市经济得到发展」用拟人化表达 cities have witnessed economic growth，是六级翻译高分技巧。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：a large number of cities (in the province) have witnessed substantial and rapid economic growth（主语 cities，谓语 have witnessed，宾语 growth）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：本句无定语从句或名词性从句，核心是「句首介词短语原因状语 + 句尾 with 复合结构伴随状语 + 主句」；Thanks to its rich reserves... 置于句首作原因状语，with the development of oil and natural gas industries 作伴随状语；层次为「原因状语（句首）+ 主句 + 伴随状语（句尾）」。③关键连接词/引导词：thanks to 为复合介词表「由于、得益于」，后接名词短语（不接从句）；with 复合结构（with + 名词）表伴随；witness 用拟人手法，主语为 cities。④翻译要点：中文「得益于……随着……城市经济得到发展」，英文用 Thanks to.../with... 两个介词短语把「得益于」「随着」提前，主干 cities have witnessed... 用拟人，中文还原为「城市经济取得增长」；词性转换：growth（名词）译为动词性「增长」。⑤易错点：thanks to 后接名词而非句子，勿写成 thanks to...develops；witness 拟人是六级高分技巧，勿直译为「城市看见」；rich reserves 意为「储量丰富」，reserve 表示「储量」时常用复数。
【断句版】Thanks to its rich reserves of petroleum and natural gas, | a large number of cities in the province | have witnessed substantial and rapid economic growth | with the development of oil and natural gas industries.
sentences.cut: [[原因状语 Thanks to its rich reserves of petroleum and natural gas [[主句 S:a large number of cities [后置定语 in the province] V:have witnessed O:substantial and rapid economic growth [伴随状语 with the development of oil and natural gas industries]]]]]
phrases: thanks to　由于、得益于
its rich reserves of　其丰富的……储量
petroleum and natural gas　石油和天然气
a large number of cities　大量城市
witness economic growth　见证经济增长（拟人）
substantial and rapid growth　长足而迅速的增长
oil and natural gas industries　石油和天然气工业

sentences.en: The unique natural scenery and the rich ethnic cultures make Yunnan one of the favourite tourist destinations in China, which attracts domestic and foreign tourists in their multitudes every year.
sentences.zh: 云南独特的自然景色和丰富的民族文化使其成为中国最受欢迎的旅游目的地之一，每年都吸引着大批国内外游客前来观光。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文末句「每年都吸引着……」与前句共用主语，英译时用 which 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明，避免简单句堆砌。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The unique natural scenery and the rich ethnic cultures make Yunnan one of the favourite tourist destinations in China（主语为并列名词短语，谓语 make，宾语 Yunnan，宾语补足语 one of the favourite tourist destinations）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：主句 + which 引导的非限制性定语从句（which attracts...）补充说明前面整件事；该从句内嵌套方式状语 in their multitudes 与时间状语 every year；层次为「主句 + 非限制性定语从句（内含方式状语 + 时间状语）」。③关键连接词/引导词：which 在此指代前面整个主句所述内容（「云南成为热门旅游地」这一情况），在从句中作 attracts 的主语；in their multitudes 为固定短语表「大批地」。④翻译要点：中文「使其成为……之一，每年都吸引着……」共用主语，英文用 which 非限制性定语从句衔接，汉译时把 which 从句还原为独立分句「每年都吸引大批游客」；in their multitudes 译为「大批地」。⑤易错点：which 此处指代整句而非仅指 Yunnan，勿误译；which 指「整件事」为单数，谓语用 attracts 形式正确；in their multitudes 不是「在人群中」，而是「大批地、大量地」。
【断句版】The unique natural scenery and the rich ethnic cultures | make Yunnan | one of the favourite tourist destinations in China, | which attracts domestic and foreign tourists | in their multitudes | every year.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The unique natural scenery and the rich ethnic cultures V:make O:Yunnan O-C:one of the favourite tourist destinations [后置定语 in China] [非限制性定语从句（指代整句）which S:which V:attracts O:domestic and foreign tourists A:in their multitudes A:every year]]]
phrases: unique natural scenery　独特的自然景色
ethnic cultures　民族文化
favourite tourist destinations　最受欢迎的旅游目的地
domestic and foreign tourists　国内外游客
in their multitudes　大批地、大量地
every year　每年

sentences.en: Mao Zedong and other revolutionaries of the older generation used to live and fight here for 13 years, leading the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the War of Liberation, cultivating the Yan'an spirit and making great contributions to the Chinese revolution.
sentences.zh: 毛泽东等老一辈革命家曾在这里生活、战斗了十三个春秋，领导了抗日战争和解放战争，培育了延安精神，并为中国革命做出了巨大贡献。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文原句含五个并列动词（生活战斗、领导、培育、做出贡献），英译时以 live and fight 为主句谓语，其余三个动词处理为现在分词短语作伴随状语，是多动词句的典型译法。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：①句子主干：Mao Zedong and other revolutionaries of the older generation used to live and fight here for 13 years（主+谓+地点/时间状语）。②各从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句，为主句+三个并列现在分词短语作伴随状语（leading... / cultivating... / making...），单层嵌套；每个分词短语内部自带宾语（the War of Resistance...and the War of Liberation / the Yan'an spirit / great contributions to...）。③关键连接词/引导词：used to 表「过去曾经」；for 13 years 时间状语；三个分词短语并列，最后一个 making 前加 and 收束。④翻译要点：中文五个并列动词共用同一主语，英译以 live and fight 提为主句谓语，其余三个降格为现在分词伴随状语，避免多个谓语动词堆砌；还原时按中文时间逻辑处理为并列动词。⑤易错点：revolutionaries of the older generation 不可译作 old revolutionaries（易被误读为「年老的革命者」）；「十三个春秋」译为 for 13 years，不可逐字 thirteen springs and autumns；现在分词与主句动作须同时发生，不可拆成独立的先后句。
【断句版】Mao Zedong and other revolutionaries of the older generation | used to live and fight here | for 13 years, | leading the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the War of Liberation, | cultivating the Yan'an spirit | and making great contributions to the Chinese revolution.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Mao Zedong and other revolutionaries of the older generation V:used to live and fight A:here A:for 13 years [伴随状语1 leading the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the War of Liberation] [伴随状语2 cultivating the Yan'an spirit] [伴随状语3 and making great contributions to the Chinese revolution]]]
phrases: revolutionaries of the older generation　老一辈革命家
used to do　过去曾经
used to live and fight　曾生活战斗
the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression　抗日战争
the War of Liberation　解放战争
cultivate the Yan'an spirit　培育延安精神
make great contributions to　为……做出巨大贡献

sentences.src: 六级·2021.12·中共一大会址翻译句
sentences.en: On July 23, 1921, the First National Congress of the CPC was held here, where the first creed and resolution of the CPC were adopted, the central leadership was elected, and the birth of the CPC was announced.
sentences.zh: 1921年7月23日，中国共产党第一次全国代表大会在此召开，大会通过了党的第一个纲领和第一个决议，选举产生了中央领导机构，并宣告了中国共产党的诞生。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文「大会通过了……，选举产生了……，宣告了……」三个并列分句，英译时共用一个 where 定语从句，内部用三个并列的被动谓语，体现正式庄重的文体。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：①句子主干：the First National Congress of the CPC was held here（被动语态，主+谓+地点状语）。②各从句类型与嵌套层次：here 之后 where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 here（即会址）；从句内部含三个并列被动分句（were adopted / was elected / was announced），构成「主句→where 定语从句→从句内三并列被动谓语」两层嵌套。③关键连接词/引导词：where 为关系副词，在从句中作地点状语，不可换成 which；三个被动谓语用逗号分隔、最后一个前加 and。④翻译要点：中文主动句「大会通过/选举/宣告」英译统一转为被动（were adopted / was elected / was announced），避免重复主语 the congress；后续动作挂在 where 从句上，符合英文「先主干、后细节」；党史文体保持庄重。⑤易错点：where 不可替换为 which（从句缺地点状语而非宾语）；「纲领」译 creed/guiding principle、「决议」译 resolution；三个被动结构缺一不可，勿漏译「宣告诞生」。
【断句版】On July 23, 1921, | the First National Congress of the CPC was held here, | where the first creed and resolution of the CPC were adopted, | the central leadership was elected, | and the birth of the CPC was announced.
sentences.cut: [[主句（被动） A:On July 23, 1921 S:the First National Congress of the CPC V:was held A:here [非限制性定语从句 where S:the first creed and resolution of the CPC V:were adopted, S:the central leadership V:was elected, and S:the birth of the CPC V:was announced]]]
phrases: the First National Congress of the CPC　中国共产党第一次全国代表大会
be held　召开（被动）
adopt the first creed and resolution　通过第一个纲领和决议
elect the central leadership　选举中央领导机构
be announced　被宣告
the birth of the CPC　中国共产党的诞生

sentences.en: The Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge is the first railroad bridge across the Yangtze River which was designed by China and constructed with China-made materials.
sentences.zh: 南京长江大桥是长江上第一座由中国自行设计、采用国产材料建造的铁路、公路两用桥。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文「由中国设计、采用国产材料建造」两个定语后置为 which 引导的定语从句；「铁路、公路两用桥」译为 a railroad bridge（上下文已含两用之意），避免逐字翻译造成累赘。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：①句子主干：The Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge is the first railroad bridge（主系表）。②各从句类型与嵌套层次：介词短语 across the Yangtze River 作后置定语修饰 bridge；其后 which 引导限制性定语从句修饰先行词 bridge，从句中 designed 与 constructed 为并列被动谓语（后一个 was 省略），构成「主句→定语从句（并列被动谓语）」两层嵌套。③关键连接词/引导词：which 为关系代词，指代 bridge，在从句中作主语；and 连接 was designed... 与 (was) constructed... 两个并列被动谓语。④翻译要点：中文长定语「由中国自行设计、采用国产材料建造」前置在「桥」前，英译将其后置为 which 从句，符合英文「先主干、后修饰」；「铁路、公路两用桥」上下文简化为 railroad bridge，不逐字硬译。⑤易错点：which 的先行词是 bridge 而非紧挨着的 the Yangtze River（隔位修饰，极易误读）；「自行设计」译 designed by China 即可，不必叠加 by itself；China-made materials 勿写成 self-made materials。
【断句版】The Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge | is the first railroad bridge | across the Yangtze River | which was designed by China | and constructed with China-made materials.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge V:is(系动词) C:the first railroad bridge [后置定语 across the Yangtze River] [限制性定语从句 which S:which(=bridge) V:was designed by China and (was) constructed with China-made materials]]]
phrases: the first railroad bridge　第一座铁路桥（此处指铁路公路两用桥）
across the Yangtze River　横跨长江
be designed by　由……设计
be constructed with　用……建造
China-made materials　国产材料

sentences.en: The bridge boasts a novel structure and a graceful appearance, with a major arch in the middle and two minor ones on its ends which help discharge floods, reduce the weight of the bridge and save stones.
sentences.zh: 赵州桥结构新颖、造型优美，桥身有一个大拱，大拱两端各有两个小拱，有助于排泄洪水、减轻桥身重量并节省石材。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文连动式「桥有一个大拱……帮助……」译为 with 复合结构（with a major arch... and two minor ones...）+ which 定语从句，把多个并列动词（discharge / reduce / save）收进从句，符合英文「主干突出、从句承载细节」的习惯。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：①句子主干：The bridge boasts a novel structure and a graceful appearance（主谓宾；boast 此处为褒义「拥有（值得自豪之物）」）。②各从句类型与嵌套层次：with a major arch in the middle and two minor ones on its ends 为 with 复合结构作伴随状语；其后 which 引导限制性定语从句，就近修饰 two minor ones（小拱），从句中 discharge / reduce / save 三个动词并列作谓语，构成「主句→with 复合结构→which 定语从句（三并列谓语）」三层嵌套。③关键连接词/引导词：which 指代 two minor ones（复数，故从句谓语用原形 help）；and 在 with 结构内连接 major arch 与 minor ones、在从句内连接三个并列动词。④翻译要点：中文流水句「桥有一个大拱……小拱帮助……」英译以 boasts 提主干，用 with 复合结构承载桥身细节、which 从句承载三项功能动词，把散句收进英文主干；「有助于」译 help do，后接三个并列动词原形。⑤易错点：which 的先行词是 two minor ones（小拱）而非 major arch，若误读为单数会误用 helps；ones 指代 arches，避免重复；boast 不译「吹嘘」，此处为褒义「拥有」。
【断句版】The bridge boasts a novel structure and a graceful appearance, | with a major arch in the middle | and two minor ones on its ends | which help discharge floods, | reduce the weight of the bridge | and save stones.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The bridge V:boasts O:a novel structure and a graceful appearance [伴随状语 with a major arch in the middle and two minor ones on its ends] [限制性定语从句 which S:which(=two minor ones) V:help O:discharge floods, reduce the weight of the bridge and save stones]]]
phrases: boast a novel structure　拥有新颖的结构
a graceful appearance　造型优美
a major arch　一个大拱
two minor ones　两个小拱
discharge floods　排泄洪水
reduce the weight of the bridge　减轻桥身重量
save stones　节省石材

sentences.en: The Loess Plateau is one of the cradles of the Chinese nation where Chinese began farming 5,500 years ago.
sentences.zh: 黄土高原是中华民族的发祥地之一，早在5500年前，人们就已经在黄土高原上开始农耕。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文两个短句「是发祥地之一」「人们在此开始农耕」用 where 引导的定语从句合并为一句，使英文更紧凑；「发祥地」固定译为 cradle（摇篮/发源地）。
sentences.parse:
① 句子主干：The Loess Plateau is one of the cradles of the Chinese nation（主系表：主语 The Loess Plateau + 系动词 is + 表语 one of the cradles）。② 从句类型与嵌套层次：主句→where Chinese began farming 5,500 years ago 为关系副词 where 引导的限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 the Chinese nation（实指黄土高原这一文明发祥之地）；从句内部为「主谓宾+时间状语」简单句，无再嵌套。③ 关键连接词/引导词：where 为关系副词，在定语从句中作地点状语，相当于 on which（= on the plateau），指代「在这片高原上」。④ 翻译要点：把中文并列短句用 where 定语从句合并，避免简单堆砌两个主谓句；时间状语「早在5500年前」后置为 5,500 years ago；「发祥地」译为 cradle。⑤ 易错点：where 并非修饰就近的 the Chinese nation（nation 不能作地点），翻译时须还原其真正指代的地点「黄土高原」，切勿误成「中华民族5500年前开始农耕」；one of 后必须接复数名词 cradles，不可写 one of the cradle。
【断句版】The Loess Plateau | is one of the cradles of the Chinese nation | where Chinese began farming | 5,500 years ago.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Loess Plateau V:is(系动词) C:one of the cradles [后置定语 of the Chinese nation] [限制性定语从句 where S:Chinese V:began O:farming A:5,500 years ago]]]
phrases: the Loess Plateau　黄土高原
one of the cradles of the Chinese nation　中华民族的发祥地之一
the Chinese nation　中华民族
begin farming　开始农耕
5,500 years ago　5500年前

sentences.en: It is also the region with the most minority peoples in China, where their colourful cultural traditions are well preserved.
sentences.zh: 云贵高原也是中国少数民族数量最多的地区，各民族在此都保留了自己丰富多彩的文化传统。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「各民族都保留了……」译为 where 引导的非限制性定语从句，where 在从句中作地点状语；「保留」译为 are well preserved（被动），突出「文化传统被保存完好」的状态。
sentences.parse:
① 句子主干：It is also the region（主系表，It 指代云贵高原）。② 从句类型与嵌套层次：主句→with the most minority peoples in China 介词短语作后置定语修饰 region→where their colourful cultural traditions are well preserved 为关系副词 where 引导的非限制性定语从句，补充说明 region，从句用被动语态 are well preserved；无更深嵌套。③ 关键连接词/引导词：where 关系副词，在从句中作地点状语（= in this region）；where 前有逗号，属非限制性定语从句。④ 翻译要点：「少数民族数量最多」译为 with the most minority peoples 介词短语后置定语；「各民族在此都保留了文化传统」译为 where 非限制性定语从句，「保留」转译为被动 are well preserved；It 指代云贵高原，译时还原为「云贵高原」。⑤ 易错点：where 前有逗号，是非限制性定语从句，不可紧贴 region 死译为「中国少数民族最多的、保存着传统的地区」，应单独成句；被动 are well preserved 不要漏译「被」的意味，也不要硬译成主动 they preserve；minority peoples 用复数表「多个民族」。
【断句版】It is also the region | with the most minority peoples in China, | where their colourful cultural traditions are well preserved.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:It(=云贵高原) V:is(系动词) C:also the region [后置定语 with the most minority peoples in China] [非限制性定语从句 where S:their colourful cultural traditions V:are well preserved]]]
phrases: the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau　云贵高原
the region　该地区
minority peoples　少数民族
colourful cultural traditions　丰富多彩的文化传统
be well preserved　被完好保存

sentences.en: With the rapid development of foreign culture trade, the export volume of Chinese culture products has been ranking high in the world for many years in a row, contributing to the establishment of a series of Chinese culture products and brands with international influence.
sentences.zh: 随着中国对外文化贸易的快速发展，中国文化产品出口额已连续多年位居世界前列，从而形成了一批具有国际影响力的文化产品和品牌。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文「形成了……」是结果，译为现在分词短语 contributing to... 作结果状语，比再译一个独立谓语更紧凑；「位居世界前列」译 rank high in the world，「持续多年」用 for many years in a row。
sentences.parse:
① 句子主干：the export volume has been ranking high in the world（主谓状；主语 the export volume，谓语 has been ranking，状语 high in the world）。② 修饰层次：句首 With the rapid development of foreign culture trade 为 With 介词短语作背景状语→主句→for many years in a row 时间状语→现在分词短语 contributing to the establishment of... 作结果状语，修饰前面整个主句；其中 with international influence 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 products and brands；无嵌套从句。③ 关键连接词/引导词：With 介词（表「随着」）引出背景；现在分词 contributing to 引出自然而然的结果，相当于 which contributes to（省去 which 用分词使句子紧凑）。④ 翻译要点：「随着……」前置为 With 短语，符合中文先铺背景；「连续多年位居前列」用现在完成进行时 has been ranking high... for many years in a row 强调持续；「从而形成」不另起谓语，用现在分词 contributing to the establishment of...，译时补出「从而」；「具有国际影响力的」后置定语译时前置。⑤ 易错点：contributing to 的逻辑主语是前面整句话（出口额持续居前这件事），不是 export volume 本身，须译出「结果」关系；rank high 是「位居前列」而非字面「排名高」；in a row = 连续，不可漏译；正式写作建议用 cultural products 而非 culture products。
【断句版】With the rapid development of foreign culture trade, | the export volume of Chinese culture products | has been ranking high in the world | for many years in a row, | contributing to the establishment of a series of Chinese culture products and brands | with international influence.
sentences.cut: [[背景状语 With the rapid development of foreign culture trade [[主句 S:the export volume [后置定语 of Chinese culture products] V:has been ranking A:high in the world A:for many years in a row [结果状语 contributing to the establishment of a series of Chinese culture products and brands [后置定语 with international influence]]]]]
phrases: foreign culture trade　对外文化贸易
export volume　出口额
rank high in the world　位居世界前列
for many years in a row　连续多年
contribute to the establishment of　促成……的形成
a series of　一系列
culture products and brands　文化产品和品牌
with international influence　具有国际影响力

sentences.en: Many cities have been making efforts to explore the path of high-quality urban development with Chinese characteristics, bringing about continuous improvement of urban functions and a noticeable rise in the level of governance.
sentences.zh: 许多城市一直在努力探索中国特色的城市高质量发展之路，从而带来城市功能的不断完善和治理水平的明显提升。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文「城市功能不断完善，治理水平明显提高」是前一动作带来的结果，译为现在分词短语 bringing about... 作结果状语；「中国特色」译为 with Chinese characteristics，是高频固定译法。
sentences.parse:
① 句子主干：Many cities have been making efforts to explore the path（主谓宾；主语 Many cities，谓语 have been making efforts，宾语 to explore the path）。② 修饰层次：主句→of high-quality urban development with Chinese characteristics 介词短语作后置定语修饰 path（其中 with Chinese characteristics 又修饰 development）→现在分词短语 bringing about continuous improvement... and a noticeable rise... 作结果状语，其中 improvement 与 rise 并列作 bringing about 的宾语；无嵌套从句。③ 关键连接词/引导词：现在分词 bringing about 引导结果状语，相当于 which brings about，表前一动作自然导致的结果；have been making 为现在完成进行时，强调「一直在努力」的持续性。④ 翻译要点：「中国特色」用 with Chinese characteristics 后置定语，译时前置为「中国特色的城市高质量发展之路」；「从而带来……」用现在分词 bringing about 作结果状语，不另立句子；「城市功能不断完善」「治理水平明显提升」两个名词化结构并列作宾语，译时还原为中文偏正短语。⑤ 易错点：bring about 的逻辑主语是前面整句（探索发展之路这件事），须译出「从而带来」的因果；with Chinese characteristics 是固定译法，不可译成 Chinese-featured；have been making 现在完成进行时要译出「一直在」；governance 此处为「治理（水平）」，不可误作「政府」。
【断句版】Many cities have been making efforts | to explore the path | of high-quality urban development with Chinese characteristics, | bringing about continuous improvement of urban functions | and a noticeable rise in the level of governance.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Many cities V:have been making efforts O:to explore the path [后置定语 of high-quality urban development [后置定语 with Chinese characteristics]] [结果状语 bringing about O:continuous improvement of urban functions and a noticeable rise in the level of governance]]]
phrases: make efforts to explore　努力探索
high-quality urban development　城市高质量发展
with Chinese characteristics　具有中国特色
bring about continuous improvement　带来不断完善
urban functions　城市功能
a noticeable rise　明显提升
the level of governance　治理水平

sentences.en: Through the reform of the social security system, the government has continuously increased social security funds and gradually expanded the coverage of social security, in order to benefit more elderly people.
sentences.zh: 通过改革社会保障制度，政府不断增加社会保障经费，逐步扩大社会保障覆盖范围，使更多老年人受益。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：①「通过……」方式状语译作 Through the reform of... 置于句首；②「不断增加……、逐步扩大……」两个并列谓语用 and 连接，共享助动词 has；③ 结尾「使更多老年人受益」译作 in order to benefit more elderly people，表目的，不宜直译为 making。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：the government（主语）has increased... and expanded...（并列现在完成时谓语）。全句为简单句（无从句），主语后接两个并列谓语。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：本句无名词性从句、定语从句，也无状语从句，仅由「状语+主谓主干+目的状语」构成；两个并列谓语 has increased... and expanded... 共享助动词 has。层次：方式状语 Through... → 主句主干 the government has increased A → 并列谓语 and expanded B → 目的状语 in order to benefit...。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：Through（介词短语作方式状语，置于句首）；and（连接两个并列谓语，不可省略）；in order to（不定式短语作目的状语）。
④ 翻译要点：中文流水句「方式+主语+并列谓语+目的」，英译按英文「方式状语前置—主谓主干—目的状语后置」重组；「不断/逐步」分别译为 continuously/gradually 修饰两个谓语；「使……受益」用 in order to benefit 表目的。
⑤ 易错点：「社会保障」social security 全句统一，勿时而 social insurance；两个并列谓语共享 has，第二个 expanded 前勿再加 has；「覆盖范围」是 coverage 不是 range。
【断句版】Through the reform of the social security system, | the government has continuously increased social security funds | and gradually expanded the coverage of social security, | in order to benefit more elderly people.
sentences.cut: [[方式状语 Through the reform of the social security system [[主句 S:the government V:has continuously increased O:social security funds and (has) gradually expanded O:the coverage of social security] [目的状语 in order to benefit more elderly people]]]
phrases: the reform of the social security system　改革社会保障制度
the government　政府
continuously increase　不断增加
social security funds　社会保障经费
gradually expand　逐步扩大
expand the coverage of　扩大……的覆盖范围
in order to benefit more elderly people　使更多老年人受益

sentences.en: Through government guidance and social participation, more and better elderly-care service institutions can be established, community service centers can be improved, and home-based self-care for the elderly can be encouraged. It is also advisable to promote a model that combines family care with social care.
sentences.zh: 可以通过政府引导和社会参与，建立更多更好的养老服务机构，改进社区服务中心，鼓励居家自助养老，还可以推行家庭养老与社会养老相结合的模式。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文无主句、连动流水句，英译改用被动语态；「家庭养老与社会养老相结合」用定语从句 a model that combines family care with social care；「还可以推行……」用 It is also advisable to... 提建议。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：第一句为三个并列被动分句（more institutions can be established, community centers can be improved, home-based self-care can be encouraged）；第二句 It 作形式主语，真正主语为不定式 to promote a model...。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：第二句中 that combines family care with social care 为限制性定语从句，修饰 a model。层次：第二句 It(形式主语) → 真正主语不定式 to promote a model → 不定式宾语 a model 中嵌套定语从句 that combines...。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：Through（介词短语作方式状语）；and（连接三个并列被动分句）；It（形式主语，无实义）；that（定语从句引导词，指代 a model，在从句中作主语）。
④ 翻译要点：中文无主句「可以通过……建立……改进……鼓励……推行……」，英译改用被动语态 more...can be established / can be improved / can be encouraged；第二句「还可以推行……」用 It is also advisable to...；「相结合」译作定语从句 that combines family care with social care 后置修饰 model。
⑤ 易错点：无主句勿硬补主语 we/you，用被动更得体；定语从句谓语 combines 用第三人称单数（先行词 a model）；「居家自助养老」home-based self-care，勿逐字译 home self-support。
【断句版】Through government guidance and social participation, | more and better elderly-care service institutions can be established, | community service centers can be improved, | and home-based self-care for the elderly can be encouraged. | It is also advisable to promote a model | that combines family care with social care.
sentences.cut: [[方式状语 Through government guidance and social participation [[分句1（被动） S:more and better elderly-care service institutions V:can be established] [分句2（被动） S:community service centers V:can be improved] [分句3（被动） S:home-based self-care for the elderly V:can be encouraged]]] [[主句 It(形式主语) V:is also advisable C:表语 [真正主语不定式 to promote O:a model [限制性定语从句 that S:that(=model) V:combines O:family care C:with social care]]]]]
phrases: government guidance and social participation　政府引导与社会参与
elderly-care service institutions　养老服务机构
community service centers　社区服务中心
home-based self-care　居家自助养老
It is advisable to do　……是可取的
promote a model　推行一种模式
combine family care with social care　家庭养老与社会养老相结合

sentences.en: To make dining easier for the elderly, many cities have opened community canteens that provide affordable meals. Meals-on-wheels are also available for elderly people with limited mobility.
sentences.zh: 许多城市为方便老年人用餐，开设了社区食堂，为他们提供价格实惠的饭菜。行动不便的老年人还能享受上门送餐服务。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「上门送餐服务」套用英语固定表达 meals-on-wheels；「行动不便的老年人」the elderly with limited mobility；「价格实惠」用 affordable，避免 cheap 的贬义。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：第一句 many cities（主语）have opened（谓语）community canteens（宾语）；第二句 Meals-on-wheels（主语）are（系动词）available（表语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：第一句 that provide affordable meals 为限制性定语从句，修饰 community canteens；To make dining easier for the elderly 为不定式短语作目的状语；第二句 with limited mobility 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 elderly people。层次：目的状语 To make... → 主句 many cities have opened canteens → 其中嵌套定语从句 that provide...。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：To（不定式符号，引导句首目的状语）；that（定语从句引导词，指代 canteens，作从句主语）；with（介词，短语 with limited mobility 作后置定语）。
④ 翻译要点：「为方便老年人用餐」译不定式目的状语 To make dining easier for the elderly 前置；「社区食堂」community canteens；「价格实惠」affordable 修饰 meals；「行动不便的老年人」the elderly with limited mobility；「上门送餐服务」套用固定表达 meals-on-wheels。
⑤ 易错点：两句为独立句，第二句勿用 which 连接（meals-on-wheels 与 canteens 非同指）；affordable 勿误译 cheap（cheap 含「廉价低质」贬义）；meals-on-wheels 为固定短语，勿改写为 door-to-door meal。
【断句版】To make dining easier for the elderly, | many cities have opened community canteens | that provide affordable meals. | Meals-on-wheels are also available | for elderly people with limited mobility.
sentences.cut: [[目的状语 To make dining easier for the elderly [[主句 S:many cities V:have opened O:community canteens [限制性定语从句 that S:that(=canteens) V:provide O:affordable meals]]] [[主句2 S:Meals-on-wheels V:are(系动词) C:also available A:for elderly people [后置定语 with limited mobility]]]]]
phrases: make dining easier　方便用餐
community canteens　社区食堂
provide affordable meals　提供价格实惠的饭菜
affordable meals　价格实惠的饭菜
be available　可获得/可享受
the elderly with limited mobility　行动不便的老年人
meals-on-wheels / home-delivered meals　上门送餐服务

sentences.en: Nowadays, the practical function of fans has greatly diminished, but as a cultural symbol and an art form, they still play a significant role in traditional Chinese culture.
sentences.zh: 如今，扇子的实用功能已大为减弱，但作为一种文化符号和艺术形式，扇子仍然在中国传统文化中扮演着重要角色。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「实用功能」practical function；后半句主语用 they 指代 fans 避免重复；用 but 连接并列转折句。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：并列转折句。分句1：the practical function of fans（主语）has greatly diminished（谓语）；分句2：they（主语，指代 fans）still play（谓语）a significant role（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为并列句，无从句；as a cultural symbol and an art form 为介词短语作身份状语，插入分句2句首；of fans 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 function。层次：分句1（转折前）→ but → 分句2（含插入状语 as...）。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：but（并列转折连词）；as（介词，「作为」）；of（介词，of fans 后置定语）。
④ 翻译要点：「实用功能已大为减弱」the practical function has greatly diminished；「作为文化符号和艺术形式」as a cultural symbol and an art form 插入分句2句首；后半句主语用 they 指代 fans 避免重复；「扮演重要角色」play a significant role in。
⑤ 易错点：they 指代 fans（复数），勿误指 function；diminish 含「重要性减弱」，勿简单译 decreased；but 前后主语不同（function vs fans），后半句主谓勿省略。
【断句版】Nowadays, | the practical function of fans has greatly diminished, | but as a cultural symbol and an art form, | they still play a significant role | in traditional Chinese culture.
sentences.cut: [[分句1 A:Nowadays S:the practical function [后置定语 of fans] V:has greatly diminished [转折连词 but] 分句2 A:as a cultural symbol and an art form S:they(=fans) V:still play O:a significant role A:in traditional Chinese culture]]
phrases: nowadays　如今
practical function　实用功能
diminish / decline greatly　大为减弱
a cultural symbol and an art form　文化符号和艺术形式
play a significant role in　在……中扮演重要角色
traditional Chinese culture　中国传统文化

sentences.en: Bamboo possesses remarkable vitality and adaptability; however harsh the environment, it can survive tenaciously, and thus it symbolizes the spirit of perseverance.
sentences.zh: 竹子具有强大的生命力和适应能力，无论环境多么恶劣，都能够顽强生存，因而寓意坚韧不拔的精神。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「无论环境多么恶劣」用 however harsh the environment (may be) 让步从句；「因而」译作 and thus；注意 however 此处为让步引导词，非转折「然而」。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：三个分句。分句1：Bamboo（主语）possesses（谓语）remarkable vitality and adaptability（宾语）；分句2：it（主语）can survive（谓语）tenaciously（状语）；分句3：it（主语）symbolizes（谓语）the spirit of perseverance（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：分号连接分句1与分句2；however harsh the environment (may be) 为 however 引导的让步状语从句（省略 may be），修饰分句2；and thus 连接分句2与分句3（因果关系）。层次：分句1 → 分号 → 让步从句 + 分句2 → and thus → 分句3。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：however（让步状语从句引导词，「无论多么」，结构 however + adj/adv + 主语 + 动词）；分号（连接并列独立分句）；and thus（因果连接，「因而」）。
④ 翻译要点：「无论环境多么恶劣」用 however harsh the environment (may be)，形容词 harsh 前置；「顽强生存」survive tenaciously；「因而」and thus；「寓意坚韧不拔的精神」symbolizes the spirit of perseverance。
⑤ 易错点：however 此处引导让步从句，勿误译为转折连词「然而」；however + adj 后用陈述语序（the environment may be），不用疑问倒装语序；分号后独立分句首字母小写 it。
【断句版】Bamboo possesses remarkable vitality and adaptability; | however harsh the environment, | it can survive tenaciously, | and thus it symbolizes the spirit of perseverance.
sentences.cut: [[分句1 S:Bamboo V:possesses O:remarkable vitality and adaptability; [让步状语从句 however harsh the environment (may be)] 分句2 S:it(=bamboo) V:can survive A:tenaciously, [因果连接 and thus] 分句3 S:it V:symbolizes O:the spirit of perseverance]]
phrases: vitality and adaptability　生命力与适应能力
however harsh the environment　无论环境多么恶劣
survive tenaciously　顽强生存
and thus　因而
symbolize the spirit of perseverance　寓意坚韧不拔的精神
the spirit of perseverance　坚韧不拔的精神

sentences.en: The wedding venue is elaborately decorated, with red—the color symbolizing jubilance—as the dominant tone, and is adorned with many objects that wish the newlyweds happiness.
sentences.zh: 婚礼场地经过精心装饰，以象征喜庆的红色为主色调，摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「以……红色为主色调」用 with red—the color symbolizing jubilance—as the dominant tone，破折号引出同位语；后半句用并列被动 be adorned with + 定语从句。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：The wedding venue（主语）带两个并列被动谓语：is elaborately decorated 与 (is) adorned with many objects...。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：with red...as the dominant tone 为 with 复合结构作伴随状语；破折号后 the color symbolizing jubilance 为 red 的同位语，其中 symbolizing jubilance 为现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 the color；that wish the newlyweds happiness 为限制性定语从句，修饰 many objects。层次：主句（并列被动谓语）→ 伴随状语 with 复合结构（内含同位语+分词定语）→ 定语从句 that wish...。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：with...as...（with 复合结构，「以……作为……」）；that（定语从句引导词，指代 objects，作从句主语）；破折号（引出同位语 the color...）。
④ 翻译要点：「婚礼场地经过精心装饰」被动 The wedding venue is elaborately decorated；「以象征喜庆的红色为主色调」用 with red—the color symbolizing jubilance—as the dominant tone，插入同位语解释 red；「摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件」用并列被动 is adorned with many objects that wish the newlyweds happiness，定语从句后置。
⑤ 易错点：with 复合结构中插入破折号同位语，语序为 with X—同位语—as Y，勿写成 with red as the dominant tone which symbolizes...；that wish 的先行词是 objects（复数），谓语 wish 用复数；「主色调」dominant tone，勿译 main color。
【断句版】The wedding venue is elaborately decorated, | with red—the color symbolizing jubilance—as the dominant tone, | and is adorned with many objects | that wish the newlyweds happiness.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The wedding venue V:is elaborately decorated and (is) adorned with many objects [伴随状语 with red [同位语 the color [后置定语 symbolizing jubilance]] as the dominant tone] [限制性定语从句 that S:that(=objects) V:wish O:the newlyweds O-C:happiness]]]
phrases: the wedding venue　婚礼场地
be elaborately decorated　经过精心装饰
the dominant color / tone　主色调
symbolize jubilance　象征喜庆
jubilance　喜庆
be adorned with　摆放着、装饰着
wish the newlyweds happiness　祝愿新人幸福
the newlyweds　新人

sentences.en: Through relentless efforts, researchers have overcome a series of technical challenges and successfully achieved global coverage and high-precision positioning, making China one of the few countries with an independent satellite navigation system.
sentences.zh: 研发人员经过不懈努力，攻克了一系列技术难题，成功地实现了全球覆盖和高精度定位，使中国成为少数几个独立拥有卫星定位导航系统的国家之一。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：结尾「使中国成为……之一」用现在分词短语 making China one of the few countries with... 作结果状语，避免另起一句。
sentences.parse:
【①句子主干】researchers（主语） have overcome... and achieved...（并列谓语），核心骨架＝研发人员攻克难题并实现定位。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】句首 Through relentless efforts 为介词短语作方式状语；主干后现在分词短语 making China one of the few countries... 作结果状语；其中 with an independent satellite navigation system 为介词短语后置定语修饰 countries。层次：方式状语 → 主句（并列谓语）→ 结果状语（内含后置定语）。【③关键连接词/引导词】and 连接并列谓语 overcome/achieved；现在分词 making 引出自然结果；with 引出后置定语。【④翻译要点】中文连动句「经过…攻克…实现…使…」译为英文「方式状语＋并列谓语＋现在分词结果状语」；「经过不懈努力」前置为 Through relentless efforts；「使…」不另起句，用 making 短语收束。【⑤易错点】「使中国成为…之一」勿译成 and made...（时态割裂），用现在分词 making 表伴随结果；「之一」one of the few countries 后名词须用复数 countries；「高精度定位」high-precision positioning，勿漏连字符。
【断句版】Through relentless efforts, | researchers have overcome a series of technical challenges | and successfully achieved global coverage and high-precision positioning, | making China one of the few countries | with an independent satellite navigation system.
sentences.cut: [[方式状语 Through relentless efforts [[主句 S:researchers V:have overcome O:a series of technical challenges and (have) successfully achieved O:global coverage and high-precision positioning] [结果状语 making O:China O-C:one of the few countries [后置定语 with an independent satellite navigation system]]]]]
phrases: through relentless efforts　经过不懈努力
researchers　研发人员
overcome technical challenges　攻克技术难题
a series of　一系列
technical challenges　技术难题
global coverage and high-precision positioning　全球覆盖与高精度定位
one of the few countries with an independent...system　少数独立拥有……系统的国家之一
satellite navigation system　卫星导航系统

sentences.en: The rapid development of China's space industry has written a glorious chapter in the history of the Chinese nation and made tremendous contributions to advancing human civilization.
sentences.zh: 中国航天事业的迅速发展为中华民族历史写下了辉煌的一页，也为推进人类文明做出了巨大贡献。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：主语名词化 The rapid development of...，两个并列谓语（写下／做出）共享主语，用 and 连接。
sentences.parse:
【①句子主干】The rapid development（主语） has written... and made...（并列谓语），核心骨架＝发展写下一页并做出贡献。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】of China's space industry 介词短语后置定语修饰 development；in the history of the Chinese nation 为范围状语；to advancing human civilization 介词短语作 contributions 的后置定语（to 为介词，后接动名词）。层次：名词化主语（内含 of 定语）→ 并列谓语 → 各自的介词短语修饰。【③关键连接词/引导词】and 连接两个现在完成时并列谓语 has written / (has) made；of / in / to 一串介词链条串起名词化结构。【④翻译要点】中文「中国航天事业的迅速发展」名词化为主语 The rapid development of...；「为…写下辉煌一页／为…做出巨大贡献」两并列谓语共享主语，用 and 连接，避免重复主语。【⑤易错点】make contributions to 中 to 是介词，后须接动名词 advancing，不可接动词原形；「辉煌一页」a glorious chapter（in the history）；「推进人类文明」用 advancing human civilization，勿生硬直译 promote human civilization。
【断句版】The rapid development of China's space industry | has written a glorious chapter | in the history of the Chinese nation | and made tremendous contributions | to advancing human civilization.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The rapid development [后置定语 of China's space industry] V:has written O:a glorious chapter A:in the history of the Chinese nation and (has) made O:tremendous contributions [后置定语 to advancing human civilization]]]
phrases: China's space industry　中国航天事业
write a glorious chapter　写下辉煌的一页
in the history of　在……历史上
tremendous contributions　巨大贡献
make tremendous contributions to　为……作出巨大贡献
advance human civilization　推进人类文明
human civilization　人类文明

sentences.en: The independently developed terminal management system enables remote control of large equipment from hundreds of kilometers away. Although Yangshan Port appears bustling, no manual operation is visible on site, and it can operate around the clock.
sentences.zh: 自主研发的码头管理系统能够在百公里外对大型设备进行远程操控。洋山港看起来一片繁忙，但现场却看不到人工操作，并能24小时不间断运作。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「看起来繁忙但看不到人工操作」用 Although... 让步从句；「24小时不间断运作」operate around the clock。
sentences.parse:
【①句子主干】句1：system（主） enables（谓） remote control（宾）；句2为主从复合句：Although 让步从句 ＋ 主句 no manual operation is visible... and it can operate...。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】independently developed 过去分词前置定语修饰 system；from hundreds of kilometers away 距离状语；句2中 Although 引导让步状语从句，主句为 and 连接的两个并列分句（被动分句＋主动分句）。层次：句1简单句（含分词定语）；句2＝让步从句＋并列主句。【③关键连接词/引导词】Although（虽然……，英文不与 but 连用）；and 连接句2两个并列分句；from...away 表距离起点。【④翻译要点】中文「看起来繁忙但看不到人工操作」的「但」译 Although 让步从句，英文先让步后主句；「自主研发的」independently developed 过去分词前置；「24小时不间断」operate around the clock 固定搭配。【⑤易错点】Although/Though 与 but 不能同时出现；「看不到人工操作」用被动 no manual operation is visible，勿中式直译 no people work；「百公里外」from hundreds of kilometers away，勿漏 away。
【断句版】The independently developed terminal management system | enables remote control of large equipment | from hundreds of kilometers away. | Although Yangshan Port appears bustling, | no manual operation is visible on site, | and it can operate around the clock.
sentences.cut: [[分句1 S:The independently developed terminal management system V:enables O:remote control of large equipment A:from hundreds of kilometers away. [让步状语从句 Although S:Yangshan Port V:appears C:bustling,] [主句2a（被动） S:no manual operation V:is visible A:on site,] and [主句2b S:it(=洋山港) V:can operate A:around the clock.]]]
phrases: independently developed　自主研发的
terminal management system　码头管理系统
remote control of large equipment　对大型设备远程操控
large equipment　大型设备
hundreds of kilometers away　百公里外
no manual operation is visible　看不到人工操作
on site　现场
operate around the clock　24小时不间断运作

sentences.en: The Tiangong Space Station, China's first space laboratory, boasts over 110 cubic meters of usable space, accommodating three astronauts as it orbits 400 to 450 kilometers above Earth's surface.
sentences.zh: 天宫空间站是中国首个太空实验室，拥有110多立方米的使用空间，可容纳三名宇航员，在距地球表面400至450公里的轨道上运行。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：boast 此处意为「拥有（引以为荣之物）」，不译「吹嘘」；accommodate 表「容纳」；orbit 此处为动词「沿轨道运行」。
sentences.parse:
【①句子主干】The Tiangong Space Station（主语） boasts（谓语） over 110 cubic meters of usable space（宾语），核心骨架＝空间站拥有使用空间。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】China's first space laboratory 为同位语，插在主谓语之间补充说明主语；accommodating three astronauts 现在分词短语作伴随状语；as it orbits 400 to 450 kilometers above Earth's surface 为 as 引导的时间状语从句，修饰 accommodating。层次：主语＋同位语 → 主句谓语 → 现在分词伴随状语 → as 时间状语从句。【③关键连接词/引导词】as 引导时间状语从句，意为「随着／当……时」，表主句动作的背景；现在分词 accommodating 表伴随；同位语前后逗号分隔。【④翻译要点】英文一长串（主语＋同位语＋谓语＋分词状语＋as从句）拆成中文四个短句「是…／拥有…／可容纳…／在…轨道运行」，按「是什么—有多大—驻几人—在哪运行」顺序顺译。【⑤易错点】boast 此处为「（自豪地）拥有」，勿译「吹嘘」；orbit 此处为动词「沿轨道运行」，勿当名词；accommodate 表「容纳宇航员」，勿用口语化的 hold；同位语前后逗号不可省，否则句子粘连。
【断句版】The Tiangong Space Station, | China's first space laboratory, | boasts over 110 cubic meters of usable space, | accommodating three astronauts | as it orbits 400 to 450 kilometers above Earth's surface.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Tiangong Space Station [同位语 China's first space laboratory] V:boasts O:over 110 cubic meters of usable space, [伴随状语 accommodating O:three astronauts [时间状语从句 as S:it V:orbits A:400 to 450 kilometers above Earth's surface]]]]
phrases: the Tiangong Space Station　天宫空间站
China's first space laboratory　中国首个太空实验室
over 110 cubic meters　110多立方米
usable space　使用空间
cubic meters　立方米
accommodate three astronauts　容纳三名宇航员
orbit above Earth's surface　在距地表上空沿轨道运行

sentences.en: The GBA aims to become not only a dynamic world-class urban cluster and an internationally influential hub for science and technology innovation, but also a high-quality living circle ideal for working, shopping and tourism.
sentences.zh: 大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群和具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心，还将打造成适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈。
sentences.parse:
【①句子主干】The GBA（主语） aims to become（谓语） not only A..., but also B...（并列表语），核心骨架＝大湾区旨在成为……。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】not only...but also... 连接两个并列表语；表语 A 内部 a dynamic world-class urban cluster 与 an internationally influential hub for science and technology innovation 为两个并列名词；ideal for working, shopping and tourism 形容词短语后置修饰 living circle。层次：主句 → 并列表语（not only 端内含两个并列名词）→ 后置形容词短语。【③关键连接词/引导词】not only...but also...（不仅……而且……）并列结构，前后须对称；for 引出用途／领域。【④翻译要点】保留「不仅……还……」递进；后置形容词短语 ideal for... 提前译为「适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈」；「世界级城市群／国际科技创新中心」按官方表述译为 world-class urban cluster / internationally influential hub for sci-tech innovation。【⑤易错点】not only...but also... 前后成分须平行（均为名词短语），勿一头动词一头名词；「优质生活圈」high-quality living circle，勿直译 good life circle；ideal for 后接动名词 working/shopping/tourism。
【断句版】The GBA aims to become | not only a dynamic world-class urban cluster | and an internationally influential hub for science and technology innovation, | but also a high-quality living circle | ideal for working, shopping and tourism.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The GBA V:aims to become C:not only a dynamic world-class urban cluster and an internationally influential hub for science and technology innovation, but also a high-quality living circle [后置形容词短语 ideal for working, shopping and tourism]]]
phrases: aim to become　旨在成为
dynamic　充满活力的
world-class urban cluster　世界级城市群
an internationally influential hub　具有全球影响力的中心
a hub for science and technology innovation　科技创新中心
science and technology innovation　科技创新
a high-quality living circle　优质生活圈
be ideal for　适合……
working, shopping and tourism　工作、购物和旅游

sentences.en: The Chinese nation upholds the spirit of self-improvement and self-reliance, which is deeply rooted in Chinese culture and serves as a vital pillar for the nation's survival and development.
sentences.zh: 中华民族崇尚自立自强的精神，这一精神深植于中华文化，是民族生存与发展的重要支柱。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：uphold 此处译「崇尚」；self-improvement and self-reliance 对应「自立自强」；serve as a vital pillar 译「是……的重要支柱」。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The Chinese nation upholds the spirit of self-improvement and self-reliance（主谓宾）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 the spirit；从句内由 and 连接两个并列谓语 is deeply rooted in Chinese culture 与 serves as a vital pillar for the nation's survival and development。层次：主句→which 非限制性定语从句→从句内并列谓语。③关键连接词/引导词：which 指代 the spirit，在从句中作主语；and 连接两个并列谓语。④翻译要点：which 从句不前置为「……的」长定语，而是拆为两个中文分句，重复先行词「这一精神」，符合中文流水句习惯；serve as a vital pillar 译为「是……的重要支柱」。⑤易错点：self-improvement and self-reliance 是「自立自强」的合译，不可拆成两个词重复翻译；which 非限制性从句勿硬译为前置定语。
【断句版】The Chinese nation upholds the spirit of self-improvement and self-reliance, | which is deeply rooted in Chinese culture | and serves as a vital pillar | for the nation's survival and development.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Chinese nation V:upholds O:the spirit of self-improvement and self-reliance, [非限制性定语从句 which S:which(=the spirit) V:is deeply rooted in Chinese culture and serves as a vital pillar A:for the nation's survival and development]]]
phrases: the Chinese nation　中华民族
uphold the spirit of　崇尚……精神
self-improvement and self-reliance　自立自强
be deeply rooted in　深植于
Chinese culture　中华文化
a vital pillar　重要支柱
survival and development　生存与发展

sentences.en: Boasting outstanding stability, high-definition imaging capability and user-friendly operation, Chinese drones are well received by consumers worldwide and have been widely applied in civil fields.
sentences.zh: 中国无人机凭借其出色的稳定性、高清成像能力和便捷的操作性，深受全球消费者的青睐，并在民用领域得到了广泛应用。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：Chinese drones are well received by consumers worldwide and have been widely applied in civil fields（主语 Chinese drones，and 连接两个并列被动谓语 are well received 与 have been widely applied）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 Boasting outstanding stability, high-definition imaging capability and user-friendly operation 为现在分词短语作原因/伴随状语，逻辑主语即主句主语 Chinese drones；and 后为第二个并列被动谓语。层次：分词状语→主句并列被动谓语。③关键连接词/引导词：boast 此处为及物动词「以拥有……而自豪/凭借」；and 连接两个并列谓语。④翻译要点：把句首分词状语提前译为「凭借……」，再接主句；英文被动语态转中文主动「深受……青睐」「得到广泛应用」。⑤易错点：boast 不可译「吹嘘」，此处为褒义「凭借/以……为荣」；user-friendly operation 译「便捷的操作性」而非「用户友好的操作」。
【断句版】Boasting outstanding stability, | high-definition imaging capability | and user-friendly operation, | Chinese drones are well received by consumers worldwide | and have been widely applied in civil fields.
sentences.cut: [[原因/伴随状语 Boasting O:outstanding stability, high-definition imaging capability and user-friendly operation [[主句 S:Chinese drones V:are well received by consumers worldwide and (have) been widely applied A:in civil fields]]]
phrases: boast outstanding stability　凭借出色的稳定性
outstanding stability　出色的稳定性
high-definition imaging capability　高清成像能力
user-friendly operation　便捷的操作性
be well received by　深受……青睐
consumers worldwide　全球消费者
be widely applied　得到广泛应用
civil fields　民用领域

sentences.en: The widespread adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly access patients' medical histories, thus avoiding unnecessary tests.
sentences.zh: 电子健康记录的广泛采用使医生能够快速获取患者的病史信息，从而避免不必要的检查。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The widespread adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly access patients' medical histories（主谓宾+宾语补足语 to access...）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：of electronic health records 介词短语后置修饰 adoption；句末 thus avoiding unnecessary tests 现在分词短语作结果状语。层次：介词后置定语→主干→现在分词结果状语。③关键连接词/引导词：enables sb to do「使某人能够做」；thus「从而」表因果。④翻译要点：of 后置定语提前译为「电子健康记录的广泛采用」；thus avoiding 译为「从而避免……」，独立成短句。⑤易错点：adoption 此处译「采用」而非「收养」；medical histories 译「病史」；avoiding 的逻辑主语是前面整件事，不是 doctors。
【断句版】The widespread adoption of electronic health records | enables doctors to quickly access patients' medical histories, | thus avoiding unnecessary tests.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The widespread adoption [后置定语 of electronic health records] V:enables O:doctors O-C:to quickly access patients' medical histories [结果状语 thus avoiding O:unnecessary tests]]]
phrases: the widespread adoption of　……的广泛采用
electronic health records　电子健康记录
enable sb to do　使某人能够做
quickly access　快速获取
access medical histories　获取病史
patients' medical histories　患者病史
thus avoiding　从而避免
avoid unnecessary tests　避免不必要的检查

sentences.en: Designed to handle 300 takeoffs and landings per hour, the airport is expected to handle 100 million passengers a year by 2040, making it the busiest airport in the world.
sentences.zh: 该机场在设计上每小时可保障300架次飞机起降，预计到2040年年客运量将达到1亿人次，从而成为世界上最繁忙的机场。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文三个小句共用主语「机场」，英文分别用过去分词状语（Design）、被动主句（is expected）、现在分词结果状语（making it...）处理；汉译时按时间顺序还原为三个分句。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：the airport is expected to handle 100 million passengers a year（主语 the airport，谓语 is expected to handle，宾语 100 million passengers，时间状语 by 2040）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 Designed to handle 300 takeoffs and landings per hour 为过去分词短语作状语（表被动/目的）；句尾 making it the busiest airport in the world 为现在分词短语作结果状语；全句无从句，层次为「过去分词状语 + 主句（被动）+ 现在分词结果状语」。③关键连接词/引导词：本句无连词；Designed 的逻辑主语即主句主语 the airport（机场是「被设计」的）；making 的逻辑主语是前面整件事（年客运量达1亿人次这一情况）。④翻译要点：中文原文三个小句（设计确保每小时300架次／2040年达1亿人次／有望成为最繁忙机场）共用主语，英文分别译为过去分词状语、被动主句、现在分词结果状语；汉译时按时间顺序还原为三个分句；by 2040 前置译为「到2040年」。⑤易错点：Designed 是过去分词表被动，勿误当作谓语或补加主语；making 是结果状语表「（因而）使得」，勿误译成并列谓语；takeoffs and landings 是固定搭配「起降」，不可拆开直译。
【断句版】Designed to handle 300 takeoffs and landings per hour, | the airport is expected to handle 100 million passengers a year | by 2040, | making it the busiest airport in the world.
sentences.cut: [[状语（过去分词，表被动/目的） Designed S:(=the airport) to handle 300 takeoffs and landings per hour [[主句（被动） S:the airport V:is expected to handle O:100 million passengers A:a year A:by 2040, [结果状语 making O:it O-C:the busiest airport in the world]]]]]
phrases: be designed to do　被设计用于……
takeoffs and landings　起降
per hour　每小时
be expected to do　预计、有望
handle 100 million passengers a year　年客运量达1亿人次
the busiest airport in the world　世界上最繁忙的机场

sentences.en: Since its founding in 1988, Hainan has made rapid development in tourism, service industries and high-tech industries and become the only special economic zone at the provincial level.
sentences.zh: 自1988年建省以来，海南在旅游业、服务业和高新技术产业方面取得了飞速发展，成为中国唯一的省级经济特区。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文「……飞速发展，是……经济特区」两个谓语共用主语「海南」，英文译为 has made rapid development... and become... 并列谓语，共用助动词 has。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：Hainan has made rapid development... and become the only special economic zone（主语 Hainan，并列谓语 has made... 与 (has) become...，两个过去分词共用助动词 has）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 Since its founding in 1988 为介词短语作时间状语（since 此处为介词，后接名词 founding，不接从句）；句尾 at the provincial level 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 the only special economic zone；层次为「时间状语 + 主句（并列谓语）+ 后置定语」。③关键连接词/引导词：since 为介词表「自……以来」；and 连接并列谓语 has made 与 (has) become，共用助动词 has；its 指代 Hainan。④翻译要点：中文两个谓语「飞速发展，是……经济特区」共用主语「海南」，英文译为 has made rapid development... and become... 并列谓语；「在……方面」用 in tourism, service industries and high-tech industries；at the provincial level 译为「省级的」前置作定语。⑤易错点：since 后接名词 founding 不接从句，勿写成 since it founded；并列谓语共用 has，become 须用过去分词原形；special economic zone 是「经济特区」，special 不可漏译。
【断句版】Since its founding in 1988, | Hainan has made rapid development | in tourism, service industries and high-tech industries | and become the only special economic zone | at the provincial level.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 Since its founding in 1988 [[主句 S:Hainan V:has made O:rapid development A:in tourism, service industries and high-tech industries and (has) become C:the only special economic zone [后置定语 at the provincial level]]]]]
phrases: since its founding in 1988　自1988年建省以来
make rapid development　取得飞速发展
tourism　旅游业
service industries　服务业
high-tech industries　高新技术产业
special economic zone　经济特区
the only special economic zone　唯一的经济特区
at the provincial level　省级层面的

sentences.en: In October 1927, the old generation like Mao Zedong and Zhu De led the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Army here, where they created the first rural revolutionary base with much extremely hard and bitter struggle and lit the sparks of Chinese revolution, breaking a revolutionary path with Chinese characteristic to besiege the city from the countryside and to seize power by armed force.
sentences.zh: 1927年10月，毛泽东、朱德等老一辈革命家率领中国工农红军来到这里；他们在这里开展了艰苦卓绝的斗争，创建了第一个农村革命根据地，点燃了中国革命的星星之火，开辟了一条具有中国特色的革命道路，即从农村包围城市、以武装夺取政权。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文流水句五个分句共用主语「毛泽东、朱德等老一辈」，英译以 led 为主句谓语，后续动作收进 where 从句，「开展斗争」转 with 介词短语、「开辟道路」转现在分词 breaking，避免谓语动词堆砌。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：①句子主干：the old generation like Mao Zedong and Zhu De led the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Army here（主谓宾+地点状语）。②各从句类型与嵌套层次：here 之后 where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 here；从句内 created... and lit... 为并列谓语；再后 breaking... 现在分词短语作结果状语；不定式 to besiege... and to seize... 作 path 的后置定语，构成「主句→where 定语从句（并列谓语）→分词结果状语→不定式定语」多层嵌套。③关键连接词/引导词：where 关系副词在从句中作地点状语，指代 here，不可换 which；and 连接 created 与 lit；breaking 引出结果；两个不定式 to besiege / to seize 并列修饰 revolutionary path。④翻译要点：中文流水句共用主语，英译以 led 提主干、where 从句收纳后续动作；「开展艰苦卓绝的斗争」转译为 with much extremely hard and bitter struggle 介词短语；「开辟……道路」译为 breaking a revolutionary path...；「农村包围城市，武装夺取政权」译作 to besiege the city from the countryside and to seize power by armed force。⑤易错点：where 不可换 which（从句缺地点状语）；light 的过去式规范为 lit（原文 light 系笔误）；「中国特色」应为 Chinese characteristics（复数）；breaking 是结果状语而非并列谓语，不可误升为谓语动词。
【断句版】In October 1927, | the old generation like Mao Zedong and Zhu De | led the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Army here, | where they created the first rural revolutionary base | with much extremely hard and bitter struggle | and lit the sparks of Chinese revolution, | breaking a revolutionary path | with Chinese characteristic | to besiege the city from the countryside | and to seize power by armed force.
sentences.cut: [[主句 A:In October 1927 S:the old generation like Mao Zedong and Zhu De V:led O:the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Army A:here, [非限制性定语从句 where S:they V:created O:the first rural revolutionary base A:with much extremely hard and bitter struggle and (they) lit O:the sparks of Chinese revolution, [结果状语 breaking O:a revolutionary path [后置定语 with Chinese characteristic] [后置定语 to besiege the city from the countryside and to seize power by armed force]]]]]
phrases: the old generation of revolutionaries　老一辈革命家
the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Army　中国工农红军
rural revolutionary base　农村革命根据地
much extremely hard and bitter struggle　艰苦卓绝的斗争
light the sparks of revolution　点燃革命的星星之火
Chinese revolution　中国革命
besiege the city from the countryside　农村包围城市
seize power by armed force　武装夺取政权
by armed force　以武装（力量）

sentences.en: The bridge is sustained by 281 pillars, each of which has a stone lion on the end and more stone lions hiding on its head, back, abdomen or claws.
sentences.zh: 卢沟桥由281根柱子支撑，每根柱子顶端都立着一头石狮，而更多的狮子藏在这些石狮的头、背、腹部或爪子之上。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文三个短句（由281根柱子支撑／每根柱子上有一头石狮／狮身上藏着更多狮子）英译合并为一句，用 each of which 衔接后两句，「藏着更多狮子」处理为现在分词 hiding 作后置定语，体现英文主干突出。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：①句子主干：The bridge is sustained by 281 pillars（被动语态，主+谓+状语）。②各从句类型与嵌套层次：逗号后「代词+of which」结构 each of which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 pillars；从句内部 has a stone lion... and more stone lions hiding... 为并列宾语结构，hiding 为现在分词作后置定语修饰 more stone lions，构成「主句→each of which 定语从句→从句内并列宾语+分词定语」两层嵌套。③关键连接词/引导词：each of which 引导定语从句，which 指代 pillars，each 在从句中作主语限定（故谓语用单数 has）；and 连接 has 的两个宾语 a stone lion 与 more stone lions。④翻译要点：中文三个短句合并为一句，第二、三句用 each of which 衔接；「藏着更多狮子」不另起谓语，用现在分词 hiding 作定语；「腹部」译 abdomen、「爪子」译 claws。⑤易错点：which 指代 pillars（柱子）而非 stone lions；hiding 的逻辑主语是 more stone lions（狮子藏在石狮身上），不可误译为狮子「躲藏/躲人」；each of which 后接单数谓语 has，主谓一致勿误为 have。
【断句版】The bridge is sustained by 281 pillars, | each of which has a stone lion on the end | and more stone lions hiding | on its head, back, abdomen or claws.
sentences.cut: [[主句（被动） S:The bridge V:is sustained by O:281 pillars, [非限制性定语从句 each of which S:each of which(=each pillar) V:has O:a stone lion on the end and more stone lions [后置定语 hiding on its head, back, abdomen or claws]]]
phrases: be sustained by　由……支撑
281 pillars　281根柱子
each of which　其中每一根（非限制性定语从句）
a stone lion on the end　柱端的一头石狮
more stone lions　更多的狮子
hide on one's head/back/abdomen/claws　藏在头/背/腹/爪上

sentences.en: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, located in southwest China, covers an area of 2.3 million square kilometres and rises over 4,000 metres above the sea level, thus enjoying the reputation as the Roof of the World.
sentences.zh: 青藏高原位于中国西南部，面积约230万平方公里，平均海拔4000米以上，被称为“世界屋脊”。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文四个并列信息（位于/面积/海拔/被称为）用「过去分词定语+并列谓语+现在分词结果状语」重组，避免简单堆砌四个主谓句；「被称为世界屋脊」不译被动，而用 enjoying the reputation as... 更地道。
sentences.parse:
① 句子主干：The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau covers an area of 2.3 million square kilometres and rises over 4,000 metres above the sea level（主语 The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau 带两个并列谓语 covers... and rises...）。② 修饰层次：主语后插入 located in southwest China 过去分词短语作后置定语（= which is located...）→并列谓语 covers... and rises...→句末 thus enjoying the reputation as... 现在分词短语作结果状语；无嵌套从句。③ 关键连接词/引导词：过去分词 located 引出地点定语；并列连词 and 连接 covers 与 rises 两个谓语；副词 thus + 现在分词 enjoying 引出顺承结果，相当于 and thus enjoys。④ 翻译要点：把中文四短句重组为「定语+并列谓语+结果状语」；「面积约230万平方公里」译 covers an area of 2.3 million square kilometres；「平均海拔4000米以上」译 rises over 4,000 metres above the sea level；「被称为世界屋脊」用 enjoying the reputation as...（享有……美誉）。⑤ 易错点：located in 是过去分词作定语，不要误读为谓语动词（真正谓语是 covers/rises）；「世界屋脊」规范译法 the Roof of the World；thus enjoying 的逻辑主语是 the plateau，须译出顺承关系；2.3 million square kilometres = 230万平方公里，单位换算不可错。
【断句版】The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, | located in southwest China, | covers an area of 2.3 million square kilometres | and rises over 4,000 metres above the sea level, | thus enjoying the reputation as the Roof of the World.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau [后置定语 located in southwest China] V:covers O:an area of 2.3 million square kilometres and (it) rises A:over 4,000 metres above the sea level, [结果状语 thus enjoying O:the reputation as the Roof of the World]]]
phrases: the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau　青藏高原
located in southwest China　位于中国西南部
southwest China　中国西南部
cover an area of　面积达……
2.3 million square kilometres　230万平方公里
rise above the sea level　海拔高达
4,000 metres　4000米
enjoy the reputation as　享有……的美誉
the Roof of the World　世界屋脊

sentences.en: Nowadays, government-funded fitness equipment and paved fitness trails can be found everywhere in many cities, significantly improving the conditions of citizens' outdoor activities and making cities more beautiful.
sentences.zh: 如今，政府出资购置的健身器械和铺设的健身步道在不少城市随处可见，既明显改善了市民户外活动的条件，又使城市更加美丽。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文「随处可见」不译 people can see everywhere，而用被动 can be found everywhere，更符合英文客观叙述；「政府出资的」「铺设的」分别前置为复合形容词 government-funded / paved；「既……又……」用 and 连接的两个现在分词结果状语译出。
sentences.parse:
① 句子主干：government-funded fitness equipment and paved fitness trails can be found everywhere in many cities（被动语态主谓；主语为 and 连接的两个并列名词短语，谓语 can be found）。② 修饰层次：句首 Nowadays 时间状语→被动主句→句末两个并列现在分词短语 significantly improving... and making... 作结果状语，二者由 and 并列，共同修饰前面整个句子；无嵌套从句。③ 关键连接词/引导词：被动谓语 can be found（= 人们随处可见）；两个现在分词 improving 与 making 由 and 并列，均表主句带来的结果，相当于 which significantly improves... and makes...。④ 翻译要点：「政府出资购置的」「铺设的」前置为复合形容词 government-funded / paved 修饰名词；「随处可见」用被动 can be found everywhere；「既明显改善……又使……美丽」用 and 连接的现在分词 improving... and making... 译出，译时还原为中文并列分句。⑤ 易错点：can be found 是被动，不可误作主动 can find（器材/步道不能发出 find 动作）；improving 与 making 的逻辑主语是前面整句，须译出结果关系；fitness trails = 健身步道，paved 意为「铺设好的」；citizens' outdoor activities 所有格不可漏 apostrophe。
【断句版】Nowadays, | government-funded fitness equipment and paved fitness trails | can be found everywhere in many cities, | significantly improving the conditions of citizens' outdoor activities | and making cities more beautiful.
sentences.cut: [[主句（被动） A:Nowadays S:government-funded fitness equipment and paved fitness trails V:can be found A:everywhere A:in many cities, [结果状语1 significantly improving O:the conditions of citizens' outdoor activities] and [结果状语2 making O:cities O-C:more beautiful]]]
phrases: government-funded fitness equipment　政府出资购置的健身器械
fitness equipment　健身器械
paved fitness trails　铺设好的健身步道
fitness trails　健身步道
can be found everywhere　随处可见
improve the conditions of outdoor activities　改善户外活动条件
outdoor activities　户外活动
make cities more beautiful　使城市更加美丽

sentences.en: As the host venue for the 9th Asian Winter Games in 2025, Harbin has forged a profound integration of ice and snow culture with sports event IP, drawing a substantial influx of tourists from Russia, Mongolia and other adjacent nations via the cross-border ice and snow tourism cooperation mechanism.
sentences.zh: 作为2025年第九届亚洲冬季运动会的主办地，哈尔滨将冰雪文化与赛事IP深度融合，并通过跨境冰雪旅游合作机制，吸引了俄罗斯、蒙古等周边国家的大量游客。
sentences.parse:
【①句子主干】Harbin（主语） has forged（谓语） a profound integration（宾语） of ice and snow culture with sports event IP，核心骨架＝哈尔滨将冰雪文化与赛事IP深度融合。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】As the host venue for the 9th Asian Winter Games in 2025 介词短语作身份状语置于句首；drawing a substantial influx of tourists... 现在分词短语作结果状语；from Russia, Mongolia and other adjacent nations 介词短语后置定语修饰 tourists；via the cross-border ice and snow tourism cooperation mechanism 介词短语方式状语。层次：身份状语 → 主句（动宾＋of...with...搭配）→ 现在分词结果状语（内含后置定语＋方式状语）。【③关键连接词/引导词】As（作为……，引出主语身份）；现在分词 drawing 表自然结果；via（通过……方式，比 through 更正式）。【④翻译要点】句首 As 短语「作为……主办地」前置顺译；英文 forge integration of A with B 译为中文动宾「将A与B深度融合」；现在分词 drawing 单独成句「吸引了……游客」；via 短语「通过……机制」置于动词前。【⑤易错点】「主办地」host venue/city；「赛事IP」sports event IP（行业术语，勿直译 game intellectual property）；「第九届亚洲冬季运动会」官方译 the 9th Asian Winter Games，勿中式译 Asia Winter Sports Meeting；adjacent nations 周边国家；draw an influx of tourists 吸引游客潮。
【断句版】As the host venue for the 9th Asian Winter Games in 2025, | Harbin has forged a profound integration | of ice and snow culture with sports event IP, | drawing a substantial influx of tourists | from Russia, Mongolia and other adjacent nations | via the cross-border ice and snow tourism cooperation mechanism.
sentences.cut: [[身份状语 As the host venue for the 9th Asian Winter Games in 2025 [[主句 S:Harbin V:has forged O:a profound integration of ice and snow culture with sports event IP, [结果状语 drawing O:a substantial influx of tourists [后置定语 from Russia, Mongolia and other adjacent nations] A:via the cross-border ice and snow tourism cooperation mechanism]]]]]
phrases: host venue　主办地
the 9th Asian Winter Games　第九届亚洲冬季运动会
Harbin　哈尔滨
ice and snow culture　冰雪文化
forge a profound integration of A with B　将A与B深度融合
sports event IP　赛事IP
draw a substantial influx of tourists　吸引大量游客
a substantial influx of　大量涌入
cross-border ice and snow tourism cooperation mechanism　跨境冰雪旅游合作机制
adjacent nations　周边国家

sentences.en: Respecting the elderly serves as a cornerstone for social harmony and development, helping to cultivate a positive social atmosphere and promote the civilized progress of the entire society.
sentences.zh: 尊老是社会和谐与发展的重要基石，有助于培育良好的社会氛围，推动整个社会文明进步。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：Respecting the elderly serves as a cornerstone for social harmony and development（动名词短语 Respecting the elderly 作主语，主系表结构 serves as）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 Respecting the elderly 为动名词短语作主语；句末 helping to cultivate a positive social atmosphere and promote the civilized progress of the entire society 为现在分词短语作伴随/结果状语，其中 cultivate 与 promote 由 and 连接并列。层次：动名词主语→主干→现在分词伴随状语（内含并列动词）。③关键连接词/引导词：serves as「充当/是」；and 连接 cultivate 与 promote；helping to 表伴随结果。④翻译要点：动名词主语直接译为「尊老」；helping to 译为「有助于……」承接主干；英文一句拆为中文流水句，不增主语。⑤易错点：cornerstone 译「基石」而非「角落石头」；civilized progress 译「文明进步」；helping 的逻辑主语是「尊老」这件事，不是某个名词。
【断句版】Respecting the elderly | serves as a cornerstone | for social harmony and development, | helping to cultivate a positive social atmosphere | and promote the civilized progress of the entire society.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Respecting the elderly(动名词短语) V:serves as C:a cornerstone A:for social harmony and development, [伴随/结果状语 helping to cultivate O:a positive social atmosphere and promote O:the civilized progress of the entire society]]]
phrases: respecting the elderly　尊老

sentences.en: In ancient China, due to low productivity, our ancestors were deeply aware of the hard-earned nature involved in creating the fruits of labor and thus upheld the principle of thrift.
sentences.zh: 在中国古代，由于生产力低下，先人们深知劳动成果来之不易，因而秉持节俭的理念。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：our ancestors were deeply aware of the hard-earned nature... and thus upheld the principle of thrift（主语 our ancestors，and 连接两个并列谓语：were deeply aware of 与 upheld）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：In ancient China 为时间状语；due to low productivity 介词短语作原因状语；involved in creating the fruits of labor 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 the hard-earned nature。层次：原因状语→主干并列谓语→其中宾语 the hard-earned nature 内嵌过去分词后置定语。③关键连接词/引导词：due to「由于」表原因；and thus「因而」表因果递进；involved in「涉及/关乎」。④翻译要点：due to 提前译为「由于生产力低下」；the hard-earned nature involved in creating the fruits of labor 意译为「劳动成果来之不易」；thus 译「因而」，体现因果。⑤易错点：hard-earned 修饰 nature 而非 fruits；fruits of labor 为固定搭配「劳动成果」；uphold the principle of thrift 译「秉持节俭的理念」。
【断句版】In ancient China, | due to low productivity, | our ancestors were deeply aware of the hard-earned nature | involved in creating the fruits of labor | and thus upheld the principle of thrift.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In ancient China, [原因状语 due to low productivity] [[主句 S:our ancestors V:were deeply aware of O:the hard-earned nature [后置定语 involved in creating the fruits of labor] and thus V:upheld O:the principle of thrift]]]
phrases: in ancient China　在中国古代
due to low productivity　由于生产力低下
low productivity　生产力低下
our ancestors　先人
be deeply aware of　深知
hard-earned nature　来之不易
the fruits of labor　劳动成果
and thus　因而
uphold the principle of thrift　秉持节俭的理念

sentences.en: E-commerce has broken down the information barrier between urban and rural areas, expanded the sales channels of agricultural products, and helped rural residents increase their incomes and improve their lives.
sentences.zh: 电子商务打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒，拓宽了农产品的销售渠道，帮助农村居民增加收入，改善生活。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：E-commerce has broken down..., expanded..., and helped...（主语 E-commerce 后接三个现在完成时并列谓语 has broken down / has expanded / has helped）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：between urban and rural areas 介词短语后置修饰 barrier；of agricultural products 介词短语后置修饰 channels；increase their incomes and improve their lives 为不带 to 的不定式作 helped 的宾语补足语（help sb do）。层次：主语→三个并列谓语→各自带后置定语/宾补。③关键连接词/引导词：and 连接最后一个谓语 helped；and 连接 increase 与 improve 作宾补；has+过去分词表现在完成。④翻译要点：三个并列谓语按中文流水句顺译「打破了……，拓宽了……，帮助……」；help sb do 译「帮助某人做某事」。⑤易错点：information barrier 译「信息壁垒」；sales channels 译「销售渠道」；三个并列谓语时态须一致（现在完成时 has+p.p.）。
【断句版】E-commerce has broken down the information barrier | between urban and rural areas, | expanded the sales channels of agricultural products, | and helped rural residents | increase their incomes | and improve their lives.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:E-commerce V:has broken down O:the information barrier [后置定语 between urban and rural areas], (has) expanded O:the sales channels [后置定语 of agricultural products], and (has) helped O:rural residents O-C:increase their incomes and improve their lives.]]
phrases: e-commerce　电子商务
break down the information barrier　打破信息壁垒
information barrier　信息壁垒
urban and rural areas　城乡
expand sales channels　拓宽销售渠道
sales channels　销售渠道
agricultural products　农产品
rural residents　农村居民
increase their incomes and improve their lives　增收改善生活

sentences.src: 六级·2018.12·阅读长难句·可教代理情感强调句
sentences.en: Above all, it's the emotions one experiences in teaching that facilitate learning.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，一个人在教学过程中所体验到的情感，才是促进学习的关键。
sentences.note: 断句版：Above all, | it's the emotions | one experiences in teaching | that facilitate learning.
