sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：这是It is...that...强调句，被强调部分是主语the emotions。还原为正常语序：the emotions (that one experiences in teaching) facilitate learning。②从句类型与嵌套层次：the emotions后接省略关系代词that/which的限制性定语从句(that) one experiences in teaching；强调框架it's...that facilitate learning中that是强调句引导词。③关键连接词/引导词：It is...that...（强调句框架）；定语从句省略了作宾语的关系代词that/which（指代emotions，作experiences的宾语，故可省）。④翻译要点：强调句译“正是……才……”；省略定从前置译“一个人在教学中所体验到的情感”；facilitate learning译“促进学习”。⑤易错点：分清两个that——一个是强调句引导词（不充当成分），一个是被省略的定从关系代词（作experiences的宾语）；facilitate是及物动词“促进”，勿与facility混淆。 断句版：Above all, | it's the emotions | one experiences in teaching | that facilitate learning.
sentences.cut: [[强调句框架 S:it's C:the emotions [限制性定语从句 (that) one experiences in teaching] that V:facilitate O:learning]]
phrases: above all　最重要的是
teachable agent　可教代理（教学智能体）
facilitate learning　促进学习
experience emotions　体验情感
student tutor　学生导师
derive pride and satisfaction　获得自豪与满足

sentences.src: 六级·2019.12·阅读长难句·态度力量母亲采访
sentences.en: When her mother was interviewed, three weeks after her daughter's birth, she was asked if she was prepared for what might be a daunting task caring for her.
sentences.zh: 当女儿出生三周后，她的母亲接受采访时，被问及是否已为照顾女儿这一或许令人生畏的任务做好了准备。
sentences.note: 断句版：When her mother was interviewed, | three weeks after her daughter's birth, | she was asked | if she was prepared for | what might be a daunting task | caring for her.
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：she was asked if...——主句被动语态，主语she，谓语was asked，后接if引导的宾语从句（间接问句）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首When引导时间状语从句When her mother was interviewed（含插入语three weeks after...）；asked后接if宾语从句if she was prepared for...；for后接what引导的名词性从句what might be a daunting task caring for her（what作连接代词，在从句中作主语）；caring for her是现在分词短语作后置定语修饰task。③关键连接词/引导词：When（时间）；if（是否，宾语从句）；what（连接代词，引导名词性从句并作从句主语）。④翻译要点：时间状语从句前置译“当……时”；if宾语从句译“是否……”；what名词性从句译“这一或许令人生畏的任务”；caring for her前置译“照顾女儿的”。⑤易错点：what引导名词性从句时既作连接词又在从句中充当主语（=the thing that），勿当作普通疑问词；she指代the mother，her指代the daughter；daunting意为“令人生畏的”。 断句版：When her mother was interviewed, | three weeks after her daughter's birth, | she was asked | if she was prepared for | what might be a daunting task | caring for her.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语从句 When her mother was interviewed, [插入语 three weeks after her daughter's birth,] ] [主句 S:she V:was asked O:if she was prepared for [名词性从句 what might be a daunting task [现在分词后置定语 caring for her]](宾语从句)]]
phrases: be interviewed　接受采访
be prepared for　为……做好准备
a daunting task　令人生畏的任务
care for her　照顾她
without hesitation　毫不犹豫
attitude　态度
psychological tool　心理工具

sentences.src: 六级·2021.6·阅读长难句·绘画天赋而非艺术
sentences.en: Rather than think of drawing as a talent that some creative people are gifted in, we should consider it as a tool for seeing and understanding the world better — one that just so happens to double as an art form.
sentences.zh: 我们不应把绘画看作某些富有创造力的人天生具备的才能，而应把它视作一种更好地观察和理解世界的工具——一种恰好同时充当艺术形式的工具。
sentences.note: 断句版：Rather than think of drawing as a talent | that some creative people are gifted in, | we should consider it as a tool | for seeing and understanding the world better | — one that just so happens to double as an art form.
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：we should consider it as a tool——主句主谓宾宾补，主语we，谓语should consider，宾语it（指代drawing），宾补as a tool。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首Rather than think of drawing as a talent是并列比较结构（rather than置于句首）；talent后接that引导的限制性定语从句that some creative people are gifted in；破折号后one作a tool的同位语，后接that引导的限制性定语从句that just so happens to double as an art form。③关键连接词/引导词：Rather than（并列比较，“而非”）；that（定从，指代talent，作in的宾语）；one（代词，指代a tool，作同位语）；that（定从，指代one，作主语）。④翻译要点：Rather than前置译“我们不应……而应……”；that定从前置译“某些有创造力的人天生具备的（才能）”；one that...同位语另起译“——一种恰好兼作艺术形式的工具”。⑤易错点：be gifted in中in与that搭配（that作in的宾语），勿漏in；one指代a tool而非drawing；double as意为“兼作”；rather than后接动词原形think。 断句版：Rather than think of drawing as a talent | that some creative people are gifted in, | we should consider it as a tool | for seeing and understanding the world better | — one that just so happens to double as an art form.
sentences.cut: [[并列比较状语 Rather than think of drawing as a talent [限制性定语从句 that some creative people are gifted in,] ] [主句 S:we V:should consider O:it C:as a tool for seeing and understanding the world better [同位语 one [限制性定语从句 that just so happens to double as an art form]]]]
phrases: rather than　而不是
think of A as B　把A看作B
be gifted in　在……有天赋
misclassification　错误归类
double as　兼作
art form　艺术形式
creative people　有创造力的人

sentences.src: 六级·2022.6·阅读长难句·精英院校辩护
sentences.en: Such charges ignore the fact that these institutions continue to prepare students for success in their work, for thoughtful engagement in civic life, for lifelong learning, and for understanding the world and those with whom they live.
sentences.zh: 这些指责忽视了一个事实：这些院校持续地帮学生做好准备——为他们的职业成功、为他们深思熟虑地参与公民生活、为终身学习，也为理解这个世界以及与他们共同生活的人。
sentences.note: 断句版：Such charges ignore the fact | that these institutions continue to prepare students | for success in their work, | for thoughtful engagement in civic life, | for lifelong learning, | and for understanding the world | and those with whom they live.
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：Such charges ignore the fact——主句主谓宾，主语Such charges，谓语ignore，宾语the fact。②从句类型与嵌套层次：the fact后接that引导的同位语从句，解释fact的内容；同位语从句主干these institutions continue to prepare students for A, for B, for C, and for D（四个for短语排比并列）；最后一个for短语中those后接“介词+whom”引导的定语从句with whom they live（=who they live with）。③关键连接词/引导词：that（同位语从句引导词，不可省）；with whom（介词+关系代词，修饰those）；四个for并列排比。④翻译要点：同位语从句用冒号引出，顺译；四个for排比保留“为……、为……、为……、也为……”；with whom they live译“与他们共同生活的人”。⑤易错点：that在此引导同位语从句（解释fact内容），而非定语从句——区别在于that不充当从句成分；with whom中whom不可换成who；四个for并列要数清。 断句版：Such charges ignore the fact | that these institutions continue to prepare students | for success in their work, | for thoughtful engagement in civic life, | for lifelong learning, | and for understanding the world | and those with whom they live.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Such charges V:ignore O:the fact [同位语从句 that these institutions continue to prepare students [介词短语排比 for success in their work, for thoughtful engagement in civic life, for lifelong learning, and for understanding the world and those [限制性定语从句 with whom they live]]]]]
phrases: such charges　这些指责
ignore the fact that　忽视这样一个事实
prepare students for　帮学生为……做准备
thoughtful engagement in civic life　深思熟虑地参与公民生活
lifelong learning　终身学习
those with whom they live　与他们共同生活的人
selective colleges and universities　选拔性院校

sentences.src: 六级·2023.12·阅读长难句·减税世界观强调句
sentences.en: It was in the context of this worldview that it became popular to argue that tax cuts would drive prosperity.
sentences.zh: 正是在这种世界观的背景下，认为减税将推动繁荣的观点才开始流行起来。
sentences.note: 断句版：It was in the context of this worldview | that it became popular | to argue | that tax cuts would drive prosperity.
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：It was...that...强调句，被强调部分是背景状语in the context of this worldview。还原：it became popular to argue that tax cuts would drive prosperity in the context of this worldview。②从句类型与嵌套层次：强调句框架内，主句是it became popular——it是形式主语，真正主语是不定式短语to argue that tax cuts would drive prosperity；to argue后接that引导的宾语从句that tax cuts would drive prosperity。③关键连接词/引导词：It was...that...（强调句框架，强调状语）；it（形式主语）；that（宾语从句，作argue的宾语）。④翻译要点：强调句译“正是在……背景下，……才……”；形式主语it不译，把真正主语“认为减税推动繁荣的观点”前置；that宾语从句顺译。⑤易错点：这是强调句而非主语从句——判断依据是去掉It was...that后句子仍完整（it became popular to argue... in the context...）；it既是强调框架的it又是形式主语，双重身份；argue在此译“认为、主张”。 断句版：It was in the context of this worldview | that it became popular | to argue | that tax cuts would drive prosperity.
sentences.cut: [[强调句框架 It was [被强调状语 in the context of this worldview] that [主句 S:it(形式主语) V:became C:popular [真正主语 to argue [宾语从句 that tax cuts would drive prosperity]]]]]
phrases: in the context of　在……背景下
worldview　世界观
it became popular to...　……开始流行
argue that　认为/主张
tax cuts　减税
drive prosperity　推动繁荣
conventional wisdom　传统观点

sentences.src: 六级·2025.6·阅读长难句·旷课作为危机信号
sentences.en: His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement.
sentences.zh: 他的公开信指出，一年中无论出于何种原因——无论准假还是无故——缺课达到上课天数的10%，都是学业成绩低下的主要原因。
sentences.note: 断句版：His open letter stated | that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason | —excused or unexcused— | is a primary cause of low academic achievement.
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：His open letter stated that...——主句主谓宾，主语His open letter，谓语stated，宾语是that引导的宾语从句。②从句类型与嵌套层次：宾语从句主干是missing 10% of school days...is a primary cause of low academic achievement——动名词短语missing 10% of school days作从句主语，系动词is，表语a primary cause；主谓之间被破折号插入语excused or unexcused割裂。③关键连接词/引导词：that（宾语从句引导词）；破折号插入语excused or unexcused补充说明for any reason。④翻译要点：that宾语从句顺译；动名词主语missing 10%...译“缺课达到10%”；插入语“无论准假还是无故”提前；a primary cause of low academic achievement译“学业成绩低下的主要原因”。⑤易错点：动名词短语missing...作主语，谓语用单数is；插入语excused or unexcused割裂主谓，找主干时先跳过插入语；excused（准假的）与unexcused（无故的）是反义派生。 断句版：His open letter stated | that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason | —excused or unexcused— | is a primary cause of low academic achievement.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:His open letter V:stated O:that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason [插入语 —excused or unexcused—] V:is C:a primary cause of low academic achievement(宾语从句)]]
phrases: open letter　公开信
state that　指出/声明
missing 10% of school days　缺课10%（动名词短语作主语）
excused or unexcused　准假的或无故的
a primary cause of　……的主要原因
low academic achievement　学业成绩低下
chronically absent　长期缺勤

sentences.en: In the 1920s, influenced by Western clothing, it embraced many changes, for example, narrower the cuffs and shorter the dress.
sentences.zh: 上世纪20年代，受西方服饰的影响，旗袍发生了一些变化，例如袖口变窄、袍身变短。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：it（主语，指代 Qipao）embraced（谓语）many changes（宾语）。in the 1920s 为时间状语置于句首。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。influenced by Western clothing 为过去分词短语作原因状语，插入主谓之间；for example 后接两个并列的名词化短语 narrower the cuffs and shorter the dress 作 changes 的同位举例。层次：时间状语(in the 1920s)→[分词状语 influenced by Western clothing]→主句(it embraced many changes)→[举例 for example, ...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：过去分词 influenced by 表被动原因「受……影响」；for example 为举例插入语；and 连接 cuffs 与 dress 两个并列名词短语。
④ 翻译要点：「受西方服饰的影响」用过去分词 influenced by Western clothing 前置作状语，避免另起一句；「袖口变窄、袍身变短」按英文习惯译为 narrower the cuffs and shorter the dress（比较级形容词前置倒装式列举），与前句「旗袍发生变化」形成总分。
⑤ 易错点：it 指代 Qipao（单数），谓语用 embraces/embraced 勿用复数；embrace 此处意为「包含、接纳（变化）」，勿误作「拥抱」；分词短语的逻辑主语必须是主句主语 it（旗袍），勿悬垂。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：In the 1920s, | influenced by Western clothing, | it embraced many changes, | for example, narrower the cuffs and shorter the dress.
sentences.cut: [时间状语 In the 1920s, [原因状语 influenced by Western clothing, [主句 S:it V:embraced O:many changes]] [举例插入 for example, narrower the cuffs and shorter the dress]]
phrases: be influenced by　受……的影响
embrace changes　经历/接纳变化
the cuffs　袖口
robe / dress length　袍身/衣长
for example　例如（举例插入语）

sentences.en: It is usually the first choice for Chinese women as they attend social parties.
sentences.zh: 中国女性出席重要社交聚会时，旗袍往往是她们的首选。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：It（主语，指代 Qipao）is（系动词）the first choice（表语）for Chinese women（介词短语作后置定语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：as they attend social parties 为 as 引导的时间状语从句，置于句末。层次：主句(主系表)→[时间状语从句 as...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：as 此处为连词「当……时」，引导时间状语从句，相当于 when；for 为介词引出选择者「对……而言」。
④ 翻译要点：「中国女性出席重要社交聚会时」处理为 as 时间状语从句；「旗袍往往是她们的首选」译文以 It 作形式主语指代 Qipao，「首选」the first choice 为高频搭配；中文无主句时补出形式主语 it。
⑤ 易错点：as 此处是连词不是介词，后接完整从句 they attend...，勿误接动名词；first choice 后接 for sb，勿用 of sb；social parties 指社交聚会，勿直译「party=政党」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：It is usually the first choice | for Chinese women | as they attend social parties.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:It V:is C:the first choice [后置定语 for Chinese women] [时间状语从句 as S:they V:attend O:social parties]]
phrases: the first choice for sb　某人的首选
attend social parties　出席社交聚会
as 引导时间状语从句　当……时
usually　往往、通常

sentences.en: In order to catch up with the developed countries in the world in science and technology as soon as possible, China has increased dramatically in recent years.
sentences.zh: 为了在科学技术上尽快赶超世界发达国家，中国近年来大幅度增加了投入。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：China（主语）has increased（谓语）。句首 In order to... 为目的状语短语。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。In order to catch up with... 为不定式短语作目的状语，置于句首表强调；其中 in the world 与 in science and technology 为两个介词短语分别作后置定语/范围状语，as soon as possible 为插入式时间状语。层次：[目的状语 In order to catch up with... ]→主句。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：In order to（不定式符号，表目的「为了」）；catch up with 为固定短语「赶上、赶超」；as soon as possible 为固定插入语「尽快」。
④ 翻译要点：「为了在科学技术上尽快赶超世界发达国家」整段处理为句首不定式目的状语 In order to catch up with the developed countries in the world in science and technology as soon as possible，符合英文「目的前置」的强调写法；「大幅度增加」has increased dramatically（副词 dramatically 修饰动词）。
⑤ 易错点：in order to 后接动词原形，勿接句子；catch up with 是短语动词勿漏 with；多个介词短语 in the world / in science and technology 顺序勿乱，范围从小到大；本参考译文中 increased 后省略宾语（研究开发资金），英译实写时宜补出（R&D funding）。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：In order to catch up with the developed countries in the world | in science and technology | as soon as possible, | China has increased dramatically in recent years.
sentences.cut: [目的状语 In order to [catch up with O:the developed countries [范围 in the world] [范围 in science and technology] [插入 as soon as possible]] , [主句 S:China V:has increased O:(funding, 承前省略) A:dramatically in recent years]]
phrases: in order to　为了（表目的）
catch up with　赶上、赶超
developed countries　发达国家
as soon as possible　尽快
increase dramatically　大幅度增加

sentences.en: At the same time, either in products or business models, Chinese entrepreneurs are also trying to be the pioneers of innovation, aiming at adapting to consumers' market, which has constantly changing and growing demand both at home and abroad.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，无论在产品还是商业模式上，中国企业家也在努力争做创新的先锋，以适应国内外消费市场不断变化和增长的需求。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Chinese entrepreneurs（主语）are trying（谓语）to be the pioneers of innovation（不定式作宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：either in products or business models 为并列介词短语作范围状语插入句首；aiming at adapting to consumers' market 为现在分词短语作伴随/目的状语；其中 which has constantly changing and growing demand both at home and abroad 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰 consumers' market。层次：[伴随状语 At the same time, either...or...]→主句→[分词状语 aiming at...]→[定语从句 which...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：either...or...（并列连词，「无论……还是……」）；现在分词 aiming at 表伴随目的；which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面的 consumers' market。
④ 翻译要点：「无论在产品还是商业模式上」用 either in products or business models 并列介词短语前置；「争做创新的先锋」try to be the pioneers of innovation；「以适应……需求」用现在分词 aiming at adapting to... 作伴随状语，避免再加一句；「国内外」both at home and abroad 后置。
⑤ 易错点：either...or... 连接两个并列成分，结构须对称（in products / in business models，本句省略第二个 in）；which 指代 market 为单数，从句谓语用 has；adapt to 中 to 为介词，后接名词/动名词；pioneer 后接 of 勿用 for。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：At the same time, | either in products or business models, | Chinese entrepreneurs are also trying to be the pioneers of innovation, | aiming at adapting to consumers' market, | which has constantly changing and growing demand both at home and abroad.
sentences.cut: [伴随状语 At the same time, [范围状语 either in products or business models], [主句 S:Chinese entrepreneurs V:are trying O:to be the pioneers of innovation] [分词目的状语 aiming at adapting to O:consumers' market] [非限制性定语从句 which S:has O:constantly changing and growing demand [地点 both at home and abroad]]
phrases: either...or...　无论……还是……
business models　商业模式
the pioneers of innovation　创新的先锋
aim at doing　旨在、以……为目标
adapt to　适应
both at home and abroad　国内外

sentences.en: Shenzhen, a newly-developing city in Guangdong Province, China, was only a fishing village with about 30,000 population before the Reform and Opening up.
sentences.zh: 深圳是中国广东省一座新开发的城市，在改革开放之前不过是一个仅有三万多人口的小渔村。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Shenzhen（主语）was（系动词）a fishing village（表语）。a newly-developing city in Guangdong Province, China 为主语 Shenzhen 的同位语，插在主谓之间。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。a newly-developing city... 为名词同位语；with about 30,000 population 为介词 with 短语作后置定语修饰 fishing village；before the Reform and Opening up 为介词短语作时间状语。层次：[主语+同位语 Shenzhen, a newly-developing city...]→主句谓语 was a fishing village→[后置定语 with...]→[时间状语 before...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：无从句引导词；with 短语表「带有、具有」作后置定语；before 为介词表时间。
④ 翻译要点：「中国广东省一座新开发的城市」处理为主语 Shenzhen 的同位语 a newly-developing city in Guangdong Province, China，置于主语后用逗号隔开，符合英文同位语习惯；「仅有三万多人口」用 with about 30,000 population 后置定语；「改革开放之前」before the Reform and Opening up。
⑤ 易错点：同位语与所指名词之间要用逗号隔开；population 前用 with 表「拥有人口」，勿误写 has population；「小渔村」a fishing village，勿漏冠词；newly-developing 为复合形容词，副词+分词。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Shenzhen, | a newly-developing city in Guangdong Province, China, | was only a fishing village | with about 30,000 population | before the Reform and Opening up.
sentences.cut: [主语 S:Shenzhen [同位语 a newly-developing city in Guangdong Province, China], [主句 V:was C:only a fishing village [后置定语 with about 30,000 population]] [时间状语 before the Reform and Opening up]]
phrases: newly-developing city　新开发的城市
a fishing village　渔村
with a population of　拥有……人口
the Reform and Opening up　改革开放
同位语结构　名词后用逗号隔开补充说明

sentences.en: Shenzhen's unique geographic position brings both domestic and overseas entrepreneurs an ideal place to start their career.
sentences.zh: 深圳独特的地理位置为国内外企业家提供了一个创业的理想之地。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Shenzhen's unique geographic position（主语）brings（谓语）both domestic and overseas entrepreneurs（间接宾语）an ideal place（直接宾语）——bring sb sth 双宾语结构。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。to start their career 为不定式短语作后置定语修饰 an ideal place。层次：主句（双宾语 bring sb sth）→[后置定语 to start their career]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：无引导词；both...and... 连接 domestic and overseas 两个并列形容词；不定式 to start 作后置定语相当于定语从句 where they can start...。
④ 翻译要点：原文「深圳也是国内企业家创业的理想之地」译文用 bring sb an ideal place 的双宾语结构，把「地理位置」作主语，中文「深圳」转译为「深圳的地理位置」；「国内外企业家」both domestic and overseas entrepreneurs；「创业」start their career。
⑤ 易错点：bring 后接双宾语 bring sb sth=bring sth to sb，勿漏介词；domestic and overseas 对应「国内外」，overseas 此处作形容词；to start their career 为后置定语，勿误作目的状语；entrepreneur 为可数名词，泛指用复数。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Shenzhen's unique geographic position | brings both domestic and overseas entrepreneurs | an ideal place | to start their career.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Shenzhen's unique geographic position V:brings [间接宾语 both domestic and overseas entrepreneurs] [直接宾语 an ideal place] [后置定语 to start their career]]
phrases: geographic position　地理位置
bring sb sth　给某人带来某物（双宾语）
domestic and overseas entrepreneurs　国内外企业家
an ideal place to do　做……的理想之地
start one's career　创业、开始职业生涯

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the rapid development in Chinese tourism as a result of a flourishing economy, which also leads to the rise of affluent middle class, has seen an unprecedented boom in travelling.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于经济繁荣、富裕中产阶级的崛起，中国旅游业的快速发展迎来了前所未有的旅游热潮。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：the rapid development in Chinese tourism（主语）has seen（谓语）an unprecedented boom in travelling（宾语）。has seen 为拟人化用法「见证、迎来」。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：as a result of a flourishing economy 为介词短语作原因状语插入主谓之间；which also leads to the rise of affluent middle class 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，插入在原因状语之后、谓语之前，补充说明经济繁荣的另一结果。层次：转折副词 Nevertheless→[主语+原因状语+定语从句插入]→谓语 has seen+宾语。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：as a result of（介词短语「由于」）；which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整句 a flourishing economy（经济繁荣）；leads to 为短语动词「导致、引发」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「经济的繁荣和富裕中产阶级的出现，引发了……」译文拆分：主干 the rapid development...has seen an unprecedented boom，把「经济繁荣」处理为 as a result of 原因状语，「中产阶级崛起」用 which 定语从句插入；「迎来/见证」用 has seen 拟人化表达，比 has triggered 更地道。
⑤ 易错点：定语从句 which 插入主谓之间，切分时勿把它误判为谓语；has seen 主语是 development（单数），勿用 have；as a result of 后接名词勿接句子；boom 与 boom 重复为参考译文瑕疵，实写可换 upsurge。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Nevertheless, | the rapid development in Chinese tourism | as a result of a flourishing economy, | which also leads to the rise of affluent middle class, | has seen an unprecedented boom in travelling.
sentences.cut: [转折 Nevertheless, [主语 S:the rapid development in Chinese tourism [原因状语 as a result of a flourishing economy,] [非限制性定语从句 which also leads to the rise of affluent middle class] V:has seen O:an unprecedented boom in travelling]]
phrases: as a result of　由于、作为……的结果
a flourishing economy　经济繁荣
lead to　导致、引发
the affluent middle class　富裕的中产阶级
unprecedented　前所未有的
has seen a boom　迎来热潮（拟人化）

sentences.en: It is estimated by the WTO that by 2020, China will be the largest tourism country which will witness a rapid increase in the outbound tourism expenditures.
sentences.zh: 据世界贸易组织估计，到2020年中国将成为世界上最大的旅游国，其出境旅游支出将快速增长。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：It（形式主语）is estimated（谓语被动）by the WTO（状语）。真正主语为 that 引导的主语从句。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：第一层为 that 引导的主语从句（真正主语），内部主干 China will be the largest tourism country；其中 which will witness a rapid increase in the outbound tourism expenditures 为 which 引导的限制性定语从句，修饰 the largest tourism country。层次：主句(It is estimated by the WTO that...)→[主语从句 China will be...]→[定语从句 which will witness...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：It 为形式主语，that 引导真正的主语从句；which 引导定语从句指代 tourism country；by 引出动作执行者 WTO。
④ 翻译要点：「据世界贸易组织估计」用 It is estimated by the WTO that... 被动形式主语句型，符合英文科技/报道文体；「到2020年」by 2020；「将成为最大旅游国」will be the largest tourism country；「出境旅游支出增长最快」用 which will witness a rapid increase in outbound tourism expenditures 定语从句承接。
⑤ 易错点：It 为形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句，勿把 it 译为「它」；by 2020 与将来时 will be 连用；which 指代 country（单数），定语从句谓语用 will witness；outbound tourism 为术语「出境旅游」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：It is estimated by the WTO | that by 2020, | China will be the largest tourism country | which will witness a rapid increase in the outbound tourism expenditures.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:It(形式主语) V:is estimated [状语 by the WTO] [主语从句 that [状语 by 2020] S:China V:will be C:the largest tourism country [定语从句 which V:will witness O:a rapid increase [定语 in the outbound tourism expenditures]]]]
phrases: It is estimated that...　据估计……（形式主语句型）
the WTO (World Tourism Organization)　世界旅游组织
outbound tourism expenditures　出境旅游支出
witness a rapid increase　见证快速增长

sentences.en: Accompanied by the economic boom in China, the number of people learning Chinese is growing rapidly, making Chinese the most welcomed language in the world.
sentences.zh: 随着中国经济的蓬勃发展，学汉语的人数迅速增加，使汉语成为世界上最受欢迎的语言之一。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：the number of people learning Chinese（主语）is growing（谓语）rapidly（状语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 Accompanied by the economic boom in China 为过去分词短语作伴随状语；learning Chinese 为现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 people；句末 making Chinese the most welcomed language in the world 为现在分词短语作结果状语。层次：[伴随状语 Accompanied by...]→主句→[结果状语 making...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：过去分词 Accompanied by 表「随着、伴随着」；现在分词 making 表自然而然的结果「使……」；the number of... 作主语谓语用单数。
④ 翻译要点：「随着中国经济蓬勃发展」用过去分词 Accompanied by... 前置；「学汉语的人数」the number of people learning Chinese（分词 learning 后置定语）；「使汉语成为……」用现在分词 making Chinese the most welcomed language... 作结果状语，避免另起一句。
⑤ 易错点：the number of... 作中心词谓语用单数 is growing，勿与 a number of（复数谓语）混淆；making 的逻辑主语是前面整句（人数增加这件事），勿悬垂；the most welcomed language 后宜补 one of（之一）。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Accompanied by the economic boom in China, | the number of people learning Chinese | is growing rapidly, | making Chinese the most welcomed language in the world.
sentences.cut: [伴随状语 Accompanied by the economic boom in China, [主句 S:the number of people [后置定语 learning Chinese] V:is growing A:rapidly] [结果状语 making O:Chinese O.C:the most welcomed language [地点 in the world]]]
phrases: be accompanied by　伴随着、随同
economic boom　经济蓬勃发展
the number of...　……的数量（谓语用单数）
learn Chinese　学汉语
making sth sth　使某物成为某物（结果状语）

sentences.en: Their choices in what they learn is not limited to Chinese language and culture but include majors like science and engineering.
sentences.zh: 他们学习的科目已不再限于中国语言和文化，而包括科学与工程等专业。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Their choices（主语）is not limited to... but include...（并列谓语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：in what they learn 为 what 引导的宾语从句（作介词 in 的宾语），嵌套在主语部分；not limited to... but include... 为 not...but... 并列结构连接两个并列谓语（to Chinese language and culture / majors like science and engineering）。层次：主语 Their choices +[介词宾语从句 in what they learn]→并列谓语 not limited to... but include...。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：what 引导名词性从句作介词 in 的宾语（「所……的（科目）」）；not...but...（「不是……而是……」，此处 not limited to...but include 表「不仅限于……还包括」）。
④ 翻译要点：「他们学习的科目」处理为 Their choices in what they learn（what 引导宾语从句作介词宾语）；「已不再限于……而包括」用 not limited to...but include... 并列结构，比 not only...but also 更贴原文「不再限于」。
⑤ 易错点：what 从句作介词 in 的宾语，what 在从句中作 learn 的宾语，勿用 that；not...but... 两端结构须对称；本参考译文主语 choices 为复数却接 is，实写宜改 are；science and engineering 指「科学与工程（学科）」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Their choices | in what they learn | is not limited to Chinese language and culture | but include majors like science and engineering.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Their choices [介词宾语从句 in what S:they V:learn] V:not limited to O:Chinese language and culture] [并列连词 but V:include O:majors like science and engineering]
phrases: what 引导名词性从句　所……的（事物）
be limited to　局限于
not...but...　不是……而是……
Chinese language and culture　中国语言和文化
science and engineering　科学与工程（学科）

sentences.en: China provides 20 percent of the world food, though its agriculture land only accounts for 10% of the world's total.
sentences.zh: 中国生产了世界20%的粮食，尽管其耕地仅占世界总量的10%。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：China（主语）provides（谓语）20 percent of the world food（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：though its agriculture land only accounts for 10% of the world's total 为 though 引导的让步状语从句，置于句末。层次：主句(主谓宾)→[让步状语从句 though...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：though（连词「尽管、虽然」，引导让步状语从句，不与 but 连用）；accounts for 为短语动词「占（比例）」。
④ 翻译要点：「尽管其耕地仅占世界总量的10%」用 though 引导让步状语从句后置，符合英文「主句在前、让步在后」的习惯；「占（比例）」用 account for；「世界总量」the world's total（total 作名词代指耕地总量，避免重复 farmland）。
⑤ 易错点：though/although 引导让步状语从句时，主句前不可再加 but；account for 表「占比例」为固定搭配，勿用 occupy；the world's total 中 total 为名词，勿误写 totally；agriculture land 应为 farmland/agricultural land（参考译文小疵）。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：China provides 20 percent of the world food, | though its agriculture land only accounts for 10% of the world's total.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:China V:provides O:20 percent of the world food, [让步状语从句 though S:its agriculture land V:only accounts for O:10% of the world's total]]
phrases: though 引导让步状语从句　尽管、虽然
account for　占（比例）
the world's total　世界总量
agricultural land / farmland　耕地
percent of　……百分比

sentences.en: Long before the use of machinery and fertilizers, industrious and creative farmers had already used different kinds of methods to increase crop yields.
sentences.zh: 早在使用机械和化肥之前，勤劳而富有创造力的农民就已经采用各种不同的方法来提高农作物产量。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：industrious and creative farmers（主语）had already used（谓语，过去完成时）different kinds of methods（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：Long before the use of machinery and fertilizers 为介词短语作时间状语，置于句首强调「早在……之前」；to increase crop yields 为不定式短语作目的状语置于句末。层次：[时间状语 Long before...]→主句(主谓宾)→[目的状语 to increase...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：Long before（介词短语「早在……之前」，比 before 语气更强）；不定式 to increase 表目的。
④ 翻译要点：「早在使用机械和化肥之前」用 Long before the use of... 前置时间状语，与过去完成时 had already used 呼应（表「过去的过去」）；「勤劳而富有创造力的农民」industrious and creative farmers 两个形容词并列作前置定语；「以提高农作物产量」to increase crop yields 不定式目的状语收尾。
⑤ 易错点：Long before 后接名词/动名词（the use of...），勿接句子；主句用过去完成时 had already used，因动作发生在「使用机械」这一过去时间之前；industrious 与 creative 并列修饰 farmers；crop yields 为术语「农作物产量」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Long before the use of machinery and fertilizers, | industrious and creative farmers | had already used different kinds of methods | to increase crop yields.
sentences.cut: [时间状语 Long before the use of machinery and fertilizers, [主句 S:industrious and creative farmers V:had already used O:different kinds of methods] [目的状语 to increase O:crop yields]]
phrases: long before　早在……之前
machinery and fertilizers　机械与化肥
industrious and creative　勤劳而富有创造力的
different kinds of　各种各样的
increase crop yields　提高农作物产量
过去完成时 had done　表过去的过去

sentences.en: Through three hundred years' development, it became the most prosperous powerful country in the world, and its capital, Chang'an, was the largest metropolis in the world.
sentences.zh: 经过三百年的发展，唐代中国成为世界上最繁荣的强国，其首都长安是世界上最大的都市。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：it（主语，指代 Tang China）became（谓语）the most prosperous powerful country（表语）；and 后并列分句 its capital, Chang'an, was the largest metropolis（主系表）。Through three hundred years' development 为介词短语作时间/方式状语置于句首。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。and 连接两个并列主句（并列复合句）；Chang'an 为主语 its capital 的同位语。层次：[状语 Through...]→分句1(it became...)→[并列连词 and]→分句2(its capital...was...)。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：and 为并列连词连接两个独立分句；所有格 three hundred years' 作定语修饰 development。
④ 翻译要点：中文「经过三百年的发展」用 Through three hundred years' development 前置状语；「其首都长安」译为 its capital, Chang'an，Chang'an 作同位语补出；「最繁荣的强国」the most prosperous powerful country、「最大的都市」the largest metropolis 均用最高级。
⑤ 易错点：it 指代 Tang China（承前），勿译「它」为泛指；and 连接两个分句，第二个分句主语 its capital 与 Chang'an 同位，切分勿误判；the most prosperous powerful 为参考译文并列形容词，实写宜加 and（the most prosperous and powerful）。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Through three hundred years' development, | it became the most prosperous powerful country in the world, | and its capital, Chang'an, | was the largest metropolis in the world.
sentences.cut: [状语 Through three hundred years' development, [并列分句1 S:it V:became C:the most prosperous powerful country [范围 in the world]] [并列连词 and] [并列分句2 S:its capital, [同位语 Chang'an,] V:was C:the largest metropolis [范围 in the world]]]
phrases: through three hundred years' development　经过三百年的发展
the most prosperous powerful country　最繁荣的强国
its capital　它的首都
the largest metropolis　最大的都市
and 连接并列分句　并列复合句

sentences.en: Their poems touched the hearts of scholars and ordinary people, many of which are still read and recited today by children and adults.
sentences.zh: 他们的诗歌打动了学者和普通人的心，即使在今天，他们的许多诗歌仍广为儿童及成人阅读背诵。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Their poems（主语）touched（谓语）the hearts（宾语）of scholars and ordinary people（介词短语作后置定语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：many of which are still read and recited today by children and adults 为「代词+of which」引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 poems，置于句末。层次：主句(主谓宾)→[非限制性定语从句 many of which...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：many of which 中 which 指代 poems（物），of which 表「其中许多（诗歌）」；by 引出被动动作执行者 children and adults。
④ 翻译要点：中文「即使在今天，他们的许多诗歌仍广为……」用 many of which 非限制性定语从句承接前面的 poems，避免重复名词；「打动了……的心」touched the hearts of；「阅读背诵」read and recited（被动并列）。
⑤ 易错点：many of which 中 which 不可换成 them（否则成逗号连接两个独立句，逗号粘连错误）；定语从句为被动 are read and recited，by 短语后置；hearts 用复数泛指「人们的心」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Their poems touched the hearts of scholars and ordinary people, | many of which are still read and recited today | by children and adults.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Their poems V:touched O:the hearts [后置定语 of scholars and ordinary people,] [非限制性定语从句 S:many of which V:are still read and recited A:today [动作执行者 by children and adults]]]
phrases: touch the hearts of　打动……的心
scholars and ordinary people　学者与普通人
many of which　其中许多（非限制性定语从句）
be read and recited　被阅读和背诵
children and adults　儿童与成人

sentences.en: During this period, China experienced sharp economic growth and became the world's most advanced economy, with science, technology, philosophy, and mathematics flourishing.
sentences.zh: 这一时期，中国经济大幅增长，成为世界上最先进的经济体，科学、技术、哲学和数学蓬勃发展。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：China（主语）experienced（谓语）sharp economic growth（宾语）and became（并列谓语）the world's most advanced economy（表语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句首 During this period 为时间状语；句末 with science, technology, philosophy, and mathematics flourishing 为 with 复合结构（with + 名词 + 现在分词）作伴随状语，补充说明「蓬勃发展」的具体领域。层次：[时间状语 During this period]→主句(experienced...and became...)→[with 伴随状语]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：and 连接 experienced 与 became 两个并列谓语；with 复合结构表伴随；现在分词 flourishing 表主动进行。
④ 翻译要点：中文「科学、技术、哲学和数学蓬勃发展」处理为句末 with 复合结构 with...flourishing，把独立短句降格为伴随状语，符合英文「主干突出、修饰后置」；「大幅增长」experienced sharp economic growth；「最先进的经济体」the world's most advanced economy。
⑤ 易错点：with 复合结构中名词与分词为主谓主动关系，须用现在分词 flourishing（勿用 flourished）；experienced sharp growth 与 became...economy 并列，共享主语 China；四个并列名词 science, technology, philosophy, mathematics 用逗号+and 连接。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：During this period, | China experienced sharp economic growth | and became the world's most advanced economy, | with science, technology, philosophy, and mathematics flourishing.
sentences.cut: [时间状语 During this period, [主句 S:China V:experienced O:sharp economic growth] [并列谓语 V:became C:the world's most advanced economy] [with 伴随状语 with [宾语 science, technology, philosophy, and mathematics] [宾语补足语 flourishing]]]
phrases: experience sharp economic growth　经济大幅增长
the world's most advanced economy　世界上最先进的经济体
with + 名词 + 现在分词　with 复合结构作伴随状语
flourish　蓬勃发展
philosophy and mathematics　哲学与数学

sentences.en: The high fertility made a growing number of people flock to cities where there were lively entertainment quarters.
sentences.zh: 人口增长迅速，越来越多的人住进城市，那里有热闹的娱乐场所。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：The high fertility（主语）made（谓语）a growing number of people（宾语）flock to cities（宾语补足语）——make sb do sth 结构。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：where there were lively entertainment quarters 为 where 引导的限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 cities。层次：主句(make sb do)→[定语从句 where there were...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：where 为关系副词，在定语从句中作地点状语，相当于 in which；make 后接不带 to 的不定式 flock 作宾补。
④ 翻译要点：中文「人口增长迅速」转译为名词主语 The high fertility（高生育率），「越来越多的人住进城市」用 make a growing number of people flock to cities 使役结构；「那里有热闹的娱乐场所」用 where 定语从句修饰 cities，避免另起一句。
⑤ 易错点：make sb do sth 中不定式省略 to（勿写 to flock）；where 引导定语从句勿误接 which（从句不缺主宾，缺地点状语用 where）；there be 句型在定语从句中用倒装语序 there were...。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：The high fertility made a growing number of people flock to cities | where there were lively entertainment quarters.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:The high fertility V:made O:a growing number of people [宾语补足语 (to)flock to O:cities] [限制性定语从句 where V:there were S:lively entertainment quarters]]
phrases: high fertility　高生育率
make sb do sth　使某人做某事（宾补省 to）
a growing number of　越来越多的
flock to cities　涌入城市
where 引导定语从句　在那里……
entertainment quarters　娱乐场所/区

sentences.en: The Ming Dynasty, which reigned China for 276 years, is described as one of the greatest epochs with orderly governance and social stability in human history.
sentences.zh: 明朝统治中国276年，被人们描绘成人类历史上治理有序、社会稳定的最伟大的时代之一。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：The Ming Dynasty（主语）is described（谓语被动）as one of the greatest epochs（主语补足语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：which reigned China for 276 years 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，插入在主语与谓语之间，补充说明明朝统治时长；with orderly governance and social stability 为介词 with 短语作后置定语修饰 epochs；in human history 为范围状语。层次：主语+[非限制性定语从句插入]→谓语 is described as→[后置定语 with...]→[范围状语 in...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：which 引导非限制性定语从句指代 The Ming Dynasty；be described as 为固定搭配「被描绘为」；with 短语表「具有……特征」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「明朝统治中国276年，被人们描绘成……」用 which 非限制性定语从句把「统治276年」插入主语后，主干保留「明朝被描绘为……」；「治理有序、社会稳定」译为 with orderly governance and social stability 作 epochs 的后置定语；「最伟大的时代之一」one of the greatest epochs（最高级+复数名词）。
⑤ 易错点：which 非限制性定语从句用逗号隔开，勿与 that 混淆；one of 后接复数名词 epochs（勿用 epoch）；be described as 中 as 为介词后接名词；reign 为不及物动词「统治」，reign over/for 搭配。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：The Ming Dynasty, | which reigned China for 276 years, | is described as one of the greatest epochs | with orderly governance and social stability | in human history.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:The Ming Dynasty, [非限制性定语从句 which V:reigned O:China [时间 for 276 years]], V:is described [主语补足语 as one of the greatest epochs [后置定语 with orderly governance and social stability] [范围 in human history]]]
phrases: reign China for 276 years　统治中国276年
be described as　被描绘为
one of the greatest epochs　最伟大的时代之一
orderly governance　治理有序
social stability　社会稳定
in human history　在人类历史上

sentences.en: Particularly worth mentioning is that three of the four great classics in Chinese literature are written during the Ming Dynasty.
sentences.zh: 还值得一提的是，中国文学的四大经典名著中有三部写于明朝。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Particularly worth mentioning（表语前置）is（系动词）that three of the four great classics in Chinese literature are written during the Ming Dynasty（that 引导的表语从句）——表语前置的倒装句。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：that 引导名词性从句作表语（表语从句）。表语从句内部主干 three of the four great classics 为主语，are written 为被动谓语。层次：[倒装表语 Particularly worth mentioning]→系动词 is→[表语从句 that...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：that 引导表语从句（不可省）；worth mentioning 为形容词短语「值得一提的」；during the Ming Dynasty 为时间状语。
④ 翻译要点：中文「还值得一提的是」译为 Particularly worth mentioning is that... 表语前置倒装句型，比 It is worth mentioning that 更具文采；「四大经典名著中有三部」three of the four great classics（分数/比例表达）；「写于明朝」are written during the Ming Dynasty（被动）。
⑤ 易错点：表语从句中 that 不可省略；worth 后接动名词主动形式表被动含义（worth mentioning=值得被提及）；three of the four 中 three 为复数，从句谓语用 are written；Particularly 拼写（勿写 Particularily）。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Particularly worth mentioning is | that three of the four great classics in Chinese literature | are written during the Ming Dynasty.
sentences.cut: [主句 [倒装表语 Particually worth mentioning] V:is [表语从句 that S:three of the four great classics [后置定语 in Chinese literature] V:are written [时间状语 during the Ming Dynasty]]]
phrases: worth mentioning　值得一提的
表语前置倒装　表语+系动词+主语从句
three of the four great classics　四大名著之三部
Chinese literature　中国文学
be written during　写于……期间

sentences.en: Located at the crossroads of several bird migration routes across Asia, Qinghai Lake offers many species an intermediate stop during their migration.
sentences.zh: 青海湖位于跨越亚洲的几条候鸟迁徙路线的交叉处，为许多鸟类提供了迁徙途中的暂息地。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Qinghai Lake（主语）offers（谓语）many species（间接宾语）an intermediate stop（直接宾语）——offer sb sth 双宾语结构。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句首 Located at the crossroads of several bird migration routes across Asia 为过去分词短语作地点状语置于句首；during their migration 为介词短语作时间状语。层次：[过去分词状语 Located at...]→主句(offer sb sth)→[时间状语 during...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：过去分词 Located 表被动状态「位于」；offer 后接双宾语 offer sb sth=offer sth to sb；across Asia 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 routes。
④ 翻译要点：中文「青海湖位于……交叉处，许多鸟类把青海湖作为……暂息地」译文把「位于……」处理为句首过去分词状语 Located at...，主干用 Qinghai Lake offers many species an intermediate stop（名词原则皆可主，以湖为主语）；「迁徙路线的交叉处」the crossroads of several bird migration routes；「暂息地」an intermediate stop。
⑤ 易错点：Located 为过去分词作状语，逻辑主语须是主句主语 Qinghai Lake（勿悬垂）；offer 双宾语结构勿漏介词；the crossroads of 中 crossroads 单复数同形；intermediate stop 为「中途停留地」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Located at the crossroads of several bird migration routes across Asia, | Qinghai Lake offers many species an intermediate stop | during their migration.
sentences.cut: [地点状语 Located at the crossroads of several bird migration routes across Asia, [主句 S:Qinghai Lake V:offers [间接宾语 many species] [直接宾语 an intermediate stop] [时间状语 during their migration]]]
phrases: located at　位于（过去分词作状语）
the crossroads of　……的交叉处
bird migration routes　候鸟迁徙路线
offer sb sth　为某人提供某物（双宾语）
an intermediate stop　中途暂息地
during one's migration　在迁徙途中

sentences.en: On the western side of the lake are the well-known "Bird Islands", which attract birdwatchers from across the globe.
sentences.zh: 湖的西侧是著名的「鸟岛」，吸引着来自世界各地的观鸟者。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：On the western side of the lake（方位状语前置）are（系动词）the well-known "Bird Islands"（主语）——方位状语前置的完全倒装句。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：which attract birdwatchers from across the globe 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 Bird Islands，置于句末。层次：[方位状语前置 On the western side...]→系动词 are+主语→[非限制性定语从句 which...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：which 引导非限制性定语从句指代 Bird Islands；from across the globe 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 birdwatchers。
④ 翻译要点：中文「湖的西侧是著名的鸟岛」译文用方位状语前置完全倒装 On the western side of the lake are...，突出方位；「吸引着来自世界各地的观鸟者」用 which 非限制性定语从句承接 Bird Islands，避免重复谓语。
⑤ 易错点：方位状语前置引起完全倒装，主语 the well-known Bird Islands 在系动词之后，切分勿误判 which 前的名词为主句谓语；which 指代 Islands（复数），定语从句谓语用 attract；birdwatchers 为「观鸟者」勿译「看鸟的人」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：On the western side of the lake are the well-known "Bird Islands", | which attract birdwatchers from across the globe.
sentences.cut: [方位状语前置 On the western side of the lake V:are [主语 S:the well-known "Bird Islands"] [非限制性定语从句 which V:attract O:birdwatchers [后置定语 from across the globe]]]
phrases: on the western side of　在……的西侧
方位状语前置完全倒装　状语+系动词+主语
the well-known Bird Islands　著名的鸟岛
attract birdwatchers　吸引观鸟者
from across the globe　来自世界各地

sentences.en: Dongting Lake is famous in Chinese culture as the birthplace of dragon boat racing, which is said to have begun on the eastern shores of Dongting Lake as a search for the body of Qu Yuan, the Chu poet (340–278 BC).
sentences.zh: 洞庭湖作为龙舟赛的发源地，在中国文化中享有盛名。据说龙舟赛始于洞庭湖东岸，为的是搜寻楚国爱国诗人屈原的遗体。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Dongting Lake（主语）is famous（系表）in Chinese culture as the birthplace of dragon boat racing（状语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：which is said to have begun on the eastern shores of Dongting Lake as a search for the body of Qu Yuan 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 dragon boat racing；其中 the Chu poet (340–278 BC) 为 Qu Yuan 的同位语。层次：主句(主系表)→[非限制性定语从句 which is said to have begun...]→[同位语 the Chu poet...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：which 引导非限制性定语从句指代 dragon boat racing；is said to have done 为「据说已做某事」（不定式完成式表过去）；as a search for 介词短语表目的「为搜寻……」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「洞庭湖作为龙舟赛的发源地，在中国文化中享有盛名」用 be famous in Chinese culture as...；「据说龙舟赛始于……为的是搜寻……」用 which is said to have begun...as a search for... 定语从句承接；「楚国爱国诗人屈原」Qu Yuan, the Chu poet，同位语后置。
⑤ 易错点：be said to have begun 用不定式完成式（动作发生在过去），勿写 to begin；which 指代 dragon boat racing（单数），定语从句谓语用 is；as a search for 中 as 为介词「作为、为」；the eastern shores 用复数。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Dongting Lake is famous in Chinese culture as the birthplace of dragon boat racing, | which is said to have begun on the eastern shores of Dongting Lake | as a search for the body of Qu Yuan, | the Chu poet (340–278 BC).
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Dongting Lake V:is famous [状语 in Chinese culture] [状语 as the birthplace of dragon boat racing,] [非限制性定语从句 which V:is said [主语补足语 to have begun [状语 on the eastern shores of Dongting Lake] [目的状语 as a search for O:the body of Qu Yuan,]] [同位语 the Chu poet (340–278 BC)]]]
phrases: be famous as　作为……而闻名
the birthplace of dragon boat racing　龙舟赛的发源地
be said to have done　据说已经做了……
the eastern shores of　……的东岸
as a search for　为搜寻……
the Chu poet　楚国诗人（屈原）

sentences.en: Together with the lake and its surrounding beauty, the racing appeals to thousands of tourists from other parts of China and beyond each year.
sentences.zh: 龙舟赛与洞庭湖及周边的美景，每年都吸引着成千上万来自全国和世界各地的游客。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：the racing（主语，指代 dragon boat racing）appeals to（谓语）thousands of tourists（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句首 Together with the lake and its surrounding beauty 为介词短语作状语（附带/伴随），表示主语「连同……一起」；from other parts of China and beyond 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 tourists；each year 为时间状语。层次：[伴随状语 Together with...]→主句(the racing appeals to...)→[后置定语 from...]→[时间状语 each year]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：together with 为复合介词「连同、和……一起」，连接伴随成分不影响主语单复数；appeal to 为短语动词「吸引」；and beyond 表「以及更远的地方」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「龙舟赛与洞庭湖及周边的美景」中真正主语是「龙舟赛」，「洞庭湖及美景」为伴随成分，用 Together with... 前置，保持主语 the racing 单数谓语 appeals；「成千上万来自全国和世界各地」thousands of tourists from other parts of China and beyond（and beyond=and beyond China，指国外）。
⑤ 易错点：together with 连接并列成分时谓语与前面真正主语一致（the racing 单数→appeals，勿写 appeal）；appeal to 中 to 为介词；and beyond 为省略说法，实写宜补 and beyond China；参考原文笔误「others parts」已校正为「other parts」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Together with the lake and its surrounding beauty, | the racing appeals to thousands of tourists | from other parts of China and beyond | each year.
sentences.cut: [伴随状语 Together with the lake and its surrounding beauty, [主句 S:the racing V:appeals to O:thousands of tourists [后置定语 from other parts of China and beyond] [时间状语 each year]]]
phrases: together with　连同、和……一起
surrounding beauty　周边的美景
appeal to　吸引
thousands of tourists　成千上万的游客
other parts of China and beyond　中国各地及海外
each year　每年

sentences.en: Located in the east of China, Taihu Lake, with an area of 2,250 square kilometers, is the third largest freshwater lake in China after Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake.
sentences.zh: 太湖位于中国东部，占地面积2250平方公里，是中国第三大淡水湖，仅次于鄱阳和洞庭。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Taihu Lake（主语）is（系动词）the third largest freshwater lake in China（表语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句首 Located in the east of China 为过去分词短语作地点状语；with an area of 2,250 square kilometers 为介词 with 短语作插入语（后置定语），插在主语与谓语之间；after Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake 为介词短语作状语修饰 third largest。层次：[过去分词状语 Located in...]→主语 Taihu Lake+[with 插入语]→系表 is the third largest freshwater lake→[状语 after...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：过去分词 Located 表被动状态；with an area of 表「面积为」；after 表「次于、落后于」；the third largest 为序数词+最高级。
④ 翻译要点：中文「太湖是中国东部的一个淡水湖，占地面积2250平方公里，是中国第三大淡水湖，仅次于鄱阳和洞庭」动词密集，译文选取「是第三大淡水湖」作主干，「位于东部」用 Located... 过去分词状语前置，「占地面积」用 with an area of... 插入语，「仅次于」用 after Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake 后置，实现「一句多动词」的英文降格处理。
⑤ 易错点：过去分词 Located 逻辑主语须是 Taihu Lake；with an area of 为插入语，切分勿误判谓语；the third largest 后接单数名词 freshwater lake；after 此处表「次于」勿译「在……之后」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Located in the east of China, | Taihu Lake, | with an area of 2,250 square kilometers, | is the third largest freshwater lake in China | after Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake.
sentences.cut: [地点状语 Located in the east of China, [主句 S:Taihu Lake, [插入语 with an area of 2,250 square kilometers,] V:is C:the third largest freshwater lake [范围 in China] [比较状语 after Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake]]]
phrases: located in　位于（过去分词作状语）
with an area of　占地面积为
the third largest freshwater lake　第三大淡水湖
after Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake　仅次于鄱阳湖与洞庭湖
一句多动词处理　主干突出、修饰后置

sentences.en: There are around 90 islands in Taihu Lake, with an area varying from a few square meters to a few square kilometers.
sentences.zh: 太湖约有90个岛屿，大小从几平方米到几平方公里不等。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：There are（谓语）around 90 islands（主语）in Taihu Lake（地点状语）——there be 存在句。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句末 with an area varying from a few square meters to a few square kilometers 为 with 复合结构（with + 名词 + 现在分词）作后置定语/伴随状语，修饰 islands。层次：There be 主句→[地点状语 in Taihu Lake]→[with 复合结构 with an area varying from...to...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：There be 存在句型；with 复合结构表伴随；现在分词 varying 表主动「变化（范围）」；from...to... 介词短语表「从……到……」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「太湖约有90个岛屿，大小从几平方米到几平方公里不等」用 There are around 90 islands in Taihu Lake 存在句主干，「大小从……到……不等」用 with an area varying from...to... 复合结构后置，把中文第二短句降格为修饰成分。
⑤ 易错点：there be 句型主谓一致（90 islands 复数→are）；with 复合结构中 area 与 vary 为主动关系用现在分词 varying（勿用 varied）；from...to... 两端结构对称（a few square meters / a few square kilometers）。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：There are around 90 islands in Taihu Lake, | with an area varying from a few square meters to a few square kilometers.
sentences.cut: [There be 主句 V:There are S:around 90 islands [地点状语 in Taihu Lake,] [with 伴随状语 with O:an area [宾语补足语 varying from a few square meters to a few square kilometers]]]
phrases: there be 存在句　有……
around 90 islands　约90个岛屿
with + 名词 + 现在分词　with 复合结构
vary from...to...　从……到……不等
a few square meters/kilometers　几平方米/平方公里

sentences.en: Compared with aircraft, the outstanding advantage of high-speed trains is punctuality, for they are basically not affected by weather or traffic control.
sentences.zh: 相对飞机而言，高铁列车的突出优势在于准时，因为基本不受天气或交通管制的影响。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：the outstanding advantage（主语）is（系动词）punctuality（表语）——主系表。Compared with aircraft 为过去分词短语作比较状语置于句首。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：for they are basically not affected by weather or traffic control 为 for 引导的并列原因状语分句（for 为并列连词，语气较 because 弱，对前句加以补充说明）。层次：[比较状语 Compared with...]→主句(the outstanding advantage is punctuality)→[并列原因连词 for]→分句(they are not affected...)。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：Compared with 表「与……相比」；for 为并列连词表原因；be affected by 中 by 引出动作的承受对象（被动）。
④ 翻译要点：中文「相对飞机而言」用 Compared with aircraft 前置；「突出优势在于准时」the outstanding advantage...is punctuality（advantage 作主语避免直译「高铁列车的突出优势在于」的头重脚轻）；「因为基本不受……影响」用 for 并列分句承接，不另起一句。
⑤ 易错点：Compared with 中 compared 为过去分词（勿用 comparing）；for 为并列连词连接两个独立分句，前须用逗号隔开；be affected by 为被动结构，weather or traffic control 为并列介词宾语。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Compared with aircraft, | the outstanding advantage of high-speed trains is punctuality, | for they are basically not affected by weather or traffic control.
sentences.cut: [比较状语 Compared with aircraft, [主句 S:the outstanding advantage [后置定语 of high-speed trains] V:is C:punctuality] [并列原因连词 for] [原因分句 S:they V:are basically not affected [方式 by weather or traffic control]]]
phrases: compared with aircraft　与飞机相比
the outstanding advantage　突出优势
high-speed train　高铁列车
punctuality　准时
be affected by　受……影响
traffic control　交通管制

sentences.en: Furthermore, many young people even choose to work in one city while living in a nearby one, taking high-speed trains to commute every day.
sentences.zh: 还有不少年轻人选择在一个城市工作而在邻近城市居住，每天乘高铁上下班。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：many young people（主语）choose（谓语）to work in one city while living in a nearby one（不定式短语作宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：while living in a nearby one 为 while 引导的时间/对比状语从句的省略形式（完整为 while they are living...），因主从句主语一致省略主语+be；句末 taking high-speed trains to commute every day 为现在分词短语作伴随状语。层次：主句(choose to work...)→[while 省略状语从句 while living...]→[现在分词伴随状语 taking...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：while 引导省略状语从句表对比「而」；现在分词 taking 表伴随动作；nearby one 中 one 指代 city（避免重复）。
④ 翻译要点：中文「在一个城市工作而在邻近城市居住」用 choose to work in one city while living in a nearby one，while 从句省略 they are，one 代 city；「每天乘高铁上下班」用现在分词 taking high-speed trains to commute 作伴随，不另起谓语。
⑤ 易错点：while 省略结构中逻辑主语须与主句主语 many young people 一致；one 为代词指代可数名词 city（勿用 it）；to commute 为不定式表目的。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Furthermore, many young people even choose to work in one city | while living in a nearby one, | taking high-speed trains to commute every day.
sentences.cut: [状语 Furthermore, [主句 S:many young people V:choose O:[不定式 to work [地点 in one city]] [while 省略状语从句 while [省略 they are] living [地点 in a nearby one,]]] [现在分词伴随状语 taking O:high-speed trains [目的 to commute [时间 every day]]]]
phrases: choose to do sth　选择做某事
while + 现在分词　while 状语从句省略形式
in a nearby one　在邻近城市（one=city）
take high-speed trains　乘高铁
commute　通勤上下班

sentences.en: Recently, Chinese entrepreneurs have combined mobile Internet technology with traditional bicycles, innovating a new business model called "shared bicycle".
sentences.zh: 近来，中国企业家将移动互联网技术与传统自行车结合在一起，发明了一种称为共享单车的商业模式。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Chinese entrepreneurs（主语）have combined（谓语）mobile Internet technology with traditional bicycles（宾语+介词补足语）——combine A with B 固定搭配。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句末 innovating a new business model called 'shared bicycle' 为现在分词短语作结果状语；其中 called 'shared bicycle' 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 business model。层次：主句(have combined A with B)→[现在分词结果状语 innovating...]→[过去分词后置定语 called...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：combine A with B 为固定搭配「把A与B结合」；现在分词 innovating 表自然而然的结果；called 为过去分词表被动「被称作」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「将……与……结合在一起，发明了……」用 have combined...with..., innovating... 现在分词结果状语，把第二句降格为结果；「一种称为共享单车的商业模式」a new business model called 'shared bicycle'，过去分词后置作定语。
⑤ 易错点：combine A with B 中 with 勿漏；现在分词 innovating 表结果（逻辑主语为整个主句）；called 为过去分词勿用 calling。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Recently, Chinese entrepreneurs have combined mobile Internet technology with traditional bicycles, | innovating a new business model called "shared bicycle".
sentences.cut: [时间状语 Recently, [主句 S:Chinese entrepreneurs V:have combined O:mobile Internet technology [搭配 with traditional bicycles,]] [现在分词结果状语 innovating O:a new business model [后置定语 called "shared bicycle"]]]
phrases: combine A with B　把A与B结合
mobile Internet technology　移动互联网技术
traditional bicycles　传统自行车
现在分词作结果状语　innovating...
business model　商业模式
called 'shared bicycle'　称为共享单车（过去分词后置定语）

sentences.en: Nowadays, as the city's traffic congestion and air pollution become increasingly serious, cycling has gained its popularity again.
sentences.zh: 如今，随着城市交通拥挤和空气污染日益严重，骑自行车又开始流行起来。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：cycling（主语）has gained（谓语）its popularity（宾语）——现在完成时。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：as the city's traffic congestion and air pollution become increasingly serious 为 as 引导的原因/时间状语从句，置于句首。层次：[时间/原因状语从句 as...]→主句(cycling has gained its popularity again)。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：as 引导状语从句表「随着」；从句主语 the city's traffic congestion and air pollution 为两个并列名词短语，视为复数/整体。
④ 翻译要点：中文「随着……日益严重」用 as 引导状语从句前置；「骑自行车又开始流行起来」cycling has gained its popularity again（动名词 cycling 作主语）；「日益严重」become increasingly serious。
⑤ 易错点：as 此处表「随着」勿与 because 混淆；从句主语为两个并列抽象名词，谓语用 become（原形感/一般现在时表趋势）；gain popularity 为固定搭配。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Nowadays, | as the city's traffic congestion and air pollution become increasingly serious, | cycling has gained its popularity again.
sentences.cut: [时间状语 Nowadays, [as 状语从句 S:the city's traffic congestion and air pollution V:become C:increasingly serious,] [主句 S:cycling V:has gained O:its popularity [状语 again]]]
phrases: as 引导状语从句　随着……
traffic congestion　交通拥堵
air pollution　空气污染
increasingly serious　日益严重
gain popularity　开始流行
cycling　骑自行车（动名词作主语）

sentences.en: In some cities, the growth of number of cars is so fast that traffic jams and parking space shortage are getting worse and worse.
sentences.zh: 有些城市的汽车增长速度过快，以至于交通拥堵和停车位不足的问题日益严峻。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：the growth of number of cars（主语）is（系动词）so fast（表语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：that traffic jams and parking space shortage are getting worse and worse 为 that 引导的结果状语从句，与前面的 so 呼应构成 so...that...「如此……以至于……」结构。层次：主句(the growth...is so fast)→[结果状语从句 that...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：so...that... 为固定结构，so 修饰形容词 fast，that 引导结果从句；getting worse and worse 为现在进行时表「日益恶化」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「增长速度过快，以至于……」用 so...that... 结果状语从句；「交通拥堵和停车位不足的问题」traffic jams and parking space shortage（并列名词短语作从句主语）；「日益严峻」are getting worse and worse。
⑤ 易错点：so 后接形容词/副词（so fast），such 后接名词；that 结果从句勿与定语从句混淆；getting worse and worse 比较级叠加表「越来越……」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：In some cities, the growth of number of cars is so fast | that traffic jams and parking space shortage are getting worse and worse.
sentences.cut: [地点状语 In some cities, [主句 S:the growth of number of cars V:is C:[so fast]] [结果状语从句 that S:traffic jams and parking space shortage V:are getting C:worse and worse]]
phrases: so...that...　如此……以至于……
the growth of number of cars　汽车数量的增长
traffic jams　交通拥堵
parking space shortage　停车位不足
get worse and worse　日益严峻

sentences.en: Meanwhile, as air pollution has become increasingly serious, more and more people are now choosing to purchase new energy vehicles, and the Chinese government has also taken some measures to support the development of new energy vehicles.
sentences.zh: 由于空气污染日益严重，现在越来越多的人选择购买新能源汽车，中国政府也采取了一些措施，支持新能源汽车的发展。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：more and more people（主语）are now choosing（谓语，现在进行时）to purchase new energy vehicles（不定式作宾语）；and 后并列分句 the Chinese government has also taken some measures。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：as air pollution has become increasingly serious 为 as 引导的原因状语从句置于句首；and 连接两个并列分句；句末 to support the development of new energy vehicles 为不定式短语作目的状语。层次：[原因状语从句 as...]→分句1(more and more people are choosing...)→[并列连词 and]→分句2(the government has taken measures)→[不定式目的状语 to support...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：as 表原因；and 并列两个独立分句；take measures to do 为固定搭配「采取措施做某事」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「由于……」用 as 原因从句前置；「越来越多的人选择购买」more and more people are now choosing to purchase；「采取措施支持……发展」has taken some measures to support the development of...（不定式作目的）。
⑤ 易错点：take measures 后接不定式 to do（勿接 doing）；and 连接两个并列分句，第二个分句主语 the Chinese government 与前句不同；new energy vehicles 为「新能源汽车」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Meanwhile, as air pollution has become increasingly serious, | more and more people are now choosing to purchase new energy vehicles, | and the Chinese government has also taken some measures | to support the development of new energy vehicles.
sentences.cut: [状语 Meanwhile, [as 原因状语从句 S:air pollution V:has become C:increasingly serious,] [并列分句1 S:more and more people V:are now choosing O:to purchase new energy vehicles,] [并列连词 and] [并列分句2 S:the Chinese government V:has also taken O:some measures] [目的状语 to support O:the development of new energy vehicles]]
phrases: as 引导原因状语　由于……
increasingly serious　日益严重
choose to purchase　选择购买
new energy vehicles　新能源汽车
take measures to do　采取措施做某事
support the development of　支持……的发展

sentences.en: Some libraries have also introduced a self-service system that makes it easier for readers to borrow books and return books, further satisfying the needs of readers.
sentences.zh: 一些图书馆还推出了自助服务系统，使读者借书还书更加方便，进一步满足了读者的需求。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Some libraries（主语）have also introduced（谓语，现在完成时）a self-service system（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：that makes it easier for readers to borrow books and return books 为 that 引导的限制性定语从句修饰 system；其中 it 为形式宾语，真正宾语为 for readers to borrow...and return...；句末 further satisfying the needs of readers 为现在分词短语作结果状语。层次：主句(have introduced a self-service system)→[定语从句 that makes it easier for readers to do]→[现在分词结果状语 further satisfying...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：that 引导定语从句指代 system；make it easier for sb to do 中 it 为形式宾语；现在分词 satisfying 表结果。
④ 翻译要点：中文「推出了自助服务系统，使读者借书还书更加方便，进一步满足了……」用 that 定语从句承接 system，从句内 make it easier for readers to borrow and return books（it 形式宾语）；「进一步满足需求」用现在分词 further satisfying... 作结果状语。
⑤ 易错点：make it + adj + for sb to do 中 it 不可省（勿写 make easier for readers to...）；that 定语从句修饰 system（单数），谓语用 makes；borrow books and return books 并列不定式共享 to。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Some libraries have also introduced a self-service system | that makes it easier for readers to borrow books and return books, | further satisfying the needs of readers.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Some libraries V:have also introduced O:a self-service system [限制性定语从句 that V:makes [形式宾语 it] [宾补 easier [逻辑宾语 for readers to borrow books and return books,]]] [现在分词结果状语 further satisfying O:the needs of readers]]
phrases: introduce a self-service system　推出自助服务系统
that 引导定语从句　修饰system
make it easier for sb to do　使某人做某事更方便（it形式宾语）
borrow and return books　借书还书
further satisfying　进一步满足（现在分词结果状语）

sentences.en: There have also been many digital libraries in recent years, which saves the space needed to store books.
sentences.zh: 近年来，也出现了许多数字图书馆，从而节省了存放图书所需的空间。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：There have also been（谓语）many digital libraries（主语）——There be 存在句的现在完成时。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：which saves the space needed to store books 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰前面整句话（「出现数字图书馆」这件事）；其中 needed to store books 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 space。层次：There be 主句→[非限制性定语从句 which saves...]→[过去分词后置定语 needed to store books]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：There be 存在句型；which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前文整句；needed 为过去分词表被动「被需要的」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「近年来，也出现了许多数字图书馆，从而节省了……」用 There have been many digital libraries 存在句主干，「从而节省了」用 which 非限制性定语从句承接整句；「存放图书所需的空间」the space needed to store books，过去分词 needed 后置。
⑤ 易错点：There be 现在完成时为 There have been（勿写 There has，主语 libraries 复数）；which 非限制性定语从句指代整句时谓语用单数 saves；needed to store 为过去分词勿用 needing。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：There have also been many digital libraries in recent years, | which saves the space needed to store books.
sentences.cut: [There be 主句 V:There have also been S:many digital libraries [时间状语 in recent years,] [非限制性定语从句 which V:saves O:the space [后置定语 needed to store books]]]
phrases: There be 现在完成时　There have been
digital libraries　数字图书馆
which 引导非限制性定语从句　指代整句
save the space　节省空间
needed to store books　存放图书所需的（过去分词后置定语）

sentences.en: Some large museums use advanced technologies, such as multimedia and virtual reality, to make the exhibition more attractive.
sentences.zh: 一些大型博物馆利用多媒体和虚拟现实等先进技术，使展览更具吸引力。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Some large museums（主语）use（谓语）advanced technologies（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。such as multimedia and virtual reality 为插入语（举例），置于 advanced technologies 之后；to make the exhibition more attractive 为不定式短语作目的状语置于句末。层次：主句(use advanced technologies)→[插入语 such as...]→[不定式目的状语 to make...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：such as 表举例「诸如」；to make... 不定式表目的；make sth + adj 为「使某物……」宾补结构。
④ 翻译要点：中文「利用多媒体和虚拟现实等先进技术，使展览更具吸引力」译文主干 use advanced technologies，举例 such as multimedia and virtual reality 插入其中，「使展览更具吸引力」用不定式 to make the exhibition more attractive 作目的状语。
⑤ 易错点：such as 后接名词短语（勿接句子）；make the exhibition more attractive 中 more attractive 为形容词比较级作宾补；virtual reality 为「虚拟现实」缩写 VR。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Some large museums use advanced technologies, | such as multimedia and virtual reality, | to make the exhibition more attractive.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Some large museums V:use O:advanced technologies, [插入语举例 such as multimedia and virtual reality,] [目的状语 to make O:the exhibition [宾补 more attractive]]]
phrases: advanced technologies　先进技术
such as　诸如、例如
multimedia　多媒体
virtual reality　虚拟现实（VR）
to make sth + adj　使某物……（不定式作目的）

sentences.en: Many museums also hold online exhibitions where people can watch rare exhibits.
sentences.zh: 不少博物馆还举办在线展览，人们可在网上观赏珍稀展品。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Many museums（主语）also hold（谓语）online exhibitions（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：where people can watch rare exhibits 为 where 引导的限制性定语从句修饰先行词 online exhibitions；where 在从句中作地点状语。层次：主句(hold online exhibitions)→[where 定语从句 where people can watch...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：where 为关系副词，在定语从句中作地点状语，相当于 on which（在在线展览上）；rare exhibits 为「珍稀展品」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「举办在线展览，人们可在网上观赏珍稀展品」用 where 定语从句承接 online exhibitions，把第二短句「人们可在网上观赏」并入，避免另起一句；「珍稀展品」rare exhibits。
⑤ 易错点：where 引导定语从句勿误接 which（从句不缺主宾，缺地点状语用 where）；online exhibitions 为复数，从句用 can watch；exhibit 此处为名词「展品」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Many museums also hold online exhibitions | where people can watch rare exhibits.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Many museums V:also hold O:online exhibitions [限制性定语从句 where S:people V:can watch O:rare exhibits]]
phrases: hold online exhibitions　举办在线展览
where 引导定语从句　在（在线展览）上
rare exhibits　珍稀展品
watch exhibits　观赏展品

sentences.en: In addition to building the new stadiums, many cities have also taken measures to renovate old factories and commercial buildings for the purpose of increasing the number of local stadiums.
sentences.zh: 除了新建体育馆外，许多城市还采取了改造旧工厂和商业建筑等措施，来增加当地体育馆的数量。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：many cities（主语）have also taken（谓语，现在完成时）measures（宾语）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句首 In addition to building the new stadiums 为介词短语作状语（in addition to + 动名词）；to renovate old factories and commercial buildings 为不定式短语作后置定语修饰 measures；for the purpose of increasing the number of local stadiums 为介词短语作目的状语。层次：[状语 In addition to...]→主句(have taken measures)→[不定式后置定语 to renovate...]→[目的状语 for the purpose of...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：In addition to 为复合介词「除……之外（还）」后接动名词；take measures to do 固定搭配；for the purpose of 介词短语表目的。
④ 翻译要点：中文「除了新建体育馆外，许多城市还采取了改造旧工厂和商业建筑等措施，来增加……」用 In addition to building... 状语前置，主干 have taken measures，「改造旧工厂和商业建筑等措施」to renovate... 不定式后置定语修饰 measures，「来增加」for the purpose of increasing 目的状语。
⑤ 易错点：In addition to 中 to 为介词后接动名词 building（勿接动词原形）；take measures to do 后接不定式；for the purpose of 中 of 为介词后接动名词 increasing。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：In addition to building the new stadiums, | many cities have also taken measures | to renovate old factories and commercial buildings | for the purpose of increasing the number of local stadiums.
sentences.cut: [状语 In addition to [动名词 building the new stadiums,] [主句 S:many cities V:have also taken O:measures [不定式后置定语 to renovate O:old factories and commercial buildings] [目的状语 for the purpose of [动名词 increasing O:the number of local stadiums]]]]
phrases: in addition to　除……之外（还，后接动名词）
take measures to do　采取措施做某事
renovate old factories　改造旧工厂
commercial buildings　商业建筑
for the purpose of　为了……（后接动名词）

sentences.en: It is foreseeable that with the continuous improvement of sports facilities, more and more people will do exercise in gymnasiums.
sentences.zh: 可以预见，随着运动设施的不断改善，愈来愈多的人将会去体育馆健身。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：It（形式主语）is foreseeable（系表）。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：that with the continuous improvement of sports facilities, more and more people will do exercise in gymnasiums 为 that 引导的主语从句（真正主语后置）；其中 with the continuous improvement of sports facilities 为 with 介词短语作条件/伴随状语，置于主语从句句首。层次：[形式主语 It]→系表 is foreseeable→[主语从句 that]→[with 状语]→从句主干(more and more people will do exercise...)。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：It 为形式主语，that 引导真正主语从句；with the continuous improvement of 为「随着……的不断改善」；will do 为一般将来时。
④ 翻译要点：中文「可以预见，随着……」用 It is foreseeable that... 形式主语句型（It 为形式主语，that 从句后置）；「随着运动设施的不断改善」with the continuous improvement of sports facilities 置于主语从句内句首；「愈来愈多的人将会去体育馆健身」more and more people will do exercise in gymnasiums。
⑤ 易错点：It is + adj + that 中 It 为形式主语勿译「它」；with the improvement of 为固定搭配勿改 with improve；主语从句用将来时 will do（预测）。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：It is foreseeable | that with the continuous improvement of sports facilities, | more and more people will do exercise in gymnasiums.
sentences.cut: [主句 [形式主语 It] V:is [表语 foreseeable] [主语从句 that [状语 with the continuous improvement of sports facilities,] S:more and more people V:will do O:exercise [地点 in gymnasiums]]]
phrases: It is foreseeable that...　可以预见……（It形式主语）
with the continuous improvement of　随着……的不断改善
sports facilities　运动设施
more and more people　愈来愈多的人
do exercise in gymnasiums　去体育馆健身

sentences.en: A great difference between Chinese and western languages is that Chinese is composed of characters rather than letters.
sentences.zh: 汉语与西方语言的一个重要区别在于，汉语是由方块字而不是由字母构成的。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：A great difference（主语）is（系动词）——主系表结构；介词短语 between Chinese and western languages 作后置定语修饰 difference。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：that Chinese is composed of characters rather than letters 为 that 引导的表语从句，置于系动词 is 之后，说明区别的具体内容。层次：主句主干(A great difference is...)→[表语从句 that Chinese is composed of...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：that 引导表语从句（that 在表语从句中不充当成分但不可省）；rather than 为并列连词「而不是」连接 characters 与 letters；be composed of「由……构成」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「汉语与西方语言的一个重要区别在于……」译文以 A great difference between... 作主语、is that... 表语从句承接；「以方块字而不是以字母构成」is composed of characters rather than letters，rather than 后接名词保持平行。
⑤ 易错点：表语从句 that 不可省（区别于宾语从句）；be composed of 中 of 勿漏；rather than 前后结构须平行（均为名词）；Chinese 此处指「汉语」，勿译「中国人」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：A great difference between Chinese and western languages | is that | Chinese is composed of characters rather than letters.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:A great difference [后置定语 between Chinese and western languages] V:is [表语从句 that S:Chinese V:is composed [介词 of characters [并列 rather than letters]]]]
phrases: a great difference between A and B　A与B之间的重要区别
western languages　西方语言
be composed of　由……构成
characters rather than letters　方块字而非字母
rather than　而不是（并列连词）

sentences.en: People from different regions may not understand each other's dialects in China. However, they hardly have difficulty in communicating since Chinese characters have a unified writing form.
sentences.zh: 在中国，来自不同地区的人可能听不懂对方的方言，但由于汉字有统一的书写形式，他们交流起来几乎没有任何困难。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：并列复合句。分句1 People from different regions may not understand each other's dialects；分句2 they hardly have difficulty in communicating。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：since Chinese characters have a unified writing form 为 since 引导的原因状语从句，置于分句2内表原因。层次：分句1(People...may not understand dialects)→[转折连词 however]→分句主干(they hardly have difficulty in communicating)→[since 原因状语从句 Chinese characters have a unified writing form]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：however 表转折；since 引导原因状语从句「由于」（语气弱于 because）；have difficulty in doing 为固定搭配「做某事有困难」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「来自不同地区的人可能听不懂对方的方言，但由于……他们交流起来几乎没有困难」译文用 however 转折并列，from different regions 介词短语后置作定语；「交流起来几乎没有困难」have hardly any difficulty in communicating，介词 in 后接动名词。
⑤ 易错点：have difficulty (in) doing 中 in 可省但后须接动名词；since 此处表原因勿误认「自从」；hardly 为半否定词「几乎不」，勿与 hard 混淆；each other's dialects 所有格。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：People from different regions may not understand each other's dialects | in China. However, | they hardly have difficulty in communicating | since Chinese characters have a unified writing form.
sentences.cut: [分句1 S:People [后置定语 from different regions] V:may not understand O:each other's dialects [地点 in China.] [转折连词 However,] [分句2 S:they V:have [状语 hardly] O:difficulty [状语 in communicating,] [since 原因状语从句 S:Chinese characters V:have O:a unified writing form]]]
phrases: from different regions　来自不同地区
understand each other's dialects　听懂彼此的方言
have difficulty in doing　做某事有困难
since 引导原因状语　由于……
a unified writing form　统一的书写形式

sentences.en: These idioms, largely derived from ancient Chinese literary works, are usually related to certain myths, legends or historical events.
sentences.zh: 成语大多来源于中国古代的文学作品，通常与某些神话、传说或者历史事件有关。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：These idioms（主语）are usually related to（谓语）certain myths, legends or historical events（宾语）——被动短语 be related to。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。largely derived from ancient Chinese literary works 为过去分词短语作插入语/后置定语，置于主语 These idioms 与谓语之间，用逗号隔开。层次：主语(These idioms)→[过去分词插入语 largely derived from...]→谓语+宾语(are usually related to...)。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：derived from 为过去分词短语表被动「来源于」；be related to 固定搭配「与……有关」；myths, legends or historical events 为三个并列名词短语。
④ 翻译要点：中文「成语大多来源于……，通常与……有关」译文把「来源于……」降格为过去分词插入语 largely derived from...，主干保留「与……有关」are related to...，避免两个谓语堆砌；「神话、传说或者历史事件」myths, legends or historical events 并列。
⑤ 易错点：derived 为过去分词表被动（勿用 deriving）；be related to 中 to 为介词后接名词；插入语前后用逗号隔开，谓语仍与主语 idioms 保持复数一致 are。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：These idioms, | largely derived from ancient Chinese literary works, | are usually related to certain myths, legends or historical events.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:These idioms, [过去分词插入语 largely derived from ancient Chinese literary works,] V:are usually related [介词 to certain myths, legends or historical events]]
phrases: be derived from　来源于（过去分词）
ancient Chinese literary works　中国古代文学作品
be related to　与……有关
myths, legends or historical events　神话、传说或历史事件

sentences.en: It will be difficult to grasp the exact meaning without knowing the source of an idiom.
sentences.zh: 如果不知道某个成语的出处，就很难理解其确切含义。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：It（形式主语）will be（系动词）difficult（表语）——主系表；真正主语为 to grasp the exact meaning。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。without knowing the source of an idiom 为 without + 动名词短语作条件状语，相当于 if one does not know...。层次：[形式主语 It]→系表 will be difficult→[真正主语 to grasp the exact meaning]→[without 条件状语 knowing the source of an idiom]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：It 为形式主语，真正主语 to grasp... 后置；without 为介词后接动名词 knowing 表「如果不/没有」；the source of an idiom「成语的出处」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「如果不知道……，就很难理解……」译文用 It will be difficult to do... 形式主语句型，把「很难理解其确切含义」主干化；「如果不知道出处」用 without knowing... 介词短语条件状语，避免 if 从句补主语。
⑤ 易错点：It 形式主语勿译「它」；without 为介词后接动名词 knowing（勿接动词原形 know）；grasp the exact meaning「理解确切含义」，grasp 比 understand 更书面。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：It will be difficult to grasp the exact meaning | without knowing the source of an idiom.
sentences.cut: [主句 [形式主语 It] V:will be C:difficult [真正主语 to grasp O:the exact meaning] [without 条件状语 without [动名词 knowing O:the source of an idiom]]]
phrases: It will be difficult to do　做某事将很困难（It形式主语）
grasp the exact meaning　理解确切含义
without doing　不做某事（条件状语，后接动名词）
the source of an idiom　成语的出处

sentences.en: Some dialects, especially the dialects of the North and the South, vary so much that it is often difficult for people who speak different dialects to understand each other's speeches.
sentences.zh: 有些方言，特别是北方和南方的方言，差异很大，以至于说不同方言的人常常很难听懂彼此的讲话。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Some dialects（主语）vary（谓语）so much（状语）——主谓结构。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：that it is often difficult for people who speak different dialects to understand each other's speeches 为 that 引导的结果状语从句，与前面 so 呼应 so...that「如此……以至于」；该从句中 it 为形式主语，真正主语为 for people...to understand...；people 后又带 who speak different dialects 限制性定语从句。层次：主句(Some dialects vary so much)→[结果状语从句 that it is difficult]→[形式主语 it / 真正主语 for people to understand]→[定语从句 who speak different dialects 修饰 people]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：so...that... 结果状语结构；it 形式主语（真正主语 for people to understand）；who 引导定语从句指代 people；especially 为插入语「尤其」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「有些方言，特别是北方和南方的方言，差异很大，以至于……」译文用 especially the dialects of the North and the South 作插入语；so...that... 结果从句；从句内 it is difficult for people to do 形式主语句型；「说不同方言的人」people who speak different dialects 定语从句。
⑤ 易错点：so...that 中 so 后接副词 much；it is difficult for sb to do 中 it 不可省；who 定语从句修饰 people（复数）谓语用 speak；speeches 此处指「话语/讲话」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Some dialects, especially the dialects of the North and the South, | vary so much | that it is often difficult for people [who speak different dialects] | to understand each other's speeches.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Some dialects, [插入语 especially the dialects of the North and the South,] V:vary [状语 so much] [结果状语从句 that [形式主语 it] V:is [表语 often difficult [逻辑主语 for people [定语从句 who V:speak O:different dialects] [真正主语 to understand O:each other's speeches]]]]]
phrases: especially　尤其（插入语）
the dialects of the North and the South　北方和南方的方言
so...that...　如此……以至于……
it is difficult for sb to do　某人做某事很困难（it形式主语）
people who speak different dialects　说不同方言的人（定语从句）
understand each other's speeches　听懂彼此的讲话

sentences.en: In order to encourage people to speak local dialects more frequently, some local governments have taken measures such as opening dialect classes in schools and broadcasting dialect programs on radio and television to preserve local cultural heritage.
sentences.zh: 为了鼓励人们更多说本地方言，一些地方政府已经采取措施，如在学校开设方言课，在广播和电视上播放方言节目，以期保存本地的文化遗产。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：some local governments（主语）have taken（谓语，现在完成时）measures（宾语）——主谓宾。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句首 In order to encourage people to speak local dialects more frequently 为不定式短语作目的状语；such as opening dialect classes...and broadcasting dialect programs... 为 such as + 两个并列动名词短语作 measures 的举例后置定语；句末 to preserve local cultural heritage 为不定式短语作目的状语。层次：[目的状语 In order to encourage people...]→主句(have taken measures)→[such as 举例 opening...and broadcasting...]→[目的状语 to preserve...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：In order to 表目的「为了」；such as 表举例后接动名词；opening...and broadcasting... 为两个并列动名词共享 such as；to preserve 不定式表目的。
④ 翻译要点：中文「为了鼓励……，一些地方政府已经采取措施，如……，以期保存……」译文用 In order to... 目的状语前置，主干 have taken measures，such as opening...and broadcasting... 举例修饰 measures，句末 to preserve local cultural heritage 目的状语收束。
⑤ 易错点：In order to 后接动词原形 encourage；such as 后接动名词 opening/broadcasting（勿接原形）；两个动名词短语并列共享 such as；to preserve 不定式表目的勿改 for preserving。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：In order to encourage people to speak local dialects more frequently, | some local governments have taken measures | such as opening dialect classes in schools and broadcasting dialect programs on radio and television | to preserve local cultural heritage.
sentences.cut: [目的状语 In order to encourage O:people [宾补 to speak local dialects [状语 more frequently,]] [主句 S:some local governments V:have taken O:measures [such as 举例 opening O:dialect classes [地点 in schools] and broadcasting O:dialect programs [地点 on radio and television]]] [目的状语 to preserve O:local cultural heritage]]
phrases: in order to　为了……（后接动词原形）
encourage sb to do　鼓励某人做某事
take measures　采取措施
such as opening...and broadcasting...　如开设……并播放……（such as后接动名词并列）
dialect programs on radio and television　广播电视上的方言节目
preserve local cultural heritage　保存本地文化遗产

sentences.en: Its flowering period lasts as long as two or three months, attracting tourists from all over the country to come and enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 荷花花期长达两三个月，吸引来自各地的游客前来观赏。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Its flowering period（主语）lasts（谓语）as long as two or three months（状语）——主谓结构。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句末 attracting tourists from all over the country to come and enjoy it 为现在分词短语作结果状语，逻辑主语为前面整句话（「花期长」这件事）。层次：主句(Its flowering period lasts...)→[现在分词结果状语 attracting tourists...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：last as long as「持续长达」；现在分词 attracting 表自然而然的结果；attract sb to do「吸引某人做某事」；from all over the country 介词短语后置修饰 tourists。
④ 翻译要点：中文「荷花花期长达两三个月，吸引来自各地的游客前来观赏」译文主干 Its flowering period lasts as long as two or three months，「吸引……」用现在分词 attracting tourists...to come and enjoy it 作结果状语，把第二短句降格，不另起谓语。
⑤ 易错点：last 为动词「持续」勿误作形容词；现在分词 attracting 逻辑主语为整句（勿用 attract）；attract sb to do 中 to 为不定式符号；tourists from all over the country 后置定语。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Its flowering period lasts as long as two or three months, | attracting tourists from all over the country | to come and enjoy it.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Its flowering period V:lasts [状语 as long as two or three months,] [现在分词结果状语 attracting O:tourists [后置定语 from all over the country] [宾补 to come and enjoy it]]]
phrases: flowering period　花期
last as long as　持续长达
attract tourists from all over the country　吸引全国各地游客
come and enjoy it　前来观赏
现在分词作结果状语　attracting...

sentences.en: The lotus, which does not fear the blazing sun and remains clean in the muddy soil, symbolizes purity and elegance and represents people's noble virtues.
sentences.zh: 荷花迎骄阳而不惧，出淤泥而不染，象征纯洁、高雅，常用来比喻人的高尚品德。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：The lotus（主语）symbolizes（谓语1）purity and elegance（宾语1）and represents（谓语2）people's noble virtues（宾语2）——并列谓语。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：which does not fear the blazing sun and remains clean in the muddy soil 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，插入主语与谓语之间，补充说明荷花特性；从句内 does not fear...and remains clean... 为两个并列谓语。层次：主语(The lotus)→[非限制性定语从句 which does not fear...and remains clean...]→并列谓语(symbolizes...and represents...)。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：which 引导非限制性定语从句指代 the lotus；从句内 and 并列 does not fear 与 remains clean；symbolize/represent 两个并列谓语动词。
④ 翻译要点：中文「荷花迎骄阳而不惧，出淤泥而不染，象征纯洁、高雅，常来比喻人的高尚品德」译文把「迎骄阳而不惧，出淤泥而不染」处理为 which 非限制性定语从句插入主干，主干保留「象征……，比喻……」symbolizes purity and elegance and represents people's noble virtues，两个并列谓语。
⑤ 易错点：which 非限制性定语从句用逗号隔开；从句内 and 并列两个谓语动词时态一致；symbolize 与 represent 并列共享主语 the lotus（单数）；muddy soil「淤泥」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：The lotus, [which does not fear the blazing sun | and remains clean in the muddy soil], | symbolizes purity and elegance | and represents people's noble virtues.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:The lotus, [非限制性定语从句 which V:does not fear O:the blazing sun [并列 and V:remains C:clean [状语 in the muddy soil,]]] V:symbolizes O:purity and elegance [并列 and V:represents O:people's noble virtues]]
phrases: blazing sun　骄阳
remain clean in the muddy soil　出淤泥而不染
symbolize purity and elegance　象征纯洁与高雅
represent people's noble virtues　比喻人的高尚品德
which 引导非限制性定语从句　补充说明荷花特性

sentences.en: In the Tang Dynasty, peonies were planted so widely in the royal gardens as "the national flower" that they enjoyed great popularity across the country.
sentences.zh: 唐代时期，牡丹在皇家园林普遍种植并被誉为国花，因而特别风行。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：peonies（主语）were planted（谓语，被动）——被动主谓结构。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：that they enjoyed great popularity across the country 为 that 引导的结果状语从句，与前面 so...as...that... 结构呼应；本句 so widely...as 'the national flower' that...。层次：主句(peonies were planted so widely in the royal gardens as 'the national flower')→[结果状语从句 that they enjoyed great popularity...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：so...that... 结果状语结构（so widely 修饰 were planted）；as 'the national flower' 介词短语作主语补足语「作为国花」；enjoy great popularity「大受欢迎」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「唐代时期，牡丹在皇家园林普遍种植并被誉为国花，因而特别风行」译文用被动 were planted so widely...as 'the national flower' that they enjoyed great popularity，so...that 结果从句承接「因而特别风行」；「被誉为国花」as 'the national flower' 作主补。
⑤ 易错点：so 后接副词 widely；被动 were planted（peonies 复数）；as 此处为介词「作为」勿误作连词；enjoy popularity 为固定搭配。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：In the Tang Dynasty, | peonies were planted so widely in the royal gardens as "the national flower" | that they enjoyed great popularity across the country.
sentences.cut: [时间状语 In the Tang Dynasty, [主句 S:peonies V:were planted [状语 so widely [地点 in the royal gardens] [主补 as "the national flower"]] [结果状语从句 that S:they V:enjoyed O:great popularity [地点 across the country]]]
phrases: the Tang Dynasty　唐代
be planted widely　广泛种植（被动）
the royal gardens　皇家园林
the national flower　国花
so...that...　如此……以至于……
enjoy great popularity　大受欢迎

sentences.en: Nowadays, hundreds of thousands of domestic tourists pour in Luoyang for the annual peony festival, when they can both appreciate the unique beauty of the flowers and explore the history of the city which is known as the capital of six dynasties.
sentences.zh: 现在，成千上万的国内游客蜂拥到洛阳参加一年一度的牡丹节，欣赏洛阳牡丹的独特之美，同时探索九朝古都的历史。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：hundreds of thousands of domestic tourists（主语）pour in（谓语）Luoyang（宾语）——主谓宾。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：when they can both appreciate...and explore... 为 when 引导的非限制性定语从句修饰 the annual peony festival；该从句中又嵌套 which is known as the capital of six dynasties 限制性定语从句修饰 the city。层次：主句(tourists pour in Luoyang for the festival)→[when 非限制性定语从句 they can both appreciate...and explore...]→[which 限制性定语从句修饰 the city]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：when 为关系副词引导定语从句修饰 festival（在节期期间）；both...and... 并列 appreciate 与 explore；which 引导定语从句修饰 the city。
④ 翻译要点：中文「成千上万的国内游客蜂拥到洛阳参加一年一度的牡丹节，欣赏……，同时探索……」译文主干 tourists pour in Luoyang for the annual peony festival，用 when 定语从句承接「在节期期间游客可欣赏……并探索……」；「九朝古都」the city which is known as the capital of six dynasties 定语从句。
⑤ 易错点：pour in「蜂拥而入」；when 定语从句修饰 festival（勿误作时间状语从句）；both...and... 并列两个动词原形；which 定语从句修饰 the city。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Nowadays, hundreds of thousands of domestic tourists pour in Luoyang for the annual peony festival, | when they can both appreciate the unique beauty of the flowers | and explore the history of the city [which is known as the capital of six dynasties].
sentences.cut: [时间状语 Nowadays, [主句 S:hundreds of thousands of domestic tourists V:pour in O:Luoyang [目的 for the annual peony festival,] [when 非限制性定语从句 when S:they V:can both appreciate O:the unique beauty of the flowers [并列 and explore O:the history of the city [限制性定语从句 which V:is known [主补 as the capital of six dynasties]]]]]
phrases: hundreds of thousands of　成千上万的
domestic tourists　国内游客
pour in Luoyang　蜂拥到洛阳
the annual peony festival　一年一度的牡丹节
when 引导定语从句　在（牡丹节）期间
both...and...　既……又……
the capital of six dynasties　九朝古都

sentences.en: In traditional Chinese culture plum blossom symbolizes toughness, purity and grace, motivating people to face hardships and move forward bravely.
sentences.zh: 在中国传统文化中，梅花象征着坚强、纯洁、高雅，激励人们不畏艰难、砥砺前行。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：plum blossom（主语）symbolizes（谓语）toughness, purity and grace（宾语）——主谓宾，三个并列抽象名词作宾语。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。句末 motivating people to face hardships and move forward bravely 为现在分词短语作结果状语，逻辑主语为前面整句话（梅花象征美好品德这件事）。层次：[状语 In traditional Chinese culture]→主干(plum blossom symbolizes toughness, purity and grace)→[现在分词结果状语 motivating people to face...and move forward...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：symbolize「象征」；现在分词 motivating 表结果；motivate sb to do「激励某人做某事」；face hardships and move forward bravely 两个并列不定式共享 to。
④ 翻译要点：中文「梅花象征着坚强、纯洁、高雅，激励人们不畏艰难、砥砺前行」译文主干 symbolizes toughness, purity and grace，「激励人们……」用现在分词 motivating people to face hardships and move forward bravely 作结果状语，不另起谓语。
⑤ 易错点：symbolize 为及物动词直接接宾语；现在分词 motivating 逻辑主语为整句；motivate sb to do 后接不定式；face hardships and move forward 并列不定式共享 to。
