⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：In traditional Chinese culture | plum blossom symbolizes toughness, purity and grace, | motivating people to face hardships | and move forward bravely.
sentences.cut: [状语 In traditional Chinese culture, [主句 S:plum blossom V:symbolizes O:toughness, purity and grace,] [现在分词结果状语 motivating O:people [宾补 to face hardships [并列 and move forward bravely]]]]
phrases: traditional Chinese culture　中国传统文化
symbolize toughness, purity and grace　象征坚强、纯洁、高雅
motivate sb to do　激励某人做某事
face hardships　不畏艰难
move forward bravely　砥砺前行
现在分词作结果状语　motivating...

sentences.en: Nanjing city has designated plum blossom as the city flower and holds the flower festival every year, which attracts hundreds of thousands of people to appreciate the flower in snow despite the cold.
sentences.zh: 南京市已将梅花定为市花，每年举办梅花节，成千上万的人冒着严寒到梅花山踏雪赏梅。
sentences.parse:
五要素解析：
① 句子主干：Nanjing city（主语）has designated（谓语1）plum blossom as the city flower（宾补）and holds（谓语2）the flower festival（宾语）——并列谓语，现在完成时+一般现在时。
② 从句类型与嵌套层次：which attracts hundreds of thousands of people to appreciate the flower in snow despite the cold 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰前面整句话（「每年举办梅花节」这件事）。层次：主句(Nanjing has designated...and holds the festival...)→[which 非限制性定语从句 attracts people to appreciate...]。
③ 关键连接词/引导词：which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前文整句；designate sth as「把某物定为」；attract sb to do「吸引某人做某事」；despite the cold 介词短语「尽管寒冷」。
④ 翻译要点：中文「南京市已将梅花定为市花，每年举办梅花节，成千上万的人冒着严寒到梅花山踏雪赏梅」译文主干 Nanjing has designated plum blossom as the city flower and holds the flower festival every year，「成千上万的人冒着严寒赏梅」用 which attracts hundreds of thousands of people to appreciate the flower in snow despite the cold 非限制性定语从句承接。
⑤ 易错点：designate sth as 中 as 勿漏；which 非限制性定语从句指代整句时谓语用单数 attracts；despite 为介词后接名词 the cold（勿接句子）；in snow「冒着雪」。
⑥ 断句版（| 切意群）：Nanjing city has designated plum blossom as the city flower | and holds the flower festival every year, | which attracts hundreds of thousands of people | to appreciate the flower in snow despite the cold.
sentences.cut: [主句 S:Nanjing city V:has designated O:plum blossom [宾补 as the city flower] [并列 and V:holds O:the flower festival [时间 every year,] [which 非限制性定语从句 which V:attracts O:hundreds of thousands of people [宾补 to appreciate O:the flower [地点 in snow [让步 despite the cold]]]]]
phrases: designate sth as the city flower　将某物定为市花
hold the flower festival　举办梅花节
which 引导非限制性定语从句　指代整句
attract hundreds of thousands of people　吸引成千上万的人
appreciate the flower in snow　踏雪赏梅
despite the cold　冒着严寒

sentences.en: The 1,956-kilometre Qinghai-Tibet Railway is the world's highest and longest plateau railway with 960 kilometres above the altitude of 4,000 metres, and it is the first train line connecting Tibet and other areas of China.
sentences.zh: 青藏铁路全长1956公里，是世界上最高、最长的高原铁路，其中960公里位于海拔4000米之上，它也是连接西藏与中国其他地区的第一条铁路。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】并列句，由 and 连接两个主系表分句：前分句 The 1,956-kilometre Qinghai-Tibet Railway(S) is(V) the world's highest and longest plateau railway(C)；后分句 it(S) is(V) the first train line(C)。【2. 从句/短语层次】① with 960 kilometres above the altitude of 4,000 metres 为 with 复合介词短语，后置修饰 plateau railway；② connecting Tibet and other areas of China 为现在分词短语，后置修饰 the first train line。层次：并列句前分句→[with短语]；并列句后分句→[现在分词短语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】and 连接两个并列主系表分句；with 引出“拥有/带有”的定语；connecting 主动修饰 line。【4. 翻译要点】中文流水短句“全长1956公里，其中有960公里……是连接……第一条铁路”，英译把“全长”处理为前置复合定语 1,956-kilometre，“其中960公里”译为 with 短语，“连接……”译为现在分词 connecting，使英文结构紧凑。【5. 易错点】① 1,956-kilometre 作前置定语用单数连字符形式；② “海拔4000米之上”用 above the altitude of 4,000 metres；③ connecting 是非谓语修饰 line，勿误作并列谓语。【断句版】The 1,956-kilometre Qinghai-Tibet Railway is the world's highest and longest plateau railway | with 960 kilometres above the altitude of 4,000 metres |, and it is the first train line | connecting Tibet and other areas of China.
sentences.cut: [[并列分句1 S:The 1,956-kilometre Qinghai-Tibet Railway V:is C:the world's highest and longest plateau railway [后置定语 with 960 kilometres above the altitude of 4,000 metres]]] + [[并列连词 and 连接后一分句 S:it V:is C:the first train line [后置定语 connecting Tibet and other areas of China]]]
phrases: Qinghai-Tibet Railway　青藏铁路
plateau railway　高原铁路
the altitude of 4,000 metres　海拔4000米
train line　铁路线
connect Tibet and other areas of China　连接西藏与中国其他地区

sentences.en: It is the world's longest sea-crossing transportation system combining bridges and tunnels, which joins the three cities, cutting the traveling time among them from 3 hours to 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 它是世界上最长的跨海桥梁隧道综合交通系统，将三座城市连接起来，把它们之间的通行时间从3小时缩短到30分钟。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】It(S) is(V) the world's longest sea-crossing transportation system(C)，主系表。【2. 从句/短语层次】① combining bridges and tunnels 现在分词短语后置修饰 system；② which joins the three cities 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，先行词为跨海交通系统；③ cutting the traveling time among them from 3 hours to 30 minutes 为现在分词短语作结果状语。层次：主句→[现在分词定语]→[which非限定定从]→[现在分词结果状语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】which 指代交通系统、在从句中作主语；combining/cutting 一作定语一作结果状语。【4. 翻译要点】中文多个短句“是……系统。大桥将三个城市连接起来……从3小时缩短到30分钟”，英译用 combining 合并“桥梁和隧道”、which 定从衔接“连接三城”、现在分词 cutting 表“从而缩短”的结果。【5. 易错点】① combining bridges and tunnels 勿误作并列谓语；② cutting 的逻辑主语是整件事；③ from...to... 固定搭配。【断句版】It is the world's longest sea-crossing transportation system | combining bridges and tunnels |, which joins the three cities |, cutting the traveling time among them | from 3 hours to 30 minutes.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:It V:is C:the world's longest sea-crossing transportation system [后置定语 combining bridges and tunnels] [非限定定语从句 S:which V:joins O:the three cities] [结果状语 cutting the traveling time among them from 3 hours to 30 minutes]]]
phrases: sea-crossing transportation system　跨海交通系统
combine bridges and tunnels　桥梁与隧道相结合
join the three cities　连接三座城市
cut the traveling time　缩短通行时间
from 3 hours to 30 minutes　从3小时到30分钟

sentences.en: The terminals feature a compact design to allow the maximum number of planes to park closest to their centre, which offers passengers considerable convenience.
sentences.zh: 航站楼设计紧凑，可让最多数量的飞机停靠在离其中心最近的位置，这给乘客带来了极大的便利。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】The terminals(S) feature(V) a compact design(O)，主谓宾（feature 此处作动词“设计有/以……为特色”）。【2. 从句/短语层次】① to allow the maximum number of planes to park closest to their centre 为不定式短语作目的状语，其中 to park 是 allow sth to do 的宾补；② which offers passengers considerable convenience 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，指代前面整件事。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】which 指代主句整件事、在从句中作主语；to allow...to park 体现 allow sth to do 使役结构。【4. 翻译要点】中文流水句“航站楼设计紧凑，可以允许最大数量的飞机……这给乘客提供了极大的方便”，英译用 feature a compact design 作谓语、to allow...to park 表目的、which 定从承接“这”。【5. 易错点】① feature 此处为动词非名词；② their 指代 terminals；③ which 指代整件事，勿误以为只修饰 centre。【断句版】The terminals feature a compact design | to allow the maximum number of planes to park closest to their centre |, which offers passengers considerable convenience.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The terminals V:feature O:a compact design [目的状语 to allow [宾补 the maximum number of planes to park closest to their centre]] [非限定定语从句 S:which V:offers O:passengers O:considerable convenience（双宾）]]]
phrases: terminal　航站楼
feature a compact design　设计紧凑
allow the maximum number of planes to park　让最多飞机停靠
closest to their centre　离其中心最近
offer passengers considerable convenience　给乘客带来极大便利

sentences.en: As most beaches are ideal places for swimming and sunbathing almost all the year around, it is well recognized as China's four-season garden and holiday resort and attracts a large number of domestic and foreign tourists.
sentences.zh: 由于大部分海滩几乎全年都是游泳和日光浴的理想场所，它被誉为中国的四季花园和度假胜地，每年都吸引着大批中外游客。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】主句 it(S) 带两个并列谓语：is well recognized as...（被动）与 attracts...（主动）。【2. 从句/短语层次】① As most beaches are ideal places for swimming and sunbathing almost all the year around 为 As 引导的原因状语从句；② 主句并列谓语 is well recognized as China's four-season garden and holiday resort / attracts a large number of domestic and foreign tourists。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】As 表“由于/因为”引导原因状语从句；and 连接主句两个并列谓语。【4. 翻译要点】中文“大部分海滩……理想场所，因而被誉为……每年都吸引……”用“因而”表因果，英译把 As 从句前置表原因，主句用被动 is recognized as 对应“被誉为”，再用 and attracts 承接并列结果。【5. 易错点】① sunbathing 日光浴双写；② all the year around=全年；③ 被动 is well recognized as 勿误译为主动。【断句版】As most beaches are ideal places for swimming and sunbathing | almost all the year around |, it is well recognized as China's four-season garden and holiday resort | and attracts a large number of domestic and foreign tourists.
sentences.cut: [[原因状语从句 As S:most beaches V:are C:ideal places for swimming and sunbathing [状语 almost all the year around]]] + [[主句 S:it V1:is well recognized as C:China's four-season garden and holiday resort [并列谓语 V2:attracts O:a large number of domestic and foreign tourists]]]
phrases: ideal places for swimming and sunbathing　游泳与日光浴的理想场所
all the year around　全年
be well recognized as　被誉为
four-season garden　四季花园
holiday resort　度假胜地
domestic and foreign tourists　中外游客

sentences.en: Yunnan is home to 25 ethnic minorities, who have their own language, custom and religion.
sentences.zh: 云南是25个少数民族的聚居地，这些民族拥有自己的语言、习俗和宗教。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Yunnan(S) is(V) home to 25 ethnic minorities(C)，主系表；be home to 为固定搭配“是……的聚居地/家园”。【2. 从句/短语层次】who have their own language, custom and religion 为 who 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 25 ethnic minorities，who 在从句中作主语。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】who 指代“25个少数民族”，非限制性定语从句作补充说明。【4. 翻译要点】中文无主句“云南居住着25个少数民族，他们大多有自己的语言、习俗和宗教”，英译用 be home to 表“居住着/是……家园”，再用 who 定从衔接“他们”。【5. 易错点】① be home to 勿直译作“云南的家”；② ethnic minorities 用复数；③ 指人用 who，勿用 which。【断句版】Yunnan is home to 25 ethnic minorities |, who have their own language, custom and religion.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Yunnan V:is C:home to 25 ethnic minorities [非限定定语从句 S:who V:have O:their own language, custom and religion]]]
phrases: be home to　是……的聚居地/家园
ethnic minorities　少数民族
language, custom and religion　语言、习俗与宗教

sentences.en: Qinghai is a province in the northwest of China with an average altitude of over 3,000 meters, most of which consists of mountains and plateaus.
sentences.zh: 青海是中国西北部的一个省份，平均海拔3000米以上，其大部分地区由高山和高原构成。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Qinghai(S) is(V) a province(C)，主系表。【2. 从句/短语层次】① in the northwest of China 介词短语后置修饰 province；② with an average altitude of over 3,000 meters 为 with 复合介词短语后置修饰；③ most of which consists of mountains and plateaus 为“代词+of which”引导的非限制性定语从句，which 指代先行词 province（青海）。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】with 引出“拥有”的定语；most of which 为分隔式非限定从，which 指代青海。【4. 翻译要点】中文流水短句“青海是中国西北部的一个省份，平均海拔3000米以上，大部分地区为高山和高原”，英译把“平均海拔3000米以上”译为 with 短语，“大部分地区为高山高原”译为 most of which consists of...。【5. 易错点】① most of which 为非限定从，勿写成 and most of it；② consist of 无被动；③ 青海在西北(northwest)勿误作 northeast。【断句版】Qinghai is a province in the northwest of China | with an average altitude of over 3,000 meters |, most of which consists of mountains and plateaus.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Qinghai V:is C:a province [后置定语 in the northwest of China] [后置定语 with an average altitude of over 3,000 meters] [非限定定语从句 S:most of which V:consists of O:mountains and plateaus]]]
phrases: in the northwest of China　中国西北部
an average altitude of over 3,000 meters　平均海拔3000米以上
most of which　其中大部分（地区）
consist of mountains and plateaus　由高山和高原构成
plateau　高原

sentences.en: The site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC) is located at No. 76 Xingye Road, Shanghai, which is a typical Shanghai style residence built in the autumn of 1920.
sentences.zh: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址位于上海兴业路76号，是一栋典型的上海式住宅，建于1920年秋。
sentences.parse:
【断句】The site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC) | is located at No. 76 Xingye Road, Shanghai, | which is a typical Shanghai style residence | built in the autumn of 1920.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC) [S] is located [V] at No. 76 Xingye Road, Shanghai [A 地点状语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：主句 S+V+A → which 引导的非限制性定语从句（which is a typical Shanghai style residence built in the autumn of 1920），修饰会址；从句内部又嵌入过去分词短语 built in the autumn of 1920 作后置定语修饰 residence。层次：主句 → which 非限制性定从 → 过去分词后置定语。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：which 指代会址（就近指代 a typical Shanghai style residence），在从句中作主语；built 为过去分词，表被动完成。
4. 翻译要点：中文原文是三句流水句（'位于…，是一栋…，建于…'），英文用一个主从复合句合并；which 定语从句在翻译时需拆成独立分句'是一栋典型的上海式住宅'；过去分词 built in the autumn of 1920 转译为'建于1920年秋'，按中文时间状语前置习惯处理。
5. 易错点：which 的先行词易误判为 Shanghai（城市），实际就近指代 a typical Shanghai style residence；'上海式住宅'不是 Shanghai's residence 而是 Shanghai style residence（石库门民居风格）；No. 76 Xingye Road 路名英译无冠词。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The site [定语 of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC)] V:is located A:at No. 76 Xingye Road, Shanghai] [非限制性定语从句 S:which V:is C:a typical Shanghai style residence [后置定语 built in the autumn of 1920]]]]
phrases: the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China　中国共产党第一次全国代表大会
be located at No. 76 Xingye Road　位于兴业路76号
Shanghai style residence　上海式住宅（石库门民居）
built in the autumn of 1920　建于1920年秋

sentences.en: There are nine revolutionary memorial halls in Yan'an, which collect a large number of important items left by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the revolutionaries of the older generation in the Yan'an period.
sentences.zh: 延安有9个革命纪念馆，珍藏着中共中央和老一辈革命家在延安时期留存下来的大量重要物品。
sentences.parse:
【断句】There are nine revolutionary memorial halls in Yan'an, | which collect a large number of important items | left by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China | and the revolutionaries of the older generation in the Yan'an period.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：There are [引导/V] nine revolutionary memorial halls [真正主语 S] in Yan'an [A 地点状语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：There be 主句 → which 非限制性定语从句修饰 nine revolutionary memorial halls；从句内部宾语 a large number of important items 后接过去分词短语 left by... 作后置定语。层次：There be 主句 → which 非限制性定从 → 过去分词后置定语 left by...。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：which 指代 nine revolutionary memorial halls，在从句中作主语；left by 为过去分词表被动，相当于 that are left by。
4. 翻译要点：中文'延安有9个革命纪念馆，珍藏着…'是流水句，英文用 There be + which 定从合并；'珍藏着'转译为 collect（而不是 treasure/hard-collect），符合博物馆语境；left by 转译为'留存下来的'，按中文长定语前置习惯，把'中共中央和老一辈革命家在延安时期留存下来的'前置到'大量重要物品'之前。
5. 易错点：There be 句型真正主语是 nine revolutionary memorial halls，不是 Yan'an；which 先行词是 halls 不是 Yan'an；'珍藏'不要直译为 treasure，collect a large number of items 更自然；left by 的逻辑主语是 items（物品被留存），不是 halls。
sentences.cut: [[There be 主句引导:There are S:nine revolutionary memorial halls A:in Yan'an] [非限制性定语从句 S:which V:collect O:a large number of important items [后置定语 left by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the revolutionaries of the older generation [A:in the Yan'an period]]]]]
phrases: revolutionary memorial hall　革命纪念馆
a large number of　大量的
important items　重要物品
be left by　由…留存下来
the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China　中共中央
revolutionaries of the older generation　老一辈革命家
in the Yan'an period　在延安时期

sentences.en: There are over 100 revolutionary sites in Jinggangshan, a vital base for patriotism and education of revolutionary traditions, which has become a revolutionary history museum without any walls.
sentences.zh: 井冈山现有100多处革命旧址，是爱国主义和革命传统教育的重要基地，已成为一个'没有围墙的革命历史博物馆'。
sentences.parse:
【断句】There are over 100 revolutionary sites in Jinggangshan, | a vital base for patriotism and education of revolutionary traditions, | which has become a revolutionary history museum without any walls.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：There are [引导/V] over 100 revolutionary sites [S] in Jinggangshan [A]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：There be 主句 → 插入同位语 a vital base for patriotism and education of revolutionary traditions（修饰井冈山整体）→ which 非限制性定语从句（which has become a revolutionary history museum without any walls）。层次：There be 主句 → 同位语短语 → which 非限制性定从。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：which 指代 Jinggangshan（井冈山整体），在从句中作主语；a vital base... 为名词同位语，补充说明井冈山的地位。
4. 翻译要点：中文是三句流水句，英文用 There be + 同位语 + which 定从重组；翻译时需把同位语'是爱国主义和革命传统教育的重要基地'按中文语序还原到'成为…博物馆'之前；'没有围墙的革命历史博物馆'译为 a revolutionary history museum without any walls，直译保留比喻。
5. 易错点：which 先行词是 Jinggangshan（地名），不是 sites；同位语 a vital base... 的修饰对象是井冈山整体；'爱国主义'是 patriotism（英文用 a vital base for patriotism，不是 patriotism education base）；'没有围墙的'是 without any walls，不是 wall-less。
sentences.cut: [[There be 主句引导:There are S:over 100 revolutionary sites A:in Jinggangshan] [同位语 a vital base for patriotism and education of revolutionary traditions] [非限制性定语从句 S:which V:has become C:a revolutionary history museum [后置定语 without any walls]]]]
phrases: revolutionary sites　革命旧址
a vital base　重要基地
patriotism　爱国主义
education of revolutionary traditions　革命传统教育
a revolutionary history museum without any walls　没有围墙的革命历史博物馆

sentences.en: The upper deck is a 4,589 metre-long four-lane road bridge, and the lower deck a 6,772 metre-long double-rail one which joins the original Tianjin-Pukou and Shanghai-Nanjing railway lines, shortening the traveling time across the river from 1.5 hours to 2 minutes.
sentences.zh: 上层的4车道公路桥长4589米，下层的双轨道铁路桥长6772米。铁路桥连接原来的天津——浦口和上海——南京两条铁路线，使火车过江从过去一个半小时缩短为现在的2分钟。
sentences.parse:
【断句】The upper deck is a 4,589 metre-long four-lane road bridge, | and the lower deck a 6,772 metre-long double-rail one | which joins the original Tianjin-Pukou and Shanghai-Nanjing railway lines, | shortening the traveling time across the river from 1.5 hours to 2 minutes.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：并列复合句。分句1：The upper deck [S] is [V] a 4,589 metre-long four-lane road bridge [C]。分句2：the lower deck [S]（is 省略）a 6,772 metre-long double-rail one [C]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：并列主句（and 连接）→ which 限制性定语从句修饰 a 6,772 metre-long double-rail one（铁路桥）→ 现在分词短语 shortening the traveling time... 作结果状语。层次：并列主句 → which 定从 → 现在分词结果状语。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：and 连接两个并列分句（第二分句省略 is，避免重复）；which 指代 double-rail one（铁路桥），在从句中作主语；shortening 为现在分词，表自然而然的结果。
4. 翻译要点：英文一个长句涵盖中文两句（'上层…下层…。铁路桥连接…使…'），翻译时需拆为两句；'the lower deck a 6,772 metre-long double-rail one'省略了 is，翻译时补出'长6772米'；which joins 定语从句转译为独立分句'铁路桥连接…'；shortening 结果状语转译为'使火车过江从…缩短为…'，按中文主谓顺序重组。
5. 易错点：第二分句省略 is（the lower deck [is] a... one），阅读时易漏；one 指代 railway bridge，不是 deck；which 先行词是 double-rail one（铁路桥），不是 lower deck；shortening 的逻辑主语是前面整件事（铁路桥连接两条线），不是 bridge 本身；'4,589 metre-long'复合形容词中 metre 用单数。
sentences.cut: [[并列主句1 S:The upper deck V:is C:a 4,589 metre-long four-lane road bridge] [并列连词 and] [并列主句2 S:the lower deck V:(is 省略) C:a 6,772 metre-long double-rail one] [限制性定语从句 S:which V:joins O:the original Tianjin-Pukou and Shanghai-Nanjing railway lines] [结果状语 shortening O:the traveling time across the river [A:from 1.5 hours to 2 minutes]]]]
phrases: upper deck　（桥的）上层
lower deck　（桥的）下层
four-lane road bridge　4车道公路桥
double-rail one　双轨铁路桥
join the railway lines　连接铁路线
shorten the traveling time　缩短行程时间
across the river　过江

sentences.en: Built in 1192 and rebuilt in 1698, the Lugou Bridge, which is located 15 kilometres southwest of the Tian'anmen Square across the Yongding River, is the most ancient bridge with multiple arches in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 卢沟桥最初建成于1192年，1698年重建，位于天安门广场西南15公里处，横跨永定河，是北京现存最古老的多拱石桥。
sentences.parse:
【断句】Built in 1192 and rebuilt in 1698, | the Lugou Bridge, | which is located 15 kilometres southwest of the Tian'anmen Square across the Yongding River, | is the most ancient bridge with multiple arches in Beijing.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：the Lugou Bridge [S] is [V] the most ancient bridge with multiple arches in Beijing [C]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：句首过去分词短语 Built in 1192 and rebuilt in 1698 作状语 → 主句 S+V+C → 插入 which 非限制性定语从句（which is located 15 kilometres southwest of... across the Yongding River）作插入语修饰 the Lugou Bridge。层次：过去分词状语 → 主句 → which 非限制性定从（插入语）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：Built/rebuilt 为过去分词作状语，逻辑主语是 the Lugou Bridge；which 指代 the Lugou Bridge，在从句中作主语；and 连接 built 与 rebuilt 两个并列过去分词。
4. 翻译要点：中文是流水句（'建成于…，重建于…，位于…，横跨…，是…'），英文用过去分词状语+主句+插入定从重组；翻译时需把插入的 which 从句拆成独立分句'位于天安门广场西南15公里处，横跨永定河'；'北京现存最古老'译为 the most ancient bridge... in Beijing，ancient 已含'现存古老'之意。
5. 易错点：Built in 1192 的逻辑主语是 the Lugou Bridge（桥被建），不是 Beijing；which 从句是插入语，打断了主语和谓语 is 的连接，阅读时需跳过插入语找主干；'多拱石桥'是 bridge with multiple arches（参考译文用 multiple arches）；'西南15公里'是 15 kilometres southwest of，方位在前。
sentences.cut: [[过去分词状语 Built in 1192 and rebuilt in 1698] [主句 S:the Lugou Bridge V:is C:the most ancient bridge [定语 with multiple arches] [A:in Beijing]] [插入的非限制性定语从句 S:which V:is located A:15 kilometres southwest of the Tian'anmen Square across the Yongding River]]]
phrases: be built in 1192　建于1192年
be rebuilt in 1698　1698年重建
be located 15 kilometres southwest of　位于…西南15公里
across the Yongding River　横跨永定河
the most ancient bridge with multiple arches　最古老的多拱桥

sentences.en: The Zhaozhou Bridge is a pioneering undertaking in the world history of bridge construction and a masterpiece of the Chinese ancient civilization for the simple reason that its similar bridge did not appear in Europe until the 14th century, 700 years later than the Zhaozhou Bridge.
sentences.zh: 赵州桥是世界桥梁建筑史上的一次创举，是中国古代文明史上的一项杰出成就。类似设计的桥梁直到14世纪才在欧洲出现，比赵州桥晚了700多年。
sentences.parse:
【断句】The Zhaozhou Bridge is a pioneering undertaking in the world history of bridge construction | and a masterpiece of the Chinese ancient civilization | for the simple reason that its similar bridge did not appear in Europe until the 14th century, | 700 years later than the Zhaozhou Bridge.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The Zhaozhou Bridge [S] is [V] a pioneering undertaking... and a masterpiece of the Chinese ancient civilization [并列表语 C1+C2]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：主句 S+V+并列C → for the simple reason that... 引导原因状语（that 引导同位语从句说明 reason 的内容）→ 从句内部 its similar bridge [S] did not appear [V] in Europe [A] until the 14th century [时间A] → 700 years later than... 比较状语短语。层次：主句 → for the simple reason that 同位语从句 → until 时间状语 → 比较短语。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：and 连接两个并列表语 a pioneering undertaking 与 a masterpiece；for the simple reason that 为固定搭配，表'原因很简单，即…'，that 引导同位语从句；not...until 表'直到…才'；later than 表比较。
4. 翻译要点：英文一个长句涵盖中文两句（'赵州桥是…创举，是…成就。类似设计的桥梁直到…才…，比…晚…'），翻译时拆为两句；'for the simple reason that'转译为'（原因很简单）类似设计的桥梁…'，按中文因果顺序重组；'not...until the 14th century'译为'直到14世纪才在欧洲出现'；'700 years later than'译为'比赵州桥晚了700多年'。
5. 易错点：for the simple reason that 中 that 引导的是同位语从句（说明 reason 内容），不是定语从句；not...until 结构翻译时'直到…才'不能漏；its similar bridge 指代'类似设计的桥梁'，不是'它的相似桥'；700 years later than 是插入比较短语，修饰 did not appear 的时间。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Zhaozhou Bridge V:is [并列表语1 C1:a pioneering undertaking [定语 in the world history of bridge construction]] [并列连词 and] [并列表语2 C2:a masterpiece of the Chinese ancient civilization]] [原因状语 for the simple reason [同位语从句 that S:its similar bridge V:did not appear A:in Europe [时间状语 until the 14th century]] [比较状语 700 years later than the Zhaozhou Bridge]]]]
phrases: a pioneering undertaking　创举、开创性事业
the world history of bridge construction　世界桥梁建筑史
a masterpiece of the Chinese ancient civilization　中国古代文明的杰出成就
for the simple reason that　原因很简单、因为
not...until the 14th century　直到14世纪才
700 years later than　比…晚700年

sentences.en: With the continuous development of agriculture, the population kept increasing on the plateau, which became the political and economic centre of China in the Han Dynasty.
sentences.zh: 随着农耕业的持续发展，高原上的人口不断增加，该地区在汉代成为中国的政治和经济中心。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：参考译文将中文「秦汉时期」简化为 in the Han Dynasty（汉代）；「人口不断增加」为主句，「成为政治经济中心」用 which 非限定从衔接，which 指代 the plateau 而非 the population。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】the population(S) kept increasing(V) on the plateau(A)，主谓状结构（一般过去时）。【2. 从句/短语层次】① With the continuous development of agriculture 为 With 介词短语作背景状语（=随着……）；② which became the political and economic centre of China in the Han Dynasty 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，which 指代先行词 the plateau（高原），在从句中作主语。层次：[With状语]→主句→[which非限定从]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】With 介词引出「随着」背景；which 为关系代词，指代 the plateau，在非限定从中作主语，从句前有逗号。【4. 翻译要点】中文「随着……人口不断增加，……在秦汉时期成为……中心」为流水句，英译把「随着农耕业发展」译为 With 短语前置，「人口不断增加」为主句，「在秦汉时期成为中心」用 which 非限定从衔接，使英文层次分明。【5. 易错点】① which 指代 the plateau 而非 the population，勿误读为「人口成为中心」；② kept increasing 为过去时，描述历史；③ 参考译文将「秦汉时期」简化为 the Han Dynasty（汉代），与原中文「秦汉时期」略有出入，以参考译文为准。【断句版】With the continuous development of agriculture |, the population kept increasing on the plateau |, which became the political and economic centre of China | in the Han Dynasty.
sentences.cut: [[背景状语 With the continuous development of agriculture]] + [[主句 S:the population V:kept increasing A:on the plateau]] + [[非限定定语从句 S:which V:became C:the political and economic centre of China [时间状语 in the Han Dynasty]]]
phrases: the continuous development of agriculture　农耕业的持续发展
keep increasing　不断增加
the political and economic centre　政治和经济中心
the Han Dynasty　汉代
on the plateau　在高原上

sentences.en: The plateau slopes from the west to the east with many rivers flowing through, gradually forming a lot of steep canyons where there are fertile lands which benefit the growth of many crops.
sentences.zh: 高原西高东低，众多河流穿流而过，逐渐形成许多陡峭的峡谷，峡谷中土地肥沃，有利于多种农作物的生长。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：四层嵌套——with 伴随结构 + 现在分词结果状语 + where 定从 + which 定从；「西高东低」译为 slopes from the west to the east（向西倾斜即西高）。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】The plateau(S) slopes(V) from the west to the east(A)，主谓状。【2. 从句/短语层次】① with many rivers flowing through 为 with 复合结构（with + 宾语 + 现在分词宾补），作伴随状语；② gradually forming a lot of steep canyons 为现在分词短语作结果状语；③ where there are fertile lands 为 where 引导的限制性定语从句修饰 canyons；④ which benefit the growth of many crops 为 which 引导的限制性定语从句修饰 fertile lands。层次：主句→[with伴随]→[现在分词结果]→[where定从]→[which定从]（四层嵌套）。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】with 引出伴随；where 关系副词在定从中作地点状语；which 关系代词在定从中作主语。【4. 翻译要点】中文「西高东低，河流众多，形成峡谷。峡谷中土壤肥沃，有利于农作物生长」为两个独立短句，英译用 with 伴随合并「河流众多」，现在分词 forming 表「形成」的结果，where 定从衔接「峡谷中」，which 定从衔接「有利于」，层层嵌套使英文紧凑。【5. 易错点】① slopes from the west to the east = 西高东低（向西倾斜→西高）；② with many rivers flowing through 中 flowing 为宾补，非谓语；③ where 与 which 两个定从分别修饰 canyons 和 lands，勿混淆；④ fertile lands = 肥沃的土地。【断句版】The plateau slopes from the west to the east | with many rivers flowing through |, gradually forming a lot of steep canyons | where there are fertile lands | which benefit the growth of many crops.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The plateau V:slopes A:from the west to the east [伴随状语 with many rivers flowing through] [结果状语 gradually forming a lot of steep canyons [定语从句 where there are fertile lands [定语从句 S:which V:benefit O:the growth of many crops]]]]]
phrases: slope from the west to the east　西高东低
with many rivers flowing through　众多河流穿流而过
steep canyons　陡峭的峡谷
fertile lands　肥沃的土地
benefit the growth of crops　有利于农作物生长

sentences.en: The Chinese government has been endeavouring to conserve the ecosystem here, gradually increasing the fraction of green coverage and effectively protecting many endangered species.
sentences.zh: 中国政府一直在努力保护这里的生态系统，逐渐提高绿地覆盖率，并有效保护了许多濒危物种。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：现在完成进行时 has been endeavouring 译「一直在努力」；两个并列现在分词 increasing... and protecting... 作伴随结果状语，逻辑主语均为政府。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】The Chinese government(S) has been endeavouring(V) to conserve the ecosystem here(O)，主谓宾（现在完成进行时）。【2. 从句/短语层次】句末 gradually increasing... and effectively protecting... 为两个并列的现在分词短语作伴随/结果状语，共同修饰主句动作，二者由 and 并列。层次：主句→[现在分词状语1] and [现在分词状语2]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】has been endeavouring 为现在完成进行时，强调「一直在努力」的持续性；and 连接两个并列的现在分词 increasing 与 protecting。【4. 翻译要点】中文「中国一直在努力保护……生态系统，草地覆盖率不断增加，许多濒危物种得到了有效保护」为三个短句，英译用现在完成进行时 has been endeavouring 译「一直在努力」，两个现在分词短语 increasing... and protecting... 译出「覆盖率增加」和「物种得到保护」两个伴随结果，避免堆砌独立句。【5. 易错点】① endeavour to do = 努力做某事；② increasing 与 protecting 的逻辑主语都是 The Chinese government（政府主动提高覆盖率、主动保护物种），勿误读为被动；③ the fraction of green coverage = 绿地覆盖率；④ endangered species = 濒危物种。【断句版】The Chinese government has been endeavouring to conserve the ecosystem here |, gradually increasing the fraction of green coverage | and effectively protecting many endangered species.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Chinese government V:has been endeavouring O:to conserve the ecosystem here [伴随状语1 gradually increasing the fraction of green coverage] [并列连词 and] [伴随状语2 effectively protecting many endangered species]]]
phrases: endeavour to conserve the ecosystem　努力保护生态系统
the fraction of green coverage　绿地覆盖率
endangered species　濒危物种
effectively protect　有效保护

sentences.en: By building new squares, parks and public green spaces, or transforming existing public areas, many cities are setting aside more spaces for dwellers' recreational and social use.
sentences.zh: 通过兴建新的广场、公园和公共绿地，或改造原有公共场地，许多城市正为居民划出更多休闲与社交空间。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：By + 动名词短语作方式状语，building 与 transforming 由 or 并列（两种方式择一）；「提供更多场所」译为 are setting aside more spaces for...。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】many cities(S) are setting aside(V) more spaces(O) for dwellers' recreational and social use(A)，主谓宾状（现在进行时）。【2. 从句/短语层次】句首 By building new squares, parks and public green spaces, or transforming existing public areas 为 By + 动名词短语作方式状语，其中 building 与 transforming 由 or 并列（两种方式择一）；主句后 for dwellers' recreational and social use 为介词短语作目的状语。层次：[By方式状语(or并列)]→主句→[目的状语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】By 介词引出方式手段（通过……）；or 并列两个动名词 building 与 transforming；for 引出用途。【4. 翻译要点】中文「通过兴建……或对原有……改造，许多城市为市民提供了更多场所」为方式+主句结构，英译把「通过……」译为 By + 动名词短语前置，「提供了更多场所」用 are setting aside more spaces 译出，「休闲和社交」后置为 for...use。【5. 易错点】① By doing 结构中动名词不可用原形；② setting aside = 留出/拨出，勿误作 set up（建立）；③ dwellers' 所有格不可漏 apostrophe；④ recreational and social use = 休闲社交用途。【断句版】By building new squares, parks and public green spaces |, or transforming existing public areas |, many cities are setting aside more spaces | for dwellers' recreational and social use.
sentences.cut: [[方式状语 By [动名词1 building new squares, parks and public green spaces] [并列连词 or] [动名词2 transforming existing public areas]]] + [[主句 S:many cities V:are setting aside O:more spaces [目的状语 for dwellers' recreational and social use]]]
phrases: by building new squares, parks and public green spaces　通过兴建新广场、公园和公共绿地
transform existing public areas　改造原有公共场地
set aside more spaces for　为……划出更多空间
dwellers' recreational and social use　居民的休闲与社交用途
public green spaces　公共绿地

sentences.en: Statistics show that the sales volume of the Chinese publications, films and TV programmes, internet literature and cartoon products has been on the rise for years.
sentences.zh: 统计数据显示，中国出版物、影视节目、网络文学和动漫产品的销售量多年来持续上升。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：Statistics show that... 主谓宾宾从结构；主语 the sales volume 为单数，故谓语用 has been on the rise（尽管 of 后并列多个名词）。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Statistics(S) show(V) that...(O 宾语从句)，主谓宾。【2. 从句/短语层次】that 引导宾语从句：从句主语 the sales volume of the Chinese publications, films and TV programmes, internet literature and cartoon products 为并列名词短语，从句谓语 has been on the rise for years。层次：主句→[that宾语从句，其中主语为多项并列名词短语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】that 引导宾语从句（可省略，此处保留以正式）；of 短语作后置定语修饰 sales volume；多个名词由 and 并列。【4. 翻译要点】中文「数据显示，中国的出版物、影视作品、网络文学与动漫产品等在国外的销售量连年攀升」，英译用 Statistics show that... 主谓宾宾从结构，「销售量」译为 the sales volume of...，「连年攀升」译为 has been on the rise for years（现在完成时表持续）。【5. 易错点】① the sales volume 为单数，故谓语用 has been（尽管 of 后并列多个名词）；② publications, films and TV programmes, internet literature and cartoon products 四个并列项注意标点；③ on the rise = 上升，勿误作 on the raise；④ 参考译文中 the Chinese publications 多了 the，以原文为准。【断句版】Statistics show that | the sales volume of the Chinese publications, films and TV programmes, internet literature and cartoon products | has been on the rise | for years.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Statistics V:show [宾语从句 that S:the sales volume of the Chinese publications, films and TV programmes, internet literature and cartoon products V:has been on the rise [时间状语 for years]]]]
phrases: statistics show that...　统计数据显示……
sales volume　销售量
publications, films and TV programmes　出版物与影视节目
internet literature and cartoon products　网络文学与动漫产品
be on the rise　持续上升

sentences.en: At the same time, China has been giving great impetus to the systematic construction of urban infrastructure, and conducting surveys of housing buildings and municipal facilities as well as the investigation and rectification of potential safety hazards, in an effort to create a high-quality living environment for citizens and make cities more beautiful, safer and more livable.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，中国一直在大力推进城市基础设施的体系化建设，开展房屋建筑与市政设施普查以及安全隐患的排查与整治，努力为市民创造高品质的生活环境，使城市更美丽、更安全、更宜居。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：两个并列完成进行时谓语 has been giving... and conducting...；as well as 连接两个并列宾语；in an effort to 引出目的状语，create 与 make 并列。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】China(S) has been giving great impetus to... and conducting...(V 两个并列谓语)，主谓宾（现在完成进行时）。【2. 从句/短语层次】① 谓语1 has been giving great impetus to the systematic construction of urban infrastructure；② 谓语2 conducting surveys of housing buildings and municipal facilities as well as the investigation and rectification of potential safety hazards（as well as 连接两个并列宾语 surveys 和 investigation and rectification）；③ 句末 in an effort to create... and make... 为介词短语作目的状语，其中 create 与 make 并列。层次：主句[谓语1 + 谓语2(as well as并列)]→[in an effort to目的状语(create and make并列)]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】and 连接两个并列完成进行时谓语 giving 与 conducting；as well as 连接两个并列宾语；in an effort to 引出目的；and 连接 create 与 make。【4. 翻译要点】中文「同时大力推进……建设，开展……普查以及……排查整治，努力为市民创造……，让城市更……」为多个并列动作，英译用 has been giving great impetus to... and conducting... 两个并列完成进行时谓语，as well as 合并「普查」与「排查整治」，in an effort to 译「努力」，create... and make... 译「创造……让城市更……」。【5. 易错点】① give impetus to = 推动/促进；② as well as 后接名词性短语，勿接动词；③ investigation and rectification of potential safety hazards = 安全隐患排查整治；④ livable = 宜居的；⑤ 两个 has been 共享完成进行时态。【断句版】At the same time |, China has been giving great impetus to the systematic construction of urban infrastructure |, and conducting surveys of housing buildings and municipal facilities | as well as the investigation and rectification of potential safety hazards |, in an effort to create a high-quality living environment for citizens | and make cities more beautiful, safer and more livable.
sentences.cut: [[状语 At the same time]] + [[主句 S:China [并列谓语1 has been giving great impetus to O:the systematic construction of urban infrastructure] [并列连词 and] [并列谓语2 conducting O:surveys of housing buildings and municipal facilities [并列 as well as O:the investigation and rectification of potential safety hazards]] [目的状语 in an effort to [create O:a high-quality living environment for citizens] [并列连词 and] [make O:cities [宾补 more beautiful, safer and more livable]]]]]
phrases: give great impetus to　大力推进
systematic construction of urban infrastructure　城市基础设施体系化建设
surveys of housing buildings and municipal facilities　房屋建筑与市政设施普查
investigation and rectification of potential safety hazards　安全隐患排查整治
in an effort to　努力/力求
livable　宜居的

sentences.en: It is expected that China's elderly population will continue to increase, and the trend of population aging will become more obvious.
sentences.zh: 预计中国老年人口将继续增加，人口老龄化的趋势将更加明显。
sentences.parse:
【断句】It is expected that | China's elderly population will continue to increase, | and the trend of population aging will become more obvious.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：本句用 It 作形式主语，真正主语是 that 引导的主语从句；从句内部为并列句：分句1 China's elderly population [S1] will continue to increase [V1]，并列分句2 the trend of population aging [S2] will become [V2] more obvious [C2]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：主句 It is expected（被动）→ that 引导主语从句作真正主语 → that 从句内部由 and 连接两个并列分句。层次：主句(形式主语) → that 主语从句 → and 并列分句1/2。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：It 为形式主语，无实义；that 是连词引导主语从句（不是关系代词）；and 连接并列分句。
4. 翻译要点：形式主语 It is expected that 按中文习惯把真正主语提前，译为“预计中国老年人口将……”；被动 is expected 转译为主动“预计/人们预计”；and 并列分句按中文顺译。
5. 易错点：勿把 It 译为“它”；that 在此引导主语从句，不要当作定语从句的关系词；continue to increase 中 continue to do 表“继续”，will 与 continue 不冲突。
sentences.cut: [[主句形式主语:It V:is expected [主语从句 that [并列分句1 S:China's elderly population V:will continue O:to increase] [并列连词 and] [并列分句2 S:the trend of population aging V:will become C:more obvious]]]]
phrases: It is expected that...　预计、人们预计
elderly population　老年人口
continue to increase　继续增长
the trend of population aging　人口老龄化趋势
become more obvious　变得更加明显

sentences.en: What kind of care model for the elderly should be adopted is the most debated topic.
sentences.zh: 应当采取什么样的养老模式，是人们谈论最多的话题。
sentences.parse:
【断句】What kind of care model for the elderly | should be adopted | is the most debated topic.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：[What kind of care model for the elderly should be adopted]（主语从句作主语 S）+ is（系动词 V）+ the most debated topic（表语 C）。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：What kind of...引导主语从句充当全句主语；该从句内部为被动语态 should be adopted（what kind of care model 是 adopt 的逻辑宾语，被前置为引导词）；主句为系表结构。层次：主语从句（作主语）→ 系表主干。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：What kind of 引导主语从句并在从句中作 adopt 的宾语（前置）；should be adopted 为情态动词被动式。
4. 翻译要点：what 主语从句还原为中文主谓结构“应当采取什么样的养老模式”，再译系表“是人们谈论最多的话题”；被动 should be adopted 转主动“应当采取”；the most debated topic 译为“谈论最多/最受争议的话题”。
5. 易错点：What kind of care model 虽在从句句首，但因充当引导词，从句用陈述语序（不是疑问语序 should...be）；整句不是疑问句；the most debated 不要机械译为“被辩论最多”，实指“谈论最多”。
sentences.cut: [[主语从句 S:What kind of care model [定语 for the elderly] V:should be adopted] [主句系动词 V:is C:the most debated topic]]
phrases: care model for the elderly　养老模式
should be adopted　应当被采用、应当采取
the most debated topic　谈论最多的话题、最受争议的话题
for the elderly　为老年人的

sentences.en: The Chinese government is taking various measures to promote the construction of a service system for the elderly, so that the elderly can live a healthy and happy life in their later years.
sentences.zh: 中国政府正采取各种措施，推进养老服务体系建设，使老年人在晚年生活健康幸福。
sentences.parse:
【断句】The Chinese government is taking various measures | to promote the construction of a service system for the elderly, | so that the elderly can live a healthy and happy life in their later years.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The Chinese government [S] is taking [V] various measures [O]；so that 引导目的状语从句，从句中 the elderly [S2] can live [V2] a healthy and happy life [O2]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：主句 S+V+O → 不定式短语 to promote...作 measures 的后置定语/目的状语 → so that 引导目的状语从句。层次：主句 → 不定式 to promote 修饰 measures → so that 目的状语从句。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：to promote 不定式表目的；so that 引导目的状语从句（“以便、使”）；in their later years 介词短语作时间状语。
4. 翻译要点：take measures to do 译为“采取措施做某事”；so that 目的从句顺译“以便/使老年人……”；live a...life 为同源宾语，译为“过着……的生活”；in their later years 译为“在晚年”。
5. 易错点：to promote...是 measures 的定语而非独立目的，译“推进……建设”；so that 表目的（不是结果）；live a healthy and happy life 中 live 后接同源宾语，不可丢 a。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Chinese government V:is taking O:various measures [后置定语/目的 to promote the construction of a service system for the elderly]] [目的状语从句 so that S:the elderly V:can live O:a healthy and happy life [A:in their later years]]]
phrases: take various measures　采取各种措施
promote the construction of　推进……建设
a service system for the elderly　养老服务体系
so that　以便、使（目的）
live a healthy and happy life　过健康幸福的生活
in their later years　在晚年

sentences.en: Many fans feature exquisite designs, fine craftsmanship, and beautiful depictions of landscapes, flowers, birds, figures, and more, possessing high artistic value.
sentences.zh: 许多扇子造型优美、做工精良，并绘有山水、花鸟、人物等精美图案，具有很高的艺术价值。
sentences.parse:
【断句】Many fans feature | exquisite designs, fine craftsmanship, | and beautiful depictions of landscapes, flowers, birds, figures, and more, | possessing high artistic value.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：Many fans [S] feature [V] 三个并列宾语（exquisite designs / fine craftsmanship / beautiful depictions...）[O1+O2+O3]，句末 possessing high artistic value 为现在分词短语作伴随状语。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：主句 S+V+并列宾语 → 句末现在分词 possessing...作伴随/结果状语，逻辑主语为 many fans。层次：主句 → 三项并列宾语 → 现在分词伴随状语。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：feature 为谓语动词（“以……为特色、具有”）；and 连接并列宾语项；possessing 现在分词表伴随。
4. 翻译要点：feature 不译名词“特征”，而译“造型优美/具有”；三项并列宾语按中文四字格重组为“造型优美、做工精良、绘有……精美图案”；depictions of landscapes, flowers, birds, figures 译为“山水、花鸟、人物等图案”；possessing 伴随状语拆译为独立分句“具有很高的艺术价值”。
5. 易错点：feature 此处是动词（不是名词）；depictions 指“描绘出的图案”而非抽象“描述”；possessing 的逻辑主语是 fans（扇子具有艺术价值）。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Many fans V:feature [并列宾语 O1:exquisite designs] [并列 O2:fine craftsmanship] [并列 O3:beautiful depictions [定语 of landscapes, flowers, birds, figures, and more]]] [伴随状语 possessing O:high artistic value]]
phrases: feature exquisite designs　造型优美
fine craftsmanship　做工精良
depictions of landscapes, flowers, birds, figures　山水花鸟人物等图案
possess high artistic value　具有很高的艺术价值

sentences.en: Highly versatile, bamboo has been used extensively in production and daily life, such as in making chopsticks, furniture, bridges, and housing structures.
sentences.zh: 竹子实用性强，已被广泛用于生产和生活的许多方面，如制作筷子、桌椅、桥梁和房屋结构。
sentences.parse:
【断句】Highly versatile, | bamboo has been used extensively in production and daily life, | such as in making chopsticks, furniture, bridges, and housing structures.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：bamboo [S] has been used [V 现在完成被动] extensively [程度状语] in production and daily life [范围状语]；句首 Highly versatile 为形容词短语作状语（评价/原因）。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：形容词短语 Highly versatile 前置作状语 → 主句 S+被动 V+状语 → such as 引出介词短语 in making...举例。层次：形容词状语 → 主句被动 → such as 举例。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：Highly versatile 省略 (Being)，形容词作状语；has been used 为现在完成时被动；such as 表举例；in making 为动名词。
4. 翻译要点：Highly versatile 前置状语译“竹子实用性强”；被动 has been used extensively 转译“已被广泛用于”；such as in making...译“如制作……”；furniture 在此泛指中文“桌椅”类家具；housing structures 译“房屋结构”。
5. 易错点：Highly versatile 形容主语 bamboo，不是修饰整句的副词；has been used 是被动（竹子被利用）；such as 后接动名词 making，不是动词原形。
sentences.cut: [[形容词状语 Highly versatile,] [主句 S:bamboo V:has been used [程度状语 extensively] [范围状语 in production and daily life]] [举例 such as in making O:chopsticks, furniture, bridges, and housing structures]]
phrases: highly versatile　实用性强、用途广泛
be used extensively in　被广泛用于
production and daily life　生产和日常生活
such as in making　如制作……
furniture　家具（桌椅）
housing structures　房屋结构

sentences.en: Traditional Chinese wedding customs have a long-standing history, evolving into a complete set of ceremonial rites since the Zhou Dynasty, some of which are still practiced today.
sentences.zh: 中国的传统婚礼习俗历史悠久，自周朝起逐渐形成一套完整的婚礼仪式，其中有些一直沿用至今。
sentences.parse:
【断句】Traditional Chinese wedding customs have a long-standing history, | evolving into a complete set of ceremonial rites since the Zhou Dynasty, | some of which are still practiced today.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：Traditional Chinese wedding customs [S] have [V] a long-standing history [O]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：主句 S+V+O → 现在分词短语 evolving into a complete set of ceremonial rites...作伴随状语（逻辑主语为 customs）→ some of which 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰 a complete set of ceremonial rites。层次：主句 → evolving 现在分词伴随 → some of which 非限制性定从。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：evolving 现在分词表伴随/结果；since the Zhou Dynasty 时间状语；some of which 中 which 指代 ceremonial rites，意为“其中有些仪式”。
4. 翻译要点：have a long-standing history 译“历史悠久”；evolving into 译“逐渐形成/演变成”；some of which 非限制性定从拆为独立分句“其中有些一直沿用至今”；are still practiced 被动译“至今仍被沿用”。
5. 易错点：evolving 逻辑主语是 customs（习俗演变），不是 history；which 指代 ceremonial rites（仪式），不是 customs；some of which 是“其中有些仪式”，不要误读为“有些习俗”。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Traditional Chinese wedding customs V:have O:a long-standing history] [伴随状语 evolving into O:a complete set of ceremonial rites [时间状语 since the Zhou Dynasty]] [非限制性定语从句 some of which S:(some of the rites) V:are practiced [状语 still] [时间 today]]]
phrases: traditional Chinese wedding customs　中国传统婚礼习俗
have a long-standing history　历史悠久
evolve into　演变成、逐渐形成
a complete set of ceremonial rites　一套完整的婚礼仪式
since the Zhou Dynasty　自周朝起
some of which　其中有些（仪式）
be still practiced today　至今仍被沿用

sentences.en: The successful development of the BeiDou Satellite Navigation System represents a significant technological advancement for China since the reform and opening-up.
sentences.zh: 北斗卫星导航系统的成功研制，是中国自改革开放以来一项重大的技术进步。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：英文名词化长主语 The successful development of... 还原为中文判断句「是……一项……进步」；since 时间状语前置。
sentences.parse: 【①句子主干】The successful development（主语） represents（谓语） a significant technological advancement（宾语），核心骨架＝成功研制代表一项技术进步。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】主语为名词化长主语 The successful development of the BeiDou Satellite Navigation System，含两层 of 后置定语；for China 范围状语；since the reform and opening-up 时间状语。层次：名词化长主语（内含 of 定语）→ 主句谓语 → 宾语 → 范围/时间状语；无从句，靠名词化与后置定语拉长。断句版：The successful development of the BeiDou Satellite Navigation System | represents a significant technological advancement for China | since the reform and opening-up.【③关键连接词/引导词】of 串起两层后置定语（development of...System）；since 引出现在完成时时间状语（自……以来）。【④翻译要点】英文名词化主语还原为中文主谓判断句「北斗卫星导航系统的成功研制，是……」；represents 译为「是……一项……进步」更合中文判断句；since 短语「自改革开放以来」前置。【⑤易错点】名词化主语勿拆成「中国成功研制了北斗……」（破坏主干）；since 与完成时连用，勿译「自从……之后」；technological advancement 勿随意换 progress 造成搭配偏差。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The successful development [后置定语 of the BeiDou Satellite Navigation System] V:represents O:a significant technological advancement [范围状语 for China] [时间状语 since the reform and opening-up]]]
phrases: the successful development of　……的成功研制
BeiDou Satellite Navigation System　北斗卫星导航系统
a significant technological advancement　一项重大的技术进步
since the reform and opening-up　自改革开放以来

sentences.en: In recent years, China's space industry has entered the "fast lane" of technological development, with comprehensive advancements in space infrastructure construction.
sentences.zh: 近年来，中国航天事业进入了科技发展的“快车道”，航天基础设施建设全面推进。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文两分句合并为「主句 + with 伴随状语」；with + 名词 advancements（名词化「全面推进」）。
sentences.parse: 【①句子主干】China's space industry（主语） has entered（谓语） the 'fast lane'（宾语），核心骨架＝航天事业进入快车道。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】In recent years 时间状语；of technological development 后置定语修饰 fast lane；句末 with comprehensive advancements in space infrastructure construction 为「with + 名词短语」伴随状语，将中文第二分句「基础设施建设全面推进」译为伴随状态。层次：时间状语 → 主句（含 of 后置定语）→ with 伴随状语（内含 in 后置定语）。断句版：In recent years, | China's space industry has entered the 'fast lane' of technological development, | with comprehensive advancements in space infrastructure construction.【③关键连接词/引导词】with 引出伴随状语（随着/同时）；of 引出后置定语。【④翻译要点】中文「进入快车道／基础设施建设全面推进」合并为英文「主句 + with 伴随状语」；with 后接名词短语（名词化「全面推进」），不接从句；「快车道」the 'fast lane' 保留比喻加引号。【⑤易错点】with 伴随结构后接名词短语，不可误写成 with space infrastructure construction has comprehensively advanced（多谓语）；「基础设施建设」space infrastructure construction 名词化；advancement 用复数 advancements。
sentences.cut: [[主句 [时间状语 In recent years] S:China's space industry V:has entered O:the 'fast lane' [后置定语 of technological development] [伴随状语 with comprehensive advancements [后置定语 in space infrastructure construction]]]]
phrases: enter the 'fast lane' of　进入……的“快车道”
technological development　科技发展
with comprehensive advancements in　在……方面全面推进
space infrastructure construction　航天基础设施建设

sentences.en: Yangshan Port, an integral part of Shanghai's shipping center, is China's first deep-water port and one of the largest deep-water ports in the world.
sentences.zh: 洋山港是上海航运中心的重要组成部分，是中国第一个深水港，也是世界上规模最大的深水港之一。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：英文同位语 an integral part of... 还原为中文独立短句；并列表语拆为中文三短句。
sentences.parse: 【①句子主干】Yangshan Port（主语） is（系动词） China's first deep-water port and one of the largest deep-water ports（并列表语），核心骨架＝洋山港是深水港之一。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】主语后 an integral part of Shanghai's shipping center 为同位语（插入主谓语之间补充说明地位）；并列表语由 and 连接；in the world 范围状语。层次：主语 → 同位语插入 → 系动词 → 并列表语（含最高级）。断句版：Yangshan Port, | an integral part of Shanghai's shipping center, | is China's first deep-water port | and one of the largest deep-water ports in the world.【③关键连接词/引导词】and 连接并列表语；one of + 最高级 + 复数名词（……之一）。【④翻译要点】英文同位语还原为中文独立短句「是上海航运中心的重要组成部分」；并列表语拆为中文「是……，是……，也是……之一」；「规模最大」the largest 最高级。【⑤易错点】同位语前后逗号不可省；one of + 最高级后名词须复数 ports；deep-water port 连字符；「重要组成部分」an integral part of，勿直译 a component。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Yangshan Port [同位语 an integral part [后置定语 of Shanghai's shipping center]] V:is C:China's first deep-water port [并列连词 and] C:one of the largest deep-water ports [范围状语 in the world]]]
phrases: an integral part of　……的重要组成部分
Shanghai's shipping center　上海航运中心
deep-water port　深水港
one of the largest...in the world　世界上规模最大的……之一

sentences.en: The station has implemented more than 180 scientific research and application projects, spanning disciplines like space life science, space medicine, and space materials science.
sentences.zh: 天宫空间站已实施180多个科学研究与应用项目，涉及空间生命科学、太空医学、空间材料科学等领域。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：中文「涉及……等领域」译为现在分词 spanning disciplines like...，不另起谓语。
sentences.parse: 【①句子主干】The station（主语） has implemented（谓语） more than 180... projects（宾语），核心骨架＝空间站实施了项目。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】scientific research and application 并列定语修饰 projects；句末 spanning disciplines like... 为现在分词短语作伴随状语，其中 like 引出并列列举（space life science, space medicine, and space materials science）。层次：主句（含并列定语）→ 现在分词伴随状语（内含 like 并列列举）。断句版：The station has implemented more than 180 scientific research and application projects, | spanning disciplines like space life science, space medicine, | and space materials science.【③关键连接词/引导词】and 连接 research and application 并列定语；spanning（涵盖/涉及）引出分词状语；like 引出举例列举。【④翻译要点】中文「涉及……等领域」译为英文现在分词 spanning disciplines like...（不另起谓语）；并列三项逐字顺译；「180多个」more than 180。【⑤易错点】spanning 此处为「涵盖/涉及」，勿译「跨度」；分词状语逻辑主语须与主句主语 the station 一致；「空间生命科学」space life science，勿译 space life's science。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The station V:has implemented O:more than 180 [并列定语 scientific research and application] projects, [现在分词伴随状语 spanning disciplines [举例 like space life science, space medicine, and space materials science]]]]
phrases: implement projects　实施项目
scientific research and application　科学研究与应用
span disciplines　涉及多个学科/领域
space life science / space medicine / space materials science　空间生命科学/太空医学/空间材料科学

sentences.en: Presently, propelled by "new quality productive forces", China's ice and snow economy has evolved into a pivotal bridge facilitating transnational cultural exchanges and synergistic regional economic development.
sentences.zh: 如今，中国冰雪经济正以“新质生产力”为引擎，成为促进跨国文化交流与区域经济协同发展的重要纽带。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：句首过去分词 propelled by 还原为中文「以……为引擎」；现在分词 facilitating 后置定语提到「纽带」前。
sentences.parse: 【①句子主干】China's ice and snow economy（主语） has evolved into（谓语） a pivotal bridge（宾语），核心骨架＝冰雪经济成为重要纽带。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】句首 propelled by... 为过去分词短语作方式/原因状语（「以……为引擎」）；宾语 bridge 后 facilitating transnational cultural exchanges and synergistic regional economic development 为现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 bridge，其中 and 连接并列名词短语。层次：分词状语（句首）→ 主句 → 现在分词后置定语（内含并列）。断句版：Presently, | propelled by 'new quality productive forces', | China's ice and snow economy has evolved into a pivotal bridge | facilitating transnational cultural exchanges | and synergistic regional economic development.【③关键连接词/引导词】propelled by（由……驱动，过去分词表被动/方式）；facilitating（促进，现在分词作后置定语）；and 连接并列宾语。【④翻译要点】句首过去分词还原为中文「以……为引擎/动力」前置；现在分词 facilitating 后置定语还原为中文「促进……的重要纽带」，把定语提到「纽带」前；「新质生产力」new quality productive forces 官方固定译法加引号。【⑤易错点】propelled by 为被动含义（被……推动），勿误译主动；「新质生产力」固定译 new quality productive forces，勿自造 new-type productive forces；facilitating 修饰 bridge，勿误认为伴随状语；「协同发展」synergistic development。
sentences.cut: [[主句 [分词状语 propelled by 'new quality productive forces'] S:China's ice and snow economy V:has evolved into O:a pivotal bridge [后置定语 facilitating transnational cultural exchanges [并列连词 and] synergistic regional economic development]]]
phrases: propelled by　由……驱动/以……为动力
new quality productive forces　新质生产力
evolve into a pivotal bridge　成为重要纽带
transnational cultural exchanges　跨国文化交流
synergistic regional economic development　区域经济协同发展

sentences.en: As one of China's most open and economically vibrant regions, it holds significant strategic importance in the nation's economic development.
sentences.zh: 大湾区是中国开放程度最高、经济活力旺盛的区域之一，在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：句首 As one of... 身份状语还原为中文「大湾区是……的区域之一」，补出 it 指代。
sentences.parse: 【①句子主干】it（主语，指代 GBA） holds（谓语） significant strategic importance（宾语），核心骨架＝大湾区具有战略地位。【②从句类型与嵌套层次】句首 As one of China's most open and economically vibrant regions 为介词短语作身份状语（「作为……之一」），其中 most open and economically vibrant 为并列最高级形容词修饰 regions；in the nation's economic development 范围状语。层次：身份状语（含并列最高级）→ 主句谓语 → 宾语 → 范围状语。断句版：As one of China's most open and economically vibrant regions, | it holds significant strategic importance | in the nation's economic development.【③关键连接词/引导词】As（作为……，引出身份）；one of + 最高级 + 复数名词；and 连接并列最高级 most open and economically vibrant。【④翻译要点】句首 As one of... 还原为中文「大湾区是……的区域之一」，把 it 还原为「大湾区」；并列最高级「开放程度最高、经济活力旺盛」逐字对应；「具有重要战略地位」holds significant strategic importance。【⑤易错点】As one of 后须接复数名词 regions；并列最高级结构平行（副词+形容词）；it 指代 GBA，中文须补出「大湾区」。
sentences.cut: [[主句 [身份状语 As one of China's [并列最高级 most open and economically vibrant] regions] S:it V:holds O:significant strategic importance [范围状语 in the nation's economic development]]]
phrases: as one of...　作为……之一
open and economically vibrant　开放且经济活跃的
hold significant strategic importance　具有重要的战略地位
in the nation's economic development　在国家经济发展中

sentences.en: Respecting the elderly is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation, which is deeply embedded in the thoughts and actions of the Chinese people.
sentences.zh: 尊老是中华民族的传统美德，深深植根于中国人的思想和行为中。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：which 指代前面整件事（尊老作为传统美德），不前置为长定语，顺译为独立分句；be deeply embedded in 译“深植于”。
sentences.parse: ①句子主干：Respecting the elderly（S，动名词短语）is（V系）a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation（C表）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句末 which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个主句所表达的概念（尊老这一传统美德），从句内 which（S）is deeply embedded（V被动）in the thoughts and actions of the Chinese people（A状语）。层次：主句→which 非限制性定语从句（修饰整个主句概念）。③关键连接词/引导词：which 指代前文整件事，在从句中作主语；of the Chinese nation 介词短语后置修饰 virtue。④翻译要点：which 从句不译为“……的”前置定语，而顺译为独立分句“深深植根于……”；thoughts and actions 译“思想和行为”。⑤易错点：which 指代整个主句而非 the Chinese nation，勿误译为“中华民族深植于……”；Respecting the elderly 动名词主语译“尊老”；embedded 此处译“植根于”而非“嵌入”。⑥断句版：Respecting the elderly is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation | which is deeply embedded | in the thoughts and actions of the Chinese people.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Respecting the elderly V:is C:a traditional virtue [后置定语 of the Chinese nation]] [非限制性定语从句 S:which V:is deeply embedded A:in the thoughts and actions of the Chinese people]]
phrases: a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation　中华民族的传统美德
be deeply embedded in　深植于
thoughts and actions　思想和行为
respect the elderly　尊老

sentences.en: Even today, amid material abundance, the Chinese people still adhere to a frugal lifestyle, embodying the life concept of rational consumption and respect for labor.
sentences.zh: 即使在物质极大丰富的今天，中国人仍然坚持节俭的生活方式，体现了理性消费和尊重劳动的生活理念。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：amid material abundance 提前译为“即使在物质极大丰富的今天”；embodying 现在分词顺译为“体现了……”。
sentences.parse: ①句子主干：the Chinese people（S）still adhere to（V）a frugal lifestyle（O）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 Even today 时间状语 + amid material abundance 介词短语环境状语；句末 embodying the life concept... 现在分词短语作伴随/结果状语，其中 of rational consumption and respect for labor 介词短语后置修饰 the life concept，rational consumption 与 respect for labor 由 and 并列。层次：时间/环境状语→主句→现在分词伴随状语（内嵌后置定语+并列名词）。③关键连接词/引导词：amid“处于……之中”；embodying 现在分词表伴随结果；and 连接两个并列名词短语。④翻译要点：amid material abundance 提前译“在物质极大丰富的今天”；adhere to a frugal lifestyle 译“坚持节俭的生活方式”；embodying 独立成句“体现了……”。⑤易错点：amid 此处译“处于（丰富）”而非“在……中间”；frugal 译“节俭的”；rational consumption 译“理性消费”；embodying 的逻辑主语是 the Chinese people。⑥断句版：Even today, amid material abundance, | the Chinese people still adhere to a frugal lifestyle, | embodying the life concept | of rational consumption and respect for labor.
sentences.cut: [[时间/环境状语 Even today [介词状语 amid material abundance]] [主句 S:the Chinese people V:still adhere to O:a frugal lifestyle] [现在分词伴随状语 S:(逻辑主语=主句主语) V:embodying O:the life concept [后置定语 of rational consumption and respect for labor]]]
phrases: amid material abundance　在物质极大丰富中
adhere to a frugal lifestyle　坚持节俭的生活方式
embody the life concept of　体现……的生活理念
rational consumption　理性消费
respect for labor　尊重劳动

sentences.en: Since the reform and opening-up, China has continuously increased investment in scientific research in its journey of self-improvement and self-reliance, achieving new breakthroughs in fields such as information technology, artificial intelligence, and aerospace engineering.
sentences.zh: 改革开放以来，中国在自立自强的征程中持续加大科研投入，在信息技术、人工智能和航天工程等领域取得了新的突破。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：Since 译“改革开放以来”；achieving 现在分词结果状语顺译为“取得了……突破”。
sentences.parse: ①句子主干：China（S）has continuously increased（V现在完成时）investment（O）in scientific research（后置定语）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：Since the reform and opening-up 时间状语；in its journey of self-improvement and self-reliance 介词短语状语；句末 achieving new breakthroughs... 现在分词短语作结果状语，其中 in fields such as information technology, artificial intelligence, and aerospace engineering 介词短语+such as 举例后置修饰 breakthroughs。层次：Since 时间状语→主句→in its journey 状语→现在分词结果状语（内嵌 such as 并列举例）。③关键连接词/引导词：Since“自从”引导时间状语；achieving 现在分词表自然结果；such as 举例；and 连接并列领域。④翻译要点：Since 提前译“改革开放以来”；increased investment in scientific research 译“加大科研投入”；achieving 译“取得了新突破”独立成句；such as 译“等领域”。⑤易错点：the reform and opening-up 固定译“改革开放”；self-improvement and self-reliance 对应“自立自强”；achieving 的逻辑主语是 China（前面整件事）；aerospace engineering 译“航天工程”。⑥断句版：Since the reform and opening-up, | China has continuously increased investment in scientific research | in its journey of self-improvement and self-reliance, | achieving new breakthroughs | in fields such as information technology, artificial intelligence, and aerospace engineering.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 Since the reform and opening-up] [主句 S:China V:has continuously increased O:investment [后置定语 in scientific research] [状语 in its journey of self-improvement and self-reliance]] [现在分词结果状语 S:(逻辑主语=主句) V:achieving O:new breakthroughs [状语 in fields such as information technology, artificial intelligence, and aerospace engineering]]]
phrases: the reform and opening-up　改革开放
increase investment in scientific research　加大科研投入
in one's journey of self-improvement and self-reliance　在自立自强的征程中
achieve new breakthroughs　取得新突破
aerospace engineering　航天工程

sentences.en: In recent years, China's drone industry has enjoyed rapid development, with its export volume ranking first across the globe.
sentences.zh: 近年来，中国无人机产业迅猛发展，出口量位居全球首位。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：with+宾语+doing 独立主格不译为从句，顺译为并列分句“出口量位居全球首位”。
sentences.parse: ①句子主干：China's drone industry（S）has enjoyed（V现在完成时）rapid development（O）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：In recent years 时间状语；句末 with its export volume ranking first across the globe 为“with + 名词 + 现在分词”独立主格（伴随）结构，对主句作补充说明，其中 its export volume 是 with 复合结构内的逻辑主语，ranking first 是逻辑谓语，across the globe 状语。层次：时间状语→主句→with 独立主格伴随结构。③关键连接词/引导词：with 引导独立主格表伴随；ranking 现在分词；enjoyed 此处译“取得/享有”。④翻译要点：with 复合结构顺译为“出口量位居全球首位”并列分句；has enjoyed rapid development 译“迅猛发展”；across the globe 译“全球”。⑤易错点：with+宾语+doing 是独立主格，ranking 的逻辑主语是 its export volume 而非 industry；export volume 译“出口量”；enjoy 此处褒义“取得”，勿译“享受”。⑥断句版：In recent years, | China's drone industry has enjoyed rapid development, | with its export volume ranking first across the globe.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In recent years] [主句 S:China's drone industry V:has enjoyed O:rapid development] [with独立主格伴随结构 with [逻辑主语 its export volume] [逻辑谓语 ranking first] [状语 across the globe]]]
phrases: China's drone industry　中国无人机产业
enjoy rapid development　迅猛发展
export volume　出口量
rank first across the globe　位居全球首位

sentences.en: As the internet and logistics networks quickly expand into the countryside, a growing number of rural residents are selling agricultural products directly to urban consumers through e-commerce platforms.
sentences.zh: 随着互联网和物流网络迅速向农村地区延伸，越来越多的农村居民通过电子商务平台直接向城市消费者销售农产品。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：As 伴随状语从句提前译“随着……”；through e-commerce platforms 方式状语中文前置。
sentences.parse: ①句子主干：a growing number of rural residents（S）are selling（V现在进行时）agricultural products（O）directly to urban consumers（状语）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：As 引导时间/伴随状语从句，从句内 the internet and logistics networks（S）quickly expand（V）into the countryside（状语）；主句内 through e-commerce platforms 介词短语方式状语。层次：As 状语从句→主句（主谓宾+方式状语）。③关键连接词/引导词：As“随着”引导伴随状语从句；a growing number of“越来越多的”；through“通过”表方式。④翻译要点：As 从句提前译“随着互联网和物流网络迅速向农村地区延伸”；are selling 译“销售”；through e-commerce platforms 译“通过电子商务平台”，中文状语前置。⑤易错点：As 此处是“随着”表伴随，勿译“因为”；expand into 译“延伸至”；logistics networks 译“物流网络”；a growing number of 译“越来越多的”。⑥断句版：As the internet and logistics networks quickly expand into the countryside, | a growing number of rural residents are selling agricultural products | directly to urban consumers through e-commerce platforms.
sentences.cut: [[As伴随状语从句 S:the internet and logistics networks V:quickly expand A:into the countryside] [主句 S:a growing number of rural residents V:are selling O:agricultural products A:directly to urban consumers [方式状语 through e-commerce platforms]]]
phrases: logistics networks　物流网络
expand into the countryside　向农村地区延伸
a growing number of　越来越多的
rural residents　农村居民
through e-commerce platforms　通过电子商务平台

sentences.en: In recent years, telemedicine technology has made it possible for high-quality medical resources to benefit more patients.
sentences.zh: 近年来，远程医疗技术使得优质医疗资源得以惠及更多患者。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：it 为形式宾语，真正宾语是 for...to... 不定式复合结构；译“使得……得以……”。
sentences.parse: ①句子主干：telemedicine technology（S）has made（V）it（形式宾语）possible（宾补）for high-quality medical resources to benefit more patients（真正宾语）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：In recent years 时间状语；句中 it 为形式宾语，真正宾语是 for high-quality medical resources to benefit more patients 不定式复合结构。层次：时间状语→主句（S+V+形式宾语 it+宾补 possible+真正宾语 for sb to do）。③关键连接词/引导词：it 为形式宾语，无实义，替代后面的不定式复合结构；for...to... 是不定式复合结构作真正宾语。④翻译要点：made it possible for...to... 译“使得……得以/能够……”；真正宾语顺译“优质医疗资源得以惠及更多患者”；telemedicine 译“远程医疗”。⑤易错点：it 是形式宾语勿译“它”；possible 是宾语补足语；benefit 此处及物“惠及/使受益”；high-quality medical resources 译“优质医疗资源”。⑥断句版：In recent years, | telemedicine technology has made it possible | for high-quality medical resources to benefit more patients.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In recent years] [主句 S:telemedicine technology V:has made [形式宾语 it] [宾语补足语 possible] [真正宾语 for high-quality medical resources to benefit more patients]]]
phrases: telemedicine technology　远程医疗技术
make it possible for...to do　使得……能够做
high-quality medical resources　优质医疗资源
benefit more patients　惠及更多患者

sentences.src: 六级·2022.6·阅读长难句·森林生态功能再认识（长篇）
sentences.en: The late 19th and early 20th century saw an increasing recognition that forests serve as habitats for countless animal and plant species that all rely on each other.
sentences.zh: 19世纪末20世纪初，人们日益认识到：森林是无数相互依存的动植物物种的栖息地。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:The late 19th and early 20th century V:saw O:an increasing recognition（时间名词作主语，saw 为“见证、经历”）。【从句与层次】recognition 后接 that 引导的同位语从句 [that forests serve as habitats for...]；其中 species 后接 that all rely on each other 定语从句。层次：主句（时间主语+saw）→同位语从句→内嵌定语从句。【连接词/引导词】saw（拟人化谓语，“这一时期见证了……”）；that（引导同位语从句，说明 recognition 的内容）；that（关系代词，指代 species，作定语从句主语）。【翻译要点】时间名词作主语+saw，中文宜转译为“这一时期，人们……”；同位语从句 that... 用冒号或“即”引出；serve as habitats for 译“充当……的栖息地”。【易错点】recognize 的名词 recognition 后接同位语从句而非定语从句；species 单复数同形；rely on each other 为“相互依存”。【断句版】The late 19th and early 20th century saw an increasing recognition | that forests serve as habitats for countless animal and plant species | that all rely on each other.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The late 19th and early 20th century V:saw O:an increasing recognition [同位语从句 that forests serve as habitats for countless animal and plant species [定语从句 that all rely on each other]]]]
phrases: an increasing recognition　日益认识到
serve as　充当/作为
habitat　栖息地
countless　无数的
rely on each other　相互依存
the late 19th and early 20th century　19世纪末20世纪初

sentences.src: 六级·2022.6·阅读长难句·善意冥想与复发性抑郁（选词）
sentences.en: These findings help us to further understand some of our clinical trials research findings, where we show that individuals with recurrent depression benefit particularly from self-awareness-based cognitive therapy.
sentences.zh: 这些发现有助于我们进一步理解一些临床试验研究结果，即我们发现，患有复发性抑郁症的人尤其能从基于自我觉察的认知疗法中获益。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:These findings V:help O:us，宾补 to further understand some of our clinical trials research findings。【从句与层次】findings 后接 where 引导的非限制性定语从句（where 指代 findings 这一研究领域）；where 从句内又嵌套 that 引导的宾语从句 [that individuals... benefit from...]。层次：主句→非限制性定语从句（where）→宾语从句（that）。【连接词/引导词】where（关系副词，引导非限制性定语从句，修饰 findings，表“在这些研究中”）；that（宾语从句引导词）；with recurrent depression 为介词短语作 individuals 的后置定语。【翻译要点】where 从句不宜硬译“那里”，宜转译为“在这些研究中/即”；with recurrent depression 前置译“患有复发性抑郁的”；benefit from 译“从……获益”。【易错点】where 的先行词 findings 是抽象“研究领域”而非地点，属抽象地点化用法；recurrent depression 为“复发性抑郁”；self-awareness-based 为复合形容词。【断句版】These findings help us to further understand some of our clinical trials research findings, | where we show that individuals with recurrent depression benefit particularly | from self-awareness-based cognitive therapy.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:These findings V:help O:us [宾补 to further understand some of our clinical trials research findings]]] [非限制性定语从句 where we show [宾语从句 that individuals [后置定语 with recurrent depression] V:benefit [状语 particularly] [状语 from self-awareness-based cognitive therapy]]]
phrases: clinical trials　临床试验
recurrent depression　复发性抑郁症
benefit from　从……获益
self-awareness-based　基于自我觉察的
cognitive therapy　认知疗法
particularly　尤其

sentences.src: 六级·2023.12·阅读长难句·非洲农业气候脆弱性（长篇）
sentences.en: Africa is particularly vulnerable, in part because it is already struggling to feed itself and it will have to vastly increase yields and productivity if it is to put food on the plates of a fast-growing population, even without climate change.
sentences.zh: 非洲尤其脆弱，部分原因在于它本就难以养活自己的人民；即便不考虑气候变化，为了给快速增长的人口提供食物，它也必须大幅提高产量和生产力。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:Africa V:is C:particularly vulnerable；后接 in part because 引导的原因状语从句。【从句与层次】原因状语从句内为 and 连接的并列分句：①it is already struggling to feed itself；②it will have to vastly increase yields and productivity；分句②中又嵌套 if it is to put food on the plates of a fast-growing population 条件状语从句；句末 even without climate change 为让步介词短语。层次：主句→原因状语从句（并列分句+条件从句）。【连接词/引导词】because（原因状语从句）；and（并列）；if（条件状语从句，it is to do 表“将要、打算”）；even without（让步介词短语）。【翻译要点】in part because 译“部分原因在于”；if it is to put food on... 转译为“为了给……提供食物”；even without climate change 前置或后置译“即便不考虑气候变化”。【易错点】be to do 表“按计划/需要将要做”；vulnerable 后接 to，此处 because 从句中省略；yield 为“产量”；productivity 为“生产力”。【断句版】Africa is particularly vulnerable, | in part because it is already struggling to feed itself | and it will have to vastly increase yields and productivity | if it is to put food on the plates of a fast-growing population, | even without climate change.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Africa V:is C:particularly vulnerable]] [原因状语从句 in part because [并列分句① it is already struggling to feed itself] and [并列分句② it will have to vastly increase yields and productivity [条件状语从句 if it is to put food on the plates of a fast-growing population]]] [让步状语 even without climate change]
phrases: vulnerable　脆弱的/易受伤害的
in part　部分地
struggle to do　艰难地做/难以做
yields and productivity　产量与生产力
a fast-growing population　快速增长的人口
climate change　气候变化

sentences.src: 六级·2023.12·阅读长难句·大脑区分事实与可能性（选词）
sentences.en: This is especially true as the study makes clear that information presented as fact evokes special responses in our brains, which are distinct from when we process the same content with clear indicators of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 情况尤其如此，因为该研究清楚地表明：作为事实呈现的信息会在我们大脑中唤起特殊反应，而这种反应与我们在处理带有明确不确定性标记的相同内容时所产生的反应截然不同。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:This V:is C:especially true；后接 as 引导的原因状语从句。【从句与层次】as 从句：S:the study V:makes clear，后接 that 引导的宾语从句 [that information... evokes special responses]；其中 information presented as fact 为过去分词作后置定语；responses 后接 which are distinct from... 非限制性定语从句；from 后接 when 引导的宾语从句（省略句，= from when we process...）。层次：主句→原因状语从句（as）→宾语从句（that）→非限制性定语从句（which）→when 从句。【连接词/引导词】as（原因状语从句，“因为”）；that（宾语从句）；presented as fact（过去分词，= which is presented as fact）；which（非限制性定语从句）；when（引导 from 的宾语从句）。【翻译要点】makes clear that 译“清楚地表明”；presented as fact 前置译“作为事实呈现的”；distinct from 译“与……不同”；when 从句补出“当……时”。【易错点】presented as fact 是分词定语非谓语；which 先行词是 responses；indicators of uncertainty 为“不确定性的标记/信号”。【断句版】This is especially true | as the study makes clear that information presented as fact evokes special responses in our brains, | which are distinct from | when we process the same content with clear indicators of uncertainty.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:This V:is C:especially true]] [原因状语从句 as [S:the study V:makes clear [宾语从句 that information [过去分词定语 presented as fact] V:evokes O:special responses in our brains]]] [非限制性定语从句 which are distinct from [宾语从句 when we process the same content with clear indicators of uncertainty]]
phrases: presented as fact　作为事实呈现
evoke a response　唤起反应
be distinct from　与……不同
process　处理/加工
indicator of uncertainty　不确定性的标记
content　内容

sentences.src: 六级·2020.12·阅读长难句·社交距离的爱与牺牲（选词）
sentences.en: However, at its core is love, and a sacrifice to protect those most vulnerable to the coronavirus effects — the elderly, people with compromised immune systems, and those whose life-saving resources would be used up by a malignant epidemic.
sentences.zh: 然而，其内核是爱，是为保护那些最易受冠状病毒影响的人而作出的牺牲——这些人包括老年人、免疫系统受损者，以及那些救命资源会被一场恶性疫情耗尽的人。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句为倒装句：S:love（+a sacrifice...）V:is，表语/状语 at its core 前置构成“表语前置+全部倒装”：at its core is love。【从句与层次】to protect those most vulnerable... 为不定式作后置定语修饰 sacrifice；those 后接并列的同位性列举：the elderly, people with..., and those whose...；其中 those 后接 whose 引导的定语从句 [whose life-saving resources would be used up by a malignant epidemic]。层次：倒装主句→不定式定语→定语从句（whose）。【连接词/引导词】at its core（地点/范围状语前置引发倒装）；vulnerable to（形容词短语作 those 的后置定语）；whose（关系限定词，引导定语从句，在从句中作 resources 的定语）。【翻译要点】倒装句 at its core is love 还原语序译“其内核是爱”；most vulnerable to 译“最易受……影响的”；whose 从句译“其救命资源会被……耗尽的人”。【易错点】这是完全倒装（介词短语+be+主语），真正主语是 love；compromised immune systems 为“受损的免疫系统”；malignant 为“恶性的、有害的”。【断句版】However, | at its core is love, | and a sacrifice to protect those most vulnerable to the coronavirus effects — | the elderly, people with compromised immune systems, | and those whose life-saving resources would be used up by a malignant epidemic.
sentences.cut: [[倒装主句 [状语 at its core] [V:is] [S:love, and a sacrifice [不定式定语 to protect those most vulnerable to the coronavirus effects]]] [同位列举 the elderly, people with compromised immune systems, and those [定语从句 whose life-saving resources would be used up by a malignant epidemic]]]
phrases: at its core　在其内核/本质上
vulnerable to　易受……影响
compromised immune system　受损的免疫系统
life-saving resource　救命资源
be used up　被耗尽
malignant epidemic　恶性疫情

sentences.src: 六级·2022.6·阅读长难句·生态转型叙事slow hope（长篇）
sentences.en: We need stories and histories of change and transformation: ecological stories that make us confront the fact that human power is potentially destructive, and that the survival of our species on this planet depends on the preservation of soil and water, and the habitats and ecological systems.
sentences.zh: 我们需要关于变迁与转型的故事与历史：那些让我们直面如下事实的生态故事——人类的力量可能具有破坏性，而我们这个物种在这颗星球上的存续，有赖于对土壤、水源以及栖息地与生态系统的保护。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:We V:need O:stories and histories of change and transformation；冒号后 ecological stories... 为同位语，对 stories 作展开说明。【从句与层次】ecological stories 后接 that make us confront the fact... 定语从句；the fact 后接两个并列的同位语从句：①that human power is potentially destructive；②that the survival of our species... depends on the preservation of soil and water, and the habitats and ecological systems。层次：主句→同位语（ecological stories）→定语从句（that make...）→并列同位语从句（that... and that...）。【连接词/引导词】that（关系代词，指代 stories，make us confront...）；that... and that...（两个并列同位语从句，说明 fact 的内容）。【翻译要点】冒号后同位语用“即：……”引出；make us confront the fact 译“让我们直面这一事实”；两个 that 从句用“一是……，二是……”或破折号分层；depends on 译“有赖于”。【易错点】两个 that 从句是 fact 的并列同位语，不可只译其一；potentially destructive 为“潜在地具有破坏性”；preservation 与 protection 同义此处指“保护、留存”。【断句版】We need stories and histories of change and transformation: | ecological stories that make us confront the fact | that human power is potentially destructive, | and that the survival of our species on this planet depends on the preservation of soil and water, | and the habitats and ecological systems.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:We V:need O:stories and histories of change and transformation]] [同位语 ecological stories [定语从句 that make us confront the fact [并列同位语从句① that human power is potentially destructive] and [并列同位语从句② that the survival of our species on this planet depends on the preservation of soil and water, and the habitats and ecological systems]]]]
phrases: transformation　转型/转变
confront　直面/面对
potentially destructive　潜在地具有破坏性
the survival of our species　我们物种的存续
depend on　有赖于/取决于
ecological system　生态系统

sentences.src: 六级·2016.6·阅读长难句·废水灌溉健康风险
sentences.en: While the practice carries serious health risks for many, those dangers are outweighed by the social and economic gains for poor urban farmers and consumers who need affordable food.
sentences.zh: 尽管这种做法给许多人带来严重的健康风险，但对于那些需要廉价食物的城市贫民和消费者而言，这些危险已被社会与经济收益所抵消。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句为被动句 those dangers are outweighed by the social and economic gains，主干是「危险被收益盖过」。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 While 引导让步状语从句（the practice carries serious health risks for many）；主句宾语 gains 后接由 for...and... 引出的两个并列受益对象（poor urban farmers / consumers），其中 consumers 后接 who need affordable food 限制性定语从句。层次：主句→让步状语从句→宾语后置定语中介词宾语 consumers 上嵌套定语从句。③关键连接词/引导词：While 引导让步「虽然/尽管」，不引导时间；who 指代 consumers，在定从中作 need 的主语；by 引出被动动作的发出者（gains）。④翻译要点：while 让步前置译「尽管……」；被动 are outweighed by 转主动「被……盖过/超过」；长定语 who need affordable food 前置译「需要廉价食物的……消费者」；for poor urban farmers and consumers 译为「对于……而言」，使中文主语清晰。⑤易错点：While 在此是「尽管」不是「当……时」，勿误判为时间状语；outweigh 是及物动词「比……更重要」，勿按字面「称重」理解；who 定从先行词是 consumers 不是 farmers，就近修饰。 【断句版】While the practice carries serious health risks for many, | those dangers are outweighed by the social and economic gains | for poor urban farmers and consumers | who need affordable food.
sentences.cut: [[让步状语从句 While S:the practice V:carries O:serious health risks A:for many], [主句 S:those dangers V:are outweighed O(by宾语):the social and economic gains A:for poor urban farmers and consumers [限制性定语从句 who V:need O:affordable food]]]]
phrases: carry health risks　带来健康风险
be outweighed by　被……超过/盖过
social and economic gains　社会与经济收益
urban farmers　城市农民（在城市周边务农者）
affordable food　廉价食物
wastewater irrigation　废水灌溉

sentences.src: 六级·2016.12·阅读长难句·隐形风险青少年强调句
sentences.en: But the study warns that it is teenagers who engage in all three of these practices in the extreme who are truly in jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 但该研究警告说：真正身陷险境的，是那些在上述三种不良行为上都走到极端的青少年。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句 the study warns that...；宾语从句内部是 It is...who... 强调句，被强调的主语是 teenagers，还原为正常语序：teenagers (who engage in all three...) are truly in jeopardy。②从句类型与嵌套层次：主句→宾语从句（that...）→宾语从句内部为强调句框架 it is teenagers who...→被强调部分 teenagers 后又接一个省略式定语从句 who engage in all three of these practices in the extreme。即「强调句框架内嵌套定语从句修饰被强调名词」。③关键连接词/引导词：第一个 that 是宾语从句引导词（无实义）；句中两个 who 都不是疑问词——第二个 who 是强调句框架的强调引导词（It is...who...，被强调人）；定语从句里的 who 指代 teenagers 并在从中作 engage in 的主语。④翻译要点：强调句译「真正……的正是……」；定语从句 who engage in...in the extreme 前置译「在三方面都走到极端的青少年」；warns that 译「警告说……」，冒号引出宾语从句内容更符合中文。⑤易错点：句中有两个 who，极易混淆——一个是定从关系代词（作 engage in 的主语），一个是强调句引导词（不充当成分）；in the extreme 是固定短语「极端地」，不是「在极限里」；jeopardy 是名词「危险」，in jeopardy=in danger。 【断句版】But the study warns that | it is teenagers | who engage in all three of these practices in the extreme | who are truly in jeopardy.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:the study V:warns [宾语从句 that [强调句 it is C:teenagers [限制性定语从句 who V:engage in O:all three of these practices A:in the extreme] who V:are A:in jeopardy]]]]]
phrases: warn that　警告说……
engage in　从事、参与
in the extreme　极端地、过度地
in jeopardy　处于危险中
practice　（此处指不良）行为做法
it is...who...　强调句框架

sentences.src: 六级·2017.6·阅读长难句·开放数据共享although插入
sentences.en: Although many researchers broadly agree that public access to raw data would accelerate science — because other scientists might be able to make advances not foreseen by the data's producers — most are reluctant to post the results of their own labours online.
sentences.zh: 尽管许多研究人员普遍认为，公开获取原始数据会加速科学进步——因为其他科学家或许能取得数据生产者本人未曾预见的进展——但大多数人仍不愿把自己的劳动成果发布到网上。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句 most are reluctant to post the results online；句首 Although 引导让步状语从句 many researchers agree that...。破折号之间 because... 是插入的原因状语，补充说明 agree that 从句内的理由。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首让步状语从句（Although...）→从句宾语 that public access...would accelerate science（宾语从句）→破折号插入 because 原因状语从句→该从句中 advances 后接过去分词短语 not foreseen by... 作后置定语（相当于 which are not foreseen by...）。层次：主句←让步从句←宾语从句；原因插入语内嵌过去分词定语。③关键连接词/引导词：Although 「尽管」；that 引导宾语从句；because 引导原因状语（插入在让步从句与主句之间，解释为何 agree）；破折号起隔断补充作用。④翻译要点：让步从句前置「尽管……」；破折号插入语译成中文双破折号「——因为……——」保持补充语气；过去分词 not foreseen by... 前置译「数据生产者本人未曾预见的（进展）」；reluctant to post 译「不愿把……发布」。⑤易错点：破折号插入的 because 并非修饰主句 most are reluctant，而是解释为何「公开数据会加速科学」——逻辑层次勿断错；not foreseen by 是过去分词作后置定语，不是谓语；labours 此处是名词「劳动成果」不是动词。 【断句版】Although many researchers broadly agree | that public access to raw data would accelerate science | — because other scientists might be able to make advances [not foreseen by the data's producers] — | most are reluctant to post the results of their own labours online.
sentences.cut: [[让步状语从句 Although S:many researchers V:broadly agree [宾语从句 that S:public access to raw data V:would accelerate O:science] [插入原因状语 because S:other scientists V:might be able to make O:advances [过去分词后置定语 not foreseen by the data's producers]]], [主句 S:most V:are reluctant to post O:the results of their own labours A:online]]]
phrases: broadly agree　普遍认同
public access to raw data　公开获取原始数据
accelerate science　加速科学进步
make advances　取得进展
not foreseen by　未被……预见的
be reluctant to do　不愿做某事
post...online　把……发布到网上

sentences.src: 六级·2017.12·阅读长难句·新可乐惨败so...that
sentences.en: It's become so iconic that attempts to change its taste in 1985 – sweetening it in a move projected to boost sales – proved disastrous, with widespread anger from consumers.
sentences.zh: 它已变得如此具有标志性，以至于1985年试图改变其口味——通过一次计划用来提振销量的加糖举动——的尝试惨遭失败，招致消费者的广泛愤怒。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句 It's become so iconic；that 引导结果状语从句，从句主干是 attempts proved disastrous（尝试惨败）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：主句→so...that... 结果状语从句→从句主语 attempts 后接不定式 to change its taste... 作定语；两个破折号之间 sweetening it in a move projected to boost sales 是现在分词短语作插入同位语，补充说明 attempts 的具体做法；projected to boost sales 又是过去分词短语后置修饰 move；句末 with widespread anger... 是 with 复合结构作伴随状语。③关键连接词/引导词：so...that...「如此……以至于……」引导结果状语；sweetening 是现在分词表伴随/同位；projected 是过去分词表被动「被计划用来」。④翻译要点：so...that 译「如此……以至于……」；破折号插入语保留双破折号「——加糖——」；proved disastrous 中 prove 是系动词「结果证明是」，译「惨遭失败/结果是灾难性的」；with 短语转译为动词「招致……」更符合中文。⑤易错点：so...that 中 that 是结果状语引导词，不是定语从句；proved 在此是系动词（proved + adj），不是被动「被证明」；move 此处是名词「举措、举动」不是动词移动；projected 是过去分词表被动。 【断句版】It's become so iconic | that attempts to change its taste in 1985 | — sweetening it in a move projected to boost sales — | proved disastrous, | with widespread anger from consumers.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:It V:'s become C:so iconic [结果状语从句 that S:attempts [后置定语 to change its taste in 1985] V:proved C:disastrous [插入同位语 sweetening it in a move [过去分词后置定语 projected to boost sales]] [伴随状语 with widespread anger from consumers]]]]]
phrases: so...that...　如此……以至于……
iconic　标志性的、偶像级的
attempt to do　试图做……
projected to do　预计/计划用来做……
boost sales　提振销量
prove disastrous　结果是灾难性的
widespread anger　广泛的愤怒

sentences.src: 六级·2018.6·阅读长难句·耐盐水稻嵌套定从
sentences.en: Scientists working under the banner 'Project Neurice' are seeking varieties of rice that can withstand the increasing salinity without losing the absorbency that makes European rice ideal for traditional Spanish and Italian dishes.
sentences.zh: 以「神经稻计划」之名开展工作的科学家们正在寻找这样的水稻品种：它们既能抵御日益加重的盐碱，又不失去那种使欧洲大米成为西班牙和意大利传统菜肴理想食材的吸水性。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句 Scientists are seeking varieties of rice（科学家正在寻找水稻品种）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：主语 Scientists 后接现在分词短语 working under... 作后置定语；宾语 varieties of rice 后接第一个 that 限制性定语从句 that can withstand...without losing...；该从句中 without losing the absorbency 是介词短语作伴随状语；absorbency 后又接第二个 that 限制性定语从句 that makes European rice ideal for...。层次：主句→主语分词定语→宾语第一定语从句→从句内介词短语→介词宾语第二定语从句。③关键连接词/引导词：第一个 that 指代 varieties of rice，在从中作 can withstand 的主语；without losing 表「在不失去……的情况下」；第二个 that 指代 the absorbency，在从中作 makes 的主语，构成 make + O + C（ideal for...）复合宾语。④翻译要点：现在分词 working under... 前置译「以……为名开展工作的科学家们」；第一个定从 that can withstand... 后置译「能抵御……的水稻品种」；第二个定从 that makes...ideal for... 前置译「使欧洲大米成为……理想食材的（吸水性）」；without losing 译「又不失去」。⑤易错点：两个 that 都引导定语从句，先行词不同（第一个=varieties of rice，第二个=the absorbency），勿混为一谈；make + O + adj 是「使……变得」，不是制造；banner 此处是「旗号/名义」不是旗帜；without losing 是伴随不是条件。 【断句版】Scientists [working under the banner 'Project Neurice'] | are seeking varieties of rice | that can withstand the increasing salinity | without losing the absorbency | that makes European rice ideal for traditional Spanish and Italian dishes.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Scientists [现在分词后置定语 working under the banner 'Project Neurice'] V:are seeking O:varieties of rice [定语从句1 that S:(varieties) V:can withstand O:the increasing salinity [伴随状语 without losing O:the absorbency [定语从句2 that S:(the absorbency) V:makes O:European rice C:ideal for traditional Spanish and Italian dishes]]]]]]
phrases: work under the banner of　以……为名/旗号工作
seek varieties of rice　寻找水稻品种
withstand salinity　抵御盐碱
without losing　不失去
absorbency　吸水性
make A ideal for B　使A成为B的理想选择
increasing salinity　日益加重的盐碱

sentences.src: 六级·2020.12·阅读长难句·社媒人设not...but
sentences.en: Pictures and posts should be byproducts of life's treasured moments and fun times, not the planned and calculated image that one is putting out into cyberspace in an attempt to fill insecurities or unmet needs.
sentences.zh: 图片和帖子应当是生活中珍贵时刻与欢乐时光的副产品，而不是一个人为了填补不安全感或未被满足的需求、精心策划算计后投放到网络空间的人设形象。
