sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句 Pictures and posts should be byproducts..., not the...image...（照片帖子应当是副产品，而不是人设形象）。这是 A, not B 平行判断结构。②从句类型与嵌套层次：表语有两个——byproducts of... 与 the planned and calculated image；image 后接 that 限制性定语从句 that one is putting out into cyberspace；该从句末尾 in an attempt to fill... 是目的状语短语。层次：主句→第二表语后定语从句→从句内目的状语。③关键连接词/引导词：not 表否定并列「而不是」；that 指代 image，在定从中作 putting out 的宾语（put out image into cyberspace）；in an attempt to「试图、为了」表目的。④翻译要点：A, not B 译「应当是A，而不是B」；定从 that one is putting out into cyberspace 较长，前置译「投放到网络空间的……形象」；in an attempt to fill... 目的状语前置或后译「为了填补……而……」；planned and calculated 两个并列过去分词形容词，译「精心策划、算计好的」。⑤易错点：not 前后是两个并列表语（byproducts / image），不是谓语否定；that 定从中 put out 的宾语就是 that（image），结构是 put out sth into sp；cyberspace 是「网络空间」；fill 此处是「填补」不是「装满」。 【断句版】Pictures and posts should be byproducts of life's treasured moments and fun times, | not the planned and calculated image | that one is putting out into cyberspace | in an attempt to fill insecurities or unmet needs.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Pictures and posts V:should be C:byproducts of life's treasured moments and fun times, | 并列表语 not C:the planned and calculated image [定语从句 that S:one V:is putting O:(that) A:out into cyberspace [目的状语 in an attempt to fill O:insecurities or unmet needs]]]]]
phrases: byproduct　副产品
treasured moments　珍贵时刻
planned and calculated　精心策划、算计好的
put out into cyberspace　投放到网络空间
in an attempt to do　试图做……
fill insecurities　填补不安全感
unmet needs　未被满足的需求

sentences.src: 六级·2024.6·阅读长难句·职场先例同位语从句
sentences.en: When a group of employees sees unsafe behavior not being addressed at a leadership level, it creates the precedent that this is how these situations should be addressed, thus defining the safety culture for everyone.
sentences.zh: 当一群员工看到不安全行为在领导层得不到处理时，就会开创一个先例——这类情况就该这样处理——从而为所有人界定了安全文化。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句 it creates the precedent（这开创了先例）；句首 When 引导时间状语从句 a group of employees sees unsafe behavior not being addressed...。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首时间状语从句中 see + O（unsafe behavior）+ OC（not being addressed at a leadership level，现在分词被动作宾补）；主句宾语 the precedent 后接 that 同位语从句解释 precedent 的内容；同位语从句内部 this is how these situations should be addressed 又嵌套一个 how 引导的表语从句；句末 thus defining... 是现在分词短语作结果状语。层次：时间状语从句（含see+O+OC）→主句→宾语同位语从句→同位语从句内表语从句→句末分词结果状语。③关键连接词/引导词：When 引导时间状语；that 引导同位语从句（解释 precedent，不充当成分，与定从区别开）；how 引导表语从句「这类情况应如何处理」；thus + 现在分词「从而」表结果。④翻译要点：时间状语从句 sees O not being addressed 译「看到……得不到处理」；see+O+doing/not doing 结构转主动更顺；同位语从句 that this is how... 用破折号「——这类情况就该这样处理——」；thus defining 译「从而为所有人界定了」。⑤易错点：that 同位语从句与定语从句区别——此处 that 不充当从句成分，从句本身完整，是解释 precedent 内容；see O doing 中 not being addressed 是被动进行「未被处理」；address 此处是「处理、应对」不是「地址」；precedent 中 c 不发音。 【断句版】When a group of employees sees unsafe behavior [not being addressed at a leadership level], | it creates the precedent | that this is how these situations should be addressed, | thus defining the safety culture for everyone.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语从句 When S:a group of employees V:sees O:unsafe behavior [宾补 not being addressed A:at a leadership level]], [主句 S:it V:creates O:the precedent [同位语从句 that S:this V:is [表语从句 how these situations should be addressed]] [结果状语 thus defining O:the safety culture A:for everyone]]]]
phrases: address behavior　处理/应对行为
at a leadership level　在领导层
create the precedent　开创先例
precedent　先例
thus defining　从而界定
safety culture　安全文化
see O doing/not doing　看到……正被/未被……

sentences.src: 六级·2024.12·阅读长难句·乡村外迁分词结果
sentences.en: Attracted by the improved economics of urban areas, country-dwellers across the world are moving out, contributing to the excessive crowdedness of densely populated cities, and leaving the countryside in desolation.
sentences.zh: 受城市地区改善后的经济条件吸引，世界各地的乡村居民正在外迁，这既加剧了人口稠密城市的过度拥挤，也使乡村陷入荒凉。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句 country-dwellers across the world are moving out（世界各地乡村居民正在外迁）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 Attracted by... 是过去分词短语作原因/伴随状语（=As they are attracted by...），逻辑主语就是主句主语 country-dwellers；主句后接两个并列的现在分词短语作结果状语——contributing to... 与 leaving...in desolation——由 and 连接，表示「外迁」带来的两个并行结果。层次：句首过去分词状语→主句→两个并列现在分词结果状语。③关键连接词/引导词：Attracted by（过去分词被动，逻辑主语=country-dwellers，表「被……吸引」）；and 连接两个并列现在分词结果状语；contributing to / leaving 均表主句动作带来的自然结果。④翻译要点：句首过去分词状语译「受……吸引」并补出逻辑主语；两个并列结果状语用「既……也……」「这既加剧了……，也使……」体现并行；leave...in desolation 译「使……陷入荒凉」。⑤易错点：句首 Attracted 不是谓语动词（主句谓语是 are moving out），勿误判为主句谓语；两个现在分词短语都是结果状语，不是并列谓语（并列谓语须共用 are，而 contributing/leaving 前无 are）；densely populated 是复合形容词「人口稠密的」；desolation 是名词「荒凉」。 【断句版】[Attracted by the improved economics of urban areas], | country-dwellers across the world are moving out, | contributing to the excessive crowdedness of densely populated cities, | and leaving the countryside in desolation.
sentences.cut: [[句首过去分词状语 Attracted by O:the improved economics of urban areas], [主句 S:country-dwellers across the world V:are moving out] [结果状语1 contributing to O:the excessive crowdedness of densely populated cities] [并列结果状语2 and leaving O:the countryside C:in desolation]]]
phrases: attracted by　受……吸引
urban areas　城市地区
country-dwellers　乡村居民
move out　外迁、搬出去
contribute to　导致、促成
densely populated　人口稠密的
leave...in desolation　使……陷入荒凉

sentences.src: 六级·2025.12·阅读长难句·友谊社会although动名词
sentences.en: Although we may be living in a society that treasures the independent pursuit of achievement, having people to support and love you on the way is far more important than any end result.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们或许生活在一个崇尚独立追求成就的社会里，但在人生路上有人支持你、爱你，远比任何最终结果都重要。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句是动名词短语 having people to support and love you on the way 作主语，谓语 is，表语 far more important than any end result（有人陪伴支持远比结果重要）。②从句类型与嵌套层次：句首 Although 引导让步状语从句 we may be living in a society；society 后接 that 限制性定语从句 that treasures the independent pursuit of achievement；主句主语是动名词短语 having people to support and love you（=that we have people...）；on the way 介词短语作地点状语；主句表语是 far more...than... 比较结构。层次：句首让步状语从句（内含定从修饰 society）→主句（动名词短语主语）→比较结构。③关键连接词/引导词：Although「尽管」；that 指代 society，在定从中作 treasures 的主语；having people to do 是「有某人做某事」的动名词结构；far more...than... 比较级「远比……更」。④翻译要点：让步从句前置「尽管我们生活在一个……的社会里」；定从 that treasures... 前置译「崇尚独立追求成就的社会」；动名词主语 having people to support and love you 转译为中文主谓结构「在人生路上有人支持你、爱你」；far more important than 译「远比……重要」。⑤易错点：主句主语不是 people，而是整个动名词短语 having people to support and love you，谓语用单数 is；treasure 此处是动词「珍视、崇尚」不是名词「宝藏」；on the way 在此是「在人生路上」不是「在路上即将到来」。 【断句版】Although we may be living in a society | that treasures the independent pursuit of achievement, | having people to support and love you on the way | is far more important than any end result.
sentences.cut: [[让步状语从句 Although S:we V:may be living A:in a society [定语从句 that S:(society) V:treasures O:the independent pursuit of achievement]], [主句 S:having people to support and love you on the way（动名词短语作主语） V:is C:far more important than O:any end result]]]
phrases: treasure　珍视、崇尚
independent pursuit of achievement　独立追求成就
having people to support you　有人支持你
on the way　在人生路上
far more important than　远比……重要
end result　最终结果

sentences.src: 六级·2026.6·阅读长难句·社媒危害双定从blindto
sentences.en: But the pleasure and stimulation that people of all ages find on their screens and smartphones must not blind us to the harm that spending time in this way can cause.
sentences.zh: 但是，各年龄段的人们在屏幕和智能手机上获得的快乐与刺激，绝不能使我们对这种消磨时间方式可能造成的危害视而不见。
sentences.parse: 【五要素解析】①句子主干：主句 the pleasure and stimulation must not blind us to the harm（快乐与刺激绝不能使我们对危害视而不见）。谓语是情态动词被动否定式 must not blind。②从句类型与嵌套层次：主语 the pleasure and stimulation 后接第一个 that 限制性定语从句 that people of all ages find on their screens and smartphones（人们在屏幕上找到的快乐与刺激）；宾语 the harm 后接第二个 that 限制性定语从句 that spending time in this way can cause（这种方式可能造成的危害）。两个 that 定从分别包裹主语和宾语，形成「主定从+谓+宾定从」的对称嵌套结构。③关键连接词/引导词：第一个 that 指代 the pleasure and stimulation，在从中作 find 的宾语（find pleasure/stimulation）；blind sb to sth 是固定搭配「使某人对某物视而不见」；第二个 that 指代 the harm，在从中作 cause 的宾语（cause harm）；spending time in this way 是动名词短语作第二个定从的主语。④翻译要点：第一个定从前置译「各年龄段的人们在屏幕和智能手机上获得的快乐与刺激」；blind us to the harm 译「使我们对危害视而不见」；第二个定从 that spending time...can cause 前置译「这种消磨时间方式可能造成的危害」；情态否定 must not 译「绝不能」。⑤易错点：两个 that 都引导定语从句且都在从中作宾语（find 的宾语 / cause 的宾语），不是同位语从句；blind...to... 是固定搭配，to 是介词不是不定式符号；spending time in this way 是动名词短语作第二定从主语，谓语 can cause 用单数；stimulation 是不可数名词「刺激」。 【断句版】But the pleasure and stimulation | that people of all ages find on their screens and smartphones | must not blind us to the harm | that spending time in this way can cause.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:the pleasure and stimulation [定语从句1 that S:people of all ages V:find O:(that) A:on their screens and smartphones] V:must not blind O:us A:to the harm [定语从句2 that S:spending time in this way V:can cause O:(that)]]]]
phrases: pleasure and stimulation　快乐与刺激
people of all ages　各年龄段的人
blind us to the harm　使我们对危害视而不见
spending time in this way　以这种方式消磨时间
cause harm　造成危害
must not　绝不能

sentences.src: 六级·2019.6·阅读长难句·霍金AI警告while分词
sentences.en: While the world-renowned physicist has often been cautious about AI, raising concerns that humanity could be the architect of its own destruction if it creates a super-intelligence with a will of its own, he was also quick to highlight the positives that AI research can bring.
sentences.zh: 虽然这位世界闻名的物理学家一直对人工智能持谨慎态度——他担忧如果人类创造出拥有自我意志的超级智能，人类可能会成为自身毁灭的缔造者——但他也很快强调了人工智能研究所能带来的积极面。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】While the world-renowned physicist has often been cautious about AI | raising concerns that humanity could be the architect of its own destruction | if it creates a super-intelligence with a will of its own | he was also quick to highlight the positives that AI research can bring.

1. 句子主干：主句 he was also quick to highlight the positives，主语he指代Hawking，谓语was quick to highlight，宾语the positives。
2. 从句层次：句首While引导让步状语从句（the physicist has been cautious about AI）；现在分词短语raising concerns that...作伴随状语，其中that引导同位语从句解释concerns的内容；同位语从句内部嵌套if引导的条件状语从句；句末that AI research can bring是定语从句修饰positives。
3. 关键连接词：While（尽管，表让步）；that（同位语从句引导词，不充当成分）；if（如果，表条件）；that（定语从句引导词，指代positives作bring的宾语）。
4. 翻译要点：将英文分词伴随结构raising concerns译为中文破折号引出的插入语，使长句拆分；with a will of its own译为拥有自我意志的前置定语；同位语从句按中文习惯先翻担忧的内容。
5. 易错点：its own destruction中的its指代humanity而非super-intelligence，易误读为超级智能的自我毁灭；raising concerns是伴随状语而非并列谓语。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:he V:was quick to highlight O:the positives [定语从句 that AI research can bring]]] [让步状语从句 While S:the world-renowned physicist V:has been cautious about O:AI] [伴随状语 raising concerns [同位语从句 that humanity could be the architect of its own destruction [条件状语从句 if it creates a super-intelligence [介词短语 with a will of its own]]]]
phrases: world-renowned  世界闻名的
be cautious about  对…持谨慎态度
raise concerns that  引发对…的担忧
the architect of one's own destruction  自我毁灭的缔造者
a will of its own  自身的意志
highlight the positives  强调积极面

sentences.src: 六级·2021.12·阅读长难句·波兹曼电视notjustbut
sentences.en: As Neil Postman noted in his 1985 book Amusing Ourselves to Death, the rise of television introduced not just a new medium but a new discourse: a gradual shift from a typographic culture to a photographic one, which in turn meant a shift from rationality to emotions, exposition to entertainment.
sentences.zh: 正如尼尔·波兹曼在其1985年著作《娱乐至死》中所指出的那样，电视的兴起带来的不仅是一种新媒介，更是一种新话语：从印刷文化到图像文化的逐渐转变，这反过来又意味着从理性到情感、从论述到娱乐的转变。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】As Neil Postman noted in his 1985 book Amusing Ourselves to Death | the rise of television introduced not just a new medium but a new discourse | a gradual shift from a typographic culture to a photographic one | which in turn meant a shift from rationality to emotions, exposition to entertainment.

1. 句子主干：主句 the rise of television introduced not just a new medium but a new discourse，主语the rise of television，谓语introduced，宾语为not just...but...并列结构。
2. 从句层次：句首As引导非限制性定语从句（正如波兹曼所指出的）；冒号后a gradual shift...是a new discourse的同位语，对其进行解释；句末which in turn meant...是非限制性定语从句修饰前面整个主句所述的转变。
3. 关键连接词：As（正如，引导非限制性定语从句）；not just...but...（不仅…而且…，并列宾语）；which（指代前面整句话所述的转变，引导非限制性定语从句）。
4. 翻译要点：As从句提前翻译为正如…所指出的；冒号后的同位语用破折号或即引出；which从句中的in turn译为反过来，两个from...to...并列结构译为对仗的从…到…。
5. 易错点：photographic one中的one指代culture，勿误读为照片；exposition to entertainment承前省略了from，应为from exposition to entertainment。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:the rise of television V:introduced O:not just a new medium but a new discourse]] [As引导定语从句 As Neil Postman noted [状语 in his 1985 book Amusing Ourselves to Death]] [同位语 a gradual shift from a typographic culture to a photographic one] [非限制性定语从句 which in turn meant a shift from rationality to emotions, exposition to entertainment]
phrases: Amusing Ourselves to Death  《娱乐至死》（书名）
not just...but...  不仅…而且…
typographic culture  印刷文化
photographic culture  图像文化
in turn  反过来
rationality  理性
exposition  论述；阐释

sentences.src: 六级·2022.12·阅读长难句·职场自尊less...butmore
sentences.en: However, the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they're simply motivated.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们对工作的感受与其说是取决于是否以维护自尊为动机，不如说仅仅取决于是否有动力这一事实本身。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】However | the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem | but more with the fact that they're simply motivated.

1. 句子主干：主句 the way...has less to do with...but more with...，主语the way（后接定语从句people feel about their work），谓语has less to do with...but more with...。
2. 从句层次：people feel about their work是省略that的定语从句修饰the way；whether they're motivated...是宾语从句作with的宾语；that they're simply motivated是同位语从句解释the fact的内容。
3. 关键连接词：whether（是否，引导宾语从句）；that（引导同位语从句，解释fact）；less...but more...（与其说…不如说…的比较结构）。
4. 翻译要点：has less to do with A but more with B译为与A关系更小，与B关系更大，或意译为与其说取决于A，不如说取决于B；the fact that译为这一事实本身以突出强调。
5. 易错点：preservation of self-esteem是维护自尊而非保存自尊；whether引导的宾语从句作介词with的宾语，勿误判为状语从句。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:the way [定语从句 people feel about their work] V:has less to do with O:whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem [并列 but more with O:the fact [同位语从句 that they're simply motivated]]]]
phrases: have less to do with  与…关系不大
have more to do with  与…关系更大
be motivated by  以…为动机
the preservation of self-esteem  维护自尊
the fact that  …这一事实

sentences.src: 六级·2023.6·阅读长难句·人类过度模仿so...that
sentences.en: Anthropologist Joseph Henrich points out that people around the world rely on technologies that are often so complex that no one can learn them rationally.
sentences.zh: 人类学家约瑟夫·亨里奇指出，世界各地的人们所依赖的技术往往复杂到没有任何人能够理性地理解它们。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】Anthropologist Joseph Henrich points out | that people around the world rely on technologies | that are often so complex that no one can learn them rationally.

1. 句子主干：主句 Anthropologist Joseph Henrich points out...，主语Joseph Henrich，谓语points out，后接that引导的宾语从句。
2. 从句层次：第一层that引导宾语从句（people rely on technologies）；第二层that are often so complex...是定语从句修饰technologies；定语从句内部嵌套so...that...结果状语从句（that no one can learn them rationally）。
3. 关键连接词：第一个that（引导宾语从句，可省略）；第二个that（关系代词，指代technologies，在定语从句中作主语）；so...that...（如此…以至于…，表结果）。
4. 翻译要点：points out译为指出；定语从句that are so complex译为复杂到…前置修饰技术；so...that结果从句独立成句，使中文更通顺。
5. 易错点：两个that功能不同——第一个是宾语从句引导词，第二个是关系代词；them指代technologies，勿误读为people。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Anthropologist Joseph Henrich V:points out [宾语从句 that people around the world rely on technologies [定语从句 that are often so complex [结果状语从句 that no one can learn them rationally]]]]]
phrases: anthropologist  人类学家
rely on  依赖
so...that...  如此…以至于…
rationally  理性地
complex  复杂的

sentences.src: 六级·2018.12·阅读长难句·手机行为科技定语从句
sentences.en: That's because, for the first time in human history, a large proportion of the species is in continuous contact with technology that can record key features of an individual's behavior and environment.
sentences.zh: 这是因为，在人类历史上第一次，我们这个物种中有很大一部分人持续不断地接触着能够记录个人行为与环境关键特征的技术。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】That's because | for the first time in human history | a large proportion of the species is in continuous contact with technology | that can record key features of an individual's behavior and environment.

1. 句子主干：主句 That's because...，表语由because引导的表语从句充当；表语从句主干为a large proportion of the species is in continuous contact with technology。
2. 从句层次：because引导表语从句；for the first time in human history是插入语作时间状语；that can record...是定语从句修饰technology。
3. 关键连接词：because（引导表语从句，说明原因）；that（关系代词，指代technology，在定语从句中作主语）。
4. 翻译要点：That's because译为这是因为；插入语for the first time提前翻译；定语从句that can record...译为前置定语能够记录…的技术。
5. 易错点：the species此处指人类这个物种，勿误读为物种泛指；in continuous contact with是持续接触的固定搭配。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:That V:'s [表语从句 because [时间状语插入语 for the first time in human history] S:a large proportion of the species V:is in continuous contact with O:technology [定语从句 that can record key features of an individual's behavior and environment]]]]
phrases: for the first time in human history  人类历史上第一次
a large proportion of  很大比例的
in continuous contact with  持续接触
key features  关键特征
behavior and environment  行为与环境

sentences.src: 六级·2022.6·阅读长难句·科学传播it强调句
sentences.en: It is equally imperative to emphasize that being an expert on a topic does not automatically make a scholar qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience.
sentences.zh: 同样必须强调的是，成为某一主题的专家并不自动意味着这位学者就具备了向非专业受众传播该主题的能力。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】It is equally imperative to emphasize | that being an expert on a topic does not automatically make a scholar qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience.

1. 句子主干：主句 It is equally imperative to emphasize that...，It是形式主语，真正主语是后面的不定式to emphasize that...；that引导宾语从句作emphasize的宾语。
2. 从句层次：that引导宾语从句，从句主语为动名词短语being an expert on a topic，谓语does not make，宾语a scholar，宾语补足语qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience。
3. 关键连接词：It（形式主语，无实义）；that（引导宾语从句）。
4. 翻译要点：It is imperative to emphasize译为必须强调的是；动名词短语being an expert译为动宾结构成为某一主题的专家；make a scholar qualified to do译为使学者具备做…的资格。
5. 易错点：it是形式主语而非指代前文；qualified to communicate it中的it指代a topic，勿误读为传播它（不明确）。
sentences.cut: [[主句 [形式主语 It] V:is equally imperative [真正主语 to emphasize [宾语从句 that [动名词短语作主语 being an expert on a topic] V:does not make O:a scholar [宾语补足语 qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience]]]]]
phrases: It is imperative to do  必须做某事
emphasize  强调
be an expert on a topic  某主题的专家
automatically  自动地；自然而然地
be qualified to do  有资格做某事
nonscientific audience  非专业受众

sentences.src: 六级·2016.6·阅读长难句·提前录取insofaras
sentences.en: But insofar as early decision offers a genuine admissions edge, that advantage goes largely to students who already have numerous advantages.
sentences.zh: 但就提前录取确实能带来真实的录取优势而言，这一优势在很大程度上属于那些本就已拥有众多优势的学生。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】But insofar as early decision offers a genuine admissions edge | that advantage goes largely to students | who already have numerous advantages.

1. 句子主干：主句 that advantage goes largely to students，主语that advantage（指代前面的a genuine admissions edge），谓语goes to，宾语students。
2. 从句层次：insofar as引导条件状语从句（就…而言/在…范围内）；who already have numerous advantages是定语从句修饰students。
3. 关键连接词：insofar as（就…而言，引导条件状语从句，相当于to the extent that）；who（关系代词，指代students，在定语从句中作主语）。
4. 翻译要点：insofar as译为就…而言或在…范围内；goes largely to译为在很大程度上属于/流向；定语从句who already have numerous advantages译为前置定语本就已拥有众多优势的。
5. 易错点：insofar as是固定搭配，勿拆分为in so far as；edge此处意为优势而非边缘；that advantage是特指前文提到的admissions edge。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:that advantage V:goes largely to O:students [定语从句 who already have numerous advantages]]] [条件状语从句 But insofar as S:early decision V:offers O:a genuine admissions edge]
phrases: insofar as  就…而言；在…范围内
early decision  提前录取（美国大学申请制度）
genuine admissions edge  真实的录取优势
go to  归于；流向
numerous advantages  众多优势

sentences.src: 六级·2021.6·阅读长难句·导航app交通do...but
sentences.en: The efforts of millions of drivers to get ahead do not miraculously produce a situation in which everyone does better than before, but one in which almost everyone does rather worse.
sentences.zh: 数百万司机争相抢道的努力并不会奇迹般地创造出一个人人都比之前更好的局面，反而会造成一个几乎每个人都变得更糟的局面。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The efforts of millions of drivers to get ahead | do not miraculously produce a situation in which everyone does better than before | but one in which almost everyone does rather worse.

1. 句子主干：主句 The efforts...do not produce a situation...but one...，主语The efforts of millions of drivers，谓语do not produce...but...（不产生…而是…），宾语为a situation和one（指代a situation）的对比结构。
2. 从句层次：in which everyone does better than before是定语从句修饰第一个situation；in which almost everyone does rather worse是定语从句修饰第二个one（=a situation）。
3. 关键连接词：do not...but...（不…而是…，并列宾语对比）；in which（关系副词，引导定语从句修饰situation，相当于where）。
4. 翻译要点：to get ahead是不定式作后置定语修饰efforts，译为争相抢道的努力；两个in which定语从句分别修饰两个对比的situation，翻译时用一个…的局面和另一个…的局面区分。
5. 易错点：one指代a situation而非drivers；rather worse意为反而更糟，rather在此加强比较语气；do not produce...but one...是并列宾语结构，勿误读为转折从句。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The efforts of millions of drivers [不定式定语 to get ahead] V:do not miraculously produce O:a situation [定语从句 in which everyone does better than before] [并列 but O:one [定语从句 in which almost everyone does rather worse]]]]
phrases: get ahead  抢先；取得领先
miraculously  奇迹般地
in which  在该局面中（关系副词，修饰situation）
rather worse  反而更糟

sentences.src: 六级·2026.6·阅读长难句·青少年社媒倒装that
sentences.en: Just as alarming, if not more so, is that the amount of time teens spend on social media can lead to anxiety and depression.
sentences.zh: 同样令人担忧——甚至更加令人担忧——的是，青少年花费在社交媒体上的时间之长可能导致焦虑和抑郁。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】Just as alarming, if not more so, is that | the amount of time teens spend on social media can lead to anxiety and depression.

1. 句子主干：主句为倒装结构 Just as alarming...is that...，正常语序为 That...is just as alarming (if not more so)。表语是just as alarming，主语是that引导的主语从句。
2. 从句层次：that引导主语从句（the amount of time...can lead to anxiety and depression）；teens spend on social media是省略that的定语从句修饰the amount of time。
3. 关键连接词：that（引导主语从句，在倒装句中位于句末）；if not more so（插入语，甚至更加）。
4. 翻译要点：倒装结构还原为正常语序翻译：…同样令人担忧，甚至更加令人担忧；the amount of time (that) teens spend译为青少年花费在…上的时间；lead to译为导致。
5. 易错点：这是表语提前的倒装句，正常语序为That...is just as alarming；if not more so是插入语，意为如果不是更严重的话，即甚至更严重。
sentences.cut: [[倒装主句 [表语前置 Just as alarming, [插入语 if not more so]] V:is [主语从句 that S:the amount of time [定语从句 teens spend on social media] V:can lead to O:anxiety and depression]]]
phrases: alarming  令人担忧的
if not more so  甚至更加（如果不是更严重的话）
the amount of time  时间量
social media  社交媒体
lead to  导致
anxiety and depression  焦虑与抑郁

sentences.src: 六级·2020.7·阅读长难句·积极压力运动冒号解释
sentences.en: People often discuss the dangers of too much stress, but lately a very different view of stress is gaining popularity: this view of stress, held by members of the positive stress movement, argues that stress might actually be beneficial.
sentences.zh: 人们常常谈论压力过大的危害，但近来一种截然不同的压力观点正日益流行：这种由积极压力运动支持者所持有的观点认为，压力实际上可能是有益的。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】People often discuss the dangers of too much stress | but lately a very different view of stress is gaining popularity | this view of stress, held by members of the positive stress movement, argues that stress might actually be beneficial.

1. 句子主干：并列复合句。前半句People often discuss the dangers...；后半句a very different view...is gaining popularity。冒号后this view...argues that...是对前面a very different view of stress的解释说明。
2. 从句层次：held by members of the positive stress movement是过去分词短语作后置定语修饰this view of stress；that stress might actually be beneficial是宾语从句作argues的宾语。
3. 关键连接词：but（并列转折）；that（引导宾语从句）。
4. 翻译要点：gaining popularity译为日益流行；过去分词短语held by...译为由…所持有的前置定语；冒号后的解释独立成句。
5. 易错点：held by是过去分词作定语而非谓语；argues的主语是this view of stress而非members；actually在此处加强语气，译为实际上。
sentences.cut: [[并列句1 S:People V:often discuss O:the dangers of too much stress] [并列句2 but S:a very different view of stress V:is gaining popularity] [冒号解释句 S:this view of stress [过去分词定语 held by members of the positive stress movement] V:argues [宾语从句 that stress might actually be beneficial]]]
phrases: the dangers of too much stress  压力过大的危害
gain popularity  日益流行
the positive stress movement  积极压力运动
argue that  认为；主张
beneficial  有益的

sentences.src: 六级·2019.12·阅读长难句·企鹅栖息地although
sentences.en: The report found that although some king penguins may be able to relocate to new breeding grounds closer to their retreating food source, suitable new habitats would be scarce.
sentences.zh: 报告发现，尽管一些帝企鹅或许能够迁移到更靠近其不断后退的食物来源的新繁殖地，但合适的新栖息地将是稀缺的。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The report found that | although some king penguins may be able to relocate to new breeding grounds | closer to their retreating food source | suitable new habitats would be scarce.

1. 句子主干：主句 The report found that...，主语The report，谓语found，后接that引导的宾语从句。
2. 从句层次：that引导宾语从句；宾语从句内部嵌套although引导的让步状语从句（some king penguins may be able to relocate...）；closer to their retreating food source是形容词短语作后置定语修饰new breeding grounds。
3. 关键连接词：that（引导宾语从句）；although（尽管，引导让步状语从句）。
4. 翻译要点：found that译为发现；although让步从句先译尽管…；形容词短语closer to...译为更靠近…的前置定语修饰繁殖地。
5. 易错点：retreating food source中retreating意为不断后退的（指因气候变化而退缩的食物来源区域），勿误读为撤退的；king penguins是帝企鹅（王企鹅）。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The report V:found [宾语从句 that [让步状语从句 although S:some king penguins V:may be able to relocate O:to new breeding grounds [形容词短语定语 closer to their retreating food source]] S:suitable new habitats V:would be C:scarce]]]
phrases: king penguin  帝企鹅（王企鹅）
relocate to  迁移到
breeding grounds  繁殖地
receding food source  不断后退的食物来源
scarce  稀缺的

sentences.src: 六级·2023.12·阅读长难句·竞争本能定从
sentences.en: Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.
sentences.zh: 此后，我们便受制于一场战斗——一方是我们追求自我满足的原始冲动，另一方是禁止纯粹放纵的社会与文化规范。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】Thereafter | we are at the mercy of a battle | between our base impulses for self-fulfillment | and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.

1. 句子主干：主句 we are at the mercy of a battle，主语we，谓语are at，表语the mercy of a battle。
2. 从句层次：between...and...是介词短语作后置定语修饰a battle，构成between A and B的对比结构；which prohibit pure indulgence是定语从句修饰social and cultural norms。
3. 关键连接词：between...and...（在…与…之间，对比结构）；which（关系代词，指代norms，在定语从句中作主语）。
4. 翻译要点：at the mercy of译为受制于/任凭…摆布；between...and...译为一方是…另一方是…以突出对比；定语从句which prohibit...译为禁止…的前置修饰规范。
5. 易错点：base impulses中base意为原始的/卑劣的而非基础的；which指代的是social and cultural norms而非self-fulfillment。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:we V:are at [表语 the mercy of a battle [介词短语定语 between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms [定语从句 which prohibit pure indulgence]]]]]
phrases: thereafter  此后；从那以后
at the mercy of  受制于；任凭…摆布
base impulses  原始冲动
self-fulfillment  自我实现；自我满足
social and cultural norms  社会与文化规范
prohibit pure indulgence  禁止纯粹放纵

sentences.src: 六级·2016.12·阅读长难句·大学教育价值whatever
sentences.en: Whatever your talents, it is extraordinarily difficult to get a leading job in most fields without having been to university.
sentences.zh: 无论你有怎样的才华，在大多数领域，如果没有上过大学，要获得一份顶尖工作都是异常困难的。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】形式主语句型：it（形式主语）+ is + extraordinarily difficult（表语）+ 真正主语 to get a leading job...；状语 Whatever your talents 前置让步。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】Whatever 引导让步状语从句（省略 be，补全为 Whatever your talents may be）；主句为 it 作形式主语的简单句；without having been to university 为介词 without 后接动名词完成式作条件状语。层次：让步状语→主句（形式主语+真正主语）→介词短语条件状语。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】Whatever = No matter what，引导让步状语；it 为形式主语，真正主语是不定式短语 to get a leading job in most fields；without 为否定条件介词，后接动名词完成式 having been to。
4.【翻译要点】whatever 让步状语前置译作"无论……"；形式主语 it 不译出，直接将真正主语（不定式）提前作主译；without 否定条件译作"如果没有……"或"不……就"。
5.【易错点】without having been to 是动名词完成式，表示"此前未上过大学"的经历，不可误读为 without to be；it is difficult to do 句型中 it 不指代任何前文事物，考生易误判 it 指代前文某词。
【断句版】Whatever your talents, | it is extraordinarily difficult to get a leading job in most fields | without having been to university.
sentences.cut: [[A:让步状语 Whatever your talents] [主句 S:it(形式) V:is C:extraordinarily difficult [真正主语 to get O:a leading job A:in most fields] [条件状语 without having been to university]]]
phrases: leading job　顶尖工作、要职
extraordinarily difficult　异常困难
without having been to university　没有上过大学
whatever your talents　无论你有怎样的才华

sentences.src: 六级·2017.6·阅读长难句·Grand Tour同位语which
sentences.en: Thus the idea of the Grand Tour was born, a practice which introduced Englishmen, Germans, Scandinavians, and also Americans to the art and culture of France and Italy for the next 300 years.
sentences.zh: 由此，"大旅行"的理念应运而生——这一习俗在接下来的300年里，将英国、德国、斯堪的纳维亚乃至美国人引入了法国和意大利的艺术与文化之中。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】倒装句：Thus（状语）+ V:was born（谓语，被动）+ S:the idea of the Grand Tour；其后 a practice 为 the idea 的同位语，which 引导定语从句修饰 a practice。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】主干为倒装主谓结构（状语前置+谓语+主语）；同位语 a practice 后接 which 引导的非限制性定语从句；定语从句主干为 which + V:introduced + O:Englishmen, Germans, Scandinavians, and also Americans + 状语 to the art and culture of France and Italy + 时间状语 for the next 300 years。层次：主句→同位语→定语从句。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】Thus 表结果；which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代先行词 a practice；introduce sb to sth 为固定搭配"使某人了解/接触某事物"。
4.【翻译要点】倒装语序 was born 译作"应运而生"；同位语 a practice 用破折号引出，译作"这一习俗"；定语从句 which introduced...to... 译作"将……引入/使……接触"；时间状语 for the next 300 years 前置译作"在接下来的300年里"。
5.【易错点】倒装句 was born 易被误认为是主语后置的全部倒装；which 引导的非限制性定语从句修饰的是 a practice 而非 the Grand Tour，两者同位但从句修饰的是 a practice；introduced sb to sth 中的 to 是介词而非不定式符号。
【断句版】Thus the idea of the Grand Tour was born, | a practice which introduced Englishmen, Germans, Scandinavians, and also Americans | to the art and culture of France and Italy | for the next 300 years.
sentences.cut: [[主句 A:Thus S:the idea of the Grand Tour V:was born] [同位语 a practice [定语从句 which V:introduced O:Englishmen, Germans, Scandinavians, and also Americans A:to the art and culture of France and Italy A:for the next 300 years]]]
phrases: Grand Tour　大旅行（贵族游学）
be born　应运而生、产生
introduce sb to sth　使某人接触/了解某事物
Scandinavians　斯堪的纳维亚人
for the next 300 years　在接下来的300年里

sentences.src: 六级·2017.12·阅读长难句·忙碌地位as同位语
sentences.en: As marketing professors Silvia Bellezza, Neeru Paharia, and Anat Keinan recently explained in Harvard Business Review (HBR), leisure time was once seen as an indicator of high social status, something attainable only for those at the top.
sentences.zh: 正如营销学教授Silvia Bellezza、Neeru Paharia和Anat Keinan最近在《哈佛商业评论》（HBR）中所述，闲暇时间曾被视为高社会地位的标志——一种只有处于社会顶端的人才享有的东西。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】as 引导方式状语从句前置，主句为 leisure time（S）+ was once seen as（V被动短语）+ an indicator of high social status（O）；something attainable only for those at the top 为 indicator 的同位语。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】as 引导方式状语从句（as...explained，从句主谓宾完整但 explained 后省略宾语指代主句内容）；主句为被动语态简单句；something 后接形容词短语 attainable only for those at the top 作后置定语。层次：方式状语从句→主句→同位语（含后置定语）。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】As 引导方式状语从句，表"正如……"；see...as... 固定搭配"把……看作……"；attainable 为形容词后置修饰 something；those at the top 指"处于社会顶层的人"。
4.【翻译要点】as 从句译作"正如……所述"；was once seen as 被动语态译作主动"曾被视为"或"人们曾把……看作"；同位语 something attainable... 用破折号引出译作"——一种只有……才享有的东西"。
5.【易错点】as 在此引导方式状语从句而非原因状语从句；something attainable 中 attainable 是形容词后置定语，不可误读为动词；those at the top 为指代性表达，需根据上下文理解为"社会上层人士"。
【断句版】As marketing professors Silvia Bellezza, Neeru Paharia, and Anat Keinan recently explained in Harvard Business Review (HBR), | leisure time was once seen as an indicator of high social status, | something attainable only for those at the top.
sentences.cut: [[方式状语从句 As S:marketing professors... V:explained A:recently A:in Harvard Business Review (HBR)] [主句 S:leisure time V:was once seen as O:an indicator of high social status] [同位语 something [后置定语 attainable only for those at the top]]]
phrases: leisure time　闲暇时间
an indicator of high social status　高社会地位的标志
attainable　可获得的
those at the top　处于社会顶层的人
see...as...　把……看作……

sentences.src: 六级·2018.6·阅读长难句·决策疲劳whereas定从
sentences.en: That's not to say that risk is always good, but it is related to taking action, whereas decision fatigue assuredly leads to inaction and the possible chagrin of a decision maker who might otherwise prefer a new course but is unfortunately hindered.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说风险总是好的，但风险与采取行动相关；而决策疲劳则必然导致不作为，以及一个决策者可能因此产生的懊恼——他本想选择一条新的行动路线，却不幸受阻。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】由 not...but... 并列结构连接两个分句，再由 whereas 引导对比分句。前分句：That's not to say（主句）+ that 宾语从句；后分句（but 后）：it（S）+ is related to（V）+ taking action（O）；whereas 分句：decision fatigue（S）+ leads to（V）+ inaction and the possible chagrin（O）+ of a decision maker 定语。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】第一层：not...but... 并列对比；第二层：that 宾语从句（say 的宾语）；第三层：who 引导定语从句修饰 a decision maker，从句内含 but 并列谓语 might prefer...but is hindered。层次：not to say that... / but it is related to... / whereas decision fatigue leads to... who might prefer...but is hindered。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】That's not to say that...but... 固定句型"这并不是说……而是说……"；whereas 引导对比状语从句，表"然而/反之"；who 引导定语从句修饰 decision maker；otherwise 为副词"本应/在其他情况下"。
4.【翻译要点】That's not to say that...but... 译作"这并不是说……但……"；whereas 译作"而/反之"；who might otherwise prefer...but is hindered 定语从句较长，拆分为独立分句译作"——他本想……却不幸受阻"；chagrin 译作"懊恼/沮丧"。
5.【易错点】That's not to say that...but... 中 but 后省略了 it is related to 的并列结构，考生易误读为 but 连接两个独立句子；otherwise 为副词修饰 might prefer，不可误读为连词；whereas 引导的是对比状语从句而非时间状语从句。
【断句版】That's not to say that risk is always good, | but it is related to taking action, | whereas decision fatigue assuredly leads to inaction | and the possible chagrin of a decision maker | who might otherwise prefer a new course | but is unfortunately hindered.
sentences.cut: [[分句1 S:That V:is C:not to say [宾语从句 that risk is always good]] [分句2 but S:it V:is related to O:taking action] [对比分句 whereas S:decision fatigue V:leads to O:inaction and the possible chagrin [定语 of a decision maker [定语从句 who V:might prefer O:a new course but V:is hindered A:unfortunately]]]]
phrases: decision fatigue　决策疲劳
That's not to say that...but...　这并不是说……而是说……
whereas　然而、反之
chagrin　懊恼、沮丧
otherwise　在其他情况下、本应
be hindered　受阻

sentences.src: 六级·2019.6·阅读长难句·AI创造力enough to
sentences.en: So far, machines have a pretty hard time emulating creativity, arbitrary enough not to be predicted by a computer, and yet more than simple randomness.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，机器在模仿创造力方面还相当困难——创造力足够任意，以至于无法被计算机预测，但又不仅仅是简单的随机性。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】简单句：machines（S）+ have（V）+ a pretty hard time（O）+ emulating creativity（现在分词作时间/伴随状语）；其后 arbitrary enough... 为形容词短语修饰 creativity。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】主句为简单句（have a hard time doing sth 固定句型）；arbitrary enough not to be predicted by a computer 为形容词+enough+不定式被动式作后置定语修饰 creativity；and yet more than simple randomness 为形容词短语并列，同样修饰 creativity。层次：主句→形容词短语1（enough to）→形容词短语2（and yet more than）。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】So far 时间状语；have a hard time (in) doing sth 固定搭配"做某事很困难"；enough...to... 结构"足够……以至于……"；not to be predicted 为不定式被动式；and yet 表转折"然而"。
4.【翻译要点】have a hard time emulating 译作"在模仿……方面还相当困难"；arbitrary enough not to be predicted 译作"足够任意，以至于无法被预测"；and yet more than simple randomness 译作"但又不仅仅是简单的随机性"。
5.【易错点】have a hard time (in) doing sth 中 in 省略，emulating 为动名词而非现在分词作定语；enough 修饰形容词 arbitrary 时置于其后，不可误读为 enough arbitrary；and yet 中 yet 为副词而非连词，连接两个并列形容词短语。
【断句版】So far, machines have a pretty hard time emulating creativity, | arbitrary enough not to be predicted by a computer, | and yet more than simple randomness.
sentences.cut: [[主句 A:So far S:machines V:have O:a pretty hard time [伴随 emulating creativity]] [后置定语修饰creativity: [adj短语1 arbitrary enough not to be predicted by a computer] [adj短语2 and yet more than simple randomness]]]
phrases: have a hard time doing sth　做某事很困难
emulate creativity　模仿创造力
arbitrary　任意的、武断的
enough...to...　足够……以至于……
randomness　随机性

sentences.src: 六级·2020.7·阅读长难句·狩猎治疗性while定语从句
sentences.en: Hunting "designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both"—what Varner terms "therapeutic hunting"—is defensible, while subsistence and sport hunting—both of which only benefit human beings—are not.
sentences.zh: "旨在保障目标物种整体福祉、其生态系统完整性、或二者兼顾"的狩猎——即Varner所谓的"治疗性狩猎"——是可被辩护的；而生计性狩猎和运动性狩猎——这两者都只让人类得益——则不可辩护。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】while 连接对比并列句。前分句主语为 Hunting，后接 designed to secure...or both 过去分词短语作后置定语；what Varner terms 'therapeutic hunting' 为插入语同位语；谓语 is defensible。后分句主语为 subsistence and sport hunting，后接 both of which 非限制性定语从句；谓语 are not（省略 defensible）。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】第一层：while 连接对比并列句；第二层：what Varner terms... 为名词性从句作插入语同位语；第三层：both of which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 subsistence and sport hunting。层次：Hunting (designed to...) — what Varner terms... — is defensible / while subsistence and sport hunting (both of which...) — are not。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】designed to 过去分词作后置定语；what Varner terms... 中 what 引导名词性从句且在从句中作 terms 的宾语（terms 为"把……称作"）；while 表对比；both of which 为"介词+关系代词"引导非限制性定语从句；are not 后省略了 defensible。
4.【翻译要点】长主语被修饰语和插入语切割，翻译时先还原主干"狩猎是可辩护的"，再将修饰语前置；what Varner terms 译作"即Varner所谓的"；both of which only benefit human beings 译作"这两者都只让人类得益"；are not 承前省略，译作"则不可辩护"。
5.【易错点】主语 Hunting 被 designed to 长修饰语和插入语隔开，考生易找不到谓语 is defensible；what Varner terms 中 what 作 terms 的宾语而非主语；are not 后省略 defensible，不可误读为 are not benefiting；therapeutic hunting 为术语"治疗性狩猎"。
【断句版】Hunting 'designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both' | —what Varner terms 'therapeutic hunting'— | is defensible, | while subsistence and sport hunting | —both of which only benefit human beings— | are not.
sentences.cut: [[前分句 S:Hunting [后置定语 designed to secure O:the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both] [插入语同位语 what Varner terms 'therapeutic hunting'] V:is C:defensible] [对比分句 while S:subsistence and sport hunting [定语从句 both of which V:benefit O:human beings] V:are not(省略defensible)]]
phrases: aggregate welfare　整体福祉
target species　目标物种
ecosystem integrity　生态系统完整性
therapeutic hunting　治疗性狩猎
subsistence hunting　生计性狩猎
sport hunting　运动性狩猎
both of which　这两者都

sentences.src: 六级·2020.12·阅读长难句·抱怨者that并列
sentences.en: When you're feeling hard done by—taken for granted by your partner, say, or obliged to work for a half-witted boss—it's easy to become attached to the position that it's not your job to address the matter, and that doing so would be an admission of fault.
sentences.zh: 当你感到受了委屈时——比如说被伴侣视作理所当然，或者不得不为一个愚蠢的老板工作——你很容易执着于这样的立场：解决这件事不是你的职责，而且这样做将是承认过错。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】When 引导时间状语从句（内含破折号插入补充成分），主句为 it 作形式主语的简单句：it（形式）+ is easy（表语）+ to become attached to the position（真正主语）；the position 后接 that...and that... 两个并列同位语从句。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】第一层：When 时间状语从句（you're feeling hard done by）；第二层：破折号内插入两个过去分词短语（taken for granted... / obliged to work...）作补充说明；第三层：that...and that... 两个并列同位语从句修饰 the position。层次：When you're feeling hard done by—插入语—it's easy to become attached to the position [that... and that...]。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】When 引导时间状语从句；hard done by 为固定习语"受委屈、被不公平对待"；say 为插入语"比如说"；it 为形式主语；that...and that... 两个并列同位语从句解释 position 的内容。
4.【翻译要点】When 从句译作"当你感到……时"；破折号插入语用破折号保留并译作"——比如说……或者……"；形式主语 it 不译，真正主语提前；that...and that... 两个同位语从句用冒号引出译作"：……，而且……"。
5.【易错点】hard done by 为习语不可按字面理解为"被困难打倒"；taken for granted 和 obliged to work 为并列过去分词短语作插入补充；that...and that... 是同位语从句而非定语从句，解释 position 的内容而非修饰 position。
【断句版】When you're feeling hard done by | —taken for granted by your partner, say, or obliged to work for a half-witted boss— | it's easy to become attached to the position | that it's not your job to address the matter, | and that doing so would be an admission of fault.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语从句 When S:you V:are feeling C:hard done by [插入补充 taken for granted by your partner, say, or obliged to work for a half-witted boss]] [主句 S:it(形式) V:is C:easy [真正主语 to become attached to O:the position] [同位语从句1 that it's not your job to address the matter] [同位语从句2 and that doing so would be an admission of fault]]]
phrases: hard done by　受委屈、被不公平对待
take for granted　视作理所当然
be obliged to do　不得不做
half-witted　愚蠢的、笨的
become attached to the position　执着于某种立场
admission of fault　承认过错

sentences.src: 六级·2021.12·阅读长难句·食品标签while冒号notbut
sentences.en: While creating labels that play on consumer fears and misconceptions about their food may give a company a temporary marketing advantage over competing products on the grocery aisle, in the long term this strategy will have just the opposite effect: by injecting fear into the discourse about our food, we run the risk of eroding consumer trust in not just a single product, but the entire food business.
sentences.zh: 尽管制造那些利用消费者对食品的恐惧和误解的标签，可能在杂货店货架上给企业带来相对于竞品的暂时营销优势，但从长远来看，这一策略将产生恰恰相反的效果：通过将恐惧注入关于我们食品的讨论中，我们冒着侵蚀消费者不仅对某一产品、而是对整个食品行业信任的风险。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】While 引导让步状语从句（从句主语为动名词短语 creating labels...，谓语为 may give），主句为 this strategy（S）+ will have（V）+ the opposite effect（O）；冒号后 by injecting... 介词短语作方式状语，主句 we（S）+ run（V）+ the risk（O）+ of eroding... 定语。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】第一层：While 让步状语从句；第二层：that play on consumer fears and misconceptions 定语从句修饰 labels；第三层：冒号后 by injecting... 方式状语 + we run the risk of eroding consumer trust in not just...but... 并列结构。层次：While creating labels [that play on...] may give... advantage, | this strategy will have the opposite effect: | by injecting fear..., we run the risk of eroding trust in not just... but...。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】While 引导让步状语从句，表"尽管"；that 引导定语从句修饰 labels；play on 固定搭配"利用（恐惧等）"；not just...but... 并列结构"不仅……而且……"；run the risk of doing sth"冒着……的风险"。
4.【翻译要点】While 让步从句动名词主语较长，译作"尽管制造那些……的标签，可能……"；that play on fears 定语从句前置译作"利用消费者恐惧和误解的标签"；冒号后 by injecting... 译作"通过将恐惧注入……"；not just...but... 译作"不仅……而是……"。
5.【易错点】While 在句首引导让步状语从句而非时间状语从句；creating labels 为动名词短语作从句主语而非现在分词作状语；not just...but... 中 but 后接 the entire food business 与 a single product 并列，不可误读为 not...but... 否定结构。
【断句版】While creating labels that play on consumer fears and misconceptions about their food | may give a company a temporary marketing advantage over competing products on the grocery aisle, | in the long term this strategy will have just the opposite effect: | by injecting fear into the discourse about our food, | we run the risk of eroding consumer trust | in not just a single product, but the entire food business.
sentences.cut: [[让步状语从句 While S:creating labels [定语从句 that V:play on O:consumer fears and misconceptions about their food] V:may give O:a company [O补语:a temporary marketing advantage over competing products on the grocery aisle]] [主句 A:in the long term S:this strategy V:will have O:just the opposite effect] [冒号解释 A:by injecting fear into the discourse about our food S:we V:run O:the risk [定语 of eroding consumer trust in not just a single product, but the entire food business]]]
phrases: play on fears and misconceptions　利用恐惧和误解
temporary marketing advantage　暂时营销优势
grocery aisle　杂货店货架
in the long term　从长远来看
run the risk of doing sth　冒着……的风险
erode consumer trust　侵蚀消费者信任
not just...but...　不仅……而是……

sentences.src: 六级·2022.12·阅读长难句·塑料污染where定从
sentences.en: About 1 million plastic bottles are sold each minute around the globe and, with just 14% recycled, many end up in the oceans where they have polluted even the remotest parts, harming marine life and potentially people who eat sea food.
sentences.zh: 全球每分钟约售出100万个塑料瓶，其中仅有14%被回收，许多最终流入海洋——在那里它们甚至污染了最偏远的地区，危害着海洋生物以及食用海鲜的人类。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】and 连接两个并列分句。前分句：About 1 million plastic bottles（S）+ are sold（V被动）+ each minute（状语）；后分句：many（S，指代 plastic bottles）+ end up in the oceans（V+状语）；where 引导定语从句修饰 the oceans；harming... 现在分词短语作结果状语。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】第一层：and 并列两个被动/主动分句；第二层：with just 14% recycled 为 with 复合结构作插入状语；第三层：where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 the oceans；第四层：harming marine life and potentially people 现在分词短语作结果状语，后接 who eat sea food 定语从句修饰 people。层次：bottles are sold... / and, with 14% recycled, many end up in the oceans [where they have polluted...], [harming... people [who eat sea food]]。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】and 并列；with just 14% recycled 为 with 复合结构（with+宾语+过去分词）；where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 oceans；harming 为现在分词作结果状语；who 引导定语从句修饰 people。
4.【翻译要点】被动语态 are sold 译作主动"售出"；with 复合结构译作"其中仅有14%被回收"；where 定语从句译作"在那里它们甚至污染了……"；harming 结果状语译作"危害着……"；who eat sea food 前置译作"食用海鲜的人类"。
5.【易错点】many 为代词指代 plastic bottles 而非其他名词；with just 14% recycled 为 with 复合结构而非介词短语；where 引导定语从句修饰 oceans 而非地点状语从句；harming 为结果状语而非伴随状语。
【断句版】About 1 million plastic bottles are sold each minute around the globe | and, with just 14% recycled, | many end up in the oceans | where they have polluted even the remotest parts, | harming marine life and potentially people | who eat sea food.
sentences.cut: [[并列分句1 S:About 1 million plastic bottles V:are sold A:each minute around the globe] [并列分句2 and A:with just 14% recycled S:many V:end up A:in the oceans [定语从句 where S:they V:have polluted O:even the remotest parts] [结果状语 harming O:marine life and potentially people [定语从句 who V:eat O:sea food]]]]
phrases: plastic bottles　塑料瓶
end up in the oceans　最终流入海洋
remote parts　偏远地区
harming marine life　危害海洋生物
potentially　潜在地、可能
sea food　海鲜

sentences.src: 六级·2023.6·阅读长难句·职场监控同位语that
sentences.en: For example, it was found that people who sat at 12-person lunch tables tended to interact, share ideas more and outperform those who regularly sat at four-person tables, a fact that would probably have gone undetected without such data analysis.
sentences.zh: 例如，研究发现，坐在12人午餐桌旁的人往往互动更多、分享想法更多，并且表现优于那些经常坐在4人桌旁的人——如果没有这种数据分析，这一事实很可能一直无法被发现。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】形式主语句型：it（形式）+ was found（被动谓语）+ that 引导主语从句；主语从句主干为 people（S）+ tended to interact, share ideas more and outperform（V并列）+ those（O）；a fact 为前面整句话的同位语，后接 that 定语从句。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】第一层：it was found that... 形式主语结构，that 引导主语从句；第二层：who sat at 12-person lunch tables 定语从句修饰 people；第三层：who regularly sat at four-person tables 定语从句修饰 those；第四层：a fact that would probably have gone undetected 同位语+定语从句，that 修饰 fact。层次：it was found that people [who sat at...] tended to interact... and outperform those [who sat at...], [a fact that would have gone undetected without...]。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】it was found that 形式主语结构；who 引导两个定语从句分别修饰 people 和 those；a fact 为同位语指代前文整个发现；that would probably have gone undetected 定语从句修饰 fact；without such data analysis 为介词短语条件状语。
4.【翻译要点】it was found that 译作"研究发现"；两个 who 定语从句前置译作"坐在12人桌旁的人……那些经常坐在4人桌旁的人"；a fact that... 同位语用破折号引出译作"——如果没有……，这一事实很可能……"。
5.【易错点】it was found that 中 it 为形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句；a fact 为同位语而非定语从句修饰某个名词；would have gone undetected 为虚拟语气/推测，表"很可能一直未被发现"。
【断句版】For example, it was found that | people who sat at 12-person lunch tables tended to interact, share ideas more and outperform | those who regularly sat at four-person tables, | a fact that would probably have gone undetected without such data analysis.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:it(形式) V:was found [主语从句 that S:people [定语从句 who V:sat at O:12-person lunch tables] V:tended to interact, share ideas more and outperform O:those [定语从句 who regularly V:sat at O:four-person tables]]] [同位语 a fact [定语从句 that V:would probably have gone undetected A:without such data analysis]]]
phrases: it was found that　研究发现
outperform　表现优于
a fact that...　这一事实……
go undetected　未被发现
data analysis　数据分析
lunch table　午餐桌

sentences.src: 六级·2024.6·阅读长难句·职业身份whether目的状语
sentences.en: In an age where career progression may lead us into new sectors it is ever more important to challenge our sense of self and explore whether you can create a new experience of your identity by changing the beliefs you hold about yourself in order to expand your career options.
sentences.zh: 在一个职业发展可能将我们带入新行业的时代，挑战我们的自我认知、并探索是否可以通过改变你对自己持有的信念来创造一种新的身份体验、以拓宽你的职业选择，变得越来越重要。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】形式主语句型：it（形式）+ is ever more important（表语）+ to challenge...and explore...（真正主语，两个并列不定式）；In an age where... 为时间/背景状语，where 引导定语从句修饰 age。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】第一层：In an age where... 状语 + where 定语从句修饰 age；第二层：it is important to challenge...and explore... 形式主语结构；第三层：whether 引导宾语从句作 explore 的宾语；第四层：by changing the beliefs 方式状语 + (that) you hold about yourself 定语从句修饰 beliefs + in order to expand... 目的状语。层次：In an age [where career progression may lead us into new sectors] | it is ever more important [to challenge our sense of self] and [explore whether you can create... by changing the beliefs (you hold...) in order to expand...]。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】where 引导定语从句修饰 age（抽象地点）；it 为形式主语；whether 引导宾语从句；by changing... 方式状语；(that) you hold about yourself 省略关系代词的定语从句；in order to 目的状语。
4.【翻译要点】In an age where... 前置译作"在一个……的时代"；形式主语 it is important to... 译作"……变得越来越重要"；whether 宾语从句译作"是否可以……"；by changing... 方式状语译作"通过改变……"；in order to 目的状语译作"以……"。
5.【易错点】where 引导定语从句修饰抽象名词 age 而非地点名词；it 为形式主语，真正主语是后面两个并列不定式 to challenge...and explore...；whether 引导宾语从句而非条件状语从句；(that) you hold about yourself 中关系代词 that 省略。
【断句版】In an age where career progression may lead us into new sectors | it is ever more important | to challenge our sense of self | and explore whether you can create a new experience of your identity | by changing the beliefs you hold about yourself | in order to expand your career options.
sentences.cut: [[背景状语 In an age [定语从句 where S:career progression V:may lead O:us A:into new sectors]] [主句 S:it(形式) V:is C:ever more important [真正主语 to challenge O:our sense of self and explore [宾语从句 whether S:you V:can create O:a new experience of your identity [方式状语 by changing O:the beliefs [定语从句 (that) you hold about yourself]] [目的状语 in order to expand O:your career options]]]]]
phrases: career progression　职业发展
sense of self　自我认知
explore whether　探索是否
by changing the beliefs　通过改变信念
in order to expand　以拓宽
career options　职业选择

sentences.src: 六级·2024.12·阅读长难句·审美原则which定从
sentences.en: Possible universal principles of beauty—such as proportion, fittingness, radiance, and others—are general categories, which allow for a wide array of embodiments.
sentences.zh: 可能存在的普遍美学原则——如比例、适宜性、光辉等——是一般性范畴，允许有多种多样的体现方式。
sentences.parse:
1.【句子主干】简单句：Possible universal principles of beauty（S）+ are（V）+ general categories（C）；破折号内 such as... 为插入举例；which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 categories。
2.【从句类型与嵌套层次】主句为简单主系表结构；破折号内 such as proportion, fittingness, radiance, and others 为举例插入语；which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 general categories，从句谓语 allow for，宾语 a wide array of embodiments。层次：主句 S —插入举例— V C [定语从句 which allow for...]。
3.【关键连接词/引导词】such as 举例插入；which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰先行词 general categories；allow for 固定搭配"容许、考虑到"；a wide array of"多种多样的"。
4.【翻译要点】破折号插入举例保留破折号译作"——如……等——"；which 定语从句前置或独立译作"，允许有多种多样的体现方式"；allow for 译作"容许/允许有"。
5.【易错点】which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰的是 general categories 而非 principles；allow for 为固定短语不可拆分为 allow + for；embodiments 为"体现方式/具体形态"而非"化身"。
【断句版】Possible universal principles of beauty | —such as proportion, fittingness, radiance, and others— | are general categories, | which allow for a wide array of embodiments.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Possible universal principles of beauty [插入举例 such as proportion, fittingness, radiance, and others] V:are C:general categories [定语从句 which V:allow for O:a wide array of embodiments]]]
phrases: universal principles of beauty　普遍美学原则
proportion　比例
fittingness　适宜性
radiance　光辉
general categories　一般性范畴
allow for　容许、允许有
a wide array of embodiments　多种多样的体现方式

sentences.en: Some influential personalities even suggest making it as the national costume for Chinese women.
sentences.zh: 一些有影响的人士甚至建议将旗袍作为中国女性的民族服饰。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：Some influential personalities（S）suggest（V）making it as the national costume for Chinese women（动名词短语作O）。even 为程度副词修饰 suggest。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。动名词短语 making it as... 作 suggest 的宾语，其中 it 指代前文 Qipao，as the national costume 为宾语补足语，for Chinese women 为后置定语修饰 costume。层次：主语→状语even→谓语→[动名词宾语 making it as the national costume [后置定语 for Chinese women]]。
③关键连接词/引导词：suggest 后接动名词 doing sth.，不接不定式；it 指代 Qipao（上下文）；even 表递进「甚至」。
④翻译要点：中文「建议将旗袍作为……」译为 suggest making it as...；「有影响的人士」译 influential personalities；「民族服饰」译 national costume。
⑤易错点：suggest 后不可接 to do；it 指代单数 Qipao，勿漏；influential 勿拼错为 influencial。
⑥断句版：Some influential personalities even suggest | making it as the national costume | for Chinese women.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Some influential personalities [状语 even] V:suggest O:making it as the national costume [宾语补足语 as the national costume] [后置定语 for Chinese women]]]
phrases: influential personalities　有影响力的人士
suggest doing sth.　建议做某事
national costume　民族服饰
Chinese women　中国女性

sentences.en: The Tang dynasty began in 618 and ended in 907, which was the most glorious period in Chinese history.
sentences.zh: 唐朝始于618年，终于907年，是中国历史上最灿烂的时期。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The Tang dynasty（S）began（V）in 618 and ended（V并列）in 907，后接 which 引导的非限制性定语从句补充说明。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：which was the most glorious period in Chinese history 为非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 The Tang dynasty。层次：主句(两个并列谓语 began...and ended...)→[非限制性定语从句 which was...]。
③关键连接词/引导词：and 连接 began 与 ended 两个并列谓语；which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个前句所述的唐朝。
④翻译要点：中文「始于618年，终于907年」译为 began in 618 and ended in 907；「最灿烂的时期」译 the most glorious period；「中国历史上」译 in Chinese history。
⑤易错点：非限制性定语从句用 which 不用 that；glorious 此处译「灿烂/辉煌」勿译「光荣的」；period 勿漏。
⑥断句版：The Tang dynasty began in 618 and ended in 907, | which was the most glorious period | in Chinese history.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Tang dynasty V:began [状语 in 618] and V:ended [状语 in 907]] [非限制性定语从句 S:which V:was C:the most glorious period [后置定语 in Chinese history]]]
phrases: the Tang dynasty　唐朝
begin in + 年份　始于某年
end in + 年份　终于某年
the most glorious period　最灿烂的时期
Chinese history　中国历史

sentences.en: There are 23 rivers flowing into the lake, the majority of which are seasonal.
sentences.zh: 有23条河流流入青海湖，其中大部分是季节性河流。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：There are（V存在句）23 rivers（S）flowing into the lake（现在分词短语后置定语），后接 the majority of which 引导的非限制性定语从句。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：the majority of which are seasonal 为「名词/代词 + of which」引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 23 rivers。层次：There be 主句→[后置定语 flowing into the lake]→[非限制性定语从句 the majority of which are seasonal]。
③关键连接词/引导词：which 指代 23 rivers；the majority of which 表「其中大部分」；flowing 现在分词作后置定语。
④翻译要点：中文「有23条河流流入」用 There are...rivers flowing into...；「其中大部分是季节性河流」译 the majority of which are seasonal（seasonal 后省略 rivers，避免重复）。
⑤易错点：There be 句型中真正主语是 rivers，谓语用 are；the majority of which 结构勿写成 most of them（逗号后须用关系代词 which）；seasonal 此处译「季节性的」。
⑥断句版：There are 23 rivers flowing into the lake, | the majority of which are seasonal.
sentences.cut: [[There be 主句 V:There are S:23 rivers [后置定语 flowing into the lake]] [非限制性定语从句 先行词23 rivers [主语 the majority of which] V:are C:seasonal]]
phrases: flow into　流入
the majority of　……的大多数
seasonal rivers　季节性河流
There be 句型　存在句

sentences.en: High-speed rail has greatly shortened the time people spend on traveling.
sentences.zh: 高铁大大缩短了人们出行的时间。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：High-speed rail（S）has greatly shortened（V现在完成时）the time（O），后接省略关系副词 when/that 的定语从句 people spend on traveling。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：people spend on traveling 为省略关系词的定语从句，修饰先行词 the time。关系词在从句中作 spend 的宾语（spend time on sth.），故可省略 that/which。层次：主句→[定语从句 people spend on traveling]。
③关键连接词/引导词：关系代词 that/which 省略（因作 spend 宾语）；on 为介词，与 spend 搭配 spend time on sth.。
④翻译要点：中文「高铁大大缩短了人们出行的时间」顺译为 High-speed rail has greatly shortened the time people spend on traveling；「出行」译 traveling。
⑤易错点：定语从句省略关系词的前提是关系词在从句中作宾语；spend time on sth. 搭配勿漏 on；has shortened 现在完成时表已产生影响。
⑥断句版：High-speed rail has greatly shortened the time | people spend on traveling.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:High-speed rail [状语 has greatly] V:shortened O:the time [定语从句（省略that/which）S:people V:spend O:(that) [状语 on traveling]]]]
phrases: high-speed rail　高铁
shorten the time　缩短时间
spend time on sth.　花时间做某事
traveling　出行/旅行

sentences.en: In the past, cycling was once the major means of transportation in China's urban and rural areas, for which China was once labeled the "bike kingdom."
sentences.zh: 过去，骑自行车曾是中国城乡最主要的交通工具，中国一度因此被称为「自行车王国」。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：cycling（S，动名词作主语）was（V）the major means of transportation（C），后接 for which 引导的非限制性定语从句。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：for which China was once labeled the 'bike kingdom' 为「介词+关系代词」引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词前面整个主句所述事实。层次：主句→[非限制性定语从句 for which...]。
③关键连接词/引导词：for which 中 which 指代前面整个主句内容（骑自行车是主要交通工具这一事实），for 与 label 搭配 be labeled for...；in the past 时间状语置于句首。
④翻译要点：中文「过去，骑自行车曾是……」译 In the past, cycling was once...；「中国城乡」译 China's urban and rural areas；「被称为」译 be labeled/as。
⑤易错点：动名词 cycling 作主语谓语用单数；for which 中介词 for 不可省；label A B 结构中 B 为宾语补足语。
⑥断句版：In the past, | cycling was once the major means of transportation | in China's urban and rural areas, | for which China was once labeled the "bike kingdom."
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In the past, [主句 S:cycling [状语 once] V:was C:the major means of transportation [后置定语 in China's urban and rural areas]]] [非限制性定语从句 介词+关系代词 for which [S:China V:was once labeled O:Cthe "bike kingdom"]]]
phrases: the major means of transportation　最主要的交通工具
urban and rural areas　城乡
be labeled　被称为
bike kingdom　自行车王国
for which　因此（介词+关系代词）

sentences.en: Chinese idioms are widely used in daily conversations and literary creation. Using them properly can make one's language more expressive, and thus make communication more effective.
sentences.zh: 成语广泛用于日常对话和文学创作中，恰当使用它们可以使语言更有表现力，从而使交流更加有效。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：前分句 Chinese idioms（S）are widely used（V被动）in the daily conversations and literary creation（状语）；后分句 Using them properly（动名词短语作S）can make（V）one's language more expressive（O+C），and thus make the communication more effective（并列谓语）。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。后分句为「动名词短语作主语 + make + 宾语 + 宾补」结构，and thus 连接两个并列的 make 结构。层次：前分句(被动语态)→后分句(动名词主语+并列make)。
③关键连接词/引导词：and thus 表因果递进「从而」；make + O + 形容词比较级作宾补；Using them properly 为动名词短语，properly 副词修饰 using。
④翻译要点：中文「成语广泛用于……」译被动 are widely used in...；「恰当使用它们」译动名词短语 Using them properly 作主语；「使语言更有表现力」译 make one's language more expressive。
⑤易错点：动名词短语作主语谓语用单数；make + O + C 结构中 C 用形容词；thus 后接现在分词或并列谓语均可。
⑥断句版：Chinese idioms are widely used in the daily conversations and literary creation, | Using them properly can make one's language more expressive, | and thus make the communication more effective.
sentences.cut: [[前分句 S:Chinese idioms [状语 are widely] V:used [状语 in the daily conversations and literary creation]]] + [[后分句 S:Using them properly V:can make O:one's language C:more expressive] [并列连词 and thus V:make O:the communication C:more effective]]
phrases: Chinese idioms　汉语成语
literary creation　文学创作
make one's language more expressive　使语言更有表现力
and thus　从而
daily conversations　日常对话

sentences.en: This massive reinforced concrete bridge fully proves that China is capable of building record-breaking megastructures.
sentences.zh: 这座跨度巨大的钢筋混凝土大桥充分证明，中国有能力建造创纪录的巨型建筑。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：This massive reinforced concrete bridge（S）fully proves（V）that 引导的宾语从句。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：that China is capable of building record-breaking megastructures 为宾语从句，作 proves 的宾语。层次：主句→[宾语从句 that...]。
③关键连接词/引导词：that 引导宾语从句（口语中可省略，书面语保留）；be capable of doing sth. 固定搭配「有能力做某事」。
④翻译要点：中文「这座跨度巨大的钢筋混凝土大桥」译 This massive reinforced concrete bridge；「充分证明」译 fully proves；「有能力建造」译 is capable of building。
⑤易错点：reinforced concrete 译「钢筋混凝土」；be capable of 后接动名词 doing；megastructures 译「巨型建筑」勿拆词。
⑥断句版：This massive reinforced concrete bridge fully proves | that China is capable of building record-breaking megastructures.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:This massive reinforced concrete bridge [状语 fully] V:proves] [宾语从句 that [S:China V:is capable of O:building record-breaking megastructures]]]
phrases: reinforced concrete　钢筋混凝土
be capable of doing　有能力做某事
record-breaking　创纪录的
megastructures　巨型建筑
fully prove　充分证明

sentences.en: The bridge boasts a novel structure and a graceful appearance, with a major arch in the middle and two minor ones on its ends which help discharge floods, reduce the weight of the bridge and save stones.
sentences.zh: 赵州桥结构新颖、造型优美，桥中间有一个大拱，两端各有两个小拱，有助于排泄洪水、减轻桥梁重量并节省石材。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The bridge（S）boasts（V）a novel structure and a graceful appearance（O并列），后接 with 复合短语作伴随状语，其中嵌套 which 引导的定语从句。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：with a major arch in the middle and two minor ones on its ends 为 with 介词短语作伴随状语；which help discharge floods, reduce the weight of the bridge and save stones 为非限制性定语从句，修饰前面整个 with 短语所述的结构。层次：主句→[with伴随状语]→[定语从句 which help...并列动词]。
③关键连接词/引导词：which 指代前面 with 短语所述的「大小拱结构」；help 后接并列动词原形 discharge/reduce/save；boast 此处译「拥有/以……而自豪」。
④翻译要点：中文「结构新颖、造型优美」译 boasts a novel structure and a graceful appearance；「帮助排泄洪水、减轻重量、节省石材」译 help discharge floods, reduce the weight and save stones（三个并列动词原形）。
⑤易错点：boast 此处为褒义「拥有（值得自豪的东西）」勿译「吹嘘」；help (to) do 中 to 省略；minor ones 中 ones 指代 arches 避免重复。
⑥断句版：The bridge boasts a novel structure and a graceful appearance, | with a major arch in the middle and two minor ones on its ends | which help discharge floods, reduce the weight of the bridge and save stones.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The bridge V:boasts O:a novel structure and a graceful appearance] [with伴随状语 with [宾语 a major arch in the middle and two minor ones on its ends]] [非限制性定语从句 S:which V:help [并列宾语 discharge floods, reduce the weight of the bridge and save stones]]]
phrases: boast　拥有（引以为豪之物）
novel structure　结构新颖
graceful appearance　造型优美
major arch / minor arch　大拱/小拱
discharge floods　排泄洪水

sentences.en: The bridge is sustained by 281 pillars, each of which has a stone lion on the end and more stone lions hiding on its head, back, abdomen or claws.
sentences.zh: 这座桥由281根柱子支撑，每根柱子顶端都有一头石狮，柱头上、背上、腹部或爪子上还藏着更多小狮子。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The bridge（S）is sustained by（V被动）281 pillars（O），后接「代词+of which」引导的非限制性定语从句，从句内又嵌套 with 复合结构。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：each of which has a stone lion on the end and more stone lions hiding on its head, back, abdomen or claws 为「each of which」引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 281 pillars；其中 hiding on its head... 为现在分词短语作宾语补足语（more stone lions hiding）。层次：主句→[定语从句 each of which has...and more stone lions hiding...]。
③关键连接词/引导词：each of which 表「其中每一根」；and 连接 a stone lion 与 more stone lions 两个并列宾语；hiding 现在分词表主动伴随。
④翻译要点：中文「由281根柱子支撑」译 is sustained by 281 pillars；「每根柱子上都有一头石狮」译 each of which has a stone lion；「藏着更多的狮子」译 more stone lions hiding on...。
⑤易错点：each of which 中 which 不可换用 them；sustain 译「支撑」勿译「维持」；abdomen 译「腹部」。
⑥断句版：The bridge is sustained by 281 pillars, | each of which has a stone lion on the end | and more stone lions hiding on its head, back, abdomen or claws.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The bridge V:is sustained by O:281 pillars] [非限制性定语从句 先行词pillars [主语 each of which] V:has [宾语1 a stone lion on the end] and [宾语2 more stone lions [宾补 hiding on its head, back, abdomen or claws]]]]
phrases: be sustained by　由……支撑
each of which　其中每一个
stone lion　石狮
abdomen　腹部
hide on　藏于……之上

sentences.en: To cope with various challenges brought about by population aging, the country is actively taking measures to strengthen support for elderly care.
sentences.zh: 为了应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战，国家正积极采取措施，加大对养老的支持力度。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：the country（S）is actively taking（V现在进行时）measures（O），句首不定式短语作目的状语，句末不定式短语作目的状语。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。To cope with various challenges brought about by population aging 为不定式短语作目的状语，其中 brought about by population aging 为过去分词短语后置修饰 challenges；to strengthen support for elderly care 为不定式短语作目的状语（说明采取措施的目的）。层次：目的状语→主句→目的状语。
③关键连接词/引导词：To cope with 不定式表目的；brought about by 过去分词表被动「由……带来」；take measures to do 固定搭配「采取措施做某事」。
④翻译要点：中文「为了应对……挑战」译 To cope with various challenges brought about by...；「加大对养老的支持」译 strengthen support for elderly care。
⑤易错点：brought about 为过去分词作后置定语勿误作谓语；elderly care 译「养老/老年照护」勿拆词；cope with 勿与 deal with 混用。
⑥断句版：To cope with various challenges brought about by population aging, | the country is actively taking measures | to strengthen support for elderly care.
sentences.cut: [[目的状语 To cope with various challenges [后置定语 brought about by population aging]] [主句 S:the country [状语 is actively] V:taking O:measures] [目的状语 to strengthen support for elderly care]]
phrases: cope with　应对
bring about　带来/造成
population aging　人口老龄化
take measures to do　采取措施做某事
elderly care　养老/老年照护

sentences.en: Many fans feature graceful design and fine workmanship as well as exquisite pictures of landscape, flowers, birds and figures, with superb artistic value.
sentences.zh: 许多扇子造型优美、做工精良，并绘有山水、花鸟、人物等精美图案，具有很高的艺术价值。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：Many fans（S）feature（V）graceful design and fine workmanship（O并列）as well as exquisite pictures of landscape, flowers, birds and figures（O并列），句末 with 短语作伴随状语。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。as well as 连接并列宾语；with superb artistic value 为 with 介词短语作伴随/结果状语。层次：主语→谓语→并列宾语→with伴随状语。
③关键连接词/引导词：as well as 连接并列名词短语「以及」；feature 此处译「以……为特色/具有」；with 短语表伴随「具有……价值」。
④翻译要点：中文「造型优美、做工精良」译 feature graceful design and fine workmanship；「绘有山水、花鸟、人物等精美图案」译 exquisite pictures of landscape, flowers, birds and figures；「具有很高的艺术价值」译 with superb artistic value。
⑤易错点：feature 此处为动词「以……为特色」勿误作名词；as well as 后接名词勿接句子；superb 译「极高的/卓越的」。
⑥断句版：Many fans feature graceful design and fine workmanship | as well as exquisite pictures of landscape, flowers, birds and figures, | with superb artistic value.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Many fans V:feature O:graceful design and fine workmanship [并列连词 as well as] O:exquisite pictures of landscape, flowers, birds and figures] [with伴随状语 with superb artistic value]]
phrases: feature　以……为特色
graceful design　造型优美
fine workmanship　做工精良
exquisite pictures　精美图案
artistic value　艺术价值

sentences.en: The research and development team, through relentless efforts, overcame a series of technical challenges, successfully achieving global coverage and high-precision positioning, making China one of the few countries with an independent satellite positioning and navigation system.
sentences.zh: 研发团队通过不懈努力，克服了一系列技术难题，成功实现了全球覆盖和高精度定位，使中国成为世界上少数几个拥有独立卫星定位导航系统的国家之一。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The research and development team（S）overcame（V）a series of technical challenges（O），句中 through relentless efforts 为插入状语，句末两个现在分词短语作结果状语。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。through relentless efforts 为介词短语作方式状语（插入主谓之间）；successfully achieving global coverage and high-precision positioning 为现在分词短语作结果状语；making China one of the few countries with an independent satellite positioning and navigation system 为第二个现在分词短语作结果状语，其中 with 短语后置修饰 countries。层次：主语→[插入状语 through...]→谓语→[结果状语 achieving...]→[结果状语 making...]。
③关键连接词/引导词：through 表方式「通过」；两个现在分词短语依次作结果状语，表顺承结果；one of the few countries with... 中 with 短语后置定语。
④翻译要点：中文「通过不懈努力」译 through relentless efforts（插入主谓之间）；「克服了一系列技术难题」译 overcame a series of technical challenges；「使中国成为……之一」译 making China one of the few countries...。
⑤易错点：两个现在分词短语均表结果，逻辑主语均为 the team；high-precision 为复合形容词；navigation system 译「导航系统」。
⑥断句版：The research and development team, | through relentless efforts, | overcame a series of technical challenges, | successfully achieving global coverage and high-precision positioning, | making China one of the few countries with an independent satellite positioning and navigation system.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The research and development team [插入状语 through relentless efforts] V:overcame O:a series of technical challenges] [结果状语1 successfully achieving global coverage and high-precision positioning] [结果状语2 making China one of the few countries [后置定语 with an independent satellite positioning and navigation system]]]
phrases: research and development team　研发团队
relentless efforts　不懈努力
overcome technical challenges　克服技术难题
global coverage　全球覆盖
high-precision positioning　高精度定位
satellite navigation system　卫星导航系统

sentences.en: The Tiangong Space Station, China's first space laboratory, boasts over 110 cubic meters of usable space and is able to accommodate three astronauts, orbiting at an altitude of 400 to 450 kilometers above the Earth's surface.
sentences.zh: 天宫空间站是中国首个太空实验室，拥有110多立方米使用空间，可驻留三名宇航员，在距地球表面400至450公里的轨道上运行。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The Tiangong Space Station（S）boasts（V）over 110 cubic meters of usable space（O）and is able to accommodate（V并列）three astronauts（O），句末现在分词短语作伴随状语。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：China's first space laboratory 为同位语，补充说明主语；orbiting at an altitude of 400 to 450 kilometers above the Earth's surface 为现在分词短语作伴随状语。层次：主语+同位语→并列谓语1(boasts...)→并列谓语2(is able to accommodate...)→[伴随状语 orbiting...]。
③关键连接词/引导词：and 连接 boasts 与 is able to accommodate 两个并列谓语；orbiting 现在分词表主动伴随；boast 此处译「拥有」。
④翻译要点：中文「是中国首个太空实验室」译同位语 China's first space laboratory；「拥有110多立方米使用空间」译 boasts over 110 cubic meters of usable space；「在距地球表面400-450公里的轨道上运行」译 orbiting at an altitude of...。
⑤易错点：boast 此处为褒义「拥有」勿译「吹嘘」；cubic meters 译「立方米」；altitude 译「海拔/高度」。
⑥断句版：The Tiangong Space Station, [同位语 China's first space laboratory], | boasts over 110 cubic meters of usable space | and is able to accommodate three astronauts, | orbiting at an altitude of 400 to 450 kilometers above the Earth's surface.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Tiangong Space Station [同位语 China's first space laboratory] V:boasts O:over 110 cubic meters of usable space] [并列谓语 and V:is able to accommodate O:three astronauts] [伴随状语 orbiting at an altitude of 400 to 450 kilometers above the Earth's surface]]
phrases: Tiangong Space Station　天宫空间站
space laboratory　太空实验室
cubic meters　立方米
accommodate three astronauts　驻留三名宇航员
orbit at an altitude of　在……高度运行

sentences.en: Chinese drones are popular with consumers around the world for their excellent stability, high-definition shooting capability and convenient operation, and have been widely used in civilian fields.
sentences.zh: 中国无人机以其出色的稳定性、高清拍摄能力和便捷的操作而受到全球消费者的欢迎，并已在民用领域得到广泛应用。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：Chinese drones（S）are popular with（V）consumers around the world（O）for their excellent stability, high-definition shooting capability and convenient operation（原因状语），and have been widely used（V被动并列）in civilian fields（状语）。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。for their excellent stability, high-definition shooting capability and convenient operation 为介词短语作原因状语，解释受欢迎的原因；and 连接 are popular with 与 have been widely used 两个并列谓语。层次：主语→并列谓语1(are popular with...)→[原因状语 for...]→并列谓语2(have been widely used...)。
③关键连接词/引导词：for 表原因「因为」；and 连接两个并列谓语；be popular with sb. 固定搭配「受某人欢迎」。
④翻译要点：中文「以其出色的稳定性、高清拍摄能力和便捷的操作而受到……欢迎」译 are popular with... for their...；「在民用领域得到广泛应用」译 have been widely used in civilian fields。
⑤易错点：be popular with 后接人勿用 by；high-definition 为复合形容词「高清的」；civilian fields 译「民用领域」勿译「公民领域」。
⑥断句版：Chinese drones are popular with consumers around the world | for their excellent stability, high-definition shooting capability and convenient operation, | and have been widely used in civilian fields.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Chinese drones V:are popular with O:consumers around the world [原因状语 for their excellent stability, high-definition shooting capability and convenient operation]] [并列谓语 and S:(Chinese drones) V:have been widely used [状语 in civilian fields]]]
phrases: be popular with　受……欢迎
stability　稳定性
high-definition shooting capability　高清拍摄能力
civilian fields　民用领域
widely used　广泛应用

sentences.en: It was also in Ming Dynasty that Zheng He led the seven large-scale expeditions to the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 也是在明代，郑和率领船队曾到印度洋进行了七次大规模探险航行。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：It was also in Ming Dynasty（强调句 It was...that...）that Zheng He led the seven large-scale expeditions to the Indian Ocean。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：本句为强调句型 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that + 其他成分。被强调部分为时间状语 also in Ming Dynasty。层次：强调句框架 It was [被强调状语 in Ming Dynasty] that [从句 Zheng He led the seven large-scale expeditions to the Indian Ocean]。
③关键连接词/引导词：It was...that... 强调句型；that 后接陈述语序；lead expeditions to 译「率队前往……探险」。
④翻译要点：中文「也是在明代」译为强调句 It was also in Ming Dynasty that...；「郑和率领的船队曾到印度洋进行了七次大规模探险航行」译 Zheng He led the seven large-scale expeditions to the Indian Ocean。
⑤易错点：强调句中被强调部分是状语时仍用 that 不用 when；expedition 译「探险/远征」；lead-led-led 不规则变化。
⑥断句版：It was also in Ming Dynasty | that Zheng He led the seven large-scale expeditions | to the Indian Ocean.
sentences.cut: [[强调句框架 It was [被强调状语 also in Ming Dynasty]] [that从句 S:Zheng He V:led O:the seven large-scale expeditions [状语 to the Indian Ocean]]]
phrases: It was...that...　强调句型
Ming Dynasty　明朝
lead expeditions to　率队前往……探险
large-scale　大规模的
the Indian Ocean　印度洋

sentences.en: The bridge marks a huge progress in China's bridge construction, greatly facilitating the exchanges of both goods and people on both sides of the Yangtze River and playing a major role in the development of economy and the improvement of people's living condition.
sentences.zh: 南京长江大桥的建成标志着中国桥梁建设的一次巨大进步，极大地促进了长江两岸的物资交流和人员往来，并对经济发展和人民生活改善发挥了重要作用。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：The bridge（S）marks（V）a huge progress（O），后接两个并列的现在分词短语作结果状语。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：无从句。greatly facilitating the exchanges of both goods and people on both sides of the Yangtze River 为现在分词短语作结果状语；and playing a major role in the development of economy and the improvement of people's living condition 为第二个并列现在分词短语作结果状语。层次：主句→[结果状语 facilitating...]→[并列结果状语 playing...]。
③关键连接词/引导词：and 连接 facilitating 与 playing 两个并列现在分词短语；play a major role in 固定搭配「在……中发挥重要作用」。
④翻译要点：中文「标志着……的一次巨大进步」译 marks a huge progress in...；「极大地促进了……交流」译 greatly facilitating the exchanges of...；「对……发挥了巨大作用」译 playing a major role in...。
⑤易错点：两个现在分词短语逻辑主语均为 the bridge（桥的建成）；on both sides of the Yangtze River 译「长江两岸」；living condition 常用复数 conditions。
⑥断句版：The bridge marks a huge progress in China's bridge construction, | greatly facilitating the exchanges of both goods and people on both sides of the Yangtze River | and playing a major role in the development of economy and the improvement of people's living condition.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The bridge V:marks O:a huge progress [后置定语 in China's bridge construction]] [结果状语1 greatly facilitating the exchanges of both goods and people on both sides of the Yangtze River] [并列结果状语2 and playing a major role in [宾语 the development of economy and the improvement of people's living condition]]]
phrases: mark a huge progress　标志着巨大进步
facilitate the exchanges of　促进……的交流
on both sides of　在……两岸
play a major role in　在……中发挥重要作用
living condition　生活条件

sentences.en: Motor vehicles have become an integral part of people's lives: not only do they drive to work, they also go for self-driving travel a lot.
sentences.zh: 汽车已成为人们生活中不可或缺的一部分：他们不仅开车上下班，还经常驾车出游。
sentences.parse:
①句子主干：Motor vehicles（S）have become（V）an integral part of people's lives（C），冒号后为并列句解释说明。
②从句类型与嵌套层次：冒号后 not only...but also... 结构中 not only 置于句首引起部分倒装（do they drive）。层次：主句→冒号解释→[倒装分句 not only do they drive to work]→[并列分句 they also go for self-driving travel a lot]。
③关键连接词/引导词：not only...but also... 并列结构；not only 置于分句句首时助动词 do 提前构成部分倒装；integral 译「不可或缺的」。
④翻译要点：中文「汽车成了人们生活中不可或缺的一部分」译 Motor vehicles have become an integral part of people's lives；「不仅开车上下班，还经常驾车出游」译 not only do they drive to work, they also go for self-driving travel a lot。
⑤易错点：not only 置于句首时必须部分倒装（do they drive 而非 they drive）；self-driving travel 译「自驾出游」；integral 勿与 integer 混淆。
⑥断句版：Motor vehicles have become an integral part of people's lives: | not only do they drive to work, | they also go for self-driving travel a lot.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Motor vehicles V:have become C:an integral part of people's lives] [冒号解释 not only [倒装助动词 do + S:they + V:drive [状语 to work]], S:they [状语 also] V:go for O:self-driving travel a lot]]
phrases: integral part　不可或缺的部分
not only...but also...　不仅……而且……
部分倒装　partial inversion
self-driving travel　自驾出游
motor vehicles　机动车/汽车

sentences.en: Many famous Chinese painters and calligraphers prefer to have poems or paintings on the fans to demonstrate their artistic taste.
sentences.zh: 中国许多著名画家和书法家喜欢在扇子上题诗绘画，以展示其艺术品味。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】Many famous Chinese painters and calligraphers | prefer to have poems or paintings on the fans | to demonstrate their artistic taste.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：Many famous Chinese painters and calligraphers [S] prefer to have [V] poems or paintings [O] on the fans [地点状语] to demonstrate their artistic taste [目的状语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。谓语 prefer 后接不定式 to have sth.；on the fans 为介词短语作地点状语；句末 to demonstrate... 为不定式短语作目的状语。层次：主语（含两个并列名词 painters and calligraphers）→ 谓语 prefer to have → 宾语 poems or paintings → 地点状语 on the fans → 目的状语 to demonstrate...。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：prefer to do sth.（更喜欢做某事）；have poems or paintings on the fans（让人在扇上题诗作画，have 为使役义）；to demonstrate（不定式表目的，以展示）。
4. 翻译要点：prefer to have poems or paintings on the fans 不译更喜欢拥有，而译喜欢在扇子上题诗绘画；on the fans 地点状语前置融入中文动宾结构；句末 to demonstrate 目的状语译以展示。
5. 易错点：calligrapher 意为书法家（非书法本身）；prefer to have 中的 have 不是有而是使、让的使役含义；artistic taste 译艺术品味而非艺术味道。
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Many famous Chinese painters and calligraphers V:prefer to have O:poems or paintings A:on the fans [目的状语 to demonstrate O:their artistic taste]]]
phrases: calligrapher　书法家
prefer to do sth.　喜欢做某事
have poems or paintings on the fans　在扇上题诗作画
demonstrate artistic taste　展示艺术品味

sentences.en: The Chinese have a deep affection for bamboo, and since ancient times, numerous scholars have created colorful literature and paintings on the theme of bamboo.
sentences.zh: 中国人对竹子怀有深厚的感情，自古以来，众多文人以竹为题材创作了丰富多彩的文学作品和绘画。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The Chinese have a deep affection for bamboo, | and since ancient times, | numerous scholars have created colorful literature and paintings | on the theme of bamboo.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：并列句。分句1：The Chinese [S] have [V] a deep affection for bamboo [O]；分句2：numerous scholars [S] have created [V] colorful literature and paintings [O] on the theme of bamboo [后置定语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：and 连接两个并列分句。分句2中 since ancient times 为时间状语前置；on the theme of bamboo 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 literature and paintings。层次：分句1（主谓宾）→ and → 分句2（含时间状语+主谓宾+后置定语）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：and（并列连词）；since ancient times（时间状语，自古以来）；on the theme of（以……为题材）。
4. 翻译要点：have a deep affection for 译对……怀有深厚感情；since ancient times 前置译自古以来；numerous scholars 译众多文人；on the theme of bamboo 译以竹为题材作后置定语前置。
5. 易错点：affection 为不可数名词感情、喜爱，不译影响；scholar 此处译文人比学者更贴合竹文化语境；literature and paintings 译文学作品和绘画。
sentences.cut: [[分句1 S:The Chinese V:have O:a deep affection [定语 for bamboo]] [并列连词 and] [时间状语 since ancient times] 分句2 S:numerous scholars V:have created O:colorful literature and paintings [后置定语 on the theme of bamboo]]]
phrases: have a deep affection for　对……怀有深厚感情
since ancient times　自古以来
numerous scholars　众多文人
on the theme of　以……为题材
colorful literature and paintings　丰富多彩的文学与绘画

sentences.en: At the wedding ceremony, the couple should bow to Heaven and Earth, to their parents and to each other, and afterward hold a banquet to entertain and toast to the guests.
sentences.zh: 在婚礼上，新人要拜天地、拜父母、相互对拜，然后设宴招待宾客并向宾客敬酒致谢。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】At the wedding ceremony, | the couple should bow to Heaven and Earth, | to their parents and to each other, | and afterward hold a banquet to entertain and toast to the guests.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：the couple [S] 带两个并列谓语：should bow [V1] to Heaven and Earth, to their parents and to each other [三个并列介词宾语] and afterward hold [V2] a banquet [O] to entertain and toast to the guests [目的状语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。主语 the couple 共享两个谓语动词 bow 和 hold。bow 后接三个并列介词短语；hold 后接宾语 a banquet，再接不定式 to entertain and toast 作目的状语。层次：主语 → 谓语1 bow（三个并列介词宾语）→ 并列谓语2 hold（宾语+目的状语）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：and（连接两个并列谓语 bow and hold）；afterward（副词，然后）；to entertain and toast（不定式表目的）。
4. 翻译要点：bow to Heaven and Earth 为固定译法拜天地；三个 to 并列介词宾语按中文动宾排比译拜天地、拜父母、相互对拜；hold a banquet 译设宴；toast to the guests 译向宾客敬酒。
5. 易错点：couple 此处指新人而非泛指夫妻；bow to each other 译相互对拜不可漏译；toast 此处为动词敬酒，不译名词烤面包。
sentences.cut: [[状语 At the wedding ceremony] S:the couple V1:should bow [介词宾语 to Heaven and Earth] [介词宾语 to their parents] [介词宾语 to each other] [并列连词 and afterward] V2:hold O:a banquet [目的状语 to entertain and toast to the guests]]]
phrases: bow to Heaven and Earth　拜天地
hold a banquet　设宴
entertain the guests　招待宾客
toast to the guests　向宾客敬酒
afterward　然后

sentences.en: The BeiDou system has attracted worldwide attention and has begun to provide high-quality services to an increasing number of countries and regions.
sentences.zh: 北斗系统在世界上受到了广泛关注，并已开始为越来越多的国家和地区提供优质服务。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The BeiDou system | has attracted worldwide attention | and has begun to provide high-quality services | to an increasing number of countries and regions.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The BeiDou system [S] 带两个并列谓语：has attracted [V1] worldwide attention [O1] and has begun to provide [V2] high-quality services [O2] to an increasing number of countries and regions [状语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。主语共享两个现在完成时谓语 has attracted 和 has begun。provide sth. to sb. 结构中 to an increasing number of... 为介词短语作对象状语。层次：主语 → 谓语1 has attracted（宾语 worldwide attention）→ and → 谓语2 has begun to provide（宾语 high-quality services + 对象状语 to...）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：and（连接两个并列谓语，均为现在完成时）；has begun to do（已开始做某事）；an increasing number of（越来越多的）。
4. 翻译要点：has attracted worldwide attention 译在世界上受到广泛关注；has begun to provide 译已开始提供；provide services to... 译为……提供服务；an increasing number of 译越来越多的。
5. 易错点：attract attention 为吸引关注不译吸引注意力；high-quality services 译优质服务；注意两个谓语时态一致（现在完成时），不可只译一个。
sentences.cut: [[S:The BeiDou system V1:has attracted O1:worldwide attention [并列连词 and] V2:has begun to provide O2:high-quality services A:to an increasing number of countries and regions]]
phrases: attract worldwide attention　受到世界广泛关注
high-quality services　优质服务
an increasing number of　越来越多的
provide services to　为……提供服务

sentences.en: In 2003, the successful launch of Shenzhou V made Yang Liwei the first Chinese astronaut to travel into space.
sentences.zh: 2003年，神舟五号发射成功，杨利伟成为了第一位飞入太空的中国宇航员。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】In 2003, | the successful launch of Shenzhou V | made Yang Liwei | the first Chinese astronaut | to travel into space.
【五要素】
