1. 句子主干：the successful launch of Shenzhou V [S] made [V] Yang Liwei [宾语] the first Chinese astronaut [宾语补足语] to travel into space [后置定语修饰 astronaut]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。使用 make + 宾语 + 宾补（make sb. + 名词短语）结构。to travel into space 为不定式作后置定语修饰 the first Chinese astronaut。层次：时间状语 In 2003 → 主语（含 of 后置定语）→ 谓语 made → 宾语 Yang Liwei → 宾补 the first Chinese astronaut → 不定式后置定语 to travel into space。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：make sb. + n.（使某人成为……）；the first ... to do sth.（第一个做某事的……，不定式作后置定语）。
4. 翻译要点：the successful launch 译发射成功（名词转动词）；made Yang Liwei the first... 译杨利伟成为了第一位……；to travel into space 后置定语译飞入太空的前置修饰宇航员；In 2003 译句首2003年。
5. 易错点：launch 此处为名词发射而非动词；make 后接复合宾语（宾语+宾补），不可漏译宾补；the first...to do 结构中不定式不可省略 to；Shenzhou V 用罗马数字 V。
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In 2003] S:the successful launch [后置定语 of Shenzhou V] V:made O:Yang Liwei C:the first Chinese astronaut [后置定语 to travel into space]]]
phrases: the successful launch of　……发射成功
make sb. the first ... to do sth.　使某人成为第一个做某事的……
travel into space　飞入太空
astronaut　宇航员

sentences.en: The use of digital technology and artificial intelligence has significantly reduced labor costs and carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 数字技术和人工智能的使用大大减少了用工成本和碳排放。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The use of digital technology and artificial intelligence | has significantly reduced labor costs and carbon emissions.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The use of digital technology and artificial intelligence [S] has significantly reduced [V] labor costs and carbon emissions [并列宾语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。主语核心为 The use，后接 of 介词短语作后置定语（含两个并列宾语 digital technology and artificial intelligence）。谓语为现在完成时 has reduced。宾语为两个并列名词短语 labor costs 和 carbon emissions。层次：主语（核心 use + of 后置定语含并列名词）→ 副词 significantly → 谓语 has reduced → 并列宾语。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：of（介词，use of... 后置定语）；and（连接两个并列宾语 digital technology and artificial intelligence / labor costs and carbon emissions）。
4. 翻译要点：The use of... 译……的使用；has significantly reduced 译大大减少了；labor costs 译用工成本；carbon emissions 译碳排放。
5. 易错点：use 此处为名词使用而非动词；artificial intelligence 缩写 AI 但全称须拼出；carbon emissions 中 emissions 用复数表泛指；注意现在完成时 has reduced 强调已产生的结果。
sentences.cut: [[S:The use [后置定语 of digital technology and artificial intelligence]] [副词 significantly] V:has reduced O1:labor costs O2:carbon emissions]]
phrases: the use of digital technology　数字技术的使用
artificial intelligence　人工智能
labor costs　用工成本
carbon emissions　碳排放
significantly reduce　大大减少

sentences.en: This not only signifies China's substantial advancements in aerospace technology but also highlights its significant contributions to global space research and applications.
sentences.zh: 这不仅标志着中国在航天技术上取得了巨大进步，也表明中国为全球的太空研究和应用做出了重大贡献。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】This | not only signifies China's substantial advancements in aerospace technology | but also highlights its significant contributions | to global space research and applications.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：This [S] 带两个并列谓语：not only signifies [V1] China's substantial advancements in aerospace technology [O1] but also highlights [V2] its significant contributions [O2] to global space research and applications [后置定语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。使用 not only...but also... 并列结构连接两个谓语动词 signifies 和 highlights。O1 中 in aerospace technology 为介词短语作后置定语；O2 中 to global space research and applications 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 contributions。层次：主语 This → not only 谓语1 signifies（宾语 advancements + in 后置定语）→ but also 谓语2 highlights（宾语 contributions + to 后置定语）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：not only...but also...（并列连词结构，不仅……也……）；signifies（标志着）；highlights（表明/凸显）；contributions to（对……的贡献）。
4. 翻译要点：not only...but also 对称译不仅……也……；signifies advancements 译标志着……取得进步；highlights contributions 译表明……做出贡献；in aerospace technology 译在航天技术上；to global space research and applications 译为全球太空研究和应用。
5. 易错点：substantial advancements 译巨大进步不译实质进步；contributions to 中 to 为介词后接名词；its 回指 China's；not only 和 but also 后须接平行结构。
sentences.cut: [[S:This [关联词 not only] V1:signifies O1:China's substantial advancements [后置定语 in aerospace technology] [关联词 but also] V2:highlights O2:its significant contributions [后置定语 to global space research and applications]]]
phrases: not only...but also...　不仅……也……
signify advancements　标志着进步
aerospace technology　航天技术
contributions to　对……的贡献
space research and applications　太空研究与应用

sentences.en: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) boasts a superior geographical location, comprehensive transportation infrastructure, and abundant industrial resources.
sentences.zh: 粤港澳大湾区（GBA）拥有得天独厚的地理位置、完善的交通基础设施和丰富的产业资源。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) | boasts a superior geographical location, | comprehensive transportation infrastructure, | and abundant industrial resources.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) [S] boasts [V] 三个并列宾语：a superior geographical location [O1], comprehensive transportation infrastructure [O2], and abundant industrial resources [O3]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。主语为长专有名词（含括号缩写 GBA），谓语为及物动词 boasts，后接三项并列名词短语作宾语。层次：主语（长专名+缩写）→ 谓语 boasts → 三项并列宾语。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：boasts（动词，拥有，褒义）；and（连接最后一项并列宾语）；括号 GBA 为主语缩写，后文可简称。
4. 翻译要点：boasts 译拥有（褒义，不译吹嘘）；superior geographical location 译得天独厚的地理位置；comprehensive transportation infrastructure 译完善的交通基础设施；abundant industrial resources 译丰富的产业资源；三个并列宾语按中文偏正结构排列。
5. 易错点：boast 此处为褒义动词拥有，不可译为吹嘘；Greater Bay Area 为固定译法大湾区；infrastructure 不可数名词无复数；三个宾语并列注意词性一致。
sentences.cut: [[S:The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) V:boasts O1:a superior geographical location O2:comprehensive transportation infrastructure O3:and abundant industrial resources]]
phrases: boast　拥有（褒义）
superior geographical location　得天独厚的地理位置
transportation infrastructure　交通基础设施
abundant industrial resources　丰富的产业资源

sentences.en: The government has also introduced a series of policies to strongly protect the rights and interests of the elderly.
sentences.zh: 政府还出台了一系列政策，以切实保障老年人的权益。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The government has also introduced a series of policies | to strongly protect the rights and interests of the elderly.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The government [S] has also introduced [V] a series of policies [O] to strongly protect the rights and interests of the elderly [目的状语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。谓语为现在完成时 has introduced。to strongly protect... 为不定式短语作目的状语，其中 strongly 为副词修饰 protect；the rights and interests of the elderly 中 of the elderly 为介词短语作后置定语。层次：主语 → 谓语 has introduced（宾语 a series of policies）→ 目的状语 to protect（宾语 the rights and interests + of 后置定语）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：has introduced（现在完成时，已出台）；a series of（一系列）；to protect（不定式表目的，以保障）；rights and interests（固定搭配权益）。
4. 翻译要点：introduced 译出台（政策类搭配，不译介绍）；a series of policies 译一系列政策；to strongly protect 译以切实保障；rights and interests of the elderly 译老年人的权益。
5. 易错点：introduce 与 policies 搭配译出台政策而非介绍政策；rights and interests 为固定搭配权益不可拆开译；strongly 译切实比强烈地更贴合政策语境。
sentences.cut: [[S:The government [副词 also] V:has introduced O:a series of policies [目的状语 to strongly protect O:the rights and interests [后置定语 of the elderly]]]]
phrases: introduce policies　出台政策
a series of　一系列
protect the rights and interests　保障权益
the elderly　老年人

sentences.en: In recent years, the Chinese government has been stepping up efforts to build a resource-conserving society: it advocates the Clean Plate Campaign to cut food waste, promotes a simple and low-carbon lifestyle, advances resource recycling, and opposes over-consumption.
sentences.zh: 近年来，中国政府不断加大建设资源节约型社会的力度：倡导光盘行动以减少食物浪费，倡导简约低碳的生活方式，推进资源循环利用，反对过度消费。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】In recent years, | the Chinese government has been stepping up efforts to build a resource-conserving society: | it advocates the Clean Plate Campaign to cut food waste, | promotes a simple and low-carbon lifestyle, | advances resource recycling, | and opposes over-consumption.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The Chinese government [S1] has been stepping up efforts [V1] to build a resource-conserving society [目的状语]。冒号后为并列说明分句，主语 it（=the government）带四个并列谓语：advocates [V2] / promotes [V3] / advances [V4] / opposes [V5]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：冒号前后为总分关系。冒号后四个谓语动词并列（advocates... promotes... advances... and opposes...），共享主语 it。to cut food waste 为不定式作目的状语修饰 advocates。层次：主句（政府加大力度建设节约型社会）→ 冒号 → 并列分句1 advocates（+目的状语）→ 并列谓语 promotes → advances → and opposes。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：has been stepping up（现在完成进行时，一直在加大）；冒号引出并列说明；and（连接最后一个并列谓语 opposes）；to cut（不定式表目的）。
4. 翻译要点：has been stepping up efforts to build 译不断加大建设……的力度；resource-conserving society 译资源节约型社会；冒号后四个并列动词按中文排比译倡导……倡导……推进……反对……；Clean Plate Campaign 为固定译法光盘行动；low-carbon lifestyle 译低碳生活方式。
5. 易错点：step up efforts 为固定搭配加大力度；冒号后四个并列动词须时态一致（一般现在时）；over-consumption 译过度消费；it 回指 government 不译它而译政府。
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In recent years] S1:the Chinese government V1:has been stepping up O:efforts [目的状语 to build O:a resource-conserving society] [冒号引出并列说明] S2:it V2:advocates O:the Clean Plate Campaign [目的状语 to cut food waste] V3:promotes O:a simple and low-carbon lifestyle V4:advances O:resource recycling V5:and opposes O:over-consumption]]
phrases: step up efforts to do　加大力度做某事
resource-conserving society　资源节约型社会
Clean Plate Campaign　光盘行动
low-carbon lifestyle　低碳生活方式
resource recycling　资源循环利用
over-consumption　过度消费

sentences.en: The nationwide coverage of 5G networks, advances in telemedicine, and the Chang'e lunar exploration program all demonstrate remarkable progress in aerospace and technology.
sentences.zh: 全国5G网络的覆盖、远程医疗的发展以及嫦娥探月工程，都展现了航天领域引人注目的进步。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The nationwide coverage of 5G networks, | advances in telemedicine, | and the Chang'e lunar exploration program | all demonstrate remarkable progress in aerospace and technology.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：三个并列名词短语作主语（The nationwide coverage of 5G networks / advances in telemedicine / the Chang'e lunar exploration program）+ all [同位语] demonstrate [V] remarkable progress in aerospace and technology [O]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。主语由三个并列名词短语构成，each 含 of/in 后置定语。all 为代词作主语同位语，强调三者都。谓语 demonstrate 后接宾语 remarkable progress，in aerospace and technology 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 progress。层次：并列主语1（coverage + of 后置定语）+ 并列主语2（advances + in 后置定语）+ 并列主语3（Chang'e...program）→ all demonstrate → 宾语 remarkable progress（+ in 后置定语）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：and（连接第三个并列主语）；all（主语同位语，都）；demonstrate（动词，展现）；in aerospace and technology（后置定语，在航天技术领域）。
4. 翻译要点：三个并列主语按中文并列结构译……的覆盖、……的发展以及……；nationwide coverage 译全国覆盖；advances in telemedicine 译远程医疗的发展；Chang'e lunar exploration program 译嫦娥探月工程；all demonstrate remarkable progress 译都展现了引人注目的进步。
5. 易错点：三个并列主语均为名词短语（不可混入从句）；all 置于主语后谓语前表强调；lunar exploration 为探月固定搭配；demonstrate 此处为展现不译演示。
sentences.cut: [[并列主语1 S1:The nationwide coverage [后置定语 of 5G networks]] [并列 S2:advances [后置定语 in telemedicine]] [并列连词 and] S3:the Chang'e lunar exploration program [同位语 all] V:demonstrate O:remarkable progress [后置定语 in aerospace and technology]]]
phrases: nationwide coverage　全国覆盖
telemedicine　远程医疗
lunar exploration program　探月工程
demonstrate remarkable progress　展现引人注目的进步
aerospace and technology　航天与技术

sentences.en: Drones have been included by the state in strategic emerging industries, and are gradually becoming intelligent assistants that can meet the needs of various scenarios.
sentences.zh: 无人机已被国家纳入战略性新兴产业，正逐步成为能够满足多种场景需求的智能助手。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】Drones have been included by the state in strategic emerging industries, | and are gradually becoming intelligent assistants | that can meet the needs of various scenarios.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：Drones [S] 带两个并列谓语：have been included by the state in strategic emerging industries [被动谓语1] and are gradually becoming [进行时谓语2] intelligent assistants [表语]。that can meet the needs of various scenarios 为定语从句修饰 assistants。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：and 连接两个并列谓语（被动语态+进行时）。句末 that 引导限制性定语从句修饰 intelligent assistants，从句主语 that (=assistants) + 谓语 can meet + 宾语 the needs of various scenarios。层次：主语 Drones → 并列谓语1 have been included（被动，by the state 施事，in... 状语）→ and → 并列谓语2 are becoming（表语 assistants）→ 定语从句 that can meet...。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：and（连接两个并列谓语）；that（关系代词引导定语从句，指代 assistants）；have been included（现在完成时被动）；are becoming（现在进行时表趋势）。
4. 翻译要点：have been included by the state in 译已被国家纳入；strategic emerging industries 译战略性新兴产业（政策固定表述）；are gradually becoming 译正逐步成为；that can meet... 定语从句前置译能够满足……需求的智能助手；various scenarios 译多种场景需求。
5. 易错点：have been included 为现在完成时被动，不可漏译已；strategic emerging industries 为政策术语不可自造译法；that 指代 assistants（复数），从句谓语用 can meet 复数；scenario 译场景不译剧本。
sentences.cut: [[S:Drones V1:have been included [被动 by the state] A:in strategic emerging industries [并列连词 and] V2:are gradually becoming C:intelligent assistants [定语从句 S:that(=assistants) V:can meet O:the needs [后置定语 of various scenarios]]]]
phrases: be included in　被纳入
strategic emerging industries　战略性新兴产业
intelligent assistants　智能助手
meet the needs of various scenarios　满足多种场景需求
gradually become　逐步成为

sentences.en: The deep integration of the digital economy and rural revitalization is injecting unprecedented vitality into the development of rural China.
sentences.zh: 数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合，正在为中国农村的发展注入前所未有的活力。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】The deep integration of the digital economy and rural revitalization | is injecting unprecedented vitality | into the development of rural China.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：The deep integration of the digital economy and rural revitalization [S] is injecting [V 现在进行时] unprecedented vitality [O] into the development of rural China [状语]。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。主语核心为 The deep integration，后接 of 介词短语作后置定语（含两个并列宾语 the digital economy and rural revitalization）。inject sth. into sth. 为固定搭配，into... 为方向状语。层次：主语（核心 integration + of 后置定语含并列名词）→ 谓语 is injecting → 宾语 unprecedented vitality → into 方向状语（the development of rural China）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：of（介词，integration of... 后置定语）；and（连接 the digital economy and rural revitalization）；inject...into...（固定搭配为……注入……）。
4. 翻译要点：The deep integration of... 译……的深度融合；is injecting 译正在为……注入；unprecedented vitality 译前所未有的活力；into the development of rural China 译为中国农村的发展。
5. 易错点：integration 译融合不译整合；rural revitalization 为政策术语乡村振兴；unprecedented 译前所未有的；inject...into... 介词 into 不可改为 in；注意现在进行时 is injecting 表正在。
sentences.cut: [[S:The deep integration [后置定语 of the digital economy and rural revitalization]] V:is injecting O:unprecedented vitality A:into the development of rural China]]
phrases: deep integration　深度融合
digital economy　数字经济
rural revitalization　乡村振兴
inject...into...　为……注入……
unprecedented vitality　前所未有的活力

sentences.en: With the development of economy and society, there has been a significant change in the population structure in China, gradually transitioning into an aging society.
sentences.zh: 随着经济与社会的发展，中国人口结构发生了显著变化，正逐渐步入老龄化社会。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】With the development of economy and society, | there has been a significant change in the population structure in China, | gradually transitioning into an aging society.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：there has been [there be 存在句型谓语] a significant change [真正主语] in the population structure in China [定语]，句末 gradually transitioning into an aging society 为现在分词短语作结果/伴随状语。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句无从句。With... 介词短语作句首状语。there has been 为现在完成时存在句，主语为 a significant change。in the population structure in China 为介词短语作后置定语。gradually transitioning... 现在分词短语作结果状语，逻辑主语为 China。层次：With 状语 → there has been（主语 a significant change）→ in 后置定语 → 现在分词结果状语 transitioning into...。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：With（介词，随着）；there has been（there be 的现在完成时）；gradually transitioning（现在分词作结果状语）。
4. 翻译要点：With the development of 译随着……的发展；there has been a significant change 译发生了显著变化；in the population structure 译人口结构；gradually transitioning into 译正逐渐步入；aging society 译老龄化社会。
5. 易错点：there be 句型译中文时转为发生了，不可直译为有；transition into 译步入不译过渡；现在分词 transitioning 的逻辑主语是 China；aging society 中 aging 为形容词老龄化的。
sentences.cut: [[状语 With the development of economy and society] [[主句 there be 结构] V:there has been S:a significant change [后置定语 in the population structure in China]] [结果状语 gradually transitioning into O:an aging society]]]
phrases: with the development of　随着……的发展
there has been　已经发生
population structure　人口结构
transition into　步入
aging society　老龄化社会

sentences.en: In China, with the arrival of an aging society, elderly care has drawn widespread attention.
sentences.zh: 在中国，随着老龄化社会的到来，养老问题已引起广泛关注。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】In China, | with the arrival of an aging society, | elderly care has drawn widespread attention.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：elderly care [S] has drawn [V 现在完成时] widespread attention [O]。句首 In China 为地点状语，with the arrival of an aging society 为介词短语作伴随状语。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。with the arrival of... 为 with 复合结构作状语，其中 of an aging society 为介词短语作后置定语。层次：地点状语 In China → with 伴随状语（the arrival + of 后置定语）→ 主句 elderly care has drawn widespread attention。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：with（介词，随着）；has drawn（现在完成时，已引起）；the arrival of（……的到来）。
4. 翻译要点：In China 译在中国；with the arrival of 译随着……的到来；aging society 译老龄化社会；elderly care 译养老（问题）；has drawn widespread attention 译已引起广泛关注。
5. 易错点：elderly care 为名词短语养老事宜，不译老人照顾；draw attention 为固定搭配引起关注；widespread 译广泛的；with 此处为介词后接名词 arrival（非句子）。
sentences.cut: [[地点状语 In China] [伴随状语 with the arrival [后置定语 of an aging society]] S:elderly care V:has drawn O:widespread attention]]
phrases: with the arrival of　随着……的到来
aging society　老龄化社会
elderly care　养老
draw widespread attention　引起广泛关注

sentences.en: In order to improve the service quality of elderly care institutions, the government has issued a series of standards to strengthen the supervision of elderly care institutions.
sentences.zh: 为提升养老机构的服务质量，政府颁布了一系列标准，以加强对养老机构的监管。
sentences.parse:
【断句版】In order to improve the service quality of elderly care institutions, | the government has issued a series of standards | to strengthen the supervision of elderly care institutions.
【五要素】
1. 句子主干：the government [S] has issued [V 现在完成时] a series of standards [O]。句首 In order to improve... 为不定式短语作目的状语，句末 to strengthen... 为不定式短语作目的状语。
2. 从句类型与嵌套层次：全句为简单句，无从句。句首 In order to improve the service quality of elderly care institutions 中 of elderly care institutions 为后置定语。句末 to strengthen the supervision of elderly care institutions 中 of elderly care institutions 同样为后置定语。两个不定式目的状语分别置于句首和句末。层次：句首目的状语（improve + 宾语 service quality + of 后置定语）→ 主句 the government has issued（宾语 standards）→ 句末目的状语（strengthen + 宾语 supervision + of 后置定语）。
3. 关键连接词/引导词：In order to（不定式短语，为了）；has issued（现在完成时，已颁布）；a series of（一系列）；to strengthen（不定式表目的，以加强）。
4. 翻译要点：In order to improve 译为提升；service quality of elderly care institutions 译养老机构的服务质量；has issued a series of standards 译颁布了一系列标准；to strengthen the supervision 译以加强监管。
5. 易错点：issue 此处为颁布（标准）不译发行；supervision 译监管不译监督（政策语境用监管更准）；两处 elderly care institutions 重复出现，中文可适当简化但不可漏译；In order to 与 to 两个目的状语须分别译出。
sentences.cut: [[句首目的状语 In order to improve O:the service quality [后置定语 of elderly care institutions]] S:the government V:has issued O:a series of standards [句末目的状语 to strengthen O:the supervision [后置定语 of elderly care institutions]]]]
phrases: in order to improve　为提升
service quality　服务质量
elderly care institutions　养老机构
issue a series of standards　颁布一系列标准
strengthen the supervision　加强监管

sentences.en: Chinese universities and research institutes are actively carrying out innovative research, covering various high-tech fields ranging from big data to biochemistry and from new energy to robotics.
sentences.zh: 中国的大学和研究所正在积极开展创新研究，这些研究覆盖了从大数据到生物化学、从新能源到机器人等各类高科技领域。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:Chinese universities and research institutes V:are carrying out O:innovative research；后接现在分词 covering… 作后置定语修饰 research。【从句类型与嵌套】现在分词短语 covering various high-tech fields [ranging from A to B and from C to D] 内部嵌套 ranging from…to… 介词短语作后置定语修饰 fields；无从句。【关键连接词】现在分词 covering 表主动伴随；ranging from…to… 表范围列举。【翻译要点】中文用逗号连接两个分句，英文用现在分词短语合并为一句，避免重复 research；「从大数据到生物化学、从新能源到机器人」用 ranging from big data to biochemistry and from new energy to robotics 对仗。【易错点】「机器人」作学科领域译 robotics 而非 robots；「研究所」research institutes 不用 labs。【断句版】Chinese universities and research institutes are actively carrying out innovative research | covering various high-tech fields | ranging from big data to biochemistry | and from new energy to robotics.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Chinese universities and research institutes V:are actively carrying out O:innovative research [后置定语 covering various high-tech fields [后置定语 ranging from big data to biochemistry and from new energy to robotics]]]]
phrases: research institutes　研究所
innovative research　创新研究
high-tech fields　高科技领域
range from A to B　从A到B不等
biochemistry　生物化学
robotics　机器人学（领域）

sentences.en: In the 1980s, the Chinese government established the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone as a testing ground for implementing the socialist market economy.
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代，中国政府创立了深圳经济特区，作为实施社会主义市场经济的试验田。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:the Chinese government V:established O:the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone；后接 as 介词短语作主语补足语。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；as a testing ground [for implementing the socialist market economy] 嵌套动名词短语作目的定语。【关键连接词】as 表「作为」；for implementing 表用途。【翻译要点】中文「20世纪80年代」译 In the 1980s（加 the 与 s）；「试验田」意译 testing ground，不直译 seed plot；「实施社会主义市场经济」implementing the socialist market economy。【易错点】经济特区 Special Economic Zone 首字母大写；「试验田」不可译作 experimental field of seed。【断句版】In the 1980s, | the Chinese government established the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone | as a testing ground | for implementing the socialist market economy.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In the 1980s, [主句 S:the Chinese government V:established O:the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone [状语 as a testing ground [定语 for implementing the socialist market economy]]]]]
phrases: Special Economic Zone (SEZ)　经济特区
testing ground　试验田
implement the socialist market economy　实施社会主义市场经济

sentences.en: Chinese people not only travel within China, but traveling abroad is also becoming increasingly common.
sentences.zh: 中国人不仅在国内旅游，出国旅游也越来越普遍。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】并列句：分句1 S:Chinese people V:travel A:within China；分句2 S:traveling abroad V:is becoming C:increasingly common。【从句类型与嵌套】not only…but also… 并列结构，but also 后用动名词 travel abroad 作主语避免重复。【关键连接词】not only…but also… 表递进；increasingly 修饰 common。【翻译要点】中文「出国旅游也越来越普遍」主语转换为 traveling abroad is also becoming increasingly common；「国内旅游」travel within China。【易错点】not only 置于主语后不倒装；「越来越普遍」increasingly common。【断句版】Chinese people not only travel within China, | but traveling abroad is also becoming increasingly common.
sentences.cut: [[并列分句1 S:Chinese people V:not only travel A:within China, [并列分句2 S:traveling abroad V:is also becoming C:increasingly common]]]
phrases: not only…but also…　不仅……而且……
travel within China　在国内旅游
travel abroad　出国旅游
increasingly common　越来越普遍

sentences.en: China's history of rice cultivation dates back to as early as 7700 BC.
sentences.zh: 中国种植水稻的历史可以追溯到公元前7700年。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:China's history of rice cultivation V:dates back to O:as early as 7700 BC。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；of rice cultivation 介词短语作后置定语修饰 history。【关键连接词】date back to / date from 表「追溯到」。【翻译要点】中文「种植水稻的历史」译 China's history of rice cultivation；「公元前7700年」7700 BC，加 as early as 强调早。【易错点】date back to 不用于被动；「水稻」rice / paddy rice，栽培用 cultivation；「公元前」BC。【断句版】China's history of rice cultivation | dates back to as early as 7700 BC.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:China's history [定语 of rice cultivation] V:dates back to A:as early as 7700 BC]]
phrases: rice cultivation　水稻种植
date back to　追溯到
as early as　早在
7700 BC　公元前7700年

sentences.en: During the Song Dynasty, China was the first country to issue paper currency in world history.
sentences.zh: 宋代中国是世界历史上首先发行纸币的国家。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:China V:was C:the first country [to issue paper currency in world history]；不定式短语作后置定语。【从句类型与嵌套】the first/second/last 后接不定式 to do 作定语；无从句。【关键连接词】the first country to issue… 不定式表次序。【翻译要点】中文「首先发行纸币的国家」译 the first country to issue paper currency；「纸币」paper currency / banknote；「宋代」during the Song Dynasty 作时间状语。【易错点】the first 后接 to do 而非 doing；「纸币」paper currency 比 paper money 正式。【断句版】During the Song Dynasty, | China was the first country | to issue paper currency in world history.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 During the Song Dynasty, [主句 S:China V:was C:the first country [定语 to issue paper currency in world history]]]]
phrases: the first country to do sth.　第一个做某事的国家
issue paper currency　发行纸币
in world history　在世界历史上
Song Dynasty　宋代

sentences.en: Dongting Lake lies in the northeast of Hunan Province, with a large area but shallow water.
sentences.zh: 洞庭湖位于湖南省东北部，面积很大，但湖水很浅。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:Dongting Lake V:lies A:in the northeast of Hunan Province；后接 with 复合结构 [with a large area but shallow water] 作伴随状语。【从句类型与嵌套】with 独立主格（with + 名词 + 形容词）作状语；but 连接并列名词短语。【关键连接词】with 表伴随；but 表转折。【翻译要点】中文逗号连接三个分句，英文用 with 复合结构合并；「面积很大，但湖水很浅」with a large area but (with) shallow water。【易错点】「东北部」northeast 加 the；「浅」shallow 不用 thin。【断句版】Dongting Lake lies in the northeast of Hunan Province, | with a large area | but shallow water.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Dongting Lake V:lies A:in the northeast of Hunan Province, [伴随状语 with a large area but shallow water]]]
phrases: lie in　位于
the northeast of Hunan Province　湖南省东北部
with a large area　面积很大
shallow water　水很浅

sentences.en: Taihu Lake is famous for its unique Taihu stones, which are often used to decorate traditional Chinese gardens.
sentences.zh: 太湖以其独特的「太湖石」而闻名，太湖石常用于装饰中国传统园林。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:Taihu Lake V:is famous for O:its unique Taihu stones；后接非限制性定语从句 which are often used to decorate traditional Chinese gardens。【从句类型与嵌套】主句→非限制性定语从句（which 指代 Taihu stones）→被动语态 are used to do。【关键连接词】which 引导非限制性定语从句；be used to do 表「被用于」。【翻译要点】中文重复「太湖石」，英文用 which 引导定语从句避免重复；「以……而闻名」is famous for；「中国传统园林」traditional Chinese gardens。【易错点】太湖石是「被用于」装饰，必须用被动 are used to decorate；「园林」gardens / classical gardens 不直译 parks。【断句版】Taihu Lake is famous for its unique Taihu stones, | which are often used to decorate traditional Chinese gardens.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Taihu Lake V:is famous for O:its unique Taihu stones [非限制性定语从句 S:which V:are often used C:to decorate traditional Chinese gardens]]]
phrases: be famous for　以……而闻名
Taihu stones　太湖石
be used to do sth.　被用于做某事
decorate traditional Chinese gardens　装饰中国传统园林

sentences.en: Large public libraries not only provide a wide variety of reference materials, but also regularly hold activities such as lectures and exhibitions.
sentences.zh: 大型公共图书馆不仅提供种类繁多的参考资料，而且定期举办讲座、展览等活动。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】并列谓语：S:Large public libraries V1:not only provide O1:a wide variety of reference materials；V2:but also regularly hold O2:activities such as lectures and exhibitions。【从句类型与嵌套】not only…but also… 连接两个并列谓语共用主语；such as 引导举例。【关键连接词】not only…but also… 连接并列谓语；such as 表举例。【翻译要点】「种类繁多」a wide variety of；「定期举办」regularly hold；「讲座、展览等活动」activities such as lectures and exhibitions。【易错点】not only…but also… 连接谓语时不倒装；「参考资料」reference materials。【断句版】Large public libraries not only provide a wide variety of reference materials, | but also regularly hold activities | such as lectures and exhibitions.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Large public libraries [并列谓语1 V:not only provide O:a wide variety of reference materials] [并列谓语2 V:but also regularly hold O:activities [定语 such as lectures and exhibitions]]]]
phrases: not only…but also…　不仅……而且……
a wide variety of　种类繁多的
reference materials　参考资料
hold lectures and exhibitions　举办讲座和展览

sentences.en: With the support of government funding, more and more gymnasiums are open to the public for free or for a small fee.
sentences.zh: 在政府资金的支持下，越来越多的体育馆免费或低收费向公众开放。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:more and more gymnasiums V:are open A:to the public [for free or for a small fee]；句首 With 介词短语作状语。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；for free or for a small fee 并列介词短语作方式状语。【关键连接词】With 表「在……支持下」；or 表选择。【翻译要点】「在政府资金的支持下」With the support of government funding；「免费或低收费」for free or for a small fee；「向公众开放」are open to the public。【易错点】「体育馆」公共健身馆用 gymnasium；「低收费」a small fee 不用 cheap fee；「开放」be open to。【断句版】With the support of government funding, | more and more gymnasiums are open to the public | for free or for a small fee.
sentences.cut: [[状语 With the support of government funding, [主句 S:more and more gymnasiums V:are open A:to the public [方式状语 for free or for a small fee]]]]
phrases: with the support of　在……的支持下
government funding　政府资金
be open to the public　向公众开放
for free　免费
for a small fee　低收费

sentences.en: Chinese has played an important role in uniting the Chinese nation throughout history.
sentences.zh: 汉语历史上对团结中华民族发挥了重要作用。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:Chinese V:has played O:an important role A:in uniting the Chinese nation [throughout history]。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；in uniting the Chinese nation 介词短语作状语，uniting 为动名词。【关键连接词】play an important role in… 表「在……中发挥重要作用」。【翻译要点】「发挥了重要作用」has played an important role（完成时表历史延续）；「团结中华民族」in uniting the Chinese nation；「历史上」throughout history。【易错点】「发挥作用」play a role / play a part，不用 act；「中华民族」the Chinese nation 加 the。【断句版】Chinese has played an important role | in uniting the Chinese nation | throughout history.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Chinese V:has played O:an important role [状语 in uniting the Chinese nation [时间状语 throughout history]]]]
phrases: play an important role in　在……中发挥重要作用
unite the Chinese nation　团结中华民族
throughout history　在整个历史上

sentences.en: Dialects are considered a component of the local culture, but the number of people who can speak dialects is declining.
sentences.zh: 方言被认为是当地文化的一个组成部分，但能说方言的人数正在减少。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】并列复合句：分句1 S:Dialects V:are considered C:a component of the local culture；分句2 S:the number of people [who can speak dialects] V:is declining。【从句类型与嵌套】分句1为被动语态；分句2中 who can speak dialects 为限制性定语从句修饰 people；but 连接并列分句。【关键连接词】but 表转折；who 引导定语从句。【翻译要点】「被认为是」are considered (to be)，省略 to be；「一个组成部分」a component of；「能说方言的人数」the number of people who can speak dialects；「正在减少」is declining。【易错点】the number of 作主语谓语用单数 is；「方言」dialects 用复数；「减少」decline / decrease 不用 reduce。【断句版】Dialects are considered a component of the local culture, | but the number of people | who can speak dialects is declining.
sentences.cut: [[分句1 S:Dialects V:are considered C:a component of the local culture [连词 but] [分句2 S:the number of people [定语从句 who can speak dialects] V:is declining]]]
phrases: be considered (to be)　被认为是
a component of　……的一个组成部分
the number of people who…　……的人数
decline　减少/下降

sentences.en: The lotus has multiple functions: it can green the water surface, beautify gardens, purify water, reduce pollution and improve the environment.
sentences.zh: 荷花具有多种功能，既能绿化水面，又能美化庭园，还可净化水质，减少污染、改善环境。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:The lotus V:has O:multiple functions；后接 it can green…, beautify…, purify…, reduce…, improve… 并列谓语列举功能。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；多个动词原形并列作 can 的谓语。【关键连接词】多个并列功能用平行结构。【翻译要点】「绿化水面」green the water surface；「美化庭园」beautify gardens；「净化水质」purify water；「减少污染、改善环境」reduce pollution and improve the environment。【易错点】「荷花」lotus 不可数；「净化水质」purify water 不说 purify water quality。【断句版】The lotus has multiple functions: | it can green the water surface, | beautify gardens, | purify water, | reduce pollution | and improve the environment.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The lotus V:has O:multiple functions [列举 it can green the water surface, beautify gardens, purify water, reduce pollution and improve the environment]]]
phrases: multiple functions　多种功能
green the water surface　绿化水面
beautify gardens　美化庭园
purify water　净化水质
reduce pollution　减少污染
improve the environment　改善环境

sentences.en: Plum blossom tops the ten most famous flowers of China, originated in south China and has a planting history of more than 3,000 years.
sentences.zh: 梅花位居中国十大名花之首，源于中国南方，已有三千多年的栽培和种植历史。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】并列谓语：S:Plum blossom V1:tops O1:the ten most famous flowers of China；V2:originated A:in south China；V3:has O3:a planting history of more than 3,000 years。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；三个并列谓语共用主语。【关键连接词】三个谓语并列：tops / originated / has。【翻译要点】「位居……之首」tops the ten most famous flowers of China / ranks first among；「源于」originated in；「三千多年的栽培和种植历史」a cultivation and planting history of more than 3,000 years。【易错点】「十大名花」the ten most famous flowers of China；「栽培和种植」cultivation and planting 并列避免重复。【断句版】Plum blossom tops the ten most famous flowers of China, | originated in south China | and has a planting history of more than 3,000 years.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Plum blossom [并列谓语1 V:tops O:the ten most famous flowers of China] [并列谓语2 V:originated A:in south China] [并列谓语3 V:has O:a planting history of more than 3,000 years]]]
phrases: top the ten most famous flowers　位居十大名花之首
originate in　源于
south China　中国南方
a planting history of… years　……年的种植历史

sentences.en: The Qinghai-Tibet Railway has greatly shortened the travel time between inland China and Tibet.
sentences.zh: 青藏铁路大大缩短了中国内地与西藏之间的旅行时间。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:The Qinghai-Tibet Railway V:has greatly shortened O:the travel time A:between inland China and Tibet。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；between inland China and Tibet 介词短语作后置定语修饰 travel time。【关键连接词】between…and… 表两者之间。【翻译要点】「大大缩短了」has greatly shortened（完成时表已产生影响）；「中国内地」inland China；「西藏」Tibet；「旅行时间」travel time。【易错点】「青藏铁路」the Qinghai-Tibet Railway 加 the；「缩短」shorten 不用 reduce；「内地」inland China 不用 mainland China。【断句版】The Qinghai-Tibet Railway has greatly shortened | the travel time | between inland China and Tibet.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Qinghai-Tibet Railway V:has greatly shortened O:the travel time [定语 between inland China and Tibet]]]
phrases: the Qinghai-Tibet Railway　青藏铁路
shorten the travel time　缩短旅行时间
inland China　中国内地
Tibet　西藏

sentences.en: The airport has 82 boarding gates, but it takes passengers less than 8 minutes to walk from one gate to another.
sentences.zh: 机场设有82个登机口，但乘客从一个登机口步行到另一个登机口只需不到8分钟。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】并列复合句：分句1 S:The airport V:has O:82 boarding gates；分句2 S:it V:takes O:passengers C:less than 8 minutes [to walk from one gate to another]。【从句类型与嵌套】分句2用 it takes sb. time to do sth. 形式主语句型，真正主语为 to walk…；but 连接并列分句。【关键连接词】but 表转折；it 为形式主语。【翻译要点】「设有82个登机口」has 82 boarding gates；「从一个登机口步行到另一个」walk from one gate to another；「只需不到8分钟」it takes less than 8 minutes，用形式主语 it。【易错点】it takes sb. some time to do sth. 结构中 to do 为真正主语；「登机口」boarding gate / gate。【断句版】The airport has 82 boarding gates, | but it takes passengers less than 8 minutes | to walk from one gate to another.
sentences.cut: [[分句1 S:The airport V:has O:82 boarding gates [连词 but] [分句2 S:it(形式主语) V:takes O:passengers C:less than 8 minutes [真正主语 to walk from one gate to another]]]]
phrases: boarding gate　登机口
it takes sb. some time to do sth.　某人花多长时间做某事
less than 8 minutes　不到8分钟
from one gate to another　从一个登机口到另一个

sentences.en: Hainan is China's second largest island after Taiwan, a province located at the southernmost tip of China.
sentences.zh: 海南是仅次于台湾的中国第二大岛，是位于中国最南端的省份。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:Hainan V:is C:China's second largest island [after Taiwan]，后接同位语 a province located at the southernmost tip of China。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；located at… 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 province。【关键连接词】after 表「仅次于」；located 为过去分词表被动。【翻译要点】「仅次于台湾的中国第二大岛」China's second largest island after Taiwan；「位于中国最南端」located at the southernmost tip of China。【易错点】「第二大」the second largest（加 the）；「仅次于」after / next to；「最南端」southernmost tip。【断句版】Hainan is China's second largest island after Taiwan, | a province located at the southernmost tip of China.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Hainan V:is C:China's second largest island [定语 after Taiwan], [同位语 a province [定语 located at the southernmost tip of China]]]]
phrases: the second largest island　第二大岛
after Taiwan　仅次于台湾
located at the southernmost tip of　位于……最南端

sentences.en: In September 1952, the site was restored and a memorial hall was established.
sentences.zh: 1952年9月，会址得到修复，并建立了纪念馆。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】并列被动句：分句1 S:the site V:was restored；分句2 S:a memorial hall V:was established。共用时间状语 In September 1952。【从句类型与嵌套】无从句；and 连接两个并列被动分句。【关键连接词】and 连接并列分句；被动语态 was restored / was established。【翻译要点】中文「得到修复」用被动 was restored（中文主动形式表被动含义，英文需被动）；「建立了纪念馆」a memorial hall was established（无主语句译被动）。【易错点】中文「得到/被」等被动标志译英文必须用被动语态；「纪念馆」memorial hall。【断句版】In September 1952, | the site was restored | and a memorial hall was established.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In September 1952, [分句1 S:the site V:was restored] [连词 and] [分句2 S:a memorial hall V:was established]]]
phrases: be restored　得到修复
establish a memorial hall　建立纪念馆
the site　（会议）会址

sentences.en: It is a miracle created by nature, and is unique in the world.
sentences.zh: 这是大自然创造的一个奇迹，在世界上也是绝无仅有的。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】并列句：分句1 S:It V:is C:a miracle [created by nature]；分句2 S:it V:is C:unique A:in the world。共用主语 It。【从句类型与嵌套】created by nature 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 miracle；无从句。【关键连接词】and 连接并列分句；created 为过去分词表被动。【翻译要点】「大自然创造的」created by nature 作后置定语；「绝无仅有」unique / unparalleled；「在世界上」in the world。【易错点】「奇迹」miracle / wonder；「绝无仅有」unique 不用 only one；过去分词 created 表被动（奇迹被自然创造）。【断句版】It is a miracle created by nature, | and is unique in the world.
sentences.cut: [[分句1 S:It V:is C:a miracle [定语 created by nature] [连词 and] [分句2 S:it V:is C:unique A:in the world]]]
phrases: a miracle created by nature　大自然创造的奇迹
unique in the world　在世界上绝无仅有
the Loess Plateau　黄土高原

sentences.en: In addition, some cities have also established senior activity centers in communities, providing a place for seniors to socialize and exercise.
sentences.zh: 此外，一些城市还在社区设立了老年人活动中心，为老年人提供社交和锻炼的场所。
sentences.parse: 【句子主干】主句 S:some cities V:have also established O:senior activity centers A:in communities，后接现在分词 providing… 作伴随状语。【从句类型与嵌套】现在分词短语 providing a place for… 作伴随/目的状语；无从句。【关键连接词】In addition 表「此外」；现在分词 providing 表伴随。【翻译要点】「此外」In addition / Furthermore；「设立老年人活动中心」established senior activity centers；「为老年人提供社交和锻炼的场所」providing a place for seniors to socialize and exercise。【易错点】「老年人活动中心」senior activity centers；「社交」socialize（动词）；「锻炼」exercise。【断句版】In addition, some cities have also established senior activity centers in communities, | providing a place for seniors to socialize and exercise.
sentences.cut: [[状语 In addition, [主句 S:some cities V:have also established O:senior activity centers A:in communities [伴随状语 providing a place for seniors to socialize and exercise]]]]
phrases: in addition　此外
establish senior activity centers　设立老年人活动中心
socialize　社交
exercise　锻炼

sentences.en: In 2014, the per-capita GDP of Shenzhen has been 25,000 dollars, the level of some developed countries in the world.
sentences.zh: 到2014年，深圳的人均GDP已达25,000美元，相当于世界上一些发达国家的水平。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「相当于……水平」译为同位语 the level of...，避免再用一个谓语动词；per-capita GDP 人均国内生产总值。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Shenzhen(S) has been(V) 25,000 dollars(O/per-capita GDP)，主谓结构，In 2014 为时间状语。【2. 从句/短语层次】句首 In 2014 为时间状语；句尾 the level of some developed countries in the world 为同位语，补充说明 25,000 dollars 所达到的水平。层次：[时间状语]→主句→[同位语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】本句无从句引导词；用名词短语 the level of... 作同位语替代 which has reached... 的定语从句。【4. 翻译要点】中文「相当于世界上一些发达国家的水平」为补充说明，英译不另起谓语，而用名词同位语 the level of some developed countries in the world 紧随数字之后，使句子紧凑。【5. 易错点】① per-capita = 人均的，不可写作 per capital；② GDP 前用 the；③ 同位语 the level of 不可误作谓语，否则一句双谓。【断句版】In 2014, | the per-capita GDP of Shenzhen has been 25,000 dollars, | the level of some developed countries in the world.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 In 2014] [主句 S:the per-capita GDP of Shenzhen V:has been C:25,000 dollars] [同位语 the level of some developed countries in the world]]
phrases: per-capita GDP　人均国内生产总值
the level of　相当于……的水平
developed countries　发达国家
reform and opening-up　改革开放

sentences.en: Among them, the most famous one is the Monkey King, whose stories of fighting against all sorts of evils are extremely well-known among Chinese children.
sentences.zh: 其中最著名的是孙悟空，他与各种各样妖魔作斗争的故事几乎为每个中国孩子所熟知。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「他与妖魔作斗争的故事」用 whose 引导定语从句，whose 指代 Monkey King；be well-known with/among sb 为某人所熟知。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】the most famous one(S) is(V) the Monkey King(C)，主系表；Among them 为范围状语。【2. 从句/短语层次】句尾 whose stories of fighting against all sorts of evils are extremely well-known among Chinese children 为 whose 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰 Monkey King；其中 of fighting against all sorts of evils 为介词短语作后置定语修饰 stories。层次：[范围状语]→主句主系表→[定语从句 whose + S:stories + V:are well-known]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】whose 关系代词所有格，在定语从句中作定语修饰 stories，指代「孙悟空的」；Among them 中 them 指代前文出现的各种人物和动物形象。【4. 翻译要点】中文「其中最著名的是孙悟空，他与各种各样妖魔作斗争的故事几乎为每个中国孩子所熟知」为两个并列分句，英译后句用 whose 定语从句「嵌入」主句，避免重复 He...stories。【5. 易错点】① whose 后须接名词（stories），不可单独作主语；② be well-known among 后接人群，勿误用 to；③ evils 此处指「妖魔/邪恶势力」，非抽象「罪恶」。【断句版】Among them, | the most famous one is the Monkey King, | whose stories of fighting against all sorts of evils | are extremely well-known among Chinese children.
sentences.cut: [[范围状语 Among them] [主句 S:the most famous one V:is C:the Monkey King] [非限制性定语从句 whose [介词短语 of fighting against all sorts of evils] [修饰 stories] S:stories V:are extremely well-known A:among Chinese children]]
phrases: the Monkey King　孙悟空
fight against all sorts of evils　与各种妖魔作斗争
be well-known among sb　为某人所熟知
folk tales and myths　民间故事与神话

sentences.en: In the book, there are about 30 main figures and over 400 minor ones, each of whom is depicted vividly with distinctive personalities.
sentences.zh: 书中有大约30个主要人物和400多个次要人物，每个人物都刻画得栩栩如生，具有鲜明的个性。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「每个人物都……」用 each of whom 引导定语从句，承接先行词 30 main figures and over 400 minor ones；被动 is depicted。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】there were(V) about 30 main figures and over 400 minor ones(S)，there be 存在句，In the book 为地点状语。【2. 从句/短语层次】句尾 each of whom is depicted vividly with distinctive personalities 为「代词+of+关系代词 whom」引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰前面的人物；with distinctive personalities 为介词短语作方式/伴随状语。层次：[地点状语]→there be 主句→[定语从句 each of whom + S省略 + V:is depicted + A:with...]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】each of whom 为「不定代词+of which/whom」结构，whom 指代人（figures），each 强调「每一个」；is depicted 为一般过去时被动。【4. 翻译要点】中文「每个人物都刻画得栩栩如生，具有鲜明的个性」独立成句，英译用 each of whom 定语从句把「每个人物」挂到主句的人物上，避免另起一句 They were all depicted...。【5. 易错点】① 先行词为人用 whom 不用 which；② each of whom 后谓语用单数 is；③ vividly 副词修饰 depicted。【断句版】In the book, | there are about 30 main figures | and over 400 minor ones, | each of whom is depicted vividly | with distinctive personalities.
sentences.cut: [[地点状语 In the book] [there be 主句 V:there are S:about 30 main figures and over 400 minor ones] [非限制性定语从句 each of whom S:(each) V:is depicted vividly [伴随状语 with distinctive personalities]]]
phrases: main/ minor figures　主要/次要人物
each of whom　其中每一个（人）
be depicted vividly　被刻画得栩栩如生
distinctive personalities　鲜明的个性

sentences.en: It is no exaggeration to say that almost every single Chinese is familiar with some main characters in the book.
sentences.zh: 毫不夸张地说，几乎每个中国人都熟悉这部小说中的一些主要人物。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「毫不夸张地说」用 It is no exaggeration to say that... 形式主语句型，it 为形式主语，that 从句为真正主语。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】It(形式主语) is(V) no exaggeration(C)，真正主语为其后的 that 从句。【2. 从句/短语层次】that almost every single Chinese is familiar with some main characters in the book 为 that 引导的主语从句（真正主语）；其中 almost every single Chinese 为主语，is familiar with 为谓语短语，some main characters 为宾语，in the book 为后置定语。层次：[形式主语 It + V + C]→[that 主语从句]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】It 为形式主语，无实义；that 引导主语从句不可省略；is familiar with 为固定搭配「熟悉」。【4. 翻译要点】中文「毫不夸张地说」为评注性状语，英译套用 It is no exaggeration to say that... 固定句型，把「说」的内容装进 that 从句，符合英文「先结论后事实」的语序。【5. 易错点】① 真正主语是 that 从句，不可把 it 译成「它」；② be familiar with 后接熟悉的对象；③ single 在此加强语气「每一个」。【断句版】It is no exaggeration to say | that almost every single Chinese | is familiar with some main characters | in the book.
sentences.cut: [[形式主语句型 It(形式主语) V:is C:no exaggeration [真正主语 to say [宾语从句 that almost every single Chinese S:almost every single Chinese V:is familiar with O:some main characters [后置定语 in the book]]]]]
phrases: It is no exaggeration to say that　毫不夸张地说
be familiar with　熟悉
main characters　主要人物
the book = Water Margin　《水浒传》

sentences.src: 六级·2020.12·翻译句·大兴机场句1
sentences.en: Beijing Daxing International Airport, which is located 46 kilometers south of Tian'anmen Square, was put into operation on September 30, 2019.
sentences.zh: 北京大兴国际机场位于天安门广场以南46公里处，于2019年9月30日投入运营。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「位于天安门广场以南46公里处」用 which 引导非限制性定语从句补充机场位置；be put into operation 投入运营。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Beijing Daxing International Airport(S) was put into operation(V 被动) on September 30, 2019(A 时间)。【2. 从句/短语层次】主语后插入 which is located 46 kilometers south of Tian'anmen Square 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，补充说明机场位置；on September 30, 2019 为时间状语。层次：主句[S(主语+定语从句插入)]→[被动谓语+时间状语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】which 关系代词指代 Beijing Daxing International Airport，在从句中作主语；be located in/at 位于。【4. 翻译要点】中文主语「北京大兴国际机场」后接「位于……」再接「于……投入运营」，英译把位置信息处理为 which 非限制性定语从句插在主语与谓语之间，谓语 was put into operation 收尾。【5. 易错点】① be put into operation 被动，不可说 put into operation 主动（物作主语须被动）；② 定语从句前后用逗号隔开；③ 日期介词 on。【断句版】Beijing Daxing International Airport, | which is located 46 kilometers south of Tian'anmen Square, | was put into operation | on September 30, 2019.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Beijing Daxing International Airport [非限制性定语从句 which S:which V:is located A:46 kilometers south of Tian'anmen Square] V:was put into operation A:on September 30, 2019]]
phrases: be located 46 kilometers south of　位于……以南46公里处
Tian'anmen Square　天安门广场
be put into operation　投入运营
Daxing International Airport　大兴国际机场

sentences.src: 六级·2020.12·翻译句·港珠澳大桥句1
sentences.en: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge, with a total length of 55 kilometers, is an extraordinary engineering feat in China.
sentences.zh: 港珠澳大桥全长55公里，是中国一项非凡的工程壮举。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「全长55公里」用 with a total length of 55 kilometers 介词短语作插入/伴随状语，置于主语之后、表语之前。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge(S) is(V) an extraordinary engineering feat(C) in China。主系表。【2. 从句/短语层次】主语后 with a total length of 55 kilometers 为 with 复合结构作插入状语，补充大桥长度；句尾 in China 为范围状语。层次：[主语]→[with 长度状语]→[主系表+范围状语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】with 介词引出附带信息「全长……」；无从句引导词。【4. 翻译要点】中文「港珠澳大桥全长55公里，是中国一项非凡的工程壮举」中「全长55公里」为补充说明，英译用 with a total length of... 短语插在主语后，主干「是工程壮举」用主系表收尾，避免把「全长」另作谓语。【5. 易错点】① with 后接名词短语不接句子；② extraordinary = 非凡的，勿误写为 extreme；③ engineering feat 工程壮举，feat 不用 defeat。【断句版】The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge, | with a total length of 55 kilometers, | is an extraordinary engineering feat | in China.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge [插入状语 with a total length of 55 kilometers] V:is C:an extraordinary engineering feat [范围状语 in China]]]
phrases: with a total length of 55 kilometers　全长55公里
extraordinary engineering feat　非凡的工程壮举
the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge　港珠澳大桥
engineering feat　工程壮举

sentences.en: With the strong support of the central government and people across the country, Hainan will be built into the largest free trade pilot zone in China.
sentences.zh: 在中央政府和全国人民的大力支持下，海南将建成中国最大的自由贸易试验区。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「在……支持下」用 With the strong support of... 介词短语前置作状语；「将被建成」用将来时被动 will be built into。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Hainan(S) will be built(V 将来时被动) into the largest free trade pilot zone in China(C/主语补足语)。【2. 从句/短语层次】句首 With the strong support of the central government and people across the country 为 With 复合结构作条件/背景状语；into the largest free trade pilot zone 为介词短语作主语补足语。层次：[With 状语]→主句[S+被动谓语+主补]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】With 介词引出「在……支持下」；and 并列 the central government 与 people across the country。【4. 翻译要点】中文「在……大力支持下，海南将建成……」为条件+主句，英译把「在……支持下」译为 With 短语前置；「海南将建成」为被动含义（海南被建设成），用 will be built into。【5. 易错点】① build 此处须被动 is built；② free trade pilot zone 自由贸易试验区，pilot 不可漏；③ support 为不可数，不用 supports。【断句版】With the strong support of the central government | and people across the country, | Hainan will be built into | the largest free trade pilot zone in China.
sentences.cut: [[状语 With the strong support of [并列 the central government and people across the country]] [主句 S:Hainan V:will be built C:into the largest free trade pilot zone in China]]
phrases: with the strong support of　在……的大力支持下
the central government　中央政府
free trade pilot zone　自由贸易试验区
build ... into　把……建设成

sentences.en: With the largest number of revolutionary sites, which are distributed most widely and have the highest level in the country, Yan'an is a national base for patriotism, revolutionary tradition and the Yan'an spirit education.
sentences.zh: 延安的革命旧址在全国数量最大、分布最广、级别最高，是全国爱国主义、革命传统和延安精神教育基地。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「延安的革命旧址全国数量最大、分布最广、级别最高」用 With 短语+定语从句译出；「教育基地」译为主句表语。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Yan'an(S) is(V) a national base(C) for patriotism, revolutionary tradition and the Yan'an spirit education。主系表。【2. 从句/短语层次】句首 With the largest number of revolutionary sites 为 With 复合结构作伴随/原因状语，后接 which are distributed most widely and have the highest level in the country 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰 revolutionary sites。层次：[With 状语+定语从句]→主句主系表。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】With 引出「拥有……」；which 指代 revolutionary sites，在从句中作主语，从句含并列谓语 are distributed... and have...。【4. 翻译要点】中文先描述「旧址数量最大、分布最广、级别最高」再下判断「是教育基地」，英译用 With 短语把前三句描述打包前置，主句只保留「是教育基地」，语序由「描述→判断」变为「伴随状语→判断」。【5. 易错点】① be distributed 被动「被分布」；② which 指代 sites 为复数，从句谓语用 are；③ patriotism 爱国主义，不可数。【断句版】With the largest number of revolutionary sites, | which are distributed most widely | and have the highest level in the country, | Yan'an is a national base | for patriotism, revolutionary tradition and the Yan'an spirit education.
sentences.cut: [[状语 With the largest number of revolutionary sites [非限制性定语从句 which S:which(=sites) V1:are distributed most widely V2:and have the highest level in the country]] [主句 S:Yan'an V:is C:a national base [后置定语 for patriotism, revolutionary tradition and the Yan'an spirit education]]]
phrases: revolutionary sites　革命旧址
be distributed most widely　分布最广
patriotism education　爱国主义教育
the Yan'an spirit　延安精神

sentences.en: The Zhaozhou Bridge, which was built in the Sui Dynasty around 605 AD, is 50.82 metres long and 9.6 metres wide, with a span of 37.37 metres.
sentences.zh: 赵州桥建于隋朝，公元605年左右，长50.82米，宽9.6米，跨度37.37米。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「建于隋朝」用 which was built in the Sui Dynasty 非限制性定语从句；长宽跨度用主系表+with a span of 短语。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】The Zhaozhou Bridge(S) is(V) 50.82 metres long and 9.6 metres wide(C)，主系表，表语为并列形容词短语。【2. 从句/短语层次】主语后 which was built in the Sui Dynasty around 605 AD 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，说明建造时间；句尾 with a span of 37.37 metres 为 with 复合结构补充跨度。层次：[主语+定语从句]→主句主系表(长宽)→[with 跨度状语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】which 指代 Zhaozhou Bridge，在从句中作主语（被动 was built）；and 并列 long 与 wide。【4. 翻译要点】中文连续罗列「长50.82米、宽9.6米、跨度37.37米」，英译主干用「主语 + is + 长 and 宽」，跨度另用 with a span of 短语收尾，避免三个并列从句堆砌。【5. 易错点】① was built 被动；② metre 英式拼写，数字后用复数 metres；③ span 跨度，勿误作 spin。【断句版】The Zhaozhou Bridge, | which was built in the Sui Dynasty around 605 AD, | is 50.82 metres long | and 9.6 metres wide, | with a span of 37.37 metres.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The Zhaozhou Bridge [非限制性定语从句 which S:which V:was built A:in the Sui Dynasty around 605 AD] V:is C:50.82 metres long and 9.6 metres wide [伴随状语 with a span of 37.37 metres]]]
phrases: the Sui Dynasty　隋朝
around 605 AD　约公元605年
a span of 37.37 metres　跨度37.37米
multi-arch stone bridge　多拱石桥

sentences.src: 六级·2022.12·翻译句·黄土高原句2
sentences.en: Most of the plateau is covered with 50-80 metres thick loess, which has the most concentrated distribution and the greatest thickness in the world.
sentences.zh: 黄土高原绝大部分覆盖着50至80米厚的黄土，是世界上黄土分布最集中、覆盖厚度最大的区域。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「是世界上……最集中、最厚的区域」用 which 引导非限制性定语从句，which 指代整个前面的覆盖情况。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Most of the plateau(S) is covered(V 被动) with 50-80 metres thick loess(A)。【2. 从句/短语层次】句尾 which has the most concentrated distribution and the greatest thickness in the world 为 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰前面整个句子所述情况；从句含并列宾语 the most concentrated distribution and the greatest thickness。层次：主句[S+被动谓语+状语]→[which 定语从句(并列宾语)]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】which 关系代词，指代前文「黄土覆盖」这一情况（也可看作修饰 loess）；and 并列 distribution 与 thickness。【4. 翻译要点】中文「是世界上黄土分布最集中、覆盖厚度最大的区域」为补充评价，英译用 which 定语从句挂在主句后，「分布最集中、厚度最大」译为 the most concentrated distribution and the greatest thickness。【5. 易错点】① be covered with 被动；② loess 黄土不可数；③ 最高级前加 the。【断句版】Most of the plateau is covered | with 50-80 metres thick loess, | which has the most concentrated distribution | and the greatest thickness in the world.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Most of the plateau V:is covered A:with 50-80 metres thick loess] [非限制性定语从句 which S:which V:has O:the most concentrated distribution and the greatest thickness [范围状语 in the world]]]
phrases: be covered with　覆盖着
50-80 metres thick loess　50至80米厚的黄土
the most concentrated distribution　最集中的分布
the greatest thickness　最大厚度

sentences.src: 六级·2023.6·翻译句·公共设施句1
sentences.en: With the rapid development of China's economy and the steady improvement in people's living standards, urban residents have increasingly higher requirements for the environment and quality of life.
sentences.zh: 随着中国经济的持续发展和人民生活水平的稳步提高，城市居民对环境和生活质量的要求越来越高。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「随着……」用 With + 名词复合结构前置作状语；「要求越来越高」译为主句主谓宾 have higher requirements for。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】urban residents(S) have(V) increasingly higher requirements(O) for the environment and quality of life(A)。【2. 从句/短语层次】句首 With the rapid development of China's economy and the steady improvement in people's living standards 为 With 复合结构作背景状语，其中 and 并列 the rapid development 与 the steady improvement；for the environment and quality of life 为后置定语修饰 requirements。层次：[With 状语(and并列)]→主句[S+V+O+后置定语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】With 引出「随着」；and 并列两个名词短语 development 与 improvement。【4. 翻译要点】中文「随着经济发展和生活水平提高，居民要求越来越高」，英译把「随着……」译为 With 名词短语前置，「要求越来越高」用 have increasingly higher requirements for 译出，避免直译 more and more。【5. 易错点】① With 后接名词不接句子；② improvement in 后接领域；③ increasingly higher 比较级叠加。【断句版】With the rapid development of China's economy | and the steady improvement in people's living standards, | urban residents have increasingly higher requirements | for the environment and quality of life.
sentences.cut: [[状语 With [并列 the rapid development of China's economy and the steady improvement in people's living standards]] [主句 S:urban residents V:have O:increasingly higher requirements [后置定语 for the environment and quality of life]]]
phrases: with the rapid development of　随着……的快速发展
the steady improvement in living standards　生活水平的稳步提高
have higher requirements for　对……有更高要求
quality of life　生活质量

sentences.en: With the continuous increase in government and social investment in elderly-care services, elderly-care facilities will be continuously upgraded and service quality further improved.
sentences.zh: 随着政府和社会对养老服务投入的持续增加，养老设施将不断升级，服务质量将进一步提高。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「随着……投入持续增加」用 With + 名词短语前置；「设施升级、质量提高」用两个将来时被动并列。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】两个并列分句：elderly-care facilities(S1) will be upgraded(V1) and service quality(S2) will be further improved(V2)，均为将来时被动。【2. 从句/短语层次】句首 With the continuous increase in government and social investment in elderly-care services 为 With 复合结构作时间/条件状语；government and social 并列修饰 investment。层次：[With 状语]→并列分句1→并列连词 and→分句2。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】With 引出「随着」；and 连接两个被动分句；further 副词修饰 improved。【4. 翻译要点】中文「养老设施将不断升级，服务质量将进一步提高」为两个并列被动分句，英译保持 will be upgraded and (will be) further improved，后一分句省略重复的 will be。【5. 易错点】① upgrade/improve 均用被动；② investment in 后接领域；③ continuous increase 名词短语，不写 increase。【断句版】With the continuous increase in government and social investment in elderly-care services, | elderly-care facilities will be continuously upgraded | and service quality further improved.
sentences.cut: [[状语 With the continuous increase in [并列 government and social] investment in elderly-care services] [并列分句1 S:elderly-care facilities V:will be continuously upgraded] [并列连词 and] [分句2 S:service quality V:(will be) further improved]]
phrases: with the continuous increase in　随着……的持续增加
investment in elderly-care services　对养老服务的投入
elderly-care facilities　养老设施
upgrade / improve　升级/提高

sentences.en: However, nowadays fans are regarded less as tools for relieving heat than as works of art for people to appreciate.
sentences.zh: 然而如今，扇子与其说是消暑纳凉的工具，不如说是供人欣赏的艺术品。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「与其说……不如说……」用 less as... than as... 比较结构；be regarded as 被视作。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】fans(S) are regarded(V 被动) less as tools for relieving heat than as works of art for people to appreciate。【2. 从句/短语层次】主干为 less as A than as B 比较结构；for relieving heat 与 for people to appreciate 均为介词短语作后置定语；to appreciate 为不定式修饰 works of art。层次：主句[S+被动谓语]→[比较结构 less as...than as...（各带后置定语）]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】less...than... 为比较连词结构，「与其说……不如说……」；regard sth as sth 把某物视作。【4. 翻译要点】中文「与其说是消暑纳凉的工具，不如说是供人欣赏的艺术品」，英译套用 be regarded less as A than as B，两个 as 后均接名词短语，平行对称。【5. 易错点】① less as...than as... 两个 as 不可省；② tools for relieving heat 中 for 后接动名词；③ works of art 艺术品，用复数。【断句版】However, nowadays fans are regarded | less as tools for relieving heat | than as works of art | for people to appreciate.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:fans V:are regarded [比较结构 less as C1:tools for relieving heat than as C2:works of art [后置定语 for people to appreciate]]]]
phrases: be regarded as　被视作
less as ... than as ...　与其说……不如说……
tools for relieving heat　消暑纳凉的工具
works of art　艺术品

sentences.en: The BeiDou system has been widely applied in public transportation, disaster rescue, weather forecasting, public safety and many other fields.
sentences.zh: 北斗系统已被广泛应用于公共交通、灾害救援、天气预报、公共安全等诸多领域。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「被广泛应用于」用现在完成时被动 has been widely applied in；后接并列领域名词作介词宾语。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】The BeiDou system(S) has been widely applied(V 现在完成时被动) in public transportation, disaster rescue, weather forecasting, public safety and many other fields(A 状语)。【2. 从句/短语层次】句末 in 介词短语中含 4 个并列名词短语作宾语：public transportation / disaster rescue / weather forecasting / public safety，再加 and many other fields 概括收束。层次：主句[S+完成被动谓语]→[in + 并列领域宾语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】无从句；and 连接最后一个并列项 many other fields；be applied in 应用于。【4. 翻译要点】中文「广泛运用于公共交通、灾害救援、天气预报、公共安全等诸多领域」，英译用 be widely applied in + 名词并列列举，最后用 and many other fields 收束，对应「等诸多领域」。【5. 易错点】① has been applied 现在完成时被动；② weather forecasting 天气预报用动名词；③ 列举最后一项前加 and。【断句版】The BeiDou system has been widely applied | in public transportation, | disaster rescue, | weather forecasting, | public safety | and many other fields.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:The BeiDou system V:has been widely applied [状语 in [并列宾语 public transportation, disaster rescue, weather forecasting, public safety and many other fields]]]]
phrases: be widely applied in　被广泛应用于
public transportation　公共交通
disaster rescue　灾害救援
weather forecasting　天气预报

sentences.src: 六级·2025.6·翻译句·天宫空间站句3
sentences.en: Tiangong's research outcomes have found extensive application in China, yielding remarkable economic benefits.
sentences.zh: 天宫空间站的研究成果在我国得到了广泛应用，产生了显著的经济效益。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「产生了显著经济效益」用现在分词 yielding... 作结果状语，表主句动作带来的自然结果。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】Tiangong's research outcomes(S) have found(V) extensive application(O) in China(A)。【2. 从句/短语层次】句尾 yielding remarkable economic benefits 为现在分词短语作结果状语，表示「成果广泛应用」带来的自然结果；in China 为范围状语。层次：主句[S+V+O+范围状语]→[现在分词结果状语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】现在分词 yielding 引导结果状语，表顺承结果；find application 为固定搭配「得到应用」。【4. 翻译要点】中文「研究成果得到广泛应用，产生了显著经济效益」两个分句，英译把后句「产生……」处理为现在分词 yielding 结果状语，使两句化为「主句+伴随结果」，逻辑更紧。【5. 易错点】① find application 不用被动；② yielding 现在分词表主动结果；③ economic benefits 经济效益用复数。【断句版】Tiangong's research outcomes have found extensive application in China, | yielding remarkable economic benefits.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Tiangong's research outcomes V:have found O:extensive application [范围状语 in China] [现在分词结果状语 yielding remarkable economic benefits]]]
phrases: research outcomes　研究成果
find extensive application　得到广泛应用
yield economic benefits　产生经济效益
remarkable　显著的

sentences.src: 六级·2025.6·翻译句·冰雪经济句4
sentences.en: Nowadays, the once daunting ice and snow are attracting tourists from all directions, becoming a popular tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 如今，曾经令人畏惧的冰天雪地正吸引着四面八方的游客，成为一处备受欢迎的旅游胜地。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「成为……旅游胜地」用现在分词 becoming... 作结果/伴随状语；daunting 令人畏惧的。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】the once daunting ice and snow(S) are attracting(V) tourists(O) from all directions(A)。【2. 从句/短语层次】句尾 becoming a popular tourist destination 为现在分词短语作结果/伴随状语；from all directions 为后置定语修饰 tourists。层次：[时间状语 Nowadays]→主句[S+V+O+后置定语]→[现在分词状语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】现在分词 becoming 引导伴随/结果状语；once 副词「曾经」修饰 daunting。【4. 翻译要点】中文「冰天雪地正吸引着四面八方的游客，成为了深受欢迎的旅游胜地」，英译把「成为……」处理为现在分词 becoming 状语，与主句「吸引游客」并列递进。【5. 易错点】① ice and snow 作整体，谓语用单数 are attracting（此处按集合）；② daunting 令人畏惧的，勿误作 daunted（人感到畏惧）；③ tourist destination 旅游目的地。【断句版】Nowadays, | the once daunting ice and snow are attracting tourists from all directions, | becoming a popular tourist destination.
sentences.cut: [[时间状语 Nowadays] [主句 S:the once daunting ice and snow V:are attracting O:tourists [后置定语 from all directions] [现在分词伴随状语 becoming a popular tourist destination]]]
phrases: the once daunting ice and snow　曾经令人畏惧的冰天雪地
attract tourists from all directions　吸引四面八方的游客
a popular tourist destination　备受欢迎的旅游胜地
daunting　令人畏惧的

sentences.en: All sectors of society are actively building a culture of respect and care for the elderly, and providing convenient services for senior citizens has become a common practice.
sentences.zh: 社会各界都在积极营造尊敬和关爱老年人的氛围，为老年人提供便利服务已成为普遍做法。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：两个中文分句用 and 连接为并列复合句；后一分句主语为动名词短语 providing convenient services...。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】并列复合句：分句1 All sectors of society(S1) are actively building(V1) a culture of respect and care for the elderly(O1)；分句2 providing convenient services for senior citizens(S2,动名词短语) has become(V2) a common practice(C2)。【2. 从句/短语层次】分句1中 of respect and care for the elderly 为后置定语修饰 culture；分句2主语为动名词短语 providing convenient services for senior citizens。层次：分句1→并列连词 and→分句2(动名词主语+谓语+表语)。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】and 连接两个独立分句；动名词短语作主语时谓语用单数 has become。【4. 翻译要点】中文「社会各界营造……氛围，为老年人提供便利服务已成为普遍做法」两个分句，英译用 and 连接，后句「为老年人提供……」处理为动名词短语作主语 providing...has become...。【5. 易错点】① 动名词短语作主语谓语用单数；② sectors of society 社会各界；③ senior citizens 老年人的礼貌说法。【断句版】All sectors of society are actively building a culture of respect and care for the elderly, | and providing convenient services for senior citizens has become a common practice.
sentences.cut: [[分句1 S:All sectors of society V:are actively building O:a culture of respect and care for the elderly] [并列连词 and] [分句2 S:providing convenient services for senior citizens(动名词短语) V:has become C:a common practice]]
phrases: all sectors of society　社会各界
a culture of respect and care for the elderly　尊老爱老的氛围
provide convenient services for　为……提供便利服务
a common practice　普遍做法

sentences.en: The development of a conservation-oriented society has effectively driven the high-quality growth of China's economy.
sentences.zh: 节约型社会的建设，切实推动了中国经济的高质量发展。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「节约型社会的建设」作主语（名词短语）；「推动高质量发展」用 has effectively driven... 现在完成时。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】The development of a conservation-oriented society(S) has effectively driven(V) the high-quality growth of China's economy(O)。主谓宾。【2. 从句/短语层次】主语 The development of a conservation-oriented society 中 of 短语作后置定语；宾语 the high-quality growth of China's economy 中 of 短语作后置定语。层次：主语[名词+of后置定语]→谓语→宾语[名词+of后置定语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】无从句；conservation-oriented 为复合形容词「节约型的」；effectively 副词修饰 driven。【4. 翻译要点】中文「发展节约型社会已切实推动了中国经济的高质量发展」，英译把「发展节约型社会」名词化为 The development of a conservation-oriented society 作主语，避免再用动词开头。【5. 易错点】① conservation-oriented 复合形容词连字符；② drive growth 推动增长，不用 push；③ high-quality growth 高质量发展。【断句版】The development of a conservation-oriented society | has effectively driven | the high-quality growth of China's economy.
sentences.cut: [[主语 S:The development of a conservation-oriented society] [谓语 V:has effectively driven] [宾语 O:the high-quality growth of China's economy]]
phrases: a conservation-oriented society　节约型社会
effectively drive　切实推动
high-quality growth　高质量发展
the Clean Plate Campaign　光盘行动

sentences.src: 六级·2026.6·翻译句·科技医疗句3
sentences.en: AI-assisted diagnostic systems help doctors detect early symptoms in patients, thereby improving diagnostic accuracy.
sentences.zh: 人工智能辅助诊断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，从而提高诊断的准确率。
sentences.note: 翻译要点：「从而提高……」用现在分词 thereby improving... 作结果状语；AI-assisted 复合形容词作定语。
sentences.parse: 【1. 句子主干】AI-assisted diagnostic systems(S) help(V) doctors(O) detect early symptoms in patients(O/C 宾语补足语)。help sb do sth 结构。【2. 从句/短语层次】句尾 thereby improving diagnostic accuracy 为现在分词短语作结果状语，thereby 加强因果；in patients 为后置定语修饰 early symptoms。层次：主句[S+help+宾语+宾补]→[thereby+现在分词结果状语]。【3. 关键连接词/引导词】thereby + 现在分词表「从而」；help sb (to) do sth 不定式省略 to。【4. 翻译要点】中文「系统帮助医生识别早期症状，从而提高诊断准确率」，英译后句用 thereby improving 现在分词结果状语，对应「从而」，使两句化为「主句+结果」。【5. 易错点】① help sb (to) do 不带 to；② AI-assisted 复合形容词连字符；③ diagnostic accuracy 诊断准确率。【断句版】AI-assisted diagnostic systems help doctors detect early symptoms in patients, | thereby improving diagnostic accuracy.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:AI-assisted diagnostic systems V:help O:doctor [宾语补足语 (to) detect early symptoms in patients] [结果状语 thereby improving diagnostic accuracy]]]
phrases: AI-assisted diagnostic systems　人工智能辅助诊断系统
detect early symptoms　识别早期症状
thereby improving diagnostic accuracy　从而提高诊断准确率
electronic health records　电子健康档案

sentences.en: Water Margin, one of the four classic novels in the Chinese literature, is based on the stories of the historical figures of Song Jiang and his partners, who rebelled against the feudal emperor. It has been popular among Chinese readers for hundreds of years.
sentences.zh: 《水浒传》(Water Margin)是中国文学四大经典小说之一。这部小说基于历史人物宋江及其伙伴反抗封建帝王的故事，数百年来一直深受中国读者的喜爱。
sentences.parse:
1.句子主干：第一句S=Water Margin，V=is based on，O=the stories of the historical figures...；第二句S=It，V=has been popular，状语=among Chinese readers for hundreds of years。2.从句层次：第一句主干→插入同位语one of the four classic novels...→其中嵌套定语从句who rebelled against the feudal emperor（修饰Song Jiang and his partners）。3.引导词：who引导定语从句，指代historical figures of Song Jiang and his partners，在从句中作主语；be based on“基于”。4.翻译要点：中文“是中国文学四大经典小说之一”处理为插入同位语，主干保留is based on the stories；“反抗封建帝王”用who引导定语从句；“数百年来一直深受喜爱”用现在完成时has been popular。5.易错点：“水浒传”Water Margin；“四大经典小说”the four classic novels；“宋江”Song Jiang（拼音）；“封建帝王”feudal emperor；“深受喜爱”be popular among。
【断句版】Water Margin, | one of the four classic novels in the Chinese literature, | is based on the stories of the historical figures of Song Jiang and his partners, | who rebelled against the feudal emperor. | It has been popular among Chinese readers for hundreds of years.
sentences.cut: [[句1 S:Water Margin V:is based on O:the stories of the historical figures of Song Jiang and his partners [同位语 one of the four classic novels in the Chinese literature] [定语从句 who S:who V:rebelled against O:the feudal emperor]]] [[句2 S:It V:has been popular [状语 among Chinese readers] [时间状语 for hundreds of years]]]
phrases: Water Margin　《水浒传》
one of the four classic novels　四大经典小说之一
be based on　基于
historical figure　历史人物
rebel against　反抗
feudal emperor　封建帝王
be popular among　深受……喜爱

sentences.en: Dream of the Red Chamber is a novel written by Cao Xueqin in the 18th century, who, based on his own hard life experience, tells the tragic love story between Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu.
sentences.zh: 《红楼梦》(Dream of the Red Chamber)是18世纪曹雪芹创作的一部小说。曹雪芹基于自己痛苦的个人经历，讲述了贾宝玉和林黛玉之间的悲剧性爱情故事。
sentences.parse:
1.句子主干：S=Dream of the Red Chamber，V=is，表语=a novel (written by Cao Xueqin...)；定语从句中S=who(=Cao Xueqin)，V=tells，O=the tragic love story。2.从句层次：主句→过去分词短语written by...作后置定语→其中嵌套非限制性定语从句who...tells...（修饰Cao Xueqin），从句内插入based on his own hard life experience作状语。3.引导词：who引导非限制性定语从句，就近指代Cao Xueqin；based on...为插入状语。4.翻译要点：中文两句都以“曹雪芹”为主语，英文合并为一句——第一句用过去分词written by，第二句用who引导定语从句，避免重复人名；“悲剧性爱情故事”tragic love story；“贾宝玉林黛玉”Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu（拼音）。5.易错点：“红楼梦”Dream of the Red Chamber；“曹雪芹”Cao Xueqin；“18世纪”in the 18th century；“基于”based on（作状语不用谓语）。
【断句版】Dream of the Red Chamber is a novel written by Cao Xueqin in the 18th century, | who, | based on his own hard life experience, | tells the tragic love story between Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Dream of the Red Chamber V:is [表语 a novel] [后置定语 written by Cao Xueqin in the 18th century] [非限制性定语从句 who S:who V:tells O:the tragic love story between Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu [插入状语 based on his own hard life experience]]]]
phrases: Dream of the Red Chamber　《红楼梦》
be written by　由……创作
Cao Xueqin　曹雪芹
based on　基于
tragic love story　悲剧性爱情故事
the 18th century　18世纪

sentences.en: Journey to the West is probably the most influential one among the four classic novels of Chinese literature and surely the best-known one on foreign lands.
sentences.zh: 《西游记》(Journey to the West)也许是中国文学四大经典小说中最具影响力的一部，当然也是在国外最广为人知的一部小说。
sentences.parse:
1.句子主干：S=Journey to the West，V=is，并列表语=the most influential one... and surely the best-known one...。2.从句层次：简单句，and连接两个并列表语，无嵌套从句。3.引导词/连接词：本句无从句引导词，并列连词and连接两个并列的最高级表语“最具影响力”“最广为人知”。4.翻译要点：中文“也许是……当然也是……”两个判断合并为一个主谓双表语句；“最具影响力”the most influential；“最广为人知”the best-known；“在国外”on foreign lands/abroad。5.易错点：“西游记”Journey to the West；“四大经典小说”the four classic novels；“影响力”influential（形容词）；最高级前加the。
【断句版】Journey to the West is probably the most influential one among the four classic novels of Chinese literature | and surely the best-known one on foreign lands.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Journey to the West V:is [并列表语 probably the most influential one among the four classic novels of Chinese literature] [并列连词 and] [并列表语 surely the best-known one on foreign lands]]]
phrases: Journey to the West　《西游记》
influential　有影响力的
the four classic novels　四大经典小说
the best-known　最广为人知的
on foreign lands　在国外

sentences.en: Peony, which features bright colour and graceful shape, symbolizes peace and prosperity and is thus well recognized as "king of flowers".
sentences.zh: 牡丹花色艳丽，形象高雅，象征着和平与繁荣，因而在中国被称为“花中之王”。
sentences.parse:
1.句子主干：S=Peony，并列谓语V1=symbolizes（O1=peace and prosperity）与V2=is recognized as（主语补足语=king of flowers）。2.从句层次：主句→非限制性定语从句which features bright colour and graceful shape（修饰Peony）。3.引导词：which引导非限制性定语从句，指代Peony；thus（因而）引出结果。4.翻译要点：中文“花色艳丽，形象高雅”两个四字短语处理为which引导的定语从句；“象征着和平与繁荣”与“被称为花中之王”为并列谓语；“花中之王”king of flowers。5.易错点：“牡丹”Peony；“花色艳丽”bright colour；“高雅”graceful/elegant；“繁荣”prosperity；“被称为”be recognized as/be known as。
【断句版】Peony, | which features bright colour and graceful shape, | symbolizes peace and prosperity | and is thus well recognized as "king of flowers".
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:Peony [非限制性定语从句 which S:which V:features O:bright colour and graceful shape] V1:symbolizes O1:peace and prosperity [并列谓语 and V2:is recognized [主语补足语 as "king of flowers"]] [结果状语 thus]]]
phrases: peony　牡丹
feature bright colour　花色艳丽
graceful shape　形象高雅
symbolize peace and prosperity　象征和平与繁荣
be recognized as　被称为
king of flowers　花中之王

sentences.en: Currently, China has not only the largest but also the fastest high-speed railway network in the world.
sentences.zh: 中国目前拥有世界上最大最快的高速铁路网。
sentences.parse:
1.句子主干：S=China，V=has，O=the largest...fastest high-speed railway network，状语=Currently / in the world。2.从句层次：简单句，not only...but also...并列两个最高级定语，无嵌套。3.引导词/连接词：本句无从句引导词，用并列结构not only...but also...并列the largest与the fastest，修饰同一宾语network。4.翻译要点：中文“最大最快”两个最高级英文用not only...but also...并列；“高速铁路网”high-speed railway network；“目前”currently置句首；“世界上”in the world后置。5.易错点：“高铁”high-speed railway；最高级largest/fastest前加the；network用单数。
【断句版】Currently, | China has not only the largest but also the fastest high-speed railway network in the world.
sentences.cut: [[主句 S:China V:has O:not only the largest but also the fastest high-speed railway network [时间状语 Currently] [范围状语 in the world]]]
phrases: currently　目前
high-speed railway network　高速铁路网
not only...but also...　不仅……而且……
the largest and fastest　最大最快
in the world　世界上

sentences.en: With the increase of urbanization and wealth, art and literature also thrived.
sentences.zh: 随着城市化和财富的增加，艺术和文学也繁荣起来。
sentences.parse:
1.句子主干：S=art and literature，V=thrived，句首With the increase of...作伴随状语。2.从句层次：主句→句首with介词短语作状语，无从句嵌套。3.引导词：With引导伴随状语“随着……”；also表“也”。4.翻译要点：中文“随着……的增加”译为With the increase of...（介词短语前置）；“城市化和财富”urbanization and wealth；“繁荣起来”thrived/flourished（不及物动词，用过去时）。5.易错点：“城市化”urbanization（不可数）；“繁荣”thrive（过去式thrived）；“随着”后接名词短语用with，不用as。
【断句版】With the increase of urbanization and wealth, | art and literature also thrived.
sentences.cut: [[伴随状语 With the increase of urbanization and wealth] [[主句 S:art and literature V:thrived [状语 also]]]]
phrases: with the increase of　随着……的增加
urbanization　城市化
wealth　财富
art and literature　艺术和文学
thrive　繁荣

tips.title: 六级概览：与四级的差异
tips.text: 六级总分710分，考试130分钟。题型与四级相同（写作15%+听力35%+阅读35%+翻译15%），但难度全面升级：听力语速升至150-170词/分钟（四级120-140），讲座讲话占20%；阅读题材更偏社会议论与科技伦理，长难句与推断题比例大增；写作要求辩证思考、论证深度；翻译段落信息密度更大。四级高分≠六级轻松通过，需针对性训练。

tips.title: 写作：观点-阐释-例证-小结
tips.text: 六级写作在结构清晰基础上要求论证深度：每个分论点采用“观点→阐释→例证→小结”微结构。先提出观点句，再用1-2句解释为什么，接着给具体例子（可适当虚构但需合理），最后一句小结回归观点。论据要具体，避免“社会发展、科技进步”类万能理由；可主动使用倒装句、强调句、虚拟语气、非谓语动词提升语言质感，但必须保证正确。

tips.title: 写作：衔接与地道表达
tips.text: 六级写作30分（实际为15%折算），阅卷看逻辑连贯性。用过渡句代替过渡词：写完优势段，下一段开头写“However, the convenience of AI comes with a hidden cost”——整句过渡比十个 However 都有用。用词要精准：避免 good、bad、important，改用 significant、crucial、detrimental、beneficial；注意同义词细微差别（change 与 transform 程度不同）。避免中式英语，如 learn knowledge 应为 acquire/gain knowledge。

tips.title: 听力：同义替换与隐蔽逻辑
tips.text: 六级听力80%的考点涉及同义替换，且多为复杂替换：词汇替换（important→vital/crucial、solve→address/resolve、increase→boost/elevate）、短语替换（take part in→participate in、put off→postpone、deal with→cope with）、句式替换（“The project is difficult”→“The project poses a great challenge”）。同时要抓隐蔽逻辑：虚拟语气、反问句、对比句式都可能暗示答案，不局限于 but/so。

tips.title: 听力：讲座与长对话专项
tips.text: 六级听力以讲话/报道/讲座为主，信息密度大。方法：①听前通过选项预判讲座主题与分论点；②听中抓结构信号词（First, Next, Finally, On the other hand, In conclusion）把握脉络；③用关键词网状记忆法——以主题为中心，记录分支观点与例证关键词，形成信息网络；④讲座前两句（开篇点题）与最后两句（总结建议）必考；⑤边听边记，用符号缩写（↑增长、→导致、e.g.举例）。

tips.title: 阅读：从定位到深度理解
tips.text: 六级仔细阅读不能停留在“定位到句即找答案”，要理解段落逻辑与作者态度：①区分事实与观点，注意 believe、argue、suggest、claim 等观点动词；②推断题基于已知信息合理推导，排除过度推断和与原文相悖的选项；③态度题积累 positive、negative、neutral、skeptical、supportive、critical 等词汇，通过形容词副词和转折词判断倾向；④六级推理题、态度题占比升至约50%，选项陷阱更隐蔽。

tips.title: 阅读：选词与长篇进阶
tips.text: 六级选词填空词汇达雅思难度，注意一词多性与熟词生义（如 subject 名词“主题/学科”、形容词“易受…的”、动词“使遭受”）；先标词性、按语法线索缩小范围，实在不会宁可跳过。长篇匹配：六级可能出现一段对多题或某段不对应任何题，且答案可能藏在段中（四级多在首尾句）；先读题干圈独特关键词，扫读时重点看大写、数字、特殊标点所在句。

tips.title: 翻译：长句重组与主被动转换
tips.text: 六级翻译中文段落信息密度大、句式复杂，需处理多个语义层次。方法：①先通读全句确定主干与时态；②把中文流水句（逗号连串）重组为英文主从复合句或并列句；③修饰成分用分词短语、介词短语、定语从句、同位语处理；④中文多主动、英文科技官方文体多被动；⑤文化专有项用规范译法或解释性翻译（四合院 courtyard house、共同富裕 common prosperity）。

tips.title: 翻译：主题语料库积累法
tips.text: 六级翻译想拿高分靠“分主题积累+真题复盘”：把历年真题翻译按文化、经济、社会、科技分类，会发现词汇反复出现（剪纸、一带一路、人工智能）。每类整理20个核心词与固定表达，考前反复看：文化类（儒家思想 Confucianism、京剧 Peking Opera、节气 solar terms）、经济类（共享经济 sharing economy、消费升级 consumption upgrading）、社会类（垃圾分类 waste sorting、人口老龄化 population aging）、科技类（人工智能 artificial intelligence、5G 技术 5G technology）。

tips.title: 词汇与长难句进阶
tips.text: 六级在四级4500词基础上需拓展1500-2000个核心学术词（hypothesis、perspective、sustainable），结合真题例句记忆搭配，并系统积累同义替换组（important→crucial→vital→paramount）。语法重点攻克从句嵌套、非谓语作状语、插入语：每天分析5-8个六级真题长难句，按“找主干→析修饰→理逻辑”三步拆解。听力词汇只需听到能反应含义，写作词汇要会拼写。

tips.title: 六级考场策略
tips.text: 六级考试15:00-17:25共130分钟。答题顺序与四级一致：写作→听力→仔细阅读→翻译→长篇匹配→选词填空。听力结束立即收答题卡1，必须边听边涂卡。六级阅读总字数1400-1600词，40分钟内完成；翻译预留5分钟检查。平时每周2-3次完整听力模考、每天限时阅读，培养考场节奏。
